#3. Microsoft suffer system outage affecting Outlook, Teams and Copilot, exec says there's "no indication this is the result of malicious or cyber activity"

📅 13 Nov 2026

Microsoft suffer system outage affecting Outlook, Teams and Copilot, exec says there's "no indication this is the result of malicious or cyber activity"

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/microsoft-suffer-system-outage-affecting-outlook-teams-and-copilot-exec-says-theres-no-indication-this-is-the-result-of-malicious-or-cyber-activity

Diungkapkan bahwa microsoft 365 isn't quite living up to its name this week, as its services have suffered an extended outage that's knocked the likes of outlook, teams, and copilot for six. As of writing, the company are finally reporting "encouraging recovery progress in Europe" and are busy "addressing the remaining areas of disruption", but that's only after chunks of November 12th and 13th have seen people, businesses, and institutions left unable to use stuff they rely on.

Diungkapkan bahwa that latest update was given by microsoft to the bbc, who've had a live report on the outage running, since it's affected the likes of schools, government services and medical services. IGN and Kotaku's reports differ on whether any Xbox services appear to be affected. The Xbox status support page currently indicates all is swell, but Downdetector does show a recent uptick in reports of issues.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we regret that today’s outages caused disruptions for our customers, and we are working to address the issue," microsoft exec charles lamanna wrote in response to a support thread on the topic in the early hours of november 13th uk time. "We will continue to share more information as soon as we have it, and for now I can confirm that there is no indication this is the result of malicious or cyber activity. ".

As much as it's slightly reassuring that there currently looks to have been no big hack, the time it's taken to deploy proper fixes is concerning, with Microsoft noting some of their early attempts at rectifying things "not taking as expected".

Berdasarkan laporan, the debacle has rather emphasised how far from ideal it is that so much key infrastructure across the world runs on one clump of tech which all go down in a heartbeat, but to a certain degree that is the peril of relying on anything. One can only hope that Microsoft's ongoing efforts to fire vast numbers of staff into the sun and embrace AI haven't factored into lots of their services going tits up for an inconvenient amount of time.

"One of gaming's most important franchises".

Additionally, she revealed Doom developer idSoftware - one of the Microsoft-owned studios heavily impacted by sweeping Xbox job cuts earlier this year - is now working on a new game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sharma has, of course, been on a bit of a pr offensive of late, positioning herself alongside snippets of positive news at a time xbox is embroiled in a massive business "reset" effort that has resulted in proposed studio closures and mass layoffs that will ultimately see 3,200 xbox employees lose their jobs. This week's Wolfenstein 3 reveal similarly arrived in the form of a tweet posted directly from her social media account.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at machinegames," sharma wrote on x. " As for idSoftware's new project, confirmation of that - again attributed directly to Sharma - appeared in a post on Bethesda's website. "One of gaming's most important franchises, and a team that has done remarkable work bringing it forward. "Slaughter Mode comes to Doom: The Dark Ages - Revelations on Monday," she wrote, "and the team is already working on its next game. Looking forward to sharing more. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa in july, sweeping job cuts at xbox resulted in 96 of idsoftware's 136 employees being laid off in a move one former team member described as a "bloodbath". Since then, idSoftware co-studio director Marty Stratton has attempted to downplay the cuts, recently insisting the studio was "doing great". He added id was "working more closely than ever" with MachineGames - a studio which appears to have escaped Sharma's restructuring efforts so far.

Berdasarkan laporan, this week's wolfenstein and idsoftware news follows similar efforts by xbox to reassure fans their favourite franchises are unaffected by the recent layoffs. Berdasarkan laporan, xbox's year of bad news - which includes ongoing boycott efforts relating to microsoft's controversial involvement with the israeli military - comes as the division celebrates its 25th anniversary. #8. Steam’s Angriest New Game Is the Perfect Place to Channel Your AI Hate

📅 13 Nov 2026

Steam’s Angriest New Game Is the Perfect Place to Channel Your AI Hate

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/virtue-and-a-sledgehammer-review/

Virtue and a Sledgehammer rages against AI and finds peace in grief.

Virtue and a Sledgehammer rages against AI and finds peace in grief.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are plenty of good reasons to have an adversarial relationship with generative ai. Where photos are replaced with digital approximations of cherished moments. You could go to war over the tech’s environmental impact, its catastrophic impact on labor, the way it has driven up the cost of RAM, or the fact that it’s an empire built on mass theft. But there’s also the existential horror of it all. Imagine what a world where human beings forfeit all of their brainpower to machines would look like. Where nobody can be bothered to write so much as an email to one another. Where art is no longer created by people who have something to express, but by those who only see it as a space-filling product.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the greater threat of an unchecked ai industry is that it will siphon the soul out of humanity. And what are we without that?.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s a question that haunts pratelle, the tortured star of deconstructeam and selkie harbour’s rage-filled virtue and a sledgehammer. Grief crosses paths with cultural frustration as Pratelle sets out on a quest to smash a town full of bots. Generative AI is a clear target in this vital and timely story about resisting harmful technology before it's too late, but that’s only one piece of the game’s more thoughtful meditation on what makes a person human, and why we must accept our limitations as a species. That even means finding peace with death.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, reeling from the loss of her mother, pratelle returns to her hometown — with a sledgehammer in tow — to discover that everyone’s consciousness has been transferred into walking machines. Unable to process the impending death of her mother, Nina becomes obsessed with the idea of saving her mom by letting her thoughts live on in a machine body. Scattered flashbacks gradually reveal that her sister, Nina, is behind the town’s transformation into a robotic paradise. Pratelle detests the idea, and eventually returns home with the intention of destroying her sister’s work.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, pratelle’s rage manifests in a simple but effective mechanic: she can smash every bot and building in sight with a sledgehammer. And holding it as long as she can results in a Hulk-like smash that can level an entire house. Tapping the button simply lets her shove bots away. It’s a one-note bit of gameplay, but it’s as much as the three-hour story calls for. There’s an undeniable power that comes from pounding a bot into oblivion. Holding the button down allows her to swing it. Visceral sound design emphasizes the impact of each swing as walls crumble in an ear-splitting stone downpour.

Diungkapkan bahwa virtue and sledgehammer’s stance on ai isn’t subtle, nor is it trying to be. It’s an aggressive rejection of the tech built for anyone who has ever said what they wish they could do to a data center, out of earshot of a cellphone microphone. The entire premise of the game even evokes Ridley Scott’s iconic 1984-referencing Apple commercial, where a runner dressed in red throws a sledgehammer through a screen as Big Brother speaks to the brainwashed masses. (It’s a reclamation of the image in some way, given that an Apple is now a very major player in the tech climate that Virtue and a Sledgehammer is so ready to topple. It sees an impending dystopia and wishes one person could have the power to cut it off at the knees. ).

Virtue and a Sledgehammer frames the idea of letting go as the kindest thing you can do for a person.

Diungkapkan bahwa but catharsis is only a temporary bliss; virtue and sledgehammer is much more about the problems that can’t be solved with destruction. Nina refuses to accept that, and it’s what leads her to believe that a person could live forever if they give themself over to a tech singularity. Once her mother’s brain stops functioning, she will no longer exist. The real heart of the story comes from Pratelle and Nina’s divergent responses to an inevitable death. Death is death. Pratelle faces reality in a coldly blunt manner. A body is just a body, in her mind; it’s your thoughts that make you who you are. And if you could transplant those thoughts into a bot and simulate consciousness, isn’t that the same thing as being alive?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, virtue and sledgehammer wades into similar territory explored by yorgos lanthimos’ alps. The Greek film centers around a service that helps people get over a recent death in their life by sending them an actor who impersonates the deceased. The idea is that it could allow people to wean themselves into acceptance by giving them a substitute to fill that sudden void in their life. Is that ethical, or a manipulative business practice that causes more harm than good? It’s a Lanthimos movie, so you can probably guess the answer if you’re familiar with the pitch-black filmmaker. But Virtue and a Sledgehammer approaches similar questions, tied up in an AI premise that’s beginning to feel less sci-fi by the day, with a genuine philosophical curiosity.

Diungkapkan bahwa while destroying everything in a blind rage, pratelle is challenged by the horrifying idea that nina could be right. After all, the robots she’s crushing house the thoughts and feelings of real people she once knew. Her empathy is repeatedly tested by cowering robots who beg not to be killed, as is yours when you’re left deciding whether to hear their pleas or treat them as the cold ramblings of a machine. It would all be easier for everyone involved if you could accept the comforting idea that immortality is possible.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but it’s not. We are flawed creatures with bodies and minds that are built to break down. What makes humans special is that we aren’t machines that operate with 100% efficiency. Virtue and a Sledgehammer isn’t trying to bum players out with a bleak reality. You can skip the funerals to avoid staring at that cold truth lying in an open casket, but that doesn’t reverse a loss. It’s not a scientific problem to be solved. One of the great pains of living is knowing that everyone you’ve ever met will someday die. Instead, it embraces the fact that this cycle of life, death, grief, and acceptance is an inseparable piece of our humanity. The fact that we know that and still continue on, trying to forge legacies and leave the world a better place than we found it, is remarkable. And it’s remarkable because we know how fragile and impermanent we are, not in spite of it.

Diungkapkan bahwa virtue and a sledgehammer frames the idea of letting go as the kindest thing you can do for a person. The absence is an invisible monument to their life; it is not a void to be filled with a substitution. Let us fail, let us grow, and let us die. That’s something that a tech industry so overeager to push humanity past its natural limits fails to grasp. It’s an acknowledgment of an irreplaceable humanity that can only come from an imperfectly designed being. Otherwise, what’s the point of living?.

An official The Legend of Zelda website has listed the 3DS title A Link Between Worlds as available on Nintendo Switch Online, leading to speculation that the handheld's library could be coming to the service.

Diungkapkan bahwa the legend of zelda fans are in a pretty good place when it comes to the series on switch. If you have a Switch 2, you have access to every mainline entry in the series barring Four Swords Adventures, Twilight Princess, Phantom Hourglass, Spirit Tracks, A Link Between Worlds, and the somehow considered mainline Tri Force Heroes. And while Four Swords Adventures and Twilight Princess are on the cards thanks to the GameCube Nintendo Switch Online app, the handheld titles are generally seen as unlikely due to their dual screens.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, on the zelda game history page on the nintendo website, some have noticed an interesting disclaimer. You can click on each game to see a blurb about it, and with the games that are available to play on Nintendo Switch Online, there's a little mark showing this. Naturally this is present on the original NES game, Ocarina of Time, Wind Waker and the like, however, it's also present on The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds for the 3DS.

Berdasarkan laporan, obviously, there currently isn't a 3ds app available on switch or switch 2, and in theory, next in line would be the wii, ds, and 3ds before we reach the wii u – which already has all of its major titles on switch – and then the switch era itself. Theoretically, A Link Between Worlds would be easier to make work than the DS duology due to the second screen effectively being a menu screen.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, i'm not sure i'd get my hopes up. Firstly, if the Game Boy Advance is exclusive to Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack users, there's no way that the 3DS would be on the regular Nintendo Switch Online subscription. And as a user on Reddit points out, The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Ages – which is already on Switch Online and specifically as part of the non-Expansion Pack subscription – is missing its "Playable with Nintendo Switch Online" label, so it's likely somehow been mixed up with A Link Between Worlds.

That being said, it does hammer home that Nintendo is currently letting one of the best Legend of Zelda games of all-time remain unplayable on modern hardware since the 3DS store was discontinued, so a 3DS Nintendo Switch Online would be appreciated, as many of the other comments on Reddit prove.

#25. Xbox Shares New Fable Trailer that Divides the Fanbase

📅 13 Nov 2026

Xbox Shares New Fable Trailer that Divides the Fanbase

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/fable-new-gameplay-trailer-xbox/

The new Fable trailer looks surprisingly dark.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on nov. 12, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma shared a new gameplay trailer for Fable, the long-anticipated fourth installment in the Fable series, developed by Playground Games. While excitement for the game remains high, many fans shared their negative reactions online, confirming that this will be another controversial release.

Diungkapkan bahwa fable is scheduled for release on feb. It's the first game in the series not developed by Lionhead Studios, after the studio was closed by Microsoft in April 2016. 23, 2027. The game has been in development for almost a decade, with first reports emerging in 2018. Fable is an attempt to revive the beloved franchise created by Peter Molyneux and his team at Lionhead, which released the first three critically acclaimed games between 2004 and 2010.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in fable, players will return once again to the land of albion and take the role of the hero, but the game will not follow the established timeline of its predecessors in the series. Judging by the latest trailer, that won't be the only difference.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the fable trailer released on nov. There is a lot of walking, and a lot of talking. 12 shows a female Hero following the trail of a woman named Isabel, who allegedly attacked her village, turning the inhabitants to stone. The protagonist is accompanied by another Hero, a woman called Arden (voiced by Susan Wokoma), who rejected her heroic calling and now works as a cobbler. Together, they explore a bit of the forest, fight some undead enemies, and then find a mysterious cavern with supernatural phenomena. And everything looks bleak.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the first three fable games had their dark moments (do you remember the tattered spire in fable 2?), but the world of albion almost always looked bright and colorful, even when it was trying to kill you. The series took inspiration from fairy tales, which often mix whimsy with the unsettling, giving the games their unique tone and feel. This latest trailer for the new Fable shows a world that has discarded whimsy and retained only the darkest parts of the fairy tale (literally, there are very few colors).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, many fans have expressed their dissatisfaction with the footage. Some complained that the "gameplay" trailer consists mostly of cutscenes and characters walking and talking, with Arden acting as a source of excessive exposition. Other comments highlight how the game looks too much like any run-of-the-mill action-RPG.

Diungkapkan bahwa the trailer does have a combat sequence, which showcases the three combat styles (melee, ranged, and magic) that players can freely switch between. Some users praised the combat seen in the trailer, while others complained that the movement looked stiff. Many fans are simply excited about a new Fable game, and have high expectations for the title.

Sebagaimana diketahui, overall, the biggest source of disagreement among fans is that the new fable has a very different aesthetic from previous chapters in the series. While this is fully understandable after a decade, it's also true that the colorful and bombastic nature of Albion was one of the reasons the franchise was so successful. It must be said that the sequence shown in the trailer takes place in a forest twisted by dark forces, and the previous trailer looked a bit brighter.

Sebagaimana diketahui, fable is scheduled for release on feb. 23, 2027. It will be available on PlayStation 5, Windows PC, and Xbox.

Diungkapkan bahwa the memo, titled 25 years of xbox, charts the growth of microsoft from small beginnings through to the thousands-strong company it is today. But it's Sharma's comments at the end of the memo that are of particular interest.

Diungkapkan bahwa while talking about what the next 25 years could bring, sharma lamented that "too many ideas never become games" and that "too many games fall short of what their creators imagined". "We must change this. "For decades, this has been the unavoidable tradeoff of ambition," she wrote. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, sharma continued: "throughout human history, the scale of what we could create was determined by the people, capital, and resources we could command. A single person will soon be able to wield capabilities that once required entire nations. And our largest studios will be able to pursue ambitions as far beyond today's games as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is from its first entry in 1982. A small team will be able to build worlds that today demand hundreds of developers and hundreds of millions of dollars. That relationship is beginning to break. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, there is no explicit mention of generative ai here, but the language is suggestive - "a single person will soon be able to wield capabilities that once required entire nations". Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this isn't a surprise, of course. But it's an area she's avoided speaking too enthusiastically about since her hiring as Xbox boss earlier this year. Microsoft as a wider company is all-in on generative AI, with Copilot, and Sharma's background at Microsoft is in AI. Perhaps now we're seeing the sprouting seeds of it.

It's no secret that the market for physical video games is drying up, but don't expect physical media for gaming to go away entirely anytime soon, or ever, according to Take-Two's Strauss Zelnick.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he told the game business that it "may not be the end" for physical media entirely in games, even with sony killing off playstation discs in 2028. He said there will "always be some physical business" for gaming, but it will be a "very small part of the business. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, he likened the scale of it to the vinyl business for recorded music. Most people might stream music today, but the market for vinyl is still there--and it's growing.

Berdasarkan laporan, for take-two, however, zelnick said its business today is 98% digital. Going all-digital has a lot of benefits for publishers, but it's mainly about making more money. For GTA 6, the most highly anticipated game release ever, Rockstar is not offering the game on a disc, but the game will appear in stores via a code-in-a-box version.

GTA 6's $400 collector's edition comes with a range of physical goods (but not the game), and Rockstar is also releasing GTA 6's score on CD and vinyl, but the game itself remains a digital-only experience.

Diungkapkan bahwa gta 6 launches on november 19 for ps5 and xbox series x|s. A PC edition and online multiplayer are both rumored to launch in 2027.

Berdasarkan laporan, in response to a question asking about layoffs over the past 24 months, a total of 34 percent of respondents worldwide said they had lost a job in the games industry. S. Even those in employment are not exactly in stable work: only 50 percent of U. S. respondents are employed full-time (down 9 percent), with 21 percent of respondents currently unemployed.

Diungkapkan bahwa of those who lost their jobâroughly 900 respondents according to gdcâsome have faced multiple layoffs in that period. With fewer jobs available, over 54 percent say they have not yet found another job, while it took 15 percent of this group over six months to find new work. 17 percent of this group were laid off twice, with three percent facing three or more layoffs in a 24-month period. Speaking of AI, while there is a concern that the tech will replace jobs, its usage across the industry remains far lower than in other tech fields. Older developers tend to use it more than younger developers, with significantly more men than women using the tools (45 percent vs 33 percent). #33. World of Warcraft: Forever players in Australia and New Zealand are struggling to get sunlight, and not for the usual MMO reasons

📅 12 Nov 2026

World of Warcraft: Forever players in Australia and New Zealand are struggling to get sunlight, and not for the usual MMO reasons

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/world-of-warcraft-forever-oceania-sunlight

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, world of warcraft: forever players are having a blast in the new mmo, but not everyone is basking in the rays of its successful launch. Players located in Australia, New Zealand, and other Oceania countries are having a bit of a sunlight problem.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but it's not that too much time behind the computer is keeping wow players on the other side of the globe away from their precious vitamin d. Rather, it's in-game sunlight that's scarce for our Oceania friends.

Berdasarkan laporan, world of warcraft: forever, if you didn't already known, has a lovely in-game day/night cycle that aligns with your server clock rather than your local time. So, for a British player, the server time is one hour ahead of GMT. That means if I play during the day I see the sun hanging over Azeroth, and if I do a late night MMO session it's replaced by the moon.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, while oceania players can access a data centre in australia that allows for a solid connection to wow, they still share the same mega-servers with north americans. That mega-server is aligned with North American time, differing drastically from Oceania time zones. In other words, for World of Warcraft: Forever players in Oceania, day is night and night is day. And they've had enough!.

"There's no outcome of this that allows Valve neutrality on AI".

More indie developers say they've been forced to delay the impending release of their games as a result of Steam's growing approvals backlog - a relatively recent problem that's believed to stem from an influx of AI slop on the platform.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, earlier this month, developers began complaining about delays to valve's approval process, which was extending the time it took to get their games published on steam. Valve responded, explaining approval times could now take up to 12 days, due to the number of submissions it was having to re-review. One week on, the situation doesn't seem to have improved.

Diungkapkan bahwa new turn-based tower defence game australia did it: end-of-the-world railway defense business, co-developed by acclaimed indie designer rami ismail and aesthetician labs, was previously set for release on 10th november. Unfortunately, the game has now been delayed while the wait continues for Valve to review the latest build.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we're still waiting for steam to give us the final greenlight and finish their build review process," publisher mystic forge wrote on the steam forums. "We have been stuck waiting for it for a few weeks now and unfortunately we just don't know when they will get around to reviewing it at this point. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, speaking to eurogamer, ismail added that australia did it has been in steam's approval queue for much longer than he's used to: "we've been in the queue since 20th october, failed over a minor controller input issue on 5th november (which we resolved the same day), and we've been waiting again since with no meaningful response from valve despite follow-ups. ".

"I'm used to hold-and-wait patterns on console," Ismail continued, "but Steam has historically been much more snappy - 10-14 days pre-launch was usually enough to fail twice and still ship on time," he added.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, amazing slot survivor (a. ), the debut title from TwoMenGames, is facing similar issues, and has had to retract its release date announcement after being stuck in Steam's approval queue. S. S. Amazing Slot Survivor, which adds a slot machine spin to the bullet heaven auto-shooting genre, was initially set for release on 13th November.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "steam's review process for the release is taking longer than we expected," twomengames wrote in a message on steam. "We know many of you have been counting on the schedule we announced earlier, and we are very sorry to bring you this [postponement] news instead of the good news you were hoping for. " Amazing Slot Survivor's demo, which was previously set to disappear with the game's full release, has returned to Steam until the developer announces a new launch date.

These are far from the only examples, and a cursory look on social media reveals many more indie games are affected by the problem, including the likes of Bottled by Bears, and Food Devils.

Sebagaimana diketahui, valve recently attempted to address the delays its facing by introducing stricter submission guidelines designed to stop the lowest-effort games, such as those vibe-coded entirely with gen-ai, from joining its approval queue. However, Ismail doesn't think that's good enough.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i am concerned that valve trying to avoid taking a political position on ai is forcing them into choices that will inevitably be worse for developers," he told eurogamer. "If sloppers can submit several game clones a day through automated systems, the only way for Valve to stem the tide of games damaging genuine developers' work is to put constraints on game distribution, increase fees, or make the process more complicated.

"In the 'open market' Valve seems to so adore, they're going to be the ones carrying the costs for moderation, so I don't think they'll like the open market on this - but there's no outcome of this that allows Valve neutrality on AI and not do things that will ultimately make life worse for genuine developers," he added.

The Legend of Zelda might be one of Nintendo's biggest series, but according to two of the company's former marketing leads, it was in "dire straits" before Breath of the Wild, which introduced a massive open-world overhaul that left the franchise's classic formula behind.

Berdasarkan laporan, last week saw the launch of the legend of zelda: ocarina of time's switch 2 remake, which is already an enormous success with 5. 2 million copies sold in its first four days. Notably, although it's a remake rather than an entirely new game, it shows there's still a huge appetite for the classic Zelda formula – something that Kit Ellis and Krysta Yang have been discussing in a new episode of their podcast below.

Diungkapkan bahwa ellis and yang – former director of social media marketing and original content, and senior manager of creator relations and original content at nintendo of america, respectively – have been chatting about whether the ocarina of time remake could open the door for more traditional zelda games going forward, as opposed to the breath of the wild and tears of the kingdom-style open-world games which have served as the series' most major releases in the last nine years. While Yang would be interested in a game that combines the classic Zelda-style dungeons with the open-world format, Ellis would "like to see a modern attempt on a classic Zelda game" with that aspect left out entirely.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, this brings him to another point – what he calls "revisionist history" of the series' releases. He calls out fans who've suggested that "the Zelda team ripped these [classic-style games] away from us at the peak of their popularity," prompting Yang to jump in: "That's ridiculous. This series was in dire straits. They were selling, like, nothing. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, ellis recalls: "i remember, i was going to the focus groups. '" According to him, Nintendo had "so much data" showing that "the interest in the audience was getting smaller and smaller" with every new game. It was a really dark moment of like, the feedback is 'the fan base is dwindling, this is not bringing in new players. As a result, he says, "They had to do something dramatic like that. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, obviously, breath of the wild was an enormous success – per nintendo's data, as of the end of september, the switch 1 version had sold a whopping 34. 28 million copies, with its sequel Tears of the Kingdom coming in with 22. 9 million. They're both considered some of the best Zelda games of all time, and for good reason.

Diungkapkan bahwa but, as ellis and yang discuss, the ocarina of time remake has already proven that folks enjoy the more traditional experiences, too. I don't think we were ever at risk of Zelda going totally open world – even since Breath of the Wild's launch, we've seen the Link's Awakening remake and Echoes of Wisdom, as well as Skyward Sword's HD remaster, giving us new top-down and 3D releases, respectively.

Sign up to our Switch 2 Spotlight newsletter to make sure you get the very latest news on Nintendo's new console and its games every week.

Sebagaimana diketahui, like ellis, though, i'd be keen to see a brand new, classic-style 3d zelda game at some point. After all, not counting remakes, remasters, and ports, the last one was technically 2011's Skyward Sword – it's fair to say we're due for something fresh.

Diungkapkan bahwa despite gta 6 being pitted against zelda: ocarina of time, take-two boss has nothing but praise – nintendo "should be proud" as the game is "terrific. ".

The Final Fantasy 14 community is in mourning following news that Eikichi Iwai, the bassist for the game's house band, The Primals, has died at the age of 57, and is taking to the MMORPG's main hub cities to honor his legacy.

An "Important Announcement" post on the official FF14 website from developer Square Enix on November 11 broke the news, and stated the development team was "deeply saddened" to inform the community of Iwai's passing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "having witnessed his truly unforgettable performance on stage at the recent final fantasy 14 fan festival in japan, the sudden news of his passing has come as a profound shock," the statement reads. "The members of The Primals and the entire FF14 development and operations team are overcome with deep sorrow.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "as we reflect on all that eikichi-san has left behind, our thoughts are with him, and we offer our heartfelt condolences. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the primals, composed of iwai on bass, composer masayoshi soken, localization lead michael-christopher koji fox, and band members tetsuya tachibana and gunn, are behind some of ff14's most memorable tracks. Iwai's bass in particular stands out on songs like Shadowbringers' To the Edge and Stormblood's Amatsu Kaze. The band performed worldwide at various FF14 Fan Festivals, as well as at a UK rock festival, earlier this year.

Berdasarkan laporan, final fantasy 14's community has a reputation as being one of the best, and most welcoming, in gaming, so it's no surprise it took the time to honor iwai's passing. As spotted on Reddit, the game's playerbase has come together to pay their respects Iwai, with large gatherings of players holding firelight vigils in his memory across the game's various servers and cities.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "it's so good to see everyone come together, he deserves it for playing such a big role in the music we've fallen in love with. May he rest peacefully," one community member wrote.

More of Iwai and The Primals' music will be heard in Final Fantasy 14's next upcoming expansion, Evercold, set to release on February 23, 2027.

#50. After days of controversy, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned

📅 12 Nov 2026

After days of controversy, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns

Nvidia's founder and CEO Jensen Huang has resigned from his position as leader of one of the most valuable companies in the world.

Diungkapkan bahwa after days mired in controversy, which began amid reports of huang's alleged affair with a chinese spy, nvidia has announced huang's resignation as company president, chief executive officer, and board member, effective immediately. Finance chief Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO and will remain in the position until a permanent CEO is chosen.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "colette has helped lead nvidia through a period of extraordinary growth and has a deep understanding of our business, customers, operations and financial position," harvey jones, chair of nvidia's board of directors wrote in a statement accompanying the news. "She is supported by an experienced leadership team that has been instrumental in executing Nvidia's strategy and advancing its technology roadmap. The Board has full confidence in Colette and the leadership team, and we expect the company's operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, kress, in the same announcement, says she intends to build on the foundation laid by huang over the past 33 years, and "continue advancing the work that has made nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and ai, and execute on the opportunities ahead. " Perhaps unsurprisingly, there's no mention of gaming graphics cards in there.

Diungkapkan bahwa nvidia's announcement ends by thanking huang for his time at the company: "jensen’s contributions to nvidia are profound. The Board and the company thank Jensen for his immeasurable contributions to the company and the industry. Nvidia is one of the most consequential technology companies in the world. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nvidia's board met on wednesday to decide whether to remove huang amid allegations he had participated in a second affair, this time with a subordinate, following reports of his alleged affair with a chinese spy. That initial incident prompted a company-wide apology from Huang and an independent investigation exploring whether he'd been the target of a "foreign intelligence effort".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nvidia will likely remain under increased scrutiny moving forward. There are particular concerns around the company's chips being imported to China despite trade bans.

Diungkapkan bahwa i reported earlier this week on a bug within amd's gpu driver suite, wherein a misfiring utility was accused of making huge amounts of erroneous storage writes. Some AMD graphics card owners reported their SSD health dropping by up to 1% per month, but a fix has finally arrived.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, amd adrenalin edition 26. 1 is an optional update, which means you'll need to download the installer yourself. 11. However, according to the topline notes, the update fixes "excessive writes to the system drive" at idle for Radeon RX 7000-series graphics cards and above.

AMD's wording suggests that older GPUs might not be affected by the bug, but some of the user reports mention RX 6000-series cards, so it's unclear if a fix for earlier models is still in the works.

I also think it's a slightly odd move to make this an "optional" update, given the severity of some of the reports, though this is often how AMD deals with getting fixes out in between official driver releases—by the looks of the known issues, this interim driver might still need some work before it's patched into the next full release.

Sebagaimana diketahui, amd lists a litany of potential issues with various games, including crashes and driver timeouts in assassin's creed black flag resynced, war thunder, and cyberpunk 2077 with fsr enabled. These issues, however, match and are fewer than in the previous driver release, with the exception of the Phantom Blade Zero bug.

Diungkapkan bahwa the company notes that "visual corruption may appear on character hair while playing phantom blade zero on radeon rx 9000 series graphics products. #54. All Treasure Rooms in Queen’s Domain and how to find them

📅 13 Nov 2026

All Treasure Rooms in Queen’s Domain and how to find them

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/all-treasure-rooms-in-queens-domain-and-how-to-find-them/

Sebagaimana diketahui, queen’s domain has five treasure rooms, and locating them can be a difficult task. These secret areas are challenging to find, but they offer valuable rewards. In this guide, I will make things easy for you to find all five of them.

Sebagaimana diketahui, before we can venture to find the treasure vaults, the first task is to get the keystones. You will need them to open the vaults. Once you reach Obmuer Temple, you can find the first Keystone.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, make your way through the water until you’ll reach a point where a broken structure will slope upwards. Go past it and use the edge to air dash to move forward. You’ll come across a small plot of land where you find one of Aganmi’s missing raiders.

Sebagaimana diketahui, from there, you’ll find an opening in the temple to your right. Continue straight, and you’ll find a ledge that drops into a large room with pillars. Drop, and then turn left to find the dark cave. Go to the other side of the room, enter the open vault, and you’ll find a skeleton sitting with a note next to it.

Read this note to get the Blood Keystone from the shop for 24 Ancient Coins.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are two blood treasure rooms, and you can find the first one in the basement of the tower of knowledge. Once you defeat the boss, clear the growths. This allows you to access a room filled with candle crawlers.

Berdasarkan laporan, clear out the enemies, and you’ll discover the door to the blood vault. Inside, you’ll get the Rusted Greatsword.

Berdasarkan laporan, to find the next blood vault, head to verdant hollow. Go through the Petrified Garden and walk out of the gate that connects the Rotting Cavern and Verdant Hollow.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you can do so using the elevator from the verdant hollow wing alter. Walk into the cave from the ledge, and you’ll find the dark room.

Berdasarkan laporan, head to neasied to find the first velvet treasure room. Follow the path, and you will eventually reach the elevator that takes you all the way down. You will find a cave on one side of the area that has the altar on the cliff face. Enter the cave and go all the way down to find a hole. This hole will lead you to another room. You will find the treasure room entrance at this location.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to find the next one, head to the rotting cavern. You can find these pieces around the area, and I believe their locations are random. Look for a shine-like structure and follow the path that leads you to it. Eventually, you will come across a sealed door that requires four dark triangular slit pieces. Once you find them, it will lead you to the vault.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there is only one jet treasure room, and you will find it in the deimpo mausoleum. Go to the wing altar and take the door on the right. This will lead you to a giant stairwell, and as you descend, you will find the door to the vault.

#56. Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World details early adventure

📅 12 Nov 2026

Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World details early adventure

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.gematsu.com/2026/11/dragon-quest-monsters-the-withered-world-details-early-adventure

Publisher and developer Square Enix, and developer TOSE have released new information and screenshots for Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World introducing protagonists Bianca and Nera‘s early adventure, Witherwood Castle, and the surrounding Witherwood region.

■ Explore a Strange World with a Team of Your Favorite Monsters!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, thursday, december 3, 2026, marks the simultaneous worldwide release date of dragon quest monsters: the withered world. However, Witherwood is beset by dark forces that have drained the land of its living energy, all but eradicating the Leaves of Life from existence. Our protagonists on this adventure are none other than Bianca and Nera from Dragon Quest V: Hand of the Heavenly Bride. A mysterious fairy transports the girls to Witherwood, a kingdom in an unfamiliar world, where they hope to obtain some Leaves of Life that they believe will cure their sick fathers. To ensure the Leaves of Life will grow once more, Bianca and Nera must become monster wranglers—plucky types with the power to befriend monsters—and lead their team of loyal allies on an adventure across this strange new world.

Sebagaimana diketahui, —take your favorite monsters along with you as you explore all corners of the world. What new adventures await you beyond the curve of the horizon?.

Berdasarkan laporan, —you can now scout monsters on the fly as you explore, as well as in battle. It’s never been easier to befriend all the monsters you want!.

Berdasarkan laporan, —the synthesis feature lets you combine two monsters to create a new one. You’ll have to synthesize many, many monsters on your quest to build a powerful party.

—It’s your job to rid the world of the evil forces that drain the land of its life energy.

■ The Early Adventure: Becoming a Monster Wrangler.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, soon after arriving in witherwood to look for the leaves of life, bianca and nera are given the power to befriend monsters and set out on their quest as fledgeling monster wranglers. Once you’ve decided which character you want to control and have your starting monster, it’s time for you to go off and befriend a few more!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, —you can choose to begin the adventure as either bianca or nera. Each protagonist will find it easier to befriend monsters from different families, and their Wrangler’s Sprit ability provides different beneficial effects when it activates during battle. So, examine their differences and pick your favorite!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, —after you answer fluffy’s questions, he’ll present you with your first monster. The monster you get depends on your responses, but there’s no need to overthink things!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, —when you enter battle, the monsters you’ve befriended will fight under your command. Give them specific orders or set their general tactics and march your way to victory!.

Diungkapkan bahwa —use a show of force in battle to attempt to befriend an enemy monster. If you succeed, the monster will join your team. On rare occasions, a monster may even ask to join you of its own accord after a battle ends!.

■ The Early Adventure: Witherwood Castle, Your Base of Operations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, witherwood castle will soon become something of a home base for bianca and nera as their adventure ramps up. Conveniently, the castle town is home to many amenities that will serve the girls well on their quest.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the kingdom’s ruler, king withers, holds court in his throne hall, from where he provides the girls with invaluable advice. See what he has to say if you find yourself at a loss for where to go next.

Berdasarkan laporan, the paddock is where your monsters hang out when not in your party. From here, you can also access the monster depot when you want to make changes to your team line-up.

The item shop sells a range of wares, including meat, which monsters absolutely love! The stock changes as you progress through the story, so check back regularly to see what’s new.

Berdasarkan laporan, as the story unfolds, you’ll start to see changes in witherwood castle and the adjoining town. For starters, a monster called Tony will appear and challenge you to complete scouting trials for a reward, and townsfolk will offer their monsters to you for synthesis in the form of matchmaking opportunities. Also, the accessories you can equip to your monsters can be upgraded at a workshop that will open after a while. Witherwood has plenty on offer to help our young wranglers strengthen their team in preparation for the next step of their adventure!.

Berdasarkan laporan, this odd monster will give you clues describing a very specific monster he wants you to show him. The trials get more difficult with each one you complete, but the rewards get better to match.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, some townsfolk will offer you their monsters to use for synthesis. You can contribute any monster you like, but if you can provide the one the townsperson mentions, you’ll be able to perform a special synthesis!.

Diungkapkan bahwa with the right crafting materials and enough gold, you can upgrade your accessories twice at most. You’ll find these materials when you’re out exploring, but monsters sometimes drop them after battle as well.

■ The Early Adventure: Exploring the Witherwood Region.

Berdasarkan laporan, once all the preparations are complete, it’s time to start exploring the game’s first main area: witherwood! the region is divided into several sub-areas, each with its own distinct vibe and unique changes that occur as the day shifts to night. With Roots of Creation and Lifebuds to locate, as well as super-strong monsters and dungeons to discover, every area is worth exploring to its fullest.

Berdasarkan laporan, each area is home to monsters that may disappear or behave differently as day becomes night. For example, the teenie sanguini is strictly nocturnal, meaning you’ll find a different monster if you return to the same place during the daytime.

What to Do With the Withered Roots of Creation and Lifebuds?.

Diungkapkan bahwa —give a root of creation a sprinkle with the waterwing can to revive it. Doing so will add it to the Zoom list for fast travel and create a one-stop-shop for healing monsters, adjusting your party, synthesizing, and changing the time.

Diungkapkan bahwa —helping the lifebuds to bloom will provide your party with permanent passive boosts, such as increased experience points, that will really benefit you. If you see a Lifebud, be sure to give it a drink!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the monsters you see stomping about with a red aura around them are incredibly powerful. You can try fighting them at the start of the game if you really want, but it’s advised to wait until you have a stronger team.

While dungeons are home to hordes of monsters, they also contain valuable treasures, like mini medals that you can exchange for superb prizes at the Mini Medal Swap Swap in Witherwood.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the depths of a dungeon, a ferocious monster often lies in wait. But before you jump into battle, it’s a good idea to head to a nearby Root of Creation to heal up and prepare your party.

■ The Early Adventure: Strengthen Your Team and Head to the Next Region.

Sebagaimana diketahui, before they can start synthesizing, bianca and nera must team up to take down a massive monster in a joint battle, as well as emerge victorious at the battle arena. But you can’t just synthesize with any old riffraff—you’ll need two monsters at Level 10 or above in order to synthesize a new one. With enough battles under your belt and a few strong monsters synthesized, you’ll be ready to explore the next region: Pays de l’Oseille!.

Team Up to Beat the Massive Monster Enorman.

—If you’re controlling Bianca for the Joint Battle, she’ll command your main party, with Nera in charge of your reserves—and vice versa if you’re using Nera.

Sebagaimana diketahui, —when a massive monster becomes enraged, each of its attacks will deal heavy damage, but it’ll be more susceptible to damage itself. Keep calm and use the opportunity to attack!.

If you find the Battle Arena to be tough going, try leveling up your party and including some monsters in your team that can use spells or healing abilities.

With Both Trials Done, Go to the Starry Shine in the Castle to Start Synthesizing.

Diungkapkan bahwa —if you have two monsters at level 10 or higher, you can combine them to synthesize a new one. You can even synthesize monsters from any Root of Creation you find out in the wider world.

Sebagaimana diketahui, —child monsters born through synthesis can inherit the talents of their parents. Some monsters can only be made through synthesis, so try to explore as many combinations as you can.

Berdasarkan laporan, a number of regions beyond witherwood are waiting to be explored. Hunting for treasure in a sunken shipwreck, adventuring among giant fruits and veggies, and many more adventures await you!.

Bianca and Nera’s search for the Leaves of Life is only just beginning!.

Berdasarkan laporan, dragon quest monsters: the withered world is due out for playstation 5, xbox series, switch 2, switch, and pc via steam and microsoft store on december 3. A demo is available now.

#57. The Witcher 3 uses gen-AI to enhance Geralt's Polish voice following actor's stroke - "I do think this is one of those ways where you can use AI ethically"

📅 12 Nov 2026

The Witcher 3 uses gen-AI to enhance Geralt's Polish voice following actor's stroke - "I do think this is one of those ways where you can use AI ethically"

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/cd-projekt-red-geralt-gen-ai-voice-polish-jacek-rozenek

Diungkapkan bahwa "i have great trust. for the creators of this game. ".

CD Projekt Red has revealed that it used - and is using - generative AI technology to treat and alter the voice of the Polish actor who portrayed Geralt of Rivia in upcoming Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past.

Diungkapkan bahwa the actor, jacek rozenek, has portrayed geralt of rivia in all the major witcher games, meaning his voice has become as synonymous with the role in poland as doug cockle's has for people playing in english. But Rozenek suffered a severe stroke in 2019 that left him temporarily unable to speak, and when he was able to talk and perform again, the tonality and quality of his voice had changed.

Diungkapkan bahwa it's for these reasons that cd projekt red - with rozenek's consent - employed the help of a company called respeecher to alter the lines he recorded for the witcher 3's songs of the past expansion using generative-ai technology. As confirmed to Game File, an AI trained on Rozenek's previous Witcher work is retreating his recordings to make them sound more like the Geralt you hear elsewhere in The Witcher 3.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "the point is that this voice should be as close as possible to my voice from 12 years ago," jacek rozenek explained. for the creators of this game. "I have great trust. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, game file heard both treated and untreated recordings of rozenek's songs of the past work, and reported a "significant" difference between them. Rozenek's untreated voice was apparently "deep and gravelly" and "noticeably rougher than his recordings for the original game". But treated, the voice was "far smoother and sounds younger", and closer to the original Witcher 3 Geralt recordings.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this isn't the first time cd projekt red has used generative ai for voice recordings in one of its games. Viktor Vektor actor Miłogost "Miłek" Reczek passed away in 2021, after the original game was released, and CD Projekt Red didn't want to recast the role. The studio worked with Respeecher in 2023 to produce new voiceover lines for Cyberpunk 2077 expansion Phantom Liberty. Reczek's sons apparently gave their blessing for their father's voice to be artificially generated.

"I do think this is one of those ways where you can use AI ethically with consent and also to do something good," CD Projekt Red localisation producer Mikołaj Szwed told Game File, referring to the Rozenek recordings.

Berdasarkan laporan, "for future projects, when we consider geralt is becoming older and has a deeper voice, this is not a problem for us at all. It's more about this specific situation here, where we have both the voice from 12 years ago and from now next to each other, which could kind of take people out of the experience and feel that there is this difference. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the third witcher 3 expansion, songs of the past, releases at some point next year, an unprecedented 12 years after the original game launched. It adds an entirely new region, Letten, and centres its main story around Geralt's missing bardic bestie Dandelion, whose family lives there.

Berdasarkan laporan, in preparation for the expansion, a remastered version of the witcher 3 was released a couple of months ago, overhauling the old role-playing adventure and bringing its baseline presentation more in line with what we'd expect from a modern game; it also overhauled some animations and enemy behaviours and reworked skill trees. For that reason, old-gen consoles PS4 and Xbox One won't receive the Songs of the Past expansion, despite The Witcher 3 being available on them.

#58. Conan: The Black Pyramid shoves the titular barbarian into a very Hades-inspired action roguelite with the addition of a few other familiar heroes

📅 12 Nov 2026

Conan: The Black Pyramid shoves the titular barbarian into a very Hades-inspired action roguelite with the addition of a few other familiar heroes

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/conan-the-black-pyramid-shoves-the-titular-barbarian-into-a-very-hades-inspired-action-roguelite-with-the-addition-of-a-few-other-familiar-heroes

Diungkapkan bahwa i feel like one thing i only sort of miss from my youth, viewed through the lenses of those rose tinted goggles, is the established intellectual property game that just copies the formula of another, successful game. Obviously there are plenty of genres that are trendy to imitate, but how often do you see something that's just sort of "thing you know slapped on top of game you know?" Perhaps that's a tad mean, but I do genuinely have a fondness for such games, so I'm quite pleased by the announcement of Conan: The Black Pyramid, an action roguelite RPG that so clearly went to Supergiant Games' School of Hades you have to admire the boldness just a little bit.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, conan: the black pyramid puts you in the hotseat as the titular barbarian, of course, but also as other characters from the series like solomon kane, dark agnes, and apparently, more! so, immediately, a notable enough difference from hades, and one that seems like a neat take. As one of them you then "Descend into eldritch chambers of the Black Pyramid, a mysterious and dangerous place that defies the logic of space and time. Confront the shadows of the champions themselves and piece together the dark secrets of their past. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, where it is similar to hades lies in the fact that the titular triangle changes in form each time you go in it, and of course there are different abilities and buffs to pick up along the way to aid you in your quest. Each character has their own combination of weapons and abilities, so it does sound like you can mix it up quite nicely. There is, also, 2-player online co-op (sorry to the couch lovers, I suppose), adding to the ways it differs and making it a tad more friendly for those that have exactly one friend who also loves Conan.

Sebagaimana diketahui, overall, seems like a fresh enough take on hades while still trying to find some amount of its own identity. And hey, Hades is great, so I'm never upset about having a little bit more of that kind of game. No release date attached to Conan: The Black Pyramid just yet, but it is planned to arrive sometime in 2027. You can check it out on Steam here.

Available for DLC owners from 16th November.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, id software has revealed it's updating doom: the dark ages with a horde mode next week, called slaughter mode. It's a free addition, but there's a catch: you have to own this year's Revelations expansion to access it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, slaughter mode releases on monday, 16th november 2026, and brings with it "an all-new endless survival challenge designed to put even the most seasoned slayers to the test". It's got randomised enemies, bosses, and arenas, and the ability to record your personal high scores and compete in weekly challenges.

Berdasarkan laporan, the trailer confirms there are 19 arenas in total, and every round of every run features a new combination of enemies to defeat. At checkpoints, you can cash out your total earnings so far in exchange for rewards. Or, you can risk losing everything by continuing your run and trying for a higher score.

You'll mostly be unlocking new character and weapon skins, profile icons, and music.

Review DOOM: The Dark Ages (PS5) - Medieval Mashup Slows Down for FPS Excellence.

As an aside, Xbox boss Asha Sharma also confirmed developer id Software is also now working on its next game:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the doom series offers some of the best combat experiences and scenarios in all of video games, so being able to play it over and over again in a horde mode sounds perfect. This looks to be the full Dark Ages combat system placed into Slaughter Mode, so after a fantastic base game and supposedly even better DLC in Revelations, the title provides even more reason to return.

Doom and Wolfenstein studio id Software has begun work on a new project, according to the studio’s official social account, and it’s being directed by Hugo Martin, who previously directed both Doom: The Dark Ages and Doom: Eternal.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we're incredibly excited about our next project, a new game from our teams in texas and frankfurt, with game direction once again by hugo martin. It'll be some time before we're ready to share more but we can't wait for you to see what we're working on.

— id Software (@idSoftware) November 12, 2026.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this news comes over a year after the release of doom: the dark ages. An expansion for The Dark Ages, “Revelations,” was out this past July, and a new “Slaughter Mode” is being implemented on Monday.

Berdasarkan laporan, martin’s involvement makes it likely that this is yet another doom game even though that was not explicitly stated, which would be in keeping with xbox head asha sharma’s ambitions to focus on the company’s biggest franchises. Id Software is also the developer of Rage, and Quake, and numerous WolfensteinÂ games (though not the most recent entries in the series).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this reassurance as to id software’s current activities comes on the heels of a mass restructuring at xbox in july that saw massive swaths of the company cut: over 90 individuals across multiple offices, including a large amount of its id tech team (claims have suggested only one person was left working on id tech, but microsoft has said that is false and that “dozens” of people are working on it). Sources speaking to Kotaku following these layoffs said that the studio didn’t have any new games greenlit at the time, and that concepts kept shifting, suggesting that whatever this new project is, it’s very, very early in development.

In the wake of those layoffs, Martin attempted to reassure the public that id Software was in a good spot, noting that the team was now the same size as it was when they made Doom (2016).

Sebagaimana diketahui, “look, the fact that we made a game that people like and is critical and commercially successfulâlike i said, itâs doing very well related to the forecast and stuffâthatâs good for everyone, for the people at the studio, for the people who, unfortunately, we had to say goodbye to, i think that helps everyone and we really appreciate your support,â he said in a livestream. âBut what matters the most is that the the games are good and Iâm so happy that people, I donât knowâ¦ Itâs just a good thing for everybody, itâs going to help. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, just last month, studio co-director marty stratton said that id software was “incredibly viable. ”.

#62. After two weeks of multiplayer downtime, Dark Souls 2 & 3's mysterious server "issue" has been fixed, so it no longer feels so lonely online

📅 12 Nov 2026

After two weeks of multiplayer downtime, Dark Souls 2 & 3's mysterious server "issue" has been fixed, so it no longer feels so lonely online

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/dark-souls-2-3-servers-back-online

Developer FromSoftware has announced that online multiplayer servers for Dark Souls 2 and 3 are back online following a nearly two-week outage.

Berdasarkan laporan, fromsoftware temporarily disabled multiplayer on 30th october, citing what it called "a server issue". Some speculated this could be related to the recently discovered PHP security bug, which impacted a number of other games.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fromsoftware never specified the exact issue impacting its servers, and today's statement is equally vague. "Regarding the temporary suspension of the game server for Dark Souls 2, and Dark Souls 3, the investigation has been completed and the fix has been applied. The game server and online features are now restored," a notice on Dark Souls' official site reads.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we sincerely apologise for the inconvenience caused, and thank you for your patience and understanding. ".

Online servers do more in FromSoftware games than simply facilitating co-op and PvP; they're also responsible for handling messages players leave for each other in-game, as well as the ghostly representations of players who just went through the same area, helping the Dark Souls series' forlorn worlds feel a little less solitary.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this isn't the first time dark souls servers have gone offline, either. In 2022, servers for all three games went offline due to a vulnerability that allowed malicious code to run on them. In that instance, it took FromSoftware three months to bring servers back online for some games, and as many as nine months for others.

In other FromSoftware news, the studio recently announced - following months of speculation - it's officially delaying the Switch 2-exclusive The Duskbloods to sometime in 2027.

#64. 60 FPS Zelda or 30 FPS GTA 6, that is the question

📅 12 Nov 2026

60 FPS Zelda or 30 FPS GTA 6, that is the question

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/60fps-zelda-or-30fps-gta-6-that-is-the-question/

30 FPS in 2026, Absolute Cinema or actual Grand Theft?.

Diungkapkan bahwa gta 6 will be targeting 30 fps on consoles, per the crucial intel that rockstar only released far into the most successful preorder campaign ever. Nintendo, on the other hand, stole everyone’s hearts with Ocarina of Time’s 60 FPS version. Will this impact how we see GTA 6?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rockstar was already $1 billion deep in preorder gold when it revealed that gta 6 would run at the same framerate that gta 5 ran at back in 2012. In truth, that was expected, because if it was going to run at 60 FPS, the studio certainly would’ve mentioned it at some point, but this is the kind of news that will always disappoint people who aren’t constantly looking for GTA updates. How much of a dealbreaker could this be? The answer is complex.

Diungkapkan bahwa i think a good example is that of bloodborne, a game that barely keeps 30 fps for one second, but it’s still one of my favorite games of all time. Why? Because it’s that good, and because it was made under the assumption that the team likely wouldn’t get it to run at 60 frames per second on PS4 hardware.

Berdasarkan laporan, as for gta 5, most people would’ve preferred it to run at 60 fps even back then, but fans just knew the game would be pushing the ps3 and xbox 360’s hardware—yes, gta 5 originally released on those systems—to the limit, so everyone just felt very glad they were even getting something that looked so amazing. Also, GTA 5 pulled off some nice frame pacing, which means that the game didn’t often dip below the targeted mark, and its stability almost made it feel like it was running at a higher framerate than it actually was.

I think players will end up accepting GTA 6’s framerate, because even though a higher count has become much more common these days, GTA 6 is likely going to achieve a solid 30 FPS, which is very different from “targeting” it.

Berdasarkan laporan, but there’s a possible obstacle on rockstar’s path: the recently released ocarina of time remake. It runs at a beautifully nimble 60 FPS and is selling so well that there surely will be a lot of overlap between player bases, and that might very well start the 30 vs 60 debate again.

Diungkapkan bahwa sure, the games have very different gameplay styles and scope. Nintendo could’ve probably gotten away with Ocarina of Time running at 30 frames per second, because the original ran at under 20. Still, many gamers need to turn everything into a competition, and Zelda is running on considerably weaker hardware. To get Ocarina of Time to run any worse than that, you’ll need the hacked Sega 32X port.

Diungkapkan bahwa we would always eat up all that sweet ocarina music regardless of the speed nintendo played it at, but the company still found us deserving of that extra silky-smooth experience. With all that, those who are all about smooth over cinematic will inevitably question why Rockstar didn’t tone down the graphical fidelity a bit to give us more fluid gameplay for consoles that cost upwards of $800.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and while i can’t tell you exactly why rockstar made that choice, i remember that running at 60fps was the biggest selling point for gta 5‘s pc port, so rockstar might just be going for a tried-and-true sales strategy. Either way, I believe most people will truly enjoy GTA 6 as it comes out, but I’m 100% sure people will only go absolutely nuts for it once it reaches the PC and its sky-high framerate ceilings.

GTA 6 will come out on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, and might release on PC earlier than you expect.

#68. Paradox boss Frederik Wester stepping down after several tumultuous years for the Cities Skylines and Stellaris publisher

Paradox boss Frederik Wester stepping down after several tumultuous years for the Cities Skylines and Stellaris publisher

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/paradox-ceo-frederik-wester-stepping-down

Deputy CEO Mattias Lilja taking over role.

Sebagaimana diketahui, paradox interactive's frederik wester has announced he's stepping down from the role of ceo after a combined decade and a half leading the company. The news follows several tumultuous years for the publisher best known for grand strategy games including Stellaris, Europa Universalis, and Crusader Kings 3.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a statement announcing the change in leadership, paradox said wester had "decided to step down as ceo to continue focusing on the company's long-term development as a member of the board. " Paradox's current deputy CEO, Mattias Lilja, will take over Wester's role from 4th January 2027. Wester is to remain in the position until then in order "to ensure an orderly transition".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i'm truly grateful to all our engaged players and talented colleagues who contribute to outstanding gaming experiences every day," wester said of his decision. Mattias has had a central role in laying this foundation, and now is the right time to hand over. The goal was to build the foundation before passing the baton on for the next chapter in the company's journey. My plan was never to be CEO for life. Given his experience and vision, he is exceptionally well positioned to take the company to its next level. Since I returned as CEO, we've streamlined our strategy, rebuilt our pipeline and developed our commercial offering. "They are the ones who made these years amazing. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa wester has twice served as paradox ceo since joining the company in 2003. His first stint ran from 2009 to 2018, after which he became Paradox's executive chairman of the board. This has included the embattled development of Vampire: The Masquerade Bloodlines 2 - which finally launched last October after multiple delays, near cancellation, and a switch in developer. He returned to the CEO role in 2021, and has overseen a troubled period for the company. Unfortunately the game failed to resonate with critics and audiences, and Paradox announced a 162 percent decline in operating profit earlier this year as a result of its commercial failure.

Diungkapkan bahwa wester's most recent watch - which began with an admittance of "inappropriate behaviour" amid a damning report into paradox's workplace culture - has also seen the high-profile cancellation of sims competitor life by you, an indefinite delay for prison architect 2 after paradox parted ways with original developer double eleven, and a split with battletech studio harebrained schemes following the commercial failure of the lamplighters league. Paradox's Cities Skylines 2 has also been blighted with controversy: after a disastrous launch in 2023, its console release is still yet to emerge, and development is now being handled by a new studio after Paradox split with former developer Colossal Order last year. In 2004, Wester admitted the publisher had "made the wrong calls in several projects".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, despite all this, incoming ceo mattias lilja remains buoyant. "Paradox has a unique DNA that has made us one of the greats in deep and engaging strategy and management games," he wrote in a statement announcing his promotion. "Now we’re stepping up the pace: we will make further investments in our core business, push the boundaries of our game design, work even more closely with our loyal players, develop more and better tools and services that benefit both modders and players, and continue to sharpen our ways of working and our organisation, with player value in focus. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, paradox, does of course, have some promising games on its upcoming slate. Alongside continued work on grand strategy stalwarts like Crusader Kings 3, Europa Universalis 5, and Stellaris, next year sees the release of Lego Skylines, and post-apocalyptic grand strategy game Afterworld is also on the way.

#70. Leaked Dune Magic Secret Lair Has Amazing Value Reprints and 9 New Cards

📅 13 Nov 2026

Leaked Dune Magic Secret Lair Has Amazing Value Reprints and 9 New Cards

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/mtg-dune-magic-secret-lair-drop-leaks/

If confirmed, this drop could be one of the best in Secret Lair history.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one popular sci-fi property is the talk of the magic: the gathering community right now, and it's not star trek. On Nov. 12, leaks started to emerge online about a Dune Secret Lair drop, and while still unconfirmed, this new Universes Beyond collaboration seems legitimate.

Berdasarkan laporan, three dune secret lairs have been revealed in posts on reddit, after a first leak emerged on discord. The alleged name of the superdrop is My Arrakis, My Secret Lair. The names of the individual drops have not been revealed yet, but at least two of them, if confirmed, will quickly become coveted items for players and collectors.

Diungkapkan bahwa the first of the three dune secret lair drops focuses entirely on iconic characters from the franchise created by frank herbert. These eight legendary creatures are completely new to Magic, and offer a plethora of options for Commander players looking for ways to reinforce their favorite decks and strategies.

Sebagaimana diketahui, paul atreides appears in two variants. Muad'Dib, Prophet Foretold, represents Paul after his ascension in Arrakis. Paul Atreides, Ducal Heir, is a cheap white creature that quickly gets bigger thanks to Training and, after hitting 4 power, starts growing your board. This creature synergizes with self-mill strategies, and it quickly turns into a cheaper Future Sight.

Other interesting cards in this drop include Padishah Emperor Shaddam IV, which will fit perfectly in any black treasures deck, and Chani, Blade of Sietch Tabr, an aggressive Gruul Landfall commander that synergizes well with desert cards (perfect flavor!).

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you don't care much about new cards and are instead looking for cheap ways to get your hands on some of the expensive staples in commander, one of the leaked dune secret lairs is perfect for you. This unnamed drop includes five reprints with an overall expected average value of $75, a pretty sweet deal for a single drop.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the most expensive card in this dune secret lair is darksteel forge, coming in the form of pain box (not sure about the flavor on this one!). com. Darksteel Forge is a staple in any artifact deck, and it currently sells for an average of $43 on TGCplayer. The next-best card in the drop is Revel in Riches, which sells for an average of $20, and pairs perfectly well with Padishah Emperor Shaddam IV, in case you're thinking of getting the whole superdrop. Halo Fountain and Hedge Shredder are a step down in terms of price, but they're still useful cards to have in your collection. Cultivator Caravan is the cheapest card in the drop, but there is also a really nice-looking treasure token to round things up.

Diungkapkan bahwa the third dune secret lair comes with strong wurm flavor. It contains another new, unique card: Shai-Hulud, the iconic sandworm inhabiting the deserts of Arrakis. Shai-Hulud has Trample and Indestructible, and when it comes into play it destroys all artifacts and enchantments. The leak doesn't show the power or toughness of the card, but its rules text is impressive. Considering how popular enchantments and artifacts are in Commander, Shai-Hulud looks like a solid board wipe and finisher packed into one card. Then, for each player who lost a permanent this way, you can search your library for a basic land or desert and put it into play tapped. Unfortunately, the other cards in this drop are far from impressive or valuable.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, based on the reactions to the leak, if this secret lair superdrop is officially confirmed, it will be very popular with magic players. Besides the expected value of the drops, many fans online are praising the art and flavor on the cards, making an inevitable comparison with Magic: The Gathering — Star Trek, which got a much colder reception.

Berdasarkan laporan, dune: part three, the final movie in denis villeneuve's trilogy of dune movies, will come out on dec. 18, 2026. If this Secret Lair drop has been timed to coincide with the movie release, we can expect it around mid-December. If the leaks are real, it's also very likely that Wizards of the Coast will decide to reveal the drop officially soon.

Berdasarkan laporan, today marks 25 years since the launch of the original xbox. Sharma never says the words “artificial intelligence,” but it’s hard to imagine what else she could be gesturing at.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you might think sharma’s retrospective would start with how halo: combat evolved famously forced everyone to take microsoft’s directx box seriously as a contender in the console gaming space, but she actually begins way earlier, back with the creation of microsoft’s very first game. It was called Microsoft Adventure, and was released in 1979, roughly six years before Super Mario Bros.

Diungkapkan bahwa most gamers will be familiar with where the story went from there. Big console exclusives, cutting-edge tech, and the early adoption of networked gaming helped put Xbox neck-and-neck with PlayStation by the early 2010s. Sharma writes that there are 111 people still working across Xbox and its game studios who have been there for 25 years or more.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while modern games demonstrate the heights of human craft in ways unimaginable just decades ago, the cost, resources, and risk required to create them have grown just as dramatically. For decades, this has been the unavoidable tradeoff of ambition. As a result, too many ideas never become games, and too many games fall short of what their creators imagined. We must change this.
