But there is hope, Sharma suggests, and it sounds a lot like genAI.

Diungkapkan bahwa “throughout human history, the scale of what we could create was determined by the people, capital, and resources we could command,” sharma writes. “That relationship is beginning to break. A single person will soon be able to wield capabilities that once required entire nations. A small team will be able to build worlds that today demand hundreds of developers and hundreds of millions of dollars. And our largest studios will be able to pursue ambitions as far beyond todayâs games as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is from its first entry in 1982.

Berdasarkan laporan, this is the second time the xbox ceo has invoked the specter of seismic shifts in the video game industry without mentioning ai by name. In an October 16 blog post announcing the Xbox Labs experiment with vibe-coded projects, she pointed to the sudden influx of games being decompiled and ported to web browsers and various source codes being “remixed. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa most gamers will be familiar with this pitch. Old models will be upended and small, agile teams will thrive. We’ve heard it from Epic Games’ Tim Sweeney and other AI boosters in the space. But existing players like Microsoft and Epic Games will presumably still be hunting for ways to ride the new wave of AI-fueled creativity, or, depending on your point of view, slop.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i’m not sure that’s what the xbox fans who’ve stuck by the console platform for 25 years, especially during its recent decline, are looking forward to in the next 25 years. The only way to get the Golden Scale in Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake is to go to the Fishing Pond in East Lake Hylia as an adult, and catch a fish of 60cm or larger.

The fishing minigame costs 30 Rupees to play as an adult, but you can keep making fishing attempts until you have gotten a fish big enough, so effectively you need only ever pay once for this reward.

Sebagaimana diketahui, once you have the fish, make sure you choose to keep it, then bring it over to the fisherman who runs the pond and he'll give you the golden scale as a reward. The Golden Scale allows you to dive deeper than before. Most players will have the Silver Scale at this point, which allows a medium depth dive, acquired while trying to find Ruto in Zelda Ocarina of Time.

#86. How to raid other players in ROB RUN

📅 12 Nov 2026

How to raid other players in ROB RUN

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/how-to-raid-other-players-in-rob-run/

Sebagaimana diketahui, rob run has many ways for you to expand your criminal empire, and raiding other players is certainly a good strategy. While the method isn’t as easy as breaking into NPC houses, you can master the art by following some simple tips.

First, you need to obtain Breach Decoders.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the first task is to get the decoders, and there are different ways to get them. Uncommon Decoders are the easiest ones to get, and you can obtain them from cabinets, safes, and different containers. You can also find some from the Season 1 battle pass.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you want to have the epic decoder, you can obtain it by exchanging the uncommon variant. Go to Lenny’s Motel, and you’ll find a barter trader who will provide you with the item for $10,000.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you’re about to raid a player base, you’ll need to have multiple decoders. Unlike a house, a player base is a lot more complex when it comes to completing a breach. Each part requires a separate Decoder (or more than one) to gain entry.

In simple words, you’ll need to bring a Decoder for every base part that has a security system.

Berdasarkan laporan, completing a raid is pretty simple as long as you have the required decoders. You have to use them to strip away points from a security terminal until it hits zero. The number of points you have to strip varies across different parts.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sometimes, it feels like japan gets all the cool stuff. But it still feels like a minor tragedy. Each one had a monster near its base (Babble and Slime). All in all, despite the apparent lack of ambition, it’s like a warm mug of cocoa on a chilly day.

The system’s base itself is white with gray print, featuring an intricate design that is enhanced by a splotch of bright yellow “paint” on its left portion. The effect is very pretty, even if you aren’t super familiar with the IP.

Diungkapkan bahwa the best zelda games are mythical, with strange symbols and patterns scattered around hyrule, and that design translated beautifully to the system capturing the feel of the legend of zelda: tears of the kingdom. Berdasarkan laporan, the animal crossing: new horizons console proved difficult to acquire during the initial weeks following its release, largely because no one could have anticipated just what a monster success that game would become. #95. Best Hunter Pets in WoW Forever

📅 12 Nov 2026

Best Hunter Pets in WoW Forever

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/best-hunter-pets-in-wow-forever/

A Hunter isn't whole without their Pet, especially in WoW: Forever where Azeroth is a brave new frontier.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the hunter’s pet forms a core part of the hunter experience in world of warcraft: forever, with much of their toolkit heavily relying on these partners in combat. In fact, the Hunter has become quite the iconic WoW Class for being able to tame a huge part of the MMO’s bestiary, giving players literally hundreds of options for Pets.

But for those still leveling their Hunters or curious for what other kinds of Pets are awaiting them all over Azeroth, there are indeed some creatures you should tame and fight with in specific situations.

Diungkapkan bahwa when forever launched on nov. 4, Blizzard was quick to roll out a patch two days later (Nov. But on Nov. 6) to strengthen the ability of Hunter’s Pets to become semi-tanks, at least for the Hunters and smaller groups. 10, Blizzard rolled out a quick hotfix that streamlined some things about the Class:.

We’re keeping track of how these changes can affect the performance of Pets so far, and we’ll update this list as necessary.

Sebagaimana diketahui, hunters are dps characters by nature, and a lot of that damage is usually facilitated by their pets. And there are just some Pets that stand out among the rest as better damage dealers than their other counterparts. Cats are a standout here, as they’re among the most common Pet Families you can find as you level up.

Berdasarkan laporan, some iconic cats you could aim for would be broken tooth (badlands) and the rake (mulgore), but even the mountain lions in hillsbrad can perform well if you’re not gunning for a rare find. Raptors are a close second among recommended damage Pets as they share the same damage mod as the Cat, whereas the Gorilla has a decent AOE and the Scorpid has a stacking Poison.

Read what’s behind the latest news in gaming (with a bit of snark) by subscribing to the Destructoid Checkpoint newsletter!.

Berdasarkan laporan, hunter’s pets don’t make good tanks, unlike traditional tanking classes. With the right Pet Family, a Pet could still provide decent protection to your Hunter while you’re adventuring. Granted, they’re not as strong as we would want a “tanking” Pet to be, but these can take a beating and give a beating of their own.

Berdasarkan laporan, boars remain the best first pets as they stun and give an attack boost to their next hit. If you level up Beast Mastery with the Boar, it might just be a long-term Pet. Meanwhile, Turtles and Crabs have the best defense stats among all Pets.

Sebagaimana diketahui, say you want to tag along with a party but want to offer something other than having an extra member (your pet) in tow. Then try to bring any one of these Pet Families in your dungeoning or leveling session. The idea here is that they’re not solely focused on dealing damage, but rather supporting the team in some capacity.

Berdasarkan laporan, in this case, bring a wolf to bolster everyone’s melee attack power. But if you feel you already have enough buffs, then a Carrion Bird to lower the enemy’s attack or a Tallstrider to lower the enemy’s armor could be more practical options.

Sebagaimana diketahui, contrary to popular belief, the hunter’s pet should not focus on tanking in pvp, but rather on some form of control. The ideal PvP Pet should usually fit your current target at the moment, or if you’re unequipped to deal with a particular threat that you feel your Pet could help with.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, spiders usually win, as the 4-second rooting can be debilitating for most rotations and setups. If you prefer chasing down targets, then Hyenas and Crabs can slow them enough to leave them vulnerable.

Berdasarkan laporan, there might be situations when you prefer to not really play with a hunter’s pet. Maybe you feel they’re just bringing you down, or you prefer the damage numbers when you’re performing solo.

Berdasarkan laporan, you can perfectly go solo as a marksmanship hunter, courtesy of the lone wolf talent. Getting this Talent gives you a 20% boost to all attacks as long as you don’t have an active Pet.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "some of the best games of the last decade came from teams of 50, not 500. Black Forest Games is one of them, and the right studio to launch Third Signal. Berdasarkan laporan, it doesn't sound like black forest split with the rights to the destroy all humans series or its permanently mean alien protag crypto, but the studio has said it's still working with thq nordic in some capacity. #99. Microsoft Thinks Xbox 'Pioneered' Dual Analogue Controllers

📅 12 Nov 2026

Microsoft Thinks Xbox 'Pioneered' Dual Analogue Controllers

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/11/microsoft-thinks-xbox-pioneered-dual-analogue-controllers

It’s a big month for Xbox as it celebrates its 25th anniversary, with lots of entertaining initiatives underway – including a pretty cool website where it tracks your entire history with the brand.

But in a big – and otherwise interesting – celebratory blog post, boss Asha Sharma appears to have mixed up some of the facts.

Writing about the original Xbox, which launched 15th November 2001, she claims the console “pioneered dual analogue controllers”.

It’s obviously not a big deal, but this is blatantly not true.

While the Xbox innovated in a number ways – namely including a hard drive and ethernet port, which paved the way for the industry changing Xbox Live – dual analogue controllers had already been introduced four years earlier with the PS1.

While it’s true the DualShock wasn’t originally included with Sony’s console as standard, that changed with the PS2’s release in 2000, over a year before the original Xbox arrived.

I wondered whether Sharma may have meant to write “dual analogue triggers” here, but that’s also not true; the Dreamcast’s controller, for example, introduced pressure-sensitive triggers as early as 1999.

So, I’m not exactly sure what Microsoft thinks it invented here, but it sure wasn’t dual analogue controllers!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, yes, this relates to the symmetrical design. The origins of that design stem from the early days on PS1, where most games used digital direction control, and only a few supported analogue.

Hence Sony "tacked on" the Left-Stick in the secondary position and retained the D-Pad in the optimum ergonomic position for primary directional control, just as it was located on the original digital PS1 controller.

Everyone else (Nintendo/Microsoft) later swapped the D-Pad to the secondary position and the directional analogue stick to the primary position when it became clear that analogue control was now the majority control method for almost all games.

In that regard Microsoft were likely the first to release a fully prioritised, dedicated, dual-analogue design.

Technically speaking Sega were the first to place the directional stick in the primary position and shift the D-Pad to secondary (I don't count N64's weird design), but of course the DC only had the one stick.

As Sharma was talking about dual sticks, I'd therefore give it to her on a technicality, given that to me I don't feel Sony have released the finished optimised product yet.

From the creators of the Cook, Serve, Delicious franchise comes Cook, Serve, Delicious: Re-Mustard!—a brand new take on the original Cook, Serve, Delicious! game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, whether you’re a long time fan, or you’ve never played a cook, serve, delicious! game before, this is the game for you. Here’s what we’re serving up!.

#101. Amid soaring PC hardware prices, gaming monitors are getting cheaper and cheaper. Here's why, and what to buy

📅 12 Nov 2026

Amid soaring PC hardware prices, gaming monitors are getting cheaper and cheaper. Here's why, and what to buy

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/amid-soaring-pc-hardware-prices-gaming-monitors-are-getting-cheaper-and-cheaper-heres-why-and-what-to-buy

Berdasarkan laporan, hello, good local-time-zone-adjusted afternoon, and let's just say it's been a while. But I come back to you now at the turn of the technological tide. Sadly I'm not here to predict an end to the ridiculous AI-fuelled chip crisis. Well, sort of. That whole mess has a couple of years to run, surely.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, instead i speak of screens, where there is actually some very good news. I'm talking £60 / $60 for an entry-level 1080p panel with triple-digit refresh rate, sub-£200 / $250 for high-refresh 4K gaming. In short, have you seen how cheap PC gaming monitors are? I mean remarkably, almost stupendously, cheap. Heck, even OLED monitors now start with a "2" in both currencies.

Sebagaimana diketahui, also bear in mind we've had a fair old bit of inflation in recent years. All the while, that same £200 / $200 right now won't buy you a current-model gaming graphics card at all, even the most feeble example, and will barely secure a basic dual-channel 16GB DDR5 memory kit. A 4K panel bought today for £200 is equivalent to paying roughly £150 back in 2020. Youch.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so, i think we can all agree monitors are cheap in the current chip-catastrophe context. The immediate question is why? The answer isn't all that complicated, actually. Most obviously, the display market isn't being devoured by the AI craze. All those data centres are stuffed with GPUs, memory chips and NAND flash, not monitors.

Sebagaimana diketahui, by way of example, one of the largest new ai data centres on earth is microsoft's new fairwater site in mount pleasant, wisconsin. In other words, they have no screens at all. The cost doesn't bear thinking about, but those GPUs are built into what's known as "headless" server racks. It's thought to pack hundreds of thousands of Nvidia Blackwell GPUs. Ultimately, the key compute hardware is all managed remotely, in which capacity the Fairwater facility is reported to currently have around 375 employees. If we generously assume each has two PC monitors, that's only 750 for the entire site.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ai isn't really driving demand on the end-user side of the equation, either. At the same time, the display market is suffering from something of a glut of overcapacity. Chinese companies built out huge capacity in LCD panel manufacturing over the past decade, to the extent factories are now running underutilised. Put it this way: you don't need to buy a new phone, laptop or PC to access the latest models. Meanwhile, even the OLED market is arguably oversupplied.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in fact, samsung and lg, the two big noises in large oled panel manufacturing (as opposed to oled displays for tablets and phones), have been shifting emphasis away from tv panels to pc monitors because the latter offer better margins. Long story short, that's oodles of capacity combined with weakening demand. Meanwhile, the AI boom has almost definitely meant lower demand for new PCs. Certainly, the big research houses point to cratering PC sales thanks to higher component costs. Like I said, the explanation for cheap monitors isn't exactly rocket surgery, if you know what I mean.

Diungkapkan bahwa what is a bit more complicated is making sense of what's available today in the gaming monitor market. With so much choice, where exactly is the very best value to be found? And are there any remaining pain points?.

Diungkapkan bahwa monitor specifications, to be sure, can be tricksy at the best of times. Look for, at minimum, 300 nits brightness and 1ms response times. But if you're looking for some blanket rules to fling casually over the whole LCD monitor market - I'll be digging deeper into OLED tech another day - try these for size. Refresh rates are a slightly more complicated call, but for the vast majority of games, 144Hz is plenty. For "esports-grade multiplayer fare like Counter-Strike or Dota 2, or I think a refresh in the high 200s will get the job done for most. If you'll benefit from more than that, you almost certainly know who you are already.

Sebagaimana diketahui, oh, and heavily favour ips over va panels. But a lot of the cheaper stuff is pretty slow and smeary, making VA a risky buy. Finally, don't worry too much about claimed HDR capability, save for the fact that HDR 400 certification at least means the monitor can do 400 nits. Exceptions exist: there are some decent "Rapid VA" panels these days and Samsung, in particular, does some nippy VA models. Unless a monitor has local dimming, it won't be truly HDR capable.

Berdasarkan laporan, anywho, one immediate and rather ironic issue is the growing mismatch between monitors and gpus. For sure, it's great you can grab a high-refresh 4K monitor for such little money. It's almost hard to believe that you can have this 27-inch IPS MSI for sub-£200 (you're looking at $250 for the same model in the US), and it even has a 288Hz 1080p dual mode.

Berdasarkan laporan, i actually favour 32 inches with my 4k gaming, and that's naturally a little pricier, especially if you insist on an ips - which again, you probably should. But even $350 for that kind of panel (here's a comparable model for £340 in the UK) is a fraction of what you'd have paid for a similarly specced model a few years ago. And it probably wouldn't have included dual-mode functionality.

Sebagaimana diketahui, here's the problem, though. How are you going to drive the thing, what with its eight million-plus pixels? After all, the cheapest RTX 5090 on Newegg right now is over $6,500. So high-end Nvidia GPUs now cost about as much as a decent used car.

Berdasarkan laporan, of course, you might be surprised just how effective the likes of an amd rx 9070 xt or nvidia rtx 5070-class gpu is at 4k thanks to upscaling technologies including dlss and fsr. The latest transformer model upscalers really do knock out pretty stellar image quality. Add in a bit of frame gen and you have a compelling combination of visual sharpness, reasonably low latency and nice smoothframe rates, even in the most demanding of games. Perhaps the one thing you can't do is enable full path tracing in a game like Cyberpunk 2077 and still expect a slick experience, but standard ray tracing remains an option.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the bigger snag, unsurprisingly, is that you can no longer bag a 5070 at (let alone below) its original £539 / $549 msrp. Instead, you're looking at the thick end of £800 / $900. That's a bit of an ask for pairing with a £200 monitor, isn't it?.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'd therefore argue that, for pure gaming purposes, the bang-for-buck sweet spot remains just where it's been sat twiddling its thumbs for the better part of a decade, namely 1440p. That applies to both its vanilla 16:9 aspect variety and my personally preferred ultrawide format, the latter being so very immersive and also pretty nifty for daily multi-tasking. Indeed, the 27-inch 1440p segment even brings the vibrant colours and infinite contrast of OLED panels into a reasonably affordable window.

Diungkapkan bahwa by way of example, £179 (or $150) is enough for a circa 200hz, ips 1440p panel with super low (by ips standards) pixel response, even if the 250-nit brightness is lower than i'd like. Meanwhile, as I write these words, pricing for big-brand 27-inch 1440p gaming OLEDs kicks off at about £290 in the UK and roughly $270 in the US. Admittedly, those entry-level OLEDs come with some compromises, which I'll cover in a forthcoming post. But what you might call 'proper' OLED panels can be had around the low £300 / $300 mark - not throw-away money, for sure, but relatively accessible.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the 34-inch 1440p ultrawide segment is a bit trickier, however. The good news is that conventional LCD models can be had for relative peanuts, with prices starting at about £220 or $249 for game-focused, high-refresh models. But those two example both use a VA panel, which usually means inferior pixel response.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ips models are a little thin on the ground when it comes to 34-inch ultrawide, but sneaking in below £300 / $300 is generally possible. The real bummer is OLED, where going ultrawide invokes a massive premium. The best price I can find on a big-brand 34-inch ultrawide today is $629 for this Asus model in the US and £648 for this MSI option in the UK.

Diungkapkan bahwa that's awfully toppy, especially when you consider that you can grab a 49-inch, 5,120x1,440 ultrawide oled for barely any more money. I do actually quite like those 49-inch ultrawides, but I have to concede the ergonomics are challenging. However, 4K OLEDs in 27-inch and 32-inch formats can also be had for as much as £100 / $100 less than the current cheapest 34-inch 1440p ultrawides, which doesn't make much sense to me.

Berdasarkan laporan, again, with 4k, there's the challenge of keeping all those pixels updated. If you already have a sufficiently mighty graphics card, though, I a 32-inch 4K OLED can make a fantastic all-round option, and something like this MSI model for £549 would be absolutely lovely. You get good pixel density and lots of space for daily desktopping, plus OLED visuals and a large enough panel to be really get you into your games.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's just a pity that 34-inch oled ultrawides remain so weirdly expensive, it being a format that ticks so many different boxes. As for my own personal money-no-object pick, well, I'm typing these words on the new Alienware AW3926QW, the 39-inch 5K2K beast with a Tandem WOLED panel and RGB subpixels.

Diungkapkan bahwa one could argue it's a relative steal at £1,079 or $1,100. I mean, it's pretty much peak current PC gaming display technology, and it's about half the price of what Nvidia's second-tier RTX 5080 graphics card is going for lately. Assuming you can even find one in stock.

Berdasarkan laporan, at this point, the one major category i haven't covered is lcd monitors with mini-led full-array local dimming. The detailed reasons for that are, perhaps, the subject for another day. Cards on the table, I'm not a huge fan of mini-LED monitors. But I've reviewed countless models and have yet to see one that didn't come with pretty serious compromises.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that said, the technology has gotten a lot more accessible in the last 12 to 18 months, to the extent that 27-inch 1440p models start at just over $250. I've had that specific model in and came away pretty impressed. It's very, very punchy, and even factoring in the limitations of mini-LED versus OLED when it comes to lighting control and speed, I cannot deny the temptation.

Diungkapkan bahwa just for completeness, one further exception to the general rule of cheap gaming monitors involves ultra-high refresh monitors aimed at serious esports aficionados. I'm talking about panels like this 1,000Hz LG I sampled elsewhere. At £800 / $1,000 for a 25-inch 1080p IPS panel it's inevitably a niche proposition, and poor value by normal standards.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i think a much better compromise for just about everyone, short of an actual esports pro, is to grab a larger, higher resolution monitor that offers one of those windowed 1080p modes running at about 500hz or thereabouts. That way you've got a nice high-res panel for both work and play, as well as that ultra-low latency mode for when you want to dance around Dust 2 doling out the headshots or whatever.

Berdasarkan laporan, incidentally, i realise i've gone in a bit hot and heavy with the oled content here, the implicit assumption being oled is all that, and notably without addressing the obvious objections like the risk of burn-in. But all that, I hope you'll be pleased to hear, is very much the subject for my next RPS post on all things OLED.

Berdasarkan laporan, until then, all i can say is thank goodness pc monitors provide relative respite from the parlous state of much of the rest of the pc component market. It's absolutely brutal out there if you're building a gaming PC, but at least you'll get a lot of screen for your money.

Just to round things out, if anyone has any specific queries at any given price point, form factor or panel type, shout out below and I'll try to steer you in the direction of a decent model.

#102. 5 Sci-Fi Book Trilogies Where Every Entry Is Perfect

📅 13 Nov 2026

5 Sci-Fi Book Trilogies Where Every Entry Is Perfect

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/sci-fi-trilogy-perfect-entries/

The best sci-fi stories come in groups of three.

Sebagaimana diketahui, trilogies are a popular book format for a reason. Apart from naturally satisfying the rule of three, they also naturally mimic the classic structure of a beginning, middle, and end. The same logic is particularly true for science fiction. Trilogies allow writers to flesh out their worlds, creating enough breathing room for genre concepts and important events. Dystopian sci-fi books like The Hunger Games use the trilogy structure to map out the painstaking moving parts of a rebellion, while the Broken Earth science-fantasy trilogy encompasses a massive supercontinent full of complex lore.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of course, not all sci-fi trilogies are created equal. Polygon has rounded up five sci-fi book trilogies that are worth your time from start to finish. Plenty start strong only to flame out in book two or three, while others admittedly take a while to get good. But there are plenty of perfect trilogies, too. Check out the list below.

Berdasarkan laporan, william gibson’s neuromancer is often at the forefront of brilliant cyberpunk book lists, given how foundational the text is for the genre. The first novel drops the reader in the midst of a bustling, neon-tinted city, where a console cowboy (hacker) named Case is forced into pulling off a heist in exchange for his continued survival. Its sequels, Count Zero and Mona Lisa Overdrive, tend to get overlooked in the process, even though these entries are as exceptional as Neuromancer. A sentient AI named Wintermute emerges as an antagonist, with Count Zero detailing the aftermath of the heist, and Mona Lisa Overdrive exposing the rotten core of a hyper-technological world.

Berdasarkan laporan, sprawl is the definition of “show, don’t tell. ” This is a double-edged sword, as Gibson’s vivid prose can often feel more sensory than descriptive, making it unsuited for brisk reading. Sprawl is also a bleak, uncompromising look at corporate oppression, a sentiment that has inspired the core conflict in everything from The Matrix to Cyberpunk 2077. On the contrary, it invites the reader to decipher context cues and retains interest with strong character portraits. This doesn’t mean Sprawl isn’t immersive. This aspect is substantial enough, but Sprawl drives it home with a reflective ending that makes human presence irrelevant to the progress of machine intelligence.

Berdasarkan laporan, although isaac asimov added two sequels and two prequels to the foundation novel series after 1953, the core concept was conceived as a trilogy. Seldon foresees the fall of the Empire, a lengthy dark age, and the eventual rise of a second empire. These novels — Foundation, Foundation and Empire, and Second Foundation — are set in the final days of a Galactic Empire, where mathematician Hari Seldon uses a special technique called psychohistory to predict the future. He decides to shorten the projected number of years between the rise and fall of a dynasty.

Sebagaimana diketahui, asimov’s narrative scope in the foundation novels is massive. The novels follow the fall of a 12,000-year-old Galactic Empire, which has been shaped by sociopolitical factors that cannot be erased by history on a whim. Seldon’s plan to shorten the duration of the dark age is grand and unprecedented, but it is one that causes repeated issues over time. For Seldon, history becomes a malleable timeline instead of a fixed inevitability, which has its repercussions on the galaxy at large. The math, although solid, contains variables that were previously unaccounted for, turning the Foundation trilogy into a tense psychological mystery that plays by the rules of sci-fi.

Berdasarkan laporan, liu cixin creates a dense, compelling case for the limits of human nature and how these limits can be overcome through cold logic. These complicated events begin with a disillusioned young woman named Ye Wenjie, who dooms humanity by inviting an alien race known as the Trisolarans to invade the planet. Cixin’s Three-Body Problem offers a solid base for this idea, which turns into a full-blown conversation about civilizational entropy and cosmic forces in The Dark Forest and Death’s End. As the Trisolarans experience a vicious cycle of destruction and rebirth due to the three suns that orbit their system, Earth becomes both a source of salvation and a target for colonization.

Diungkapkan bahwa remembrance of earth’s past is full of promising characters like wang miao and luo ji, but cixin is more interested in representing humanity as a collective species. Not only are we horribly underprepared to deal with such a crisis, but we are also destined to perish according to the laws of science. This leaves us vulnerable to threats of a cosmic scale. Although internal differences remain, humanity is fundamentally driven by a need to survive, but this impulse is short-term. This fragility is at the core of Remembrance of Earth’s Past, which argues that the only way to adapt is to keep transcending at the cost of leaving our “human” identities behind.

Diungkapkan bahwa formerly known as the xenogenesis trilogy, octavia e. Butler’s Lilith’s Brood comprises Dawn, Adulthood Rites, and Imago. The story opens with a woman named Lilith being unable to recall her past, although she vaguely remembers a planet-wide catastrophic event and an accident that killed her family. Over time, Lilith realizes that an alien race known as the Oankali rescued a few survivors from an irradiated Earth, leaving humanity no choice but to evolve into a completely different species.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lilith’s brood is a radical inversion of traditional “first contact” sci-fi tales. Instead, they propose a genetic trade, giving humans the choice to “upgrade” themselves, although this freedom to choose feels like an illusion. Earth is already uninhabitable, so the Oankali aren’t interested in inheriting a new planet or ruling over its people. The Oankali perceive humanity as paranoid, self-destructive beings who are also capable of high intelligence and deep empathy. This contradiction is at the heart of the series, as we’re left to wonder whether a forced evolution makes humanity lose these traits to the point that they become unrecognizable in their own eyes.

Diungkapkan bahwa a sprawling look at the settlement and terraforming of mars, kim stanley robinson’s mars trilogy offers hard sci-fi realism. The science is mostly authentic, as Robinson is more preoccupied with the nuanced developments made on Mars while the condition on Earth deteriorates due to overpopulation and environmental disasters. The books (Red Mars, Blue Mars, and Green Mars) follow a group of colonists who are part of a joint American-Russian undertaking, and how they manage to build their first settlement on Mars and its hollowed-out moon.

Diungkapkan bahwa the mars trilogy is a multi-generational look at the rise of a new society. Even in the absence of conflict, humans are entangled in their own unique problems, which the books unravel with the same interest as they do the scientific aspects of the resettlement. Rebuilding society from scratch is no walk in the park; the planet’s terrain proves to be a challenge, along with continental ice-melt floods. There’s also the human aspect of it all, as such a high-stakes project comes with conflict. A rapidly declining Earth also becomes the point of focus, as the comparatively utopian life on Mars reminds humans how they ruined a perfectly hospitable planet tailor-made for their survival.

Berdasarkan laporan, get it — and thousands of other titles — read aloud with audible. Pick the plan that works for you.

Diungkapkan bahwa we want to hear from you. Share your perspective in the comments below, and please keep the conversation respectful.

Sebagaimana diketahui, asimov was a very plodding writer. He did have some good ideas, but was consistently let down by his leaden prose.

In addition, large chunks of Foundation were simply ripped off from the history of 6th century Byzantium.

Berdasarkan laporan, intergalactic: the heretic prophet is in the final stage of production according to neil druckmann. He describes it as a combination of Jak and Daxter, Uncharted, and The Last of Us:"We used to have another game franchise called Jak & Daxter […] And with this one, we really….

However, the director said some TLOU and Uncharted DNA definitely went into the creation of Intergalactic, with that game being “a combination” of Jack & Dexter and these two mentioned IPs. Berdasarkan laporan, “we really wanted to expand our deep gameplay systems. Like, can we sustain the kind of cinematic storytelling we’re used to telling and go even deeper with gameplay,”.

#109. "One of those ways where you can use AI ethically": CDPR have modified Geralt's Polish voice in The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past with genAI, due to actor's stroke

📅 12 Nov 2026

"One of those ways where you can use AI ethically": CDPR have modified Geralt's Polish voice in The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past with genAI, due to actor's stroke

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/one-of-those-ways-where-you-can-use-ai-ethically-cdpr-have-modified-geralts-polish-voice-in-the-witcher-3-songs-of-the-past-with-genai-due-to-actors-stroke

Jacek Rozenek reportedly gave his blessing.

Diungkapkan bahwa cd projekt red have reportedly enlisted ukrainian ai firm respeecher to modify voice lines recorded for the polish version of geralt of rivia in the witcher 3's upcoming songs of the past expansion. The move's been made with the permission of Geralt's Polish voice actor, Jacek Rozenek, and is rooted in the studio wanting his new lines to sound similar to the ones he recorded for the original game prior to having a stroke which has altered how he sounds.

Sebagaimana diketahui, game file report that after suffering a stroke in 2019 and having to rehabilitate his speech, rozenek was able to record some lines as geralt for a quest in the witcher 3's 2022 next-gen update, but that doing so left the actor "so exhausted". With next year's Songs of the Past expansion, CD Projekt Red were seemingly more concerned about making sure lines recorded by post-stroke Rozenek don't sound markedly different to those he recorded a decade ago for the base game and its existing expansions.

Berdasarkan laporan, after a meeting between the two sides confirmed that rozenek's voice had grown lower and gruffer due to some combination of the stroke and him simply getting older, the studio made the decision not to recast the actor, but instead let modify respeecher modify his lines to make them sound closer to those original recordings. "I have great trust. for the creators of this game. Rozenek reportedly gave his blessing for this to go ahead. "The point is that this voice should be as close as possible to my voice from 12 years ago," he told Game File. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, this isn't the first time cd projekt red have enlisted respeecher's services. Reczek died in 2021 before he could reprise his role as Vektor for the DLC, so rather than recasting the character across the whole game to avoid noticeable differences in voice, CD Projekt got another actor to voice Vektor's new lines for Phantom Liberty, then used the genAI tech to make those lines sound like Reczek was delivering them. Back in 2023, it was revealed that the studio had used speech synthesis software to make ripperdoc Viktor Vektor's lines in the Polish version of Cyberpunk 2077's Phantom Liberty expansion sound like actor Miłogost Reczek. CD Projekt Red said at the time that they'd gotten permission from Reczek's family before going ahead with their plan.

Sebagaimana diketahui, speaking to game file about this latest use of genai on rozenek's songs of the past lines, cd projekt localisation producer mikołaj szwed noted that "as a person working with voice actors over all the regions in the world, this is a big concern". "I do think this is one of those ways where you can use AI ethically, with consent and also to do something good," he added. The argument the studio are making at current is that this was "a special case" due to Rozenek's specific situation with Songs of the Past.

Geralt's English voice actor Doug Cockle reportedly won't have his lines for the new expansion get the same genAI treatment, nor will any lines Rozenek records for future Witcher games, with the studio seemingly happy to lean on the passage of in-game time as an explanation for Geralt sounding different in the latter case.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as ever, there's a debate to be had as to whether cd projekt red should have simply recast rozenek's role in songs of the past if the difference bothered them so, possibly while bringing the actor on to help tutor whomever his human replacement for songs of the past would be in nailing the exact gravelly tone needed for geralt. That way, you'd have two actors being paid for work rather than forking out for genAI instead of one of them, though it's possibly an idea that'd only work well in theory. If I were Rozenek I'm not sure I'd be totally happy aiding someone who could potentially be tapped to replace me going forwards, though it does very much seem like the lesser of two evils when compared to the potential of voice actors being replaced by genAI line readings.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as far as the game alone is concerned, i'm also not sure geralt's voice being different in the new expansion is something that'd bother me too much when playing. One would assume he'd not suddenly be sounding like a member of Alvin and the Chipmunks, and there are plenty of storyline justifications you could concoct or lean on for him sounding that bit gruffer at times.

Each has leaned toward more adult themes with gothic narrative undertones, while still focusing heavily on family dynamics. The studio’s hand-crafted puppetry and 3D-printing technology have brought beautiful tales to life for years, from Coraline to Kubo and the Two Strings. The same is true of Laika’s most recent outing, Travis Knight’s ethereal fantasy epic, Wildwood.

Sebagaimana diketahui, yet as much a technical and emotional achievement as wildwood has proven to be, you don’t need to head to your local theater to see laika's best animated film. All you need to do is go to YouTube, where Tim Burton’s masterful 2005 Corpse Bride is streaming right now, for free.

Berdasarkan laporan, directed by tim burton and mike johnson, corpse bride follows victor van dort (johnny depp) and his arranged marriage to victoria everglot (emily watson). But the “branch” is actually the finger of an undead bride, Emily (Helena Bonham Carter), who immediately assumes they’re engaged. After a terrible rehearsal dinner, Victor heads to the woods to practice his vows. Without thinking, he says them aloud and slips his ring onto what he believes is a tree branch sticking out from the ground. Victor is soon dragged into the land of the dead, where he comes face-to-face with its inhabitants.

Diungkapkan bahwa if the story sounds familiar, there’s a reason. ” In this tale, set in Russia rather than Victorian England, the young bridegroom also makes the same mistake as Victor, slipping his wedding ring onto a corpse's finger as he recites his vows. Burton was open about the fact that Corpse Bride was based on “The Finger”, a Jewish tale by author Howard Schwartz, and featured in “Lilith’s Cave: Jewish Tales of the Supernatural. The bride falls to pieces into a pile of bones, and the groom goes on to live his life as if nothing ever happened. However, instead of helping the undead bride find peace, the groom takes his dead spouse to a local rabbi, who annuls the marriage because his wife is dead. C’est la vie.

Berdasarkan laporan, that transition from a jewish folktale to a mainstream gothic fairy tale brought many changes. That meant Emily, the undead bride, found a more peaceful, fulfilling end, while Victor became more empathetic. As macabre and unsettling as Burton’s productions can be, he is undoubtedly a creator whose endings usually have a sweet quality — bitter or otherwise. It made sense: no matter how terrifying some of Burton’s films might seem, they usually target a family-friendly, universal audience.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “we wanted to make a version that wasn’t so disturbing that you couldn’t put it in a family movie,” corpse bride’s co-screenwriter john august explained in an interview with jewish journal. As for the setting and the change to non-Jewish characters, August said Burton gravitates toward “universal, fairy-tale qualities in his films. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, much about corpse bride was a first for many of the film's cast and crew. Burton, for example, had produced many stop-motion animated films before, such as The Nightmare Before Christmas (1993) and James and the Giant Peach (1996). Corpse Bride was Burton's first stop-motion directing credit, though he mostly took a backseat as co-director due to simultaneously working on Charlie and the Chocolate Factory. This left Johnson to take what he describes as a more “organic” approach to directing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “tim knew where he wanted the film to go as far as the emotional tone and story points to hit,” johnson explained in an interview with creative planet network. “My job was to work with the crew on a daily basis and get the footage as close as possible to how I thought he wanted it. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa burton still had exclusive control over storyboards, concepts, and scenes, and each one had to be reviewed and approved before johnson could say it was finished. But for the meat of production, Johnson was in charge.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, johnson being in charge, however, didn’t mean that corpse bride lost burton’s distinct style. Even his less well-received works, such as his Alice in Wonderland adaptations, feature a clear visual divide that makes the contrast appealing while still conveying his distinctly Burton-esque style. Burton has never shied away from his macabre, stark aesthetic. The Red Queen’s castle, for example, looks and feels very different from the Mad Hatter’s tea party.

Sebagaimana diketahui, burton’s use of contrast makes corpse bride an enigma at first. Ironically, true life begins only when we reach the land of the dead: an explosion of yellow, green, blue, and red. Everything seems the same: the world of the living is steeped in dreary gray and black, making every character appear miserable and depleted by the world they inhabit. The dead have more life and music, truly living as they wish, with the freedom death has granted them.

Berdasarkan laporan, as for laika, the stop-motion studio co-produced corpse bride as its first official project after current ceo and wildwood director travis knight took over what had been will vinton studios. Four years later, it released its debut feature, the very Burton-esque Coraline, directed by Henry Selick, before charting its own course as a leading stop-motion studio. Years later, every Laika project still carries a hint of Burton's childlike wonder and gothic beauty.

Sebagaimana diketahui, flipping audiences’ expectations of what they'll see has always been a signature trait of both burton and laika. As one of the highest-grossing animated films of all time, Corpse Bride’s success makes it easy to see why it remains so beloved more than 20 years later.

Corpse Bride is available to stream on HBO Max now.

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/after-being-laid-off-by-microsoft-former-doom-devs-found-new-smash-tv-influenced-fps-studio-that-isnt-subject-to-investor-demands

Their first project: televised deathgame shooter Danger Pay.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, back in july, doom developers id software laid off around a hundred people as part of wider microsoft blood-letting. Now, a few of those devs have founded a new employee-owned studio, Hidden Horses. Their first project is Danger Pay, a single-player FPS influenced by ancient arcade blaster Smash TV (pictured) and dystopian movies such as deadly gameshow fable The Running Man – itself an influence on Smash TV.

Sebagaimana diketahui, hidden horses have 20 id software alumni on the books, including former lead vfx artist todd boyce, principal engine programmer dustin land, senior ai and gameplay engineer daniel young, producer andrew willis, senior technical designer jordan turner, principal technical designer tim locke, and senior skybox artist allison dombek. They're looking to make "the kind of old school shooters that we think people want more of," in Land's words.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, all members of hidden horses own a share of the company, with bosses "democratically" appointed, in the words of a faq. "Our structure is quite flat, and we elect leaders when needed," Willis told Vertical Slice in a separate interview. "Financially, this means we are not subject to investor demands and the preservation of the company and the jobs it sustains is paramount over needless growth and our 'capital' doesn't compete for returns with other potential investments. ".

All of which is obviously gesturing towards the horse elephant in the room: Microsoft, who've made enormous cuts to their Xbox biz in their eagerness to further supercharge their $4 trillion market value.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we've replicated some things, changed some things, and added others [from our id software days]," willis went on. "Overall, I think top-down hierarchy is something we all have bad experiences with—we also don't want to trend chase or make a game by focus group. We want to make the kinds of classic gameplay focused games that we would play ourselves. We think there is a market for that and our experiences with the gaming community in our past work history informs that. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, willis's hope is that the "flat" structure will motivate staff to work harder, because they feel like they have a meaningful say over the company's direction. "It allows all ideas to be considered and means we don't miss out on any contributions from our employees just because they don't sit high up in some arbitrary hierarchy," he said.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm cynical about "flat" company structures, myself. I think they are very often just an excuse for the biggest egos in a company to throw their weight around. "We want to create a vehicle that allows us to make games for our livelihoods, not to make crazy profits and get 100x returns," Willis went on. It can work given a friendly initial mix of founders, but it gets complicated when you start hiring new people who don't have the same chemistry. Mind you, there are no plans to expand the company dramatically for the foreseeable. I wish Hidden Horses the best of luck with it all. The studio founders are currently working on some promotional initiatives to drum up support, including a studio documentary and *squints* a promotional beer? Still, I'm happy to hear that at least a few Cacodemon wranglers jettisoned by the big M have landed on their hooves feet. I'm also a bit leery of the fact that Hidden Horses have popped up a Kickstarter, because I'm leery about crowd-funding in general, even when Peter Molyneux isn't involved. As for Danger Pay, proper screens, footage and release details are to follow.

Diungkapkan bahwa good fun corp, the studio made up of the original developers behind hell let loose, has finally announced a release date for its anticipated next project: hunger. The extraction shooter-slasher game enters early access on Steam on 3rd December, and there's good news if you're eager to try it out before then.

Diungkapkan bahwa hunger's first and only open beta has also been announced, taking place 27th-29th november, the weekend prior to its early access launch. Unlike past tests, this one is available for anyone who requests access on Steam.

Sebagaimana diketahui, though it may appear as yet another extraction shooter on the surface, hunger offers more complex and intertwined systems than most. For one, combat has a focus on melee with only a few intentionally clunky firearms available. Though this is a PvPvE game, the vs environment side includes the sort of puzzle-solving, questing and dungeon-raiding typical of RPGs. The game's alternate history, plague-ravaged European setting gives it a grimey, steel-and-mud look few games have.

Beyond the in-match experience, Good Fun's ambitions extend to Hunger's MMO-style progression, its hub area with distinct characters and varied playable classes - all of which can be sampled in the upcoming beta.

Sebagaimana diketahui, hunger just came off a very successful closed beta, which clearly didn't suffer by kicking off right alongside modern warfare 4's dmz early access. Hunger is currently among Steam's most-wishlisted games, with over 700,000 wishlists, according to the developer.

Berdasarkan laporan, the launch version includes three large maps, six playable characters, and five mastery trees with more than 100 masteries to unlock for your characters. Hunger has only been announced for PC so far, but will presumably arrive on consoles following its early access journey.

Nintendo Switch 2The Legend of ZeldaThe Legend of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time.

Berdasarkan laporan, want 100 gold skulltulas in the legend of zelda: ocarina of time remake, but don’t want to track all of them down? well, that’s a weird thing to want, but if you’re sure, someone has found a way to make one specific gold skulltula regenerate infinitely by replicating a glitch from the original game…with a bit of extra work added. It’s time consuming and roundabout, but it seems to really work!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the original ocarina of time, you could get as many gold skulltula tokens as you wanted by visiting a grotto outside of hyrule castle that’s opened by playing the song of storms on a plant. Inside, there’s a Gold Skulltula behind a bombable wall that child Link can defeat at a distance with a boomerang, and then use the boomerang again to collect the token. However, if you used the boomerang to collect the token as you exit the room via the flower elevator, you’ll collect the token on your way out, but the Skulltula itself will be there waiting for you if you reenter the grotto, allowing you to collect the token again and again, infinitely, in the same way.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this glitch’s replication was first noted by reddit use wrong-kangaroo-4352 almost a week ago, but without much detail as to how to make it work. A few commenters at the time pointed out that doing the original method as-is wasn’t working for them:.

101 gold skulltulas ð byu/Wrong-Kangaroo-4352 inOcarinaOfTime.

They said that they tried to replicate this glitch with the same grotto and steps, but initially thought that it had been patched out, because when they reentered the grotto, the Gold Skulltula was gone. They returned, and sure enough, the Skulltula was back!.

Infinitely Regenerating Skulltula Token in Hyrule Castle byu/theletter454 inOcarinaOfTime.

Berdasarkan laporan, what theletter454 has worked out, along with some help from folks in the comments, is that the loading zones need to be completely reset for the gold skulltula to reappear. So while a bit more time-consuming than just leaving and reentering the grotto, the fundamentals of the glitch remain intact. This means doing something like swapping back and forth between adult and child Link, or warping to areas with different loading zones, like Lake Hylia. And yes, you can just load up on 100 Skulltulas this way if you’re short some, though the game’s counter won’t let you bring the number above 101.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as one commenter points out, nintendo developers including satoru iwata, when working on the 2011 3ds remake, talked about deliberately leaving in certain bugs from the original, because some of the staff who played the original game thought they were fun and a core part of the experience. It’s entirely possible that the same thought process happened here too, especially given that this glitch is ultimately pretty harmless.

Happy 25th birthday, Xbox gamers, here’s a look at how much time you’ve spent gaming.

Sebagaimana diketahui, similar to year-end recaps like spotify wrapped, microsoft just dropped xbox playback, except this one is chock full of 25 years of info by detailing your history as a gamer on the xbox platform, pulling info from decades ago if it’s available. And for me, it’s a reminder of just how much time I spent grinding Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 public matches and League Play with friends:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that 1,069 hours amounts to about 44 days of game time in bo2, which sounds about right, because i no-lifed the hell out of that game for years. But Xbox Playback has a lot more info like this, and it’s fun to peruse, including your total playtime across Xbox in general, your most active years, and the genres you played the most.

Diungkapkan bahwa my top five on xbox all come from the golden age of the xbox 360: bo2, left 4 dead, gears of war 3, and gta 5, with cod: advanced warfare on xbox one being the main outlier. It also tracks your rarest achievements, your longest play streak, and more.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, anyway, 2001 marked the beginning of the xbox. I personally didn’t join until Christmas in 2008 (Playback told me so) with the Xbox 360, which I immediately used to put in a ton of hours in L4D, Mass Effect 3, and eventually BO2, which I played 310 separate times, apparently. Yikes.

So, what about you, Destructoid reader? Check out the Xbox Playback website and log in to your account to see just how much you’ve been gaming (or not gaming) on Xbox throughout the years, and let us know in the comments below what your proudest (or most shameful) numbers are.

#128. "I wish hardware like the Xbox Series S wouldn't be released" - former Tekken director Katsuhiro Harada trashes Microsoft's console in front of senior Xbox staff

📅 11 Nov 2026

"I wish hardware like the Xbox Series S wouldn't be released" - former Tekken director Katsuhiro Harada trashes Microsoft's console in front of senior Xbox staff

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/katsuhiro-harada-xbox-series-s-wish-it-wouldnt-release

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, katsuhiro harada, formerly director on the tekken series, is known for not pulling his punches. This truth was reinforced recently, as he said he wished the Xbox Series S "wouldn't be released" at a developer panel. All while a member of the Xbox team was in the room.

Diungkapkan bahwa per inven global, harada was sitting on a panel at the console game developers conference 2026 in south korea. The panel was moderated by former Sony president Shuhei Yoshida, and featured Shift Up CTO DongKi Lee (Stellar Blade), Too Kyo Games CEO Kazutaka Kodaka (Dangenrompa), CD Projekt Red associate game director Paweł Sasko (Cyberpunk 2077), Ludeon Studios CEO Tynan Sylvester (Rimworld), and of course CEO of the newly formed VS Studio Katsuhiro Harada (Tekken).

Berdasarkan laporan, the panel were asked about the advantages of console development, as well as specific challenges when creating games for certain platforms. Harada led the charge, speaking to the advantages consoles provide for fighting game developers, as the hardware is ideal for tournaments and esports events. Following this, he took an opportunity to speak about a console that drew his ire.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "that said, there's something i really want to say while i have the floor. Since a senior Xbox official is actually in attendance here today, I wish hardware like the Xbox Series S wouldn't be released," Harada said (translations to English via Inven Global). Harada then asked Sasko from the CD Projekt Red team whether he was "upset inside" because of the Xbox Series S.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sasko proceeded to "burst out laughing" according to inven global, before responding: "it constantly throws challenges at us and forces us to optimize our code very cleanly. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, harada followed up with additional thoughts: "you just used a very polite and elegant way to say "xbox series s sucks," right? (laughs) low memory is an issue, but the hardest part is that it's a device so similar to series x while having awkwardly lower performance. When porting to Switch 2, developers can shift their mindset to 'Switch 2 is a distinct device for Nintendo fans!' But with Xbox, after delivering your absolute best output, it feels like having to do extra work for a slightly weaker child.

Diungkapkan bahwa "furthermore, in markets like the us, there are more series s users than series x users, so we can't just cut corners. Yet after launch, Series S users direct their complaints at us developers rather than Microsoft, asking 'Why is texture resolution lower only on Series S?'".

Sebagaimana diketahui, sasko stepped up to offer some perks to the series s. He even had a Cyberpunk 2077 example, as optimisation work done for the Switch 2 version were applied to all platforms "to great effect". While he agreed that many players the full technical context behind the Series S' weaknesses, he pointed out that optimisation for weaker hardware like the Series S made games run "significantly better" across all platforms. Sasko also pointed to the affordability side of the argument, saying that the cheaper price of the Series S allows for market expansion.

Sebagaimana diketahui, harada responded: "director paweł packaged series s so gracefully that the microsoft representative in the audience keeps nodding along. I'm worried they'll feel reassured and release a successor like 'Helix S' for the next-gen Xbox as well (laughs). ".

Diungkapkan bahwa here, shift up's dongki lee ended the topic with some optimism for microsoft's future consoles: "personally, i am looking forward to the next-gen xbox 'helix'. From an engineer's standpoint, if you provide us with a dev kit first in Korea as early as possible, we will put in our best efforts to develop for it. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, earlier this year harada founded vs studio with snk's support, with other veterans from bandai namco's tekken team hopping on board for whatever it's working on. As for the Xbox Helix consoles, in this current hardware environment with bloated costs for RAM and other components, it's reportedly looking a tad expensive. Maybe a Series S equivalent is on the cards?.

GTA 6 launches in one week's time, and the anticipation and excitement for the game is hard to ignore.

Rockstar Games' inbound open world action game is going to be a major cultural event when it launches on 19th November, and it seems some companies are recognising that — most notably, Pocketpair, the team behind Palworld.

The Japanese studio has announced that all employees are officially entitled to a period of leave from 19th to 23rd November so they can enjoy GTA 6 over an uninterrupted five days.

"On November 19, millions of gamers around the world will find themselves sitting at school or work, gazing longingly out the window, knowing that a new era of gaming is about to begin," the statement reads.

Diungkapkan bahwa "at pocketpair, we believe that such a historic occasion deserves our full attention. Therefore, after careful consideration, we have decided that all employees who intend to play Grand Theft Auto VI will be granted a special five-day holiday. ".

It's a move that's going down extremely well on social media, as you'd expect.

GTA 6 is reportedly causing a big spike in employees taking annual leave, with US employers estimated to lose a combined $1 billion of business on the 19th thanks to staff staying home to play.

Pocketpair isn't the only company offering time off; Logitech has announced Logi Game Day, an initiative that grants all employees a single day off for the purpose of playing video games.

While this can be used at any point over the next 12 months, the timing of its arrival suggests it's been implemented with GTA 6 in mind.

A while ago, a smaller business, Burger Motorsports, announced its intention to observe a day off for the game too.

Berdasarkan laporan, it seems there are some businesses out there trying to get ahead of the curve. For what is almost certainly the biggest game of the decade, I think it's a smart move.

This latest tweak then seems to be Blizzard making good on that philosophy.

#136. As of this week, PlayStation 5 has surpassed 100 million consoles sold

📅 11 Nov 2026

As of this week, PlayStation 5 has surpassed 100 million consoles sold

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/playstation-5-100-million-sales-november-2026

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, playstation 5 has officially surpassed 100m consoles sold, sony's updated sales data revealed. The milestone was reached on 10th November, almost exactly six years on from the console's launch.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the figure represents 'sell-in' units, meaning those shipped to retailers, as opposed to 'sell-through' which tracks consoles actually sold to consumers. In other words, the number of PS5s in people's homes is smaller than that 100m.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nevertheless, this is an impressive achievement, and gets the ps5 ever closer to the ps4's 117m, which it achieved by june 2022. 4m). It also means the PS5 has almost matched the original PlayStation in units sold (102. As impressive as the numbers are, historical data shows that PS5 sales have been in decline.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sony hasn't shied away from discussing that fact in its earnings reports. 2. 6m PS5 consoles were sold during the most recent quarter (Q2 of FY2026), well below the 4m sold over the same period the year prior. In fact, Q2 of FY2026 is the lowest second quarter on record in terms of units sold since the PS5's launch.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, it's also worth noting that, small though it may be, the second quarter's result is higher than the first quarter's 1. 6m, the second-lowest of any single quarter since the PS5's launch, beaten only by Q4 of FY2025's 1. 5m.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if numbers don't recover in the third and fourth quarters, this may be the ps5's lowest year ever in terms of units sold. Although the second quarter's sales boost can be attributed to the high anticipation of Grand Theft Auto 6, the overall downturn is largely due to the console's higher price; Sony raised the PS5 and PS5 Pro's prices on several occasions since 2020. The company's bottom line, however, hasn't been affected much, as its plan to generate more revenue from its already-engaged audience continues to work.

#137. Netflix's Disappointing New Western Thriller Wastes Its Brilliant Concept

📅 13 Nov 2026

Netflix's Disappointing New Western Thriller Wastes Its Brilliant Concept

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/heartland-netflix-review/

Chastain stars in Netflix's new musical western.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jessica chastain’s career has taken many turns. Her Apple TV thriller The Savant was postponed because of its subject matter, inspiring a wider conversation on politics. She was nominated for her acting work (Zero Dark Thirty, The Eyes of Tammy Faye) or as part of a larger ensemble (The Martian, Interstellar). For a time, she was one of the Academy’s most beloved actresses, appearing in films that made their way deep into the awards conversation. More recently, she was nominated for a Tony and helmed the buzzy horror movie Other Mommy, which made an impact at the box office but got trashed by critics. But for all those twists, turns, and bumps in the road, Heartland might be her most delirious project yet.

Berdasarkan laporan, written and directed by shana feste, the netflix-original film feels as if the director of country strong watched a couple of episodes of yellowstone and decided to take a stab at a western-noir, centering her story on a jaded country star. The result is a missing-person mystery with three musical numbers woven into it. Heartland might be the first western-noir-musical ever made, and I wish Feste took advantage of how weird that is. Instead, it’s pure straight-to-Netflix fodder.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, chastain stars as misty jones, a country singer living in seclusion. Misty threatens the neighbor and shoots out her windows. Then she gets drunk and has a one-night stand. The first time we see her, she's crying over her dog, who’s been shot and killed by the neighbor. Her successful past is alluded to when she opens her fridge to reveal moldy food sitting right next to a Grammy Award.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the plot kicks in after misty gets a call from her brother donny (paul sparks), forcing her to reckon with her nashville past. His daughter, rising country star Charlie Hart (Carter Faith), has gone missing. He wants Misty to find her. I guess a musician is better equipped to find missing people than the Nashville police? I don’t know, but let’s just roll with it.

Diungkapkan bahwa misty embarks on a road trip back home to look into the case, getting in touch with the most important people in charlie’s life, including her manager (garrett hedlund), her rude boyfriend jace jacobs (singer ross lynch), and her publicity team. Misty finds that no one cares for Charlie; they were all just using her for her to sell albums and tickets. She also uncovers a conspiracy that grows more and more tangled with every passing scene.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in heartland, nashville is depicted as a kind of rural gotham, hiding corruption and schemes on every corner. The film makes it clear that Misty is not welcome and the more she probes, the bigger the target on her back becomes. “Nashville’s changed,” warns one of Jones’ old friends. “And you and me? We ain’t famous anymore. ” Okay?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there aren’t many surprises in heartland, with charlie’s disappearance resolved in a twist you can see coming the minute misty has her first drink in nashville. Still, the film boasts a surprisingly talented cast, ranging from Sparks, who’s reduced to phone call scenes where he’s nagging at Misty, to Chastain herself.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the oscar-winning actress is fully committed to the part, looking more and more haggard as the film progresses. Chastain does her own singing, holding her own alongside real-life performers. Charlie’s boyfriend Jace Jacobs invites Misty onstage to intimidate her, only for the crowd to be swept off their feet by the unexpected comeback of a retired country superstar. Winnie Jo Lean (Jennifer Nettles, from the musical duo Sugarland) joins Misty onstage to perform the film’s official song, called, you guessed it, “Heartland. She gets dragged onstage several times, resulting in some fun numbers that mix original music and covers. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, other noteworthy performers include hedlund, who’d previously worked with feste in country strong, and an inexplicable cameo from john hawkes as misty’s former husband clark. As always, Hawkes is electric onscreen, but he’s featured in one scene.

Diungkapkan bahwa i can imagine a better version of this movie, one that goes all in on its strange fusion of genres. Instead, Heartland is formulaic, with nothing new to say about the music industry or the perils of being a young woman in it. It’s for die-hard Chastain fans, or something to play in the background if you love a mild-mannered train wreck.

No Guild Finder (so far) isn't stopping WoW: Forever players from finding (or even making) the perfect Guild.

Sebagaimana diketahui, guilds return in world of warcraft: forever, and blizzard wants to recapture the excitement of hopping into the game and dragging your guildmates to the occasional raid, a good leveling session, or the plain old shenanigans. While guilds are already a staple in most MMOs and other versions of WoW, it’s still refreshing to see Forever return with a classic iteration of a staple social experience.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but since forever is indeed a remake of classic, it also comes with the sheer difficulty of finding a guild you could be a part of. There’s really no way to tell if a Guild is available for applications, or maybe if a Guild is strictly friends-only. Then again, there are creative ways where you can score a Guild membership for your character.

Sebagaimana diketahui, historically, wow players have always been able to find guilds through the guild finder, launched back in cataclysm, as well as the improved guild & communities finder back in 2019. Forever being a remake of the OG WoW means going back to a time where none of these tools existed, so it’s back to “manual” searching for WoW: Forever players.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as of writing, there are no wow: forever add-ons specifically to help find guilds in the game. Sites like CurseForge do have a plethora of add-ons that help with Guild management, but that’s after you make your Guild.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, cataclysm launched the original guild finder back in 2011, so players had around seven years of finding guilds with no built-in tool to help them. Therefore, WoW: Forever players can also resort to old-fashioned ways of finding prospective Guilds.

Sebagaimana diketahui, even without the guild finder, wow: forever players have a plethora of social avenues to form communities and find like-minded players for their guilds. Forums and community messaging apps are perfect for guild recruitment, especially if they have dedicated group chats for Forever. Example avenues are:.

Reddit and Discord are already great places to stay connected with fellow players or even get tips on things like PvP and builds, so it’s no surprise they are also great platforms to find Guilds to join.

Berdasarkan laporan, there’s nothing wrong jumping to and from guilds if you feel like the one you’re in doesn’t really suit your needs anymore. But to avoid those awkward situations when you do need to type “/gquit” in the chat, then remember these when joining:.

Read what’s behind the latest news in gaming (with a bit of snark) by subscribing to the Destructoid Checkpoint newsletter!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, maybe you don’t want to be part of a guild. Maybe you found some Guilds taking the game too seriously and you want something chill, or some Guilds might be “too” chill for your liking. That’s probably when you should consider making your own Guild.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you want to create your own guild, it has to be something certified by your faction as 100% legit. This is quite unlike other MMOs where you can just make a Guild easy peasy, or just pay some currency to get the privilege. Instead, you need to get something called a Guild Charter.

Berdasarkan laporan, to do this, head to your capital city. Ask a guard to help you locate your Guild Master. From here, you can ask them for a Guild Charter, and they’ll sell it to you for 10 Silver.

Berdasarkan laporan, be careful if you’re doing this purchase if you’re low-level, since that 10 silver is already the current life savings of other characters. But once you’ve decided you really want to become a future guild founder, then proceed with the purchase and type in your Guild Name.

Diungkapkan bahwa this won’t stop there, though. Before your Guild actually becomes legit, you need to find 10 Signatures first.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unlike other mmos, wow: forever takes a page from classic’s rulebook and demands signatures from other players to co-found your guild. As with Classic, you also need 10 (!!!) Signatures in your Guild Charter. And if you’re not playing with friends who are ready to be your co-founders, it’s not easy to convince random people to just hop in and join someone’s Guild.

Berdasarkan laporan, once you find a player willing to help, you just right-click their name and ask them for their signature. A prompt will appear on their end where they can sign your Guild Charter.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you finally get your signatures, you must rush back to your capital city and turn in the signed guild charter. Only then do you get your guild. But first things first, how exactly do you find Signatures?.

Diungkapkan bahwa before you run off to stormwind to grab that guild charter, just remember that creating a guild in forever does have its fair set of limitations. Huddle with your prospective guildmates and remember the following:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after you create your guild, you practically have access to a mini-faction within the forever experience. As the leader, you (and a select few you appoint) have access to some of the Guild’s core settings. You can adjust these at any time, but the basics you should pay attention to are the following:.

Berdasarkan laporan, you might recall the suggestion to go to discord to find a guild to join, or maybe even find potential guildmates. That’s because you can actually connect your WoW: Forever account to your Discord account as well. Doing this is pretty simple, and it’s all done from your settings:.

Berdasarkan laporan, first, you need to connect your discord to your battle. net account. To do this, go to your Discord account and click “User Settings. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, under “connected apps,” you will see “add a new connection,” and you can click the battle. net icon there.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it will open battle. net, where you can click “Continue,” and it will send you back to Discord, where you can “Authorize” the connection.

After that, you will be redirected to your settings, where you can confirm the connection.

Back in your WoW: Forever session, go to your “Options” and find “Social” under “Gameplay” or via the search.

Diungkapkan bahwa it will show the enable discord functionality toggle. Connect so you can link your Discord to your specific WoW account.

Diungkapkan bahwa below that setting is an option to choose how your name is displayed in the chat connected to discord. It could be your Discord Global Name or your Last Online Character Name.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this part is best done if you’re the owner of the guild, so you can set this up from scratch. Over in the “Guilds & Communities” tab, you can go to your “Guild Control” and check out Discord Settings.

Sebagaimana diketahui, from there, you can choose which discord server you want to connect to your guild. And after that, you can select which specific channel you want to add to your Forever Guild.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you link the two, the discord channel overrides the guild chat by default. But there’s an option to separate the Discord chat as a separate channel from the Guild Chat.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, now, all your messages in wow: forever in that specific chat can be seen live on discord. Likewise, messages from Discord will be seen back in WoW: Forever, with a nifty Discord icon to denote that the message has been sent from Discord specifically but read in-game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while it’s possible to just separate your discord chat from your guild chat, it might be economical to fix things over on discord so that you have a dedicated guild channel for in-game players. You can lock that channel as view-only to non-players, so only guild members can actually chat there.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sony says it'll also retire the playstation plus app on pc on december 10. The company says fewer than 0. 4% of subscribers used the app, so the PlayStation Plus cloud-streaming app on PC will no longer be available starting next month.
