#140. There were 47 graphics chip makers in 1998. Where did they all go?

📅 11 Nov 2026

There were 47 graphics chip makers in 1998. Where did they all go?

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/there-were-47-graphics-chip-makers-in-1998-where-did-they-all-go

Suddenly, making faster chips mattered less than a faster release schedule - and most of the industry couldn’t keep up.

Diungkapkan bahwa some may find this hard to believe, given the absolute state of the market today, but if you were building a gaming pc in 1998, the hard part wasn’t finding somewhere that had 3d cards in stock for a reasonable price. It was choosing the right one among a glut of potential, reasonably affordable options.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in 1998, 47 companies were designing or selling pc graphics, driving a market that hit 130 million units and outsold pcs themselves. Just two years later, at the turn of the new millennium, only 15 remained, and not long after that, there were merely two: Nvidia and ATI, nowadays part of AMD.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but the nvidia of the late 1990s and early 2000s was a far cry from the vast (if tarnished) juggernaut it is today, and at the time it wasn’t even the obvious survivor. 2 million and Intel, in its first year in the market, with 6. Research firm 4th Wave put ATI top for 1998 with 24. 5 million 3D chips sold, followed by S3 with 15. Nvidia came fourth on 6. 4 million. 3dfx, the company whose Voodoo cards had made 3D gaming on PC a thing in the first place, sold 5. 5 million. 2 million.

Berdasarkan laporan, each of those companies went under or sold up for one reason or another, but what’s striking is how most did so within a few years of one another. In the four years between 1998 and 2002, the graphics business essentially stopped rewarding whoever had the fastest chip, instead favouring the companies that could iterate the fastest. A new chip every six months or so for the same APIs everyone used, backed by enough capital to ride out the dot-com crash. Nvidia was built for that; almost nobody else was.

Berdasarkan laporan, the first companies to go didn’t need any help from nvidia, though. Tseng Labs stopped developing graphics chips at the end of 1997 with roughly $28 million still in the bank, selling its graphics engineers to ATI for about $3 million. 3D acceleration had made the humble graphics chip a much bigger and more expensive thing to design, and plenty of incumbents that had found their footing on 2D couldn’t afford to keep going. Rendition, maker of the Vérité V1000 3D accelerator, agreed to sell itself to memory maker Micron in June 1998, and ATI bought Chromatic Research for $67 million that October.

Berdasarkan laporan, in its prospectus for its january 1999 ipo, nvidia warned that pc makers brought out new systems as often as twice a year, on a spring and fall schedule, and that missing one was a serious risk. The company subsequently reorganised itself around that schedule, releasing the GeForce 256 in October 1999 and the GeForce 3 in February 2001. By 2002, Nvidia’s annual report disclosed that separate design teams were working on several generations of chips at once.

Berdasarkan laporan, by this point, though, the writing had been on the wall for quite some time. Any company that was rolling out just one major chip per year was launching against a rival’s refresh at best. S3, then the world’s second-largest graphics chip maker, wrote in its annual report for 1999 that a graphics chip stayed on sale for 12 to 18 months, and that a delay "as short as a few months" could cost it a design win with a PC maker. At worst, it was launching late against next-gen chips.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that’s essentially what happened to 3dfx when rampage, the chip that was meant to succeed the voodoo5, never shipped. The company lost its other big advantage around the same time with Glide, its own programming interface that only ran on Voodoo cards. By 1999, Creative was selling Nvidia-based Riva TNT cards with drivers that let Glide games run on them. Glide flourished while Direct3D, Microsoft’s rival interface built into Windows, was still lacking features, meaning that plenty of games ran best on 3dfx hardware, but that lead was quickly eroded once Direct3D and rivals’ OpenGL drivers caught up; developers could now write a game once and run it on anyone’s card. 3dfx sued, then open-sourced Glide altogether that December.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, by then, though, 3dfx had already made its most damaging mistake. A year earlier, on December 14, 1998, it agreed to buy graphics card maker STB Systems for about $141 million in stock, and CEO Greg Ballard said the Voodoo3 would only be sold on 3dfx’s cards. That revelation left Diamond and Creative in a tough spot, having built their gaming lines on Voodoo chips. They were now stuck high and dry without access to the new one.

Diungkapkan bahwa 3dfx was solely concerned with its margins here. STB had been selling Nvidia cards right up to the deal, and its last annual report includes a $3 million note it held from "Nvidia Corporation, a supplier. Those boardmakers inevitably walked, and went where the chips were. With prices in freefall, selling the finished Voodoo Banshee meant that 3dfx pocketed the margin that’d otherwise go to a partner like Diamond or Creative. The price of its single-chip Voodoo Banshee card dropped from $150 to $89 within a month of launch. " Creative already had Riva TNT cards on shelves, and Nvidia, which then didn’t make its own cards, would sell its chips to anyone.

Sebagaimana diketahui, intel, meanwhile, was causing problems from the other end of the market. Its i740 "Auburn" graphics chip launched in early 1998, and Microprocessor Report, the newsletter for the industry’s engineers, argued that Intel’s arrival encouraged Cirrus Logic, Oak and others to fold that year. They survived on cheap chips for big PC makers, and by the second half of 2001, estimates say Intel’s integrated graphics business had risen to control 55% of the market. This was extremely problematic for companies like S3, Trident, and SiS. Just over a year later, after lacklustre sales, Intel confirmed that it was ending support for the i740, then pulled out of standalone desktop graphics chips altogether to put graphics into its motherboard chipsets instead, starting with the i810. That, in turn, pushed S3 to sell its graphics business to a VIA joint venture for $323 million.

Sebagaimana diketahui, then the money ran out. 5 million in the second quarter of 2000, with its CEO blaming a late Voodoo5, and on December 15 that year it sold its assets to Nvidia for $70 million in cash (and a million Nvidia shares) after failing to secure credit. 3dfx lost $100. Venture funding for graphics startups had already dried up in 1999 as the dot-com bubble deflated, and exits inevitably followed. STMicroelectronics, which made the PowerVR-based Kyro II, quit PC graphics in early 2002.

Berdasarkan laporan, ati, however, survived alongside nvidia because it was already operating in the way the new market wanted it to. It was the biggest seller at the time, and it made its own graphics cards, which Microprocessor Report said brought in most of its revenue and margin. So, making its own cards wasn’t 3dfx’s mistake; it was locking out boardmakers who had been selling Voodoo cards for it. That pushed those boardmakers towards Nvidia, and a late Voodoo5 and cash crunch dealt the death blow. ATI also used its stock to buy the engineers that its rivals were shedding: Tseng’s, Chromatic’s, then, in February 2000, ArtX’s for $400 million, a team that’d just designed the Flipper graphics chip for Nintendo’s GameCube.

Diungkapkan bahwa for the next two decades, the the graphics industry was dominated by ati - which eventually folded into amd in 2006 - and nvidia. It wrote off $1. For a while, it was a real fight. AMD paid $5. 4 billion for ATI, and in the second quarter of 2010, Radeon cards briefly overtook Nvidia in discrete graphics shipments. However, AMD had a problem: it couldn’t really afford ATI. 6 billion of goodwill from the deal about a year after it closed, and its PC chip business kept struggling.

Berdasarkan laporan, by early 2015, amd’s cpu and gpu revenue was down 38% on the year, and the company was close to negative book value. Its quarterly R&D budget had fallen to its lowest level since 2004, with Nvidia spending nearly half as much again. Radeon cards stayed on the same Graphics Core Next architecture for about seven years before RDNA arrived in 2019. By then, Nvidia had already launched its RTX cards with dedicated ray tracing hardware and Tensor cores for AI, and it never gave that lead back.

Diungkapkan bahwa intel was the only company with pockets deep enough to try breaking back in. It finally got there in 2022, when the Arc A770 went on sale from $329, alongside the cheaper A750. Its first go, Larrabee, was cancelled as a consumer graphics chip in December 2009. By the time then-hardware editor James returned to the A750 in 2023, Intel had drastically improved its drivers, bringing big gains to both general performance and DX9 compatibility. Both arrived after repeated delays and struggled with older DirectX 9 games, and many observers - RPS included - put their chances of breaking up the Nvidia-AMD duopoly at low. Even then, the Arc series had yet to prove it could work well at launch, without the need to be ironed out across months of updates.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the second generation did indeed fare better, with the arc b580 successfully selling out at $249 in december 2024. But that still barely impacted the wider industry, with Intel sitting at just 1% of graphics card shipments in the third quarter of 2025 and around 2% this spring, when Nvidia took roughly 90% of the 12. 5 million cards shipped.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it now looks like intel is on its way back out of gaming graphics cards. It’s important to note that Intel hasn’t confirmed any of that, and one of its execs has said that Arc isn’t leaving its PC roadmap. In April, leaker Jaykihn claimed that its next-generation Celestial gaming cards had been cancelled "long ago," and the latest rumours say B580 supply could be cut so Intel can sell more Arc Pro cards for, surprise surprise, AI work. Still, Intel had everything 3dfx didn’t: the cash, the PC makers on side, and the same APIs as everyone else. But money can’t buy two decades of Nvidia and AMD fixing their drivers game by game, and it seems to have decided its capital is better spent on AI anyway.

Sebagaimana diketahui, evidently, the question of where all the other gpu makers went does not have one single answer. Some couldn’t afford the rising costs, some couldn’t keep pace with a new Nvidia chip every six months, and some lost their cheap business to Intel’s integrated graphics or went under when the dot-com bubble burst. Left over was a Nvidia/ATI (later AMD) duopoly, and PC gamers haven’t exactly done well out of it. We saw the RTX 4080 launch at $1,199 in 2022, nearly twice the 3080’s price, and the ongoing, AI-driven RAM shortage has pushed prices higher still.

Berdasarkan laporan, in 1998, 47 companies wanted your money. Now there are two, and the bigger one, Nvidia, sells nine of every 10 graphics cards - yet still makes most of its money from data centres. Eighteen years on, it's a bad time to be a PC gamer, and nobody’s in a hurry to make things any better.

#142. World of Warcraft: Forever secret hunters have found the MMO's first hidden treasure

📅 11 Nov 2026

World of Warcraft: Forever secret hunters have found the MMO's first hidden treasure

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/world-of-warcraft-forever-secret-dawn-walker-sword

Berdasarkan laporan, world of warcraft secret hunters are a noble breed, known for scouring the mmo for years for hidden trinkets and treasures. With World of Warcraft: Forever's launch, they've uncovered a quest chain for an especially fancy sword.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, over the past week, members of the wow secret hunters discord found a quest chain that takes place entirely on the zephras isle, meaning you'll need to have access to the skyborne elves to grab this sword. Navigating the island, you'll need to first pick up an ancient heirloom ring from the starting zone. Simple enough!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, then, you'll need to head to duskwood to gather the night watchman's torch, a handy light source primarily used to light up areas across the darkened woods near stormwind. It turns out this torch has uses far beyond this one zone however, as taking it back to the Ruins of Ban'aethal on the Zephras Isle will reward you with a secret quest and the Ancient Hilt.

Berdasarkan laporan, with the hilt and ring, you then must track down an ancient blade from one of several spawn locations on the zephras isle. Once you finally track it down, that's the end of part one of this quest chain. You get the sword: Eluvi'ana, which on its own isn't particularly strong, but is speculated to be upgraded later down the line.

You then need to get a corrupted water globe from either Darkshore or the Blackfathom Deeps dungeon depending on your faction, do a fetch quest for a hidden spirit in Ashenvale, then take your hoard of special quest items to a NPC in the new Shen'Dralar zone.

Sebagaimana diketahui, he won't give you the finished sword. Instead he sends you to gather more items from higher-level zones. You'll need to raid a secluded vault in Feralas that you can only see with the Ancient Hilt, dive underwater in Azshara, and kill Highborne Shades in Winterspring. Once you've done all that, you can then cleanse the orb up in Hyjal, speak to the fella back in Shen'Dralar, then shimmy over to the end game Dire Maul dungeon to speak to Prince Tortheldrin about *another* sword.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is how far the world of warcraft: forever secret hunter community has gotten to. It's believed that grinding up the Shen'dralar reputation to Honoured is required for the next step, as Prince Tortheldrin pretty much says as much in his dialogue. So the hunt is still on!.

Diungkapkan bahwa these sorts of secrets make up an important part of any good mmo: the solving of mysteries in these vast digital open worlds. In retail WoW, I have fond memories of the Waist of Time quest chain, which was an arduous and comical grind for a fancy belt during the Battle for Azeroth expansion. This secret sword quest chain may very well evolve into something as legendary as that, at least I hope so!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you're not already playing it, world of warcraft: forever is plenty of fun. A record-breaking number of players are making the journey through Azeroth right now, diving into quests and dungeons new and old.

"Some of the best games of the last decade came from teams of fifty": Destroy All Humans! remake devs Black Forest Games split from THQ Nordic to launch new indie studio group

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/some-of-the-best-games-of-the-last-decade-came-from-teams-of-fifty-destroy-all-humans-remake-devs-black-forest-games-split-from-thq-nordic-to-launch-new-indie-studio-group

"We're excited to shape our own future as owners again".

Sebagaimana diketahui, black forest games, developers of the destroy all humans! remakes, have spun out of embracer group-owned publishers thq nordic via a management buyout and announced plans to form a new "developer-driven group" of independent studios. The new group, dubbed Third Signal, will aim to "give teams the independence, resources and creative freedom" to "bring their own ideas to life".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, black forest, based in germany, announced the move in a press release. "We are grateful to THQ Nordic and Embracer for nine good years and the games we made together," co-boss Adrian Goersch said. "Now, we're excited to shape our own future as owners again, to work on an exciting new project with a great team and strong partners behind us. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "some of the best games of the last decade came from teams of fifty, not five hundred," added third signal founder andreas tobler. " As of writing, Third Signal's website is just a logo splash which promises something coming soon. "Black Forest Games is one of them, and the right studio to launch Third Signal. Our vision is to build a developer driven group and give teams the independence, resources and creative freedom to continue their creative legacy and bring their own ideas to life. To be fair, it does also look to have an email address, plus legal and privacy notices. Black Forest's management team will become a co-owner of the studio group as part of this move, but "continue to collaborate on game development tasks" with THQ Nordic.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, black forest had been in the embrace since 2017, releasing both 2020's destroy all humans! remake and destroy all humans! 2: reprobed in that time, plus dlc clone carnage. Over the years they've also made multiple entries in the Giana Sisters platformer series, survival game Fade to Silence, and 2017's Bubsy: The Woolies Strike Back.

Berdasarkan laporan, that's a right old mix of stuff, but the biggest names in it are all resurrections of series or characters created by other folks back in the day. That makes the fact it sounds like this move'll give Black Forest a bit more creative freedom intriguing. Pandemic Studios in the case of Destroy All Humans!, Accolade in the case of Bubsy, and Germany company Time Warp in the case of Giana Sisters. Here's hoping that if they do plan to try and get some more of their own original ideas off the ground, rather than trucking on with a steady diet of remakes and revivals, they manage to stick the landing. It's all fine declaring that a 50 person team can make a top game these days, but that certainly doesn't mean it's in any way easy to pull off.

Gathering the new playable characters is crucial, because they are indeed powerful, leaving a lot of the base game’s characters in the dust. But the progress is slow at first thanks to a new material that is hard to come by in the beginning: Crystals.

Sebagaimana diketahui, these crystals are found within new levels, like gold and collectible power gems, but in scarce supply to begin with. These are needed to build basically all of the new buildings, but especially the houses that unlock the new playable Hunters. I think my favorite so far is the Wallbreaker, whose balls hit the wall and some come out the other side, making for some very fun geometry and wildness when baby balls start taking up the screen.

Your base will need to be fully upgraded from the jump, so if you’re like me and didn’t play too much New Game Plus or continue on the expansion after finishing the story, you may have some grinding to do early on because the new stages hit hard, and they hit you right in the balls.

Berdasarkan laporan, mastering the new ball abilities, and especially the new hunters and their plethora of new passive abilities you can select on any given run, will be crucial for success. I’m still trying to grind my way through the levels, collecting crystals where I can, but it’s slow-going…and still just as fun as I remember Ball x Pit to be.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but really, at $6. 99, this really is a no-brainer addition to your library if you even got the smallest amount of joy out of Ball x Pit when it launched last year. It’s just a whole lot more of the great base game, with a new challenge for those who are looking for it.

The only question that remains: do you have the balls required?.

#151. 26 Years Later, Charles Schulz' Final Comic Strip Is Still an All-Time Peanuts Classic

📅 13 Nov 2026

26 Years Later, Charles Schulz' Final Comic Strip Is Still an All-Time Peanuts Classic

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/peanuts-final-comic-strip-charlie-brown/

Schulz didn't end Peanuts by choice, but he still went out on his own terms.

Sebagaimana diketahui, charles schulz’s comic strip peanuts debuted on oct. In the very first strip, two largely forgotten characters sit together on a curb. 2, 1950,. As Charlie Brown approaches in the distance, the boy of the duo, Shermy, says to his friend, Patty (not Peppermint Patty, just Patty), “Well! Here comes ol’ Charlie Brown!” In the next panel, as Charlie Brown passes by, Shermy mostly repeats himself, saying, “Good ol’ Charlie Brown… Yes, sir!” In the third panel, he again repeats “Good ol’ Charlie Brown. ” Then the punchline arrives when Shermy says to Patty, “How I hate him!”.

Diungkapkan bahwa while that was the first official peanuts comic, a similar version by charles schulz predated peanuts and ran in minnesota’s st. Paul Pioneer Press. It was called Li’l Folks and also starred cute little children, although it did not have a regular cast like Peanuts would. Li’l Folks ran from 1947 until 1950, when Schulz quit after his editor refused to give him a raise from the $10 per comic he was making. The national cartoon syndicator liked the comic, but needed to change its name because of a 1930s comic strip called Little Folks. After that, Schulz brought Li’l Folks to United Feature Syndicate. The name Peanuts was chosen because The Howdy Doody Show was popular at the time and the studio audience of children on the show was called the “Peanut gallery. ” Thus, Peanuts became the name.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, from there, peanuts debuted in seven newspapers and would eventually be carried by over 2,600 newspapers. For 50 years, the daily adventures of the Peanuts gang were shared around the world, but it all came to a close on Feb. 13, 2000 with a sad, solemn, and eerily coincidental conclusion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it became clear that charles schulz’s health was in decline beginning in november, 1999. On Dec. He suffered a series of strokes and it was discovered that he had colorectal cancer. He began to undergo chemotherapy, but his declining health — which included declining vision — forced his hand. 14, 1999, Schulz announced his retirement. As he made clear at the time, it was not by choice, but his ability to continue Peanuts had come to an end.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on jan. 1, 2000, the last “true” weekday Peanuts strip ran in newspapers. It featured the kids having a snowball fight and Snoopy inspecting a snowball on his own. “Suddenly the dog realized that his dad had never taught him how to throw snowballs,” read the caption. The lines on the characters are notably shaky in this comic, which reflects Schulz’s difficulties with drawing at the time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that ran on a saturday. On Sunday, because Sunday strips were prepared several weeks in advance, a somewhat ordinary strip of Peppermint Patty and Marcie was published. Then, on Monday, Jan 3. 2000, Charles Schulz concluded his daily series with an image of Snoopy at his typewriter and an announcement which began with the phrase “Dear Friends…”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “i have been fortunate to draw charlie brown and his friends for almost 50 years. ⁠Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Linus, Lucy. ⁠ I have been grateful over the years for the loyalty of our editors and the wonderful support and love expressed to me by the fans of the comic strip. ⁠Unfortunately, I am no longer able to maintain the schedule demanded by a daily comic strip. It has been the fulfillment of my childhood ambition. My family does not wish Peanuts to be continued by anyone else, therefore I am announcing my retirement. how can I ever forget them…”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, again, because sunday comic strips were prepared further in advance than daily strips, five more sunday strips ran after this comic in january and february of 2000. 13, 2000, a Sunday version of the same farewell message ran. Then, on Feb. While the words in Schulz’s farewell were the same, it featured an added introduction, with Charlie Brown on the phone saying “No, I think he’s writing…” followed by an additional image of Snoopy at the typewriter. Below that, the same message ran, but it was bordered by some of the best, most memorable Peanuts images from the last 50 years.

That would be the official final Peanuts comic ever.

Berdasarkan laporan, while heartfelt, it was clear that schulz was forced to conclude his comic. Had he remained in good health, he undoubtedly would have continued to draw Peanuts for years to come. In that sense, Peanuts didn’t exactly come to a satisfying conclusion as it did a sad, albeit human one.

That said, a great many people inferred some meaning behind the timing of the ending.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that final strip ran on feb. Just one day prior, Schulz died of a heart attack. While it was clear that Schulz was nearing the end of his life at age 77, there was simply no way for him to plan this timing so poetically. 13. He had finished drawing Peanuts a month earlier, yet he died just one day before the final strip’s release.

Proving, perhaps, if you believe in that kind of thing, that Charles Schulz was here for a reason.

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/lootboxes-pay-to-win-virtual-currencies-and-other-blights-unto-gaming-face-heavy-regulation-as-the-eu-tables-new-digital-fairness-act

Diungkapkan bahwa it's been 10 years since i lasted opened a lootbox, i think. Just thought you should know.

Diungkapkan bahwa loot boxes, dark patterns, virtual currencies, subscription services, pay-to-win systems, and many other trappings of diabolical digital serfdom all face extensive regulation under the european commission's proposed digital fairness act, which has been formally presented to eu member states today. The full draft text of the regulation leaked earlier in the week. If it passes into law - and there's plenty of debate and revision ahead - it'll have big consequences for the developers and publishers of games like Overwatch, Dota 2, and GTA Online.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you can now read the draft text here on the eu commission's official site. The organisers have also published an introductory explainer that takes us through the timeline of the Act's gestation, dating back to 2020, and summarises its provisions. If passed, the Act will apply to any company doing business in the EU, not just those based in member states, with individual governments able to impose fines and consumers able to seek financial compensation if they think they've been harmed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, here's a summary from me, based on a quick delve through the text. The Act proposes a number of provisions regarding "unfair" commercial practices, including omission and distortion in advertising and PR communication at large. Amongst other things, it takes aim at "dark patterns" – that is, "visual, auditory and other components" of online interfaces that are designed to manipulate or deceive. The text also forbids personalised advertising and pricing aimed at children, and prohibits influencers from making "direct exhortations to minors to buy products or to persuade their parents or other adults to buy products in commercial communications".

The items that are probably of greatest interest to us smelly gamers are the passages on virtual currencies, "variable reward systems", and addictive design.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the act would require game publishers who sell virtual currencies to indicate the real-world monetary value of the currency and anything bought with it. It would also require companies to disable paid-for virtual currencies by default for kids, unless a parent or guardian has given approval.

Berdasarkan laporan, as for paid-for "variable reward systems", aka "loot boxes", "surprise mechanics", "schrödinger's giftbombs" or however publishers may prefer to describe them, the act would require companies to state the "types" of object they might cough up, together with the probability of obtaining them. It would also oblige publishers to disable paid-for "variable reward systems" for minors, and give everybody an "easily accessible" way to switch them off.

Diungkapkan bahwa the draft act outright prohibits "pay-to-progress and pay-to-win mechanisms" for kids. More generally, it suggests further constraints for publishers and developers who "design, organise or operate their digital products in a manner that is intended, or can reasonably be foreseen to encourage compulsive or excessive use". Again, it wants companies to give people options to switch these features off.

Berdasarkan laporan, that includes "features enabling automatic play of content and uninterrupted content consumption without effective and regular interruption moments that enable deliberation by the consumer on their willingness to consume more content". Also, "notifications not triggered by, or not directly related to, the consumer’s interaction or activity on the service", "features incentivising engagement at regular times or with greater frequency, including through penalties or loss of benefits", and "features and system behaviours that encourage continued use by simulating interpersonal relations," such as nagging prompts.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you'd like a more 'expert' account of the digital fairness act - how dare you! i have read several wikipedia pages - the bespectacled nabobs of gamesindustry. All this follows a change in EU rating law last month aimed at safeguarding the weans from predatory habit-forming devices and instruments of financialisation - games with lootboxes are now PEGI 16 by default, while blockchain games are always rated 18. biz went and got notes from an actual lawyer. Across the pond, meanwhile, lawsuits are underway in New York and Washington against Valve's tolerance of lootboxes on Steam, which the lawyers in question define as illegal gambling.

#154. Probably Stolen Lou quest walkthrough: How to complete and all rewards

Probably Stolen Lou quest walkthrough: How to complete and all rewards

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/probably-stolen-lou-quest-walkthrough-how-to-complete-and-all-rewards/

The game’s most wanted criminal, no NPC in Probably Stolen can rival or challenge the mysterious (& dangerous) Lou.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and as you can expect, her cryptic persona persists in her quest, which can only be triggered and completed by playing a dangerous game. Here’s a full walkthrough on how to complete the Lou storyline in Probably Stolen.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unlike most npcs, like serpico and eleanor, lou only appears on a random day after you purchase the business permit, available in the fifth week. During her visit, she will introduce herself before asking you for a series of ”tools” to be used on her next job. To trigger her quest and start her storyline, call Security on her and claim the 1. 500 Credits bounty.

Diungkapkan bahwa now that you surprised lou and made the questionable choice of turning in a specialist, a republic operative will pay you a visit in the next week, claiming lou to be a traitor to the republic and an alleged terrorist. He also gives you a Republic Transmitter and makes an offer: plant it into something and give it to Lou for 700 Credits, as she is sure to visit you again.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sure enough, lou will surprise you in a few weeks, inviting you to play a game and letting you know what’s at stake. The next morning, she reveals that a bomb is hidden within your wares and gives you until midnight to disarm it. Upon review, the Plastic Explosive will prove to be fake.

Read what’s behind the latest news in gaming (with a bit of snark) by subscribing to the Destructoid Checkpoint newsletter!.

Diungkapkan bahwa following your fake brush with death, lou will pay a visit to the store in around five days and leave her ”box of toys” in your care, before warning you not to touch it. The box features a document revealing more about her past and ties with the Republic.

Berdasarkan laporan, she returns to grab it the next day. If you haven’t moved the contents of the box (you can still read the document at no risk) or placed the transmitter in it, she allows you to pick either 1x Advanced Turbo Booster, 1x Smuggler’s Bay, 1x Backpack (Small), or 2x Module Expansion Kits as a reward.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, following the encounter above, just keep playing until lou visits under the guise of an inspector. You have one week to secure it. She reveals that her ”guest’ has finally given her the info she needs, before asking for 750 Credits (or 500 depending on your chosen difficulty) worth of weapons, armor, or meds as a trade for the bounty you received earlier. If you can’t, she asks for the amount in Credits on the due date.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we are now at the final stretch of her storyline, as lou will thank you and vanish upon getting the agreed-upon ”tools” (or the necessary credits) in her next visit. This will be your final meeting, with the news of the assassination of an admiral stamping the papers the next morning. She will send you a note, though, together with a Storage Bay Expansion Kit.

Lou’s quest/storyline then ends with another visit from the Republic Operative, who reveals they plan to pursue her and hints at your involvement in the whole ordeal.

With Lou’s quest done, don’t forget to also check out how to produce Huge Nutrifruits and unlock the Green Thumb achievement.

It's the first time the Xbox RPG didn't wow us.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, here at pure xbox, we're rather stoked about playground games' revival of fable. We were picking jaws up off the floor in June, then again at gamescom in August, and even left London FanFest feeling pretty jazzed with what we got to play of the upcoming RPG.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so, let it been known for the record, i fully expect fable to be a brilliant rpg. Top class in execution, full of joy and wow moments aplenty, but what on earth was Xbox thinking promoting Fable with that four-minute gameplay video? C'mon gang!.

Berdasarkan laporan, the footage was revealed during seattle fanfest as part of xbox's 25th anniversary jollies, although most of it was stuff we'd sorta seen before, and the choice of location was questionable at best. See for yourself in the video above.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "both myself and craig had a chance to play this demo last weekend, and we both came away pretty darn impressed with what we'd played. That said, we also remarked to each other that we wished we'd had a chance to explore Albion and interact with NPCs, which is something we'll have to wait a little bit longer for. ".

Feature We've Finally Played Xbox's New Fable Reboot, And Here's What We Think So Far.

We went hands on at the recent Xbox FanFest.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, where we'd previously been gobsmacked by vibrant castle towns and lush wilderness, this latest setting felt rather basic and lacking in character or detail. It was just some generic cliffside. It's not necessarily bad, but it's hardly the sort of environment I'd think to stuff into a trailer meant to turn people onto Fable.

Diungkapkan bahwa as the video goes on, we get a little combat featuring swords, archery, and a sprinkling of magic. It all looks good, and having played the combat myself, it feels fun. But it doesn't last long, nor does it show us anything new or particularly interesting. The quest itself is cut short and lacking, as though it's just been ripped from a spoiler-free section of the game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, just to reiterate, i reckon fable will come good. This one just feels a little odd, almost as if it was cobbled together last minute. Big fan. Every gameplay reveal up until this point has been great. That's not ideal when you're trying to convince players to pick up Fable when it launches on Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PS5 on February 23, 2027.

#171. Casualties: Unknown is a total pain simulator that makes other survival games seem like massive cowards

📅 11 Nov 2026

Casualties: Unknown is a total pain simulator that makes other survival games seem like massive cowards

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/casualties-unknown-is-a-total-pain-simulator-that-makes-other-survival-games-seem-like-massive-cowards

Content warning for discussion of extreme violence and self-harm.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you haven't died in a videogame till you've died in casualties: unknown, a profoundly unwholesome cousin of spelunky that simulates injury, infection and sensory distress with the same gusto crusader kings 3 reserves for papal politics. This is an intricate and imaginative celebration of pain - not merely an exacting survival game full of gauges to manage, but a laboratory study of just how many ways an animal body can feel, before it finally gives up the ghost.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i am one of a million canine hominids, created to undergo spectacular indignities by vicious human scientists, in a universe of suffering that spans several games from developer orsoniks. I am the sorrowing vat-grown pup of a conclave of star-faring Dr Moreaus. My task is to collect. something, some gadget of great importance, from a cave on a deathly planet, located beneath three kilometres of booby-trapped and infested, poisonous and hateful rock.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, currently, i am trying to burrow into a sealed titanium drop pod with my bare paws, so that i can sleep somewhere warm. Too warm, in fact. The drop pod heaters feel like they were vindictively designed to discourage occupants from lingering, but I'm finding that dehydration is easier to address than hypothermia - there are pools of groundwater around that harbour only a slight risk of "minorly" fouling my intestines. So into the pod we go. After ripping away a layer of rubber, I smash some glass panes and promptly step in the fragments.

Berdasarkan laporan, my computer screams, a hideous jangle of chords and static. My punctured dogsbody flops and writhes, spurting yellow fluids and gobs of unintelligible text, ignoring my button inputs. The interface becomes a fritzing, flexing sphincter of pinks and reds. They are my avatar no longer. They have been reduced to a squirming facet of the simulation's agony.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i gawp in guilt and terror at the status bar, now jammed with pulsing icons, then switch to my health display and determine that i am "bleeding catastrophically" from my right hind paw. But first, I need to remove the glass. I need to bandage that paw quickly. This takes the form of a 'minigame' in which I guide a shaking clawed hand with the cursor, hauling out shards even as my poor character threatens to pass out from the ordeal.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i've got two of five shards out when the earthquake kicks in. Already doubled over and delirious, my pioneering pooch is launched over the nearest cliff. The anatomical diagram on the health screen lights up like a wickerman. They fall about 50 feet, rag-dolling off crags with a concussive whump, till they smash into a flooded wooden platform. I don't appear to have broken any bones, but everything is hurting. What's more, I am soaking wet and hypothermia is taking hold, stretching blue veins through the clenching colours of my pain. The screen begins to look like some exotic, putrid flower.

Sebagaimana diketahui, wringing my hands, i allow my mutant mutt about 10 seconds to recover from the shock of the fall, then open the health screen again and slowly tug out the last three shards of glass. On the other side of the platform, I spy the corpse of another pitiful lab experiment. Now I just have to bind the wound… except that I must have dropped my roll of gauze, while tumbling through the abyss. It's actually easier than before, but not for the happiest of reasons: landing on my head appears to have numbed my senses. There will be longer term consequences, probably. With sirens still flashing on the HUD, I peer about for a cave plant or other source of crafting materials. Perhaps there's a bandage in that huddle of clothes?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i hoist my sagging and babbling starpup to their feet, and limp over to investigate. Then I step on a pressure plate, and a six foot blade shoots up through my left thigh.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the screen is almost obliterated by crimson snow. They want to be rid of their too-fruitful arteries, their stinking yellow blood. indescribable. I open the health screen again to assess the damage but I can't, because my dogperson has fallen into utter derangement. The noise is. The clawed hand reappears, and I am forced to rake my own torso with it to regain access to the controls.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i am now gushing my life out from head to foot. So instead, I detonate the chip embedded in their brain - the same chip responsible for the interface's rash of icons and warnings. I see no means of recovery, and I can't bear to watch my character bleed out. Going by my plummeting heart rate, I have about 30 seconds to burn before I lose consciousness forever. According to the subsequent mission report print-out, my canine pioneer was feeling "dejected" when their head exploded.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the worst thing about the scenario i've just recalled is that it represents casualties: unknown at its least punishing. Resources are more plentiful up here, while active threats are fewer. All of the above took place in the first of the game's 11 biomes - each procedurally generated, and 300 metres high - on the default "Tough" run setting. There is scope to faff about and prepare - gathering plant matter for a crude woven bag, so I don't have to carry everything in my hands or mouth or tuck it into the folds of my body. There is time to crack open supply crates, and craft an implement of some kind.

Diungkapkan bahwa the main danger, traps aside, is falling. Casualties: Unknown's terrain generator is not your pal. You'll frequently be doing that in the dark, and even the smallest of exertions takes a perceptible toll – whimpers of effort, wheezing breath, double vision. As regards the opening couple of biomes, at least, it works like a broken muck spreader, ejecting a mix of filthy clogs and particles that snag your jumps and often oblige you to dig through rock and gravel. The one major consolation is that you can wall-jump and slide down surfaces, a mocking touch of Prince of Persia.

Sebagaimana diketahui, still, further down is where life gets truly unpleasant. And the absolutely dreadful thing about that is that it won't necessarily end your run: given a tourniquet and antibiotics, you may yet pull through. There are sonic traps in certain biomes that cause brain damage and massive hemorrhaging. Perhaps you'll find or craft a prosthetic. There are vast, rumbling insects you simply cannot afford to get close to, because they are guaranteed to bite off a limb. The game's characters are, in general, astonishingly tough for all their immense capacity for anguish.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, casualties: unknown is a brilliant and unusual piece of design, uninhibited by any commercialised and sanitary notions of 'fun' and 'difficulty'. There's something intrinsically vital about this. Like Project Citadel, perhaps, its extravaganzas of torment are about feeling more present and alive in a twisted world, more in control. It's committed to recreating the surge of sensation through flesh. I'm not the writer to discuss this, and I know little about the developer's circumstances, but it feels like an exploration of trans survival in the face of a brutalising biopolitical regime: the online wiki notes that the game's zoomorphic Experiments or "Expies" have their own ideas about gender, though I'm finding it tricky to distinguish those accounts from the categorisations of the evidently unfriendly boffins who engineered them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i would like to get to the bottom of things. I would like to return to the surface and massacre the bastards who sent me down here. Still, I'm not sure I have the willpower to witness everything my avatar might have to endure: barotrauma, sepsis, strokes, ruptured ears, hallucinations. As I've hopefully made clear throughout this piece, it remains an open question as to whether I am them, or simply one of their human tormentors. I would like to find that goddamn gadget. #177. Keeping hold of Company of Heroes was essential for Relic to leave Sega, Relic CEO says – "Without it we would have been a dead studio"

📅 11 Nov 2026

Keeping hold of Company of Heroes was essential for Relic to leave Sega, Relic CEO says – "Without it we would have been a dead studio"

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/keeping-hold-of-company-of-heroes-was-essential-for-relic-to-leave-sega-relic-ceo-says-without-it-we-would-have-been-a-dead-studio

Diungkapkan bahwa in the nearly 30 years since they opened their doors, relic have been an enormously influential studio. Yet, despite this history, in 2024, when Relic were negotiating their sale from Sega to UK investment firm Emona Capita, CEO Justin Dowdeswell knew the rights to Company of Heroes had to be part of the deal. Responsible for lauded RTS series Homeworld, Dawn of War, and Company of Heroes, they also dabbled in other genres with third-person shooter The Outfit and the original Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine. "Without it we would have been a dead studio," he tells me.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, without naming names dowdeswell points out that there are "numerous examples" of studios that weren't able to survive on their name alone. Not only did Relic need the ability to make more games in the series that they were known for, but they also needed the income from back catalogue sales a series like Company of Heroes provides.

Sebagaimana diketahui, dowdeswell joined relic shortly after sega acquired the studio in 2013. This was in the immediate aftermath of publisher THQ's bankruptcy auction, where studios and franchises were sold off to the highest bidder. "The other games that Relic made – Homeworld, Impossible Creatures, The Outfit. While Sega bought the studio, they didn't buy the licenses to everything Relic had created. formative games in many people's memory – they were all split up, scattered," Dowdeswell says. I won't say a tragedy, but it's unfortunate because Relic is the home of those games. "I think that was. It would have been great for them to stay with the studio. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, just as a hint of the messy history of acquisitions and auctions: this year we see dawn of war 4 coming from studio king art games and published by deep silver. Deep Silver are a subdivision of Plaion, formerly called Koch Media, which was acquired by Embracer Group back when they were called THQ Nordic. Not that they were actually the THQ that originally published Relic's Dawn of War, Nordic Games renamed themselves THQ Nordic after they bought the THQ trademark at auction.

Diungkapkan bahwa as for homeworld, borderlands developer gearbox picked up the license to the sci-fi rts in the bankruptcy auction, then contracted blackbird interactive's support on the remasters, before handing the latter lead development on homeworld 3. So we very nearly existed in a world where they never got to make the brilliant Homeworld: Deserts of Kharak and Hardspace Shipbreaker. (Speaking of studios struggling without the series they made their name with, Blackbird was on the verge of bankruptcy before Gearbox got in touch with the Homeworld work. That chain of events does have a more clear throughline to Relic's past however, as Blackbird was created by two of Relic's co-founders Rob Cunningham and Jon Aaron Kambeitz. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, none of this is intended to be a knock on dawn of war 4. What do I know, though, talking about their own games, Dowdeswell tells me that while "one of the messages to the studio is we can't just make [the same] things that we made 20 years ago and hope it goes well", re-releasing the 20-year-old Dawn of War sold very well for Relic and netted the team some very positive reviews on Steam. From what I've played it's a very good Warhammer 40K RTS, if it perhaps sticks a little closely to the model laid down by Relic's original. "There's a bit of a paradox there," he adds".

Diungkapkan bahwa anyway, this is all getting side-tracked. Back to holding onto Company of Heroes when separating from Sega. "I couldn't really imagine a Relic where none of the games that the studio has made and was known for were any longer part of it. "Fighting for Company of Heroes when leaving Sega was crucial because I already lamented the fact that the other games didn't come with Relic," Dowdeswell says. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, relic and new owner uk investment firm emona capital llp were able to negotiate company of heroes as part of the sale from sega and since then the studio has spent the past two years focusing largely on supporting the ww2 rts and restoring their back catalogue. "There were a number of things that we had to learn, skills we had to develop, capacity and capability that we had to build at the studio very, very quickly. They've also released a series of DLCs adding new factions to Company of Heroes 3's skirmishes and multiplayer, re-released Dawn of War with a definitive edition and announced they're doing the same for the original Company of Heroes, along with Blackbird Interactive's help. Which, among many changes, overhauls the Mediterranean-set RTS game's special effects, audio systems, NPC AI, and makes significant changes to the singleplayer grand strategy-inspired Italy campaign, as well as adding a whole set of autumn and winter-themed assets for community map makers. Dowdeswell says foundation building masks a lot of the work going on behind the scenes: "We now self-publish all of this," he explains. The most recent update is the massive 3. 0 patch to mark the series' 20th anniversary. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i ask if it was always the plan to focus on their back catalogue, or if they had plans to release new games. "That ambition to re-establish Relic as an innovator in this strategy space is a big part of what drives our creative direction on new games. We don't have a financial safety net. "We want to make new games, we want to provide a modern Relic game," Dowdeswell says. " Though, the team do have larger ambitions. Dowdeswell says spending four years quietly working on a new game wasn't an option: "It's almost impossible to do it that way because of the current climate in the industry. " Focusing on updating Company of Heroes 3, releasing DLC for the game, and making definitive editions of Dawn of War and the original Company of Heroes is what gets the studio to the place it can make a new game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, dowdeswell resists any framing of relic's work on company of heroes 3 as spinning their wheels or resting on their laurels while working toward a new game. He argues the game "sits in between" Relic's past and its future: "It's an established game that came out three years ago, but it's also a way for us to take some chances, experiment a little bit, and while doing that staying really closely connected to the players, That's what the idea was behind the updates because it was a way to have very quick iterations and touch points with players and provide, honestly, a way for us to fund everything in the future. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, as to what relic is making next, dowdeswell wouldn't say. We're not going to go build a racer. Though, he revealed trying genres besides real-time strategy was "almost a certainty", before adding "I don't think it's going to be a vast departure for where we are, so it will still be strategic gameplay. ".

While many of us can now look back on the Skyward Swords of the Zelda series with fondness, those who were in the trenches at the time might recall that things were starting to feel stagnant.

The later games of the 'traditional' Zelda formula were well received critically, but the tried-and-tested gameplay wasn't working wonders for their sales numbers, and they were struggling to bring in new fans in the process.

Cue the open-world series reinvention in Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with ocarina of time back in the public eye (perhaps the most typical 'zelda' a zelda game can get), there are some who are wondering why it has been so long since we've seen the traditional format. So, naturally, former Nintendo employees Kit & Krysta are on hand to remind us all just how dark things were getting before the invigorating shot of BOTW.

"There has been some revisionist history out there lately about how the Zelda team 'ripped these [traditional format games] away from us at the peak of their popularity'," Kit Ellis said on the latest episode of the duo's podcast before setting the record straight.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "the series was in like dire straits," krysta yang added, "it was selling like nothing". Kit recalls going to focus groups and receiving feedback like, "the fanbase is dwindling; this is not bringing in new players; the interest is getting smaller".

With the huge success of Zelda today, it's easy to forget that such a time ever existed — particularly for those who weren't all that deep on the series at the time.

"It was depressing," Krysta adds, "it was like, we are losing this".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of course, breath of the wild was so immensely popular and so very unlike anything we had seen from the series before that it gave zelda the interest boost it so desperately needed. It's interesting to see how well-received the return of the classic format has been with OoT, so perhaps we'll see something slightly more traditional make an appearance in the next mainline game.

Diungkapkan bahwa the dream scenario would be nintendo leaving room for both formats to develop, but it's far too early to know what the team is cooking up for the next mainline entry. Until then, we have the pinnacle of the open-world structure and the very best of the traditional at our fingertips on Switch 2, so we're more than happy to wait and see what comes next.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the playstation 5 and xbox series versions of tactical first-person shooter zero hour will launch on december 3 for $24. 99, developer AttritoM7 Productions announced.

Diungkapkan bahwa zero hour first launched in early access for pc via steam on august 12, 2020, followed by a full release on september 9, 2024. It is also available via Epic Games Store.

The console versions will feature full cross-play support, as well as include six premium Weapon Aesthetics Packs—Gold, Platinum, Titanium, Redline, Serpentine, and Savanna—at no additional cost.

Berdasarkan laporan, “zero hour has come a long way since we first released it in early access back in 2020, and then the full release four years later,” said zero hour director meheraj maruf in a press release. We wouldn’t have reached this point without them. “Seeing our game finally make its way to PlayStation and Xbox honestly feels a bit unreal. It’s something we could only dream of when we first started. We have a lot to thank our community for, especially those who have supported us throughout the years and continue to play the game to this day. A huge thanks to Skymap for helping us make this possible, and I really hope everyone has a great time with the game. ”.

Here is an overview of the game, via AttritoM7 Productions:.

Diungkapkan bahwa jump in and experience true online tactical gameplay. We want to thank our community for the tremendous support and patience everyone has shown. Join our discord and get closer to the community and the game’s development. We hope you enjoy the game!.

Diungkapkan bahwa welcome to zero hour, a tactical first-person shooter with online team-based action gameplay that is set across various locations in bangladesh with real-life scale and resource management. Join forces with up to 10 players in intense cooperative missions, or go solo with up to nine AI squad mates. Experience hostage rescue and bomb defusal missions that require calculated strategies in the dynamic five-versus-five player-versus-player mode. Shape your route through compelling situations by interacting with story-driven NPCs and engaging with various objectives.

Berdasarkan laporan, engage in intense five-versus-five player-versus-player battles across various game modes, including bomb defusal, hostage rescue, and deathmatch. Experience competitive gameplay with a comprehensive leaderboard and tier system. Choose your loadout wisely, as limited guns and gadgets add a strategic layer—you’ll lose them upon dying, making every decision critical.

Berdasarkan laporan, zero hour presents serious slow-paced, and methodically intense gameplay. The game offers authentic gunplay and scenarios, where quick thinking and strategic execution are essential for victory. Utilize the planning table to overview operations and formulate your approach before taking action. Remember, every move counts, and success demands teamwork, strategy, and precision.

Innovative Gameplay Elements and Weapon Customization.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, explore over 18 diverse maps set across various locations in bangladesh, featuring unique elements like functional elevators, bulletproof glass, and dynamic shutters for strategic advantages. Strategically utilize the breaker switch to control building lights, adding tactical depth to your missions.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, choose from over 23 distinct weapons and 18 utilities, emphasizing resource management and team coordination. Fine-tune your arsenal with detailed weapon customization, modifying rails, sights, and foregrips for optimal performance. Immerse yourself in realism by checking magazine bullet counts and repacking magazines for efficiency.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, doors are your lifeline and your barrier. Infiltrate with caution as terrorists set traps and alarms. Meanwhile, attackers have an arsenal of over 4 breach options: kick, door rammer, C2 explosives, and back kick combined with grenades, ensuring a variety of strategies to navigate these vital entry points.

Diungkapkan bahwa face a variety of suspects, each with distinct behaviors. They even have the ability to sense incoming fire and strategically time their advances ensuring maximum safety. Some even wield suicide bombs, while others utilize sniper tactics in long-range maps. The dynamic nature of suspects keeps you on your toes, with no guarantee of their next move.

Diungkapkan bahwa the k9 attack dog feature brings an immersive and emotional experience to your missions. Initially resting in a cage, the puppy soon becomes interactive and starts playing around, following the player through the training facility. As the game starts, you’re assigned as a dog handler, initiating your journey with a small, nameable puppy. After successfully completing three missions, the canine companion becomes available for mission deployment.

Sick BMX flips, colourful characters, a whole lot of mail and a charming raccoon dog await you in Tanuki: Pon's Summer, which you can pick up now

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/sick-bmx-flips-colourful-characters-a-whole-lot-of-mail-and-a-charming-raccoon-dog-await-you-in-tanuki-pons-summer-which-you-can-pick-up-now

Right, today's been miserable thanks to the now hourly discourse we have to all take part in lest we be seen as approving of the current bad thing, how about something that looks simply pleasant? Today's the launch day for Tanuki: Pon's Summer, a delightfully vibrant mail delivery sim/Tony Hawk's Pro Skater but for bikes about restoring a shrine before the end of summer.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i've been enamoured by the vibe of tanuki: pon's summer since it was announced in no small part because of how in some small ways it reminds me of boku no natsuyasumi, a cult-classic, japan-only game series that's mostly just about hanging out in the japanese countryside. This one isn't so lackadaisical, as you do have a job to do in delivering mail, but I think a similar spirit is there.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when it comes to delivering mail, there is a death strandingian element to it in your need to place your boxes on your bmx (which you can do sick tricks and flips on, of course) to maximise how much you can deliver. A bit less stressful than Kojima's joint, obviously, though elements are still there. Any money you earn from this gig can then be spent on restoring the shrine that you oh so love, which falls onto the sim side of things with the ability to fully customise how the shrine looks.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are also a whole heap of minigames to perform that helps you get to know the locals. I'm talking baseball, sumo wrestling, working in a sushi restaurant and, of course, fishing. You can see bits of that in the launch trailer above, which comes with as 2010s an anime opening song you could wish for with some animation so good it makes me want an adaptation of the game. In time, perhaps! You can pick it up on Steam right here.

#185. Europe is about to get very tough on loot boxes in games, according to a leaked draft of the landmark Digital Fairness Act

📅 10 Nov 2026

Europe is about to get very tough on loot boxes in games, according to a leaked draft of the landmark Digital Fairness Act

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/digital-fairness-act-eu-europe-loot-boxes-regulation

Diungkapkan bahwa "the digital era has fundamentally transformed consumer experiences. ".

An alleged draft of the potentially game-changing Digital Fairness Act has leaked ahead of its scheduled publication tomorrow (11th November), containing proposals that could dramatically affect the way games operate and are monetised within the European Union.

Diungkapkan bahwa the draft, published by french publication contexte (via video games industry memo) goes as far as to recommend that loot boxes (uncertainty-based rewards) be turned off by default for minors, as well as the sale of in-game items and currencies. There's also a recommendation that all players - not just minors - should be able to turn off offers related to these lootboxes and gambling mechanics.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "the digital era has fundamentally transformed consumer experiences," the draft of the digital fairness act begins. "It has enabled faster, more convenient and wider access to an ever-increasing range of goods and services. At the same time, it has given rise to new and more sophisticated ways of influencing consumers' choices.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "along with the indisputable benefits in choice and efficiency, the extensive use of digital technologies allows both old and new unfair commercial practices to affect consumers at scale, exacerbating risks to their economic interests, as well as to their mental and physical wellbeing. Vulnerable consumers are particularly affected. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the digital fairness act calls for greater transparency around a "transactional decision". Which means: "Price transparency on the real value of in-app purchases using virtual currencies and the probabilities of winning for virtual offers with uncertainty-based rewards (loot boxes).

Berdasarkan laporan, "all consumers can turn off virtual offers with uncertainty-based rewards. All consumers can turn off attention-maximising features, with some prohibited for minors and the remaining turned off by default. Some spending-maximising practices prohibited for minors, with the remaining turned off by default. Supporting self-regulation for video games and legal obligation for video games to have an age-appropriate rating. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "spending-maximising" refers to systems that pressure us to spend more money than we want to, such as reward systems or pay-to-progress or pay-to-win systems. They're all being targeted here, as is virtual currency, which provides a layer of abstraction as to the real cost of goods.

Diungkapkan bahwa "it may be difficult for minors to resist such perceived pressure to pay," the digital fairness act said with regard to progression-linked systems. "Therefore, where a product is directed at minors or when the trader is aware with reasonable certainty that the product is used by minors, pay-to-progress or pay-to-win mechanisms [. ] should not be made available to minors. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the digital fairness act is a forthcoming european legislative proposal designed to update consumer protection rules for various digital dangers that we face today. Importantly, it's not law yet, and it has iterations and discussions to go through before it will be. A timeline on the Digital Fairness Act explainer website suggests it could be adopted late in 2027, then applied more broadly by 2030.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's also hoping to tackle many things besides shady video game monetisation, including "problematic" influencer marketing, "unfair" pricing practices - such as obscuring the real cost of something until you've progressed through layers trying to buy it - and mysterious-sounding "dark patterns". These relate to 'easy to sign-up, hard-to-cancel' processes, it seems.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, these changes aren't happening in a vacuum. Earlier this year, the well-known European age-rating body PEGI announced historic alterations to its game-rating criteria, with an eye to better categorising the dangers of loot box-containing games and aggressively monetised games. These changes have already started to roll out and mean that a game like EA Sports FC, which was previously routinely rated PEGI 3, now automatically gets a PEGI 16 rating because of its Ultimate Team card pack (loot box) system.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the effect of the digital fairness act could tip the balance against these systems being included in games at all. Expect more discussion and digestion of the proposed changes as the Act is officially published tomorrow.

Rockstar kills any hopes of streaming GTA 6 from Xbox to PC, but you can stream it to your old Xbox One if you like

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/gta-6-xbox-cloud-streaming-pc-xbox-one

Diungkapkan bahwa rockstar games has today clarified a few remaining details about grand theft auto 6's framerate target and visual settings on playstation 5, ps5 pro and xbox series x/s. And as part of the same announcement, the developer revealed a key detail about the game's cloud streaming options.

Berdasarkan laporan, gta 6 will be available to stream via xbox cloud gaming. However, this is only possible on Xbox Series X/S consoles, as well as - surprisingly - the last generation console, Xbox One. Notably, that means you can't use Xbox Cloud Gaming to stream to PC, or other devices, despite it being useable there.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you may recall that in early october, a verge report said microsoft had acquired exclusive cloud streaming rights for gta 6, with the understanding being that the game would be available to stream on any xcloud-supported device - as in, to pc as well. Xbox immediately shot down the report, saying GTA 6 "will not be streaming exclusively or to PC".

Berdasarkan laporan, perhaps more surprisingly, the cloud-streamed version will be using series s graphics settings, not those of the more powerful series x console. Considering the loss in quality inherent in cloud streaming, this will make for a less-than-ideal way of experiencing the game.

Beyond cloud streaming, GTA 6 supports Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox, so you can stream the game on your local network to any device, from a PS5 or Xbox Series X/S console.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, gta 6 pre-loading is now available across playstation and xbox. The code-in-box physical editions have also started shipping, letting you claim the code and pre-load your copy in time for GTA 6's 19th November launch.

#193. Sony have cancelled Fairgame$, once again reminding us that chasing live service big bucks basically never works

📅 10 Nov 2026

Sony have cancelled Fairgame$, once again reminding us that chasing live service big bucks basically never works

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/sony-have-cancelled-fairgame-once-again-reminding-us-that-chasing-live-service-big-bucks-basically-never-works

Diungkapkan bahwa you know, i'm sure that sony had every intention of following through on their intention to release 10 live service games by 2026, as they mentioned way back in 2022. Well, as far as an intention that's designed to please shareholders can go, anyway. And now here we are, almost five years on from that comment that continues to haunt them with the news Fairgame$ has been cancelled.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this comes from a report from bloomberg, who shared that, thankfully, there are no planned job cuts due to the game being cancelled. In a statement, Sony said that, "The studio will shift its focus to collaborating with other development teams across PlayStation Studios, while also exploring new creative opportunities, though didn't go into detail as to who those other teams are.

Berdasarkan laporan, bloomberg were also privy to a note shared with developers at haven studios from executives sean decker and john doyle that follows a recent test of the game: "while the test demonstrated strong operational excellence, live ops readiness and community engagement, player feedback and retention results were mixed and fell short of the goals we had set. Combined with challenging market conditions in the PVP shooter genre, we have made the difficult decision to cease development on the game. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa sony have, notably, failed to capitalise on the live service trend; i'm sure i don't need to remind you about concord. Hell, this isn't even taking the end of Destiny 2 into consideration, once a driving force of live service games, or how Marathon has struggled to pick up an audience in the way that Sony may want it to. You just can't force a game to be popular, especially in a genre like shooters.

Berdasarkan laporan, for those that either missed or forgot about fairgame$, it was announced back in 2023 and was supposed to be a "competitive modern heist game where you team up to break into exotic locations and steal the cargo," all while taking on security and other, real people. Gameplay was never formally revealed, only a CGI trailer, and was set to come to PC as well as PlayStation. Bloomberg also noted that the game had been reworked multiple times since the announcement and was set to be re-revealed with a new name. Ultimately, it looks like Katharine was a little generous with her timeline of six months.

#195. Steam now shows average Steam Deck framerates when browsing games, but Valve says it's considering expanding the feature to other hardware

📅 10 Nov 2026

Steam now shows average Steam Deck framerates when browsing games, but Valve says it's considering expanding the feature to other hardware

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/steam-deck-framerate-average-data-store-widget

By providing average data for each game, customers now have a more complete picture".

Valve has released a new Steam update that adds Steam Deck framerate data to a game's store page, giving potential buyers an indication of how well a game runs on the handheld.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as per valve's announcement post, average framerates are now listed in the steam deck compatibility section of a game's store page, but you'll need to click learn more to see it. Additionally, the feature is only available for games that have been tested for Deck compatibility - those with Verified, Playable, or Unsupported badges - so while it's not a complete list, it still covers thousands of titles.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, according to valve, average framerates are derived from players running the game on their steam decks, assuming they've opted in to provide framerate data. And the store widget also includes another helpful addition: a histogram displaying the percentage of data samples. This shows how often a particular framerate has been reported, and is useful in determining if the game's framerate is sporadic, such as due to stutters.

"The current Steam Deck Verified compatibility rating is based on standardised test criteria, but it may not match every customer's bar for acceptable gameplay," Valve explained of the new feature.

Diungkapkan bahwa "this is especially true around performance - a game with an unsupported rating due to unstable performance may be considered playable by some customers, and a verified game may not reach a framerate that some customers prefer to play at. By providing average framerate data for each game, customers now have a more complete picture of how the game performs on Steam Deck and can make more informed purchase and play decisions. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, currently, steam's framerate data feature only covers performance on steam deck, and for a very good reason: valve's handheld has standardised hardware, so the results will be the same for all players. However, Valve says it intends to provide framerate data for more devices in the future, but it's not clear if that's ever going to include desktop PCs, considering the complex nature of their hardware configurations.

#201. As Arc Raiders celebrates its first birthday, publisher Nexon reveals the extraction shooter has topped 17 million sales, but revenue is set to decline

📅 10 Nov 2026

As Arc Raiders celebrates its first birthday, publisher Nexon reveals the extraction shooter has topped 17 million sales, but revenue is set to decline

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/arc-raiders-17-million-sales-nexon-decline

Arc Raiders, Embark Studios' popular extraction shooter, has exceeded 17m copies sold, according to publisher Nexon.

Diungkapkan bahwa arc raiders was released at the end of october 2025, so reaching that milestone in a year is nothing to scoff at. According to Nexon's latest earnings report, however, only 1m copies of those 17 were sold in the third quarter - meaning sales have certainly slowed down.

Diungkapkan bahwa relatedly, nexon said it expects arc raiders' revenue to decline in the fourth quarter compared to the same period last year - when the game enjoyed its hugely successful launch - and anticipates revenue will be "broadly flat sequentially". Despite this, the company said Arc Raiders' revenue was "within the outlook", naming its Frozen Trail update as a key moment that brought back some lapsed players while introducing new ones.

Indeed, Frozen Trail boosted the game's Steam player count, and reports suggest it also helped Arc Raiders hit a six-month player high across various platforms.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, even with its slowing sales, arc raiders remains one of nexon's most successful titles. The company primarily attributed an overall year-on-year revenue increase, for the nine months ended 30th September, to the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa looking ahead, the biggest question hanging over arc raiders is whether or not it's going to get a dedicated pve playlist. Following a successful test earlier this summer, Embark has been coy, and hasn't said whether PvE will return as a permanent feature. Arc Raiders' Chinese version does have a dedicated PvE mode, and executive producer Aleksander Grøndal said he could see both PvP and PvE modes co-existing in the future.

Arc Raiders devs say that using generative AI voice acting was necessary as actors "would just go crazy if they had to read all of that".

"We need to understand what the need is here" - Arc Raiders studio still undecided about the future of PvE despite a seemingly successful test.

Arc Raiders player numbers hit a six-month high following the release of the extraction shooter's huge Frozen Trails update.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, arc raiders player-numbers rebound with the launch of frozen trail and the game's 2. 0 release, but they might be deceptively high.

Arc Raiders could eventually be split into PvE and PvP, says executive producer.

#203. Marathon is becoming a whole new game next month with a roguelite PvE mode, a beta for a very Halo-esque team deathmatch mode, a vibey social space and more

📅 10 Nov 2026

Marathon is becoming a whole new game next month with a roguelite PvE mode, a beta for a very Halo-esque team deathmatch mode, a vibey social space and more

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/marathon-is-becoming-a-whole-new-game-next-month-with-a-roguelite-pve-mode-a-beta-for-a-very-halo-esque-team-deathmatch-mode-a-vibey-social-space-and-more

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, marathon is getting a lot bigger next month. In September, Bungie outlined their plans for the shooter making some big promises, namely the arrival of a PvE mode, and now they've shown off what you can expect from its next season, Symbiosis.

Sebagaimana diketahui, top of the order is that pve mode, which has a name now: expedition. It's a roguelite mode, one that's playable in co-op, though a lack of details at this current time doesn't make it clear as to whether you can run it solo or not. The season's trailer, which you can have a gander at below, gives off the impression that you'll have to complete particular tasks before exfiltrating like you normally do. I'm sure we'll learn more in time.

Berdasarkan laporan, the previously promised social space will be coming with this update too, and it's called limbo. Morbidly appropriate! You can hang out here with your buds, head to a mini arena for some impromptu matches (I think), or head to the firing range where you can test out your weapons. You'll also be able to try out the new runner shell, Bishop, a cooler than you, samurai-sword-wielding robot who can jump real good and do that cool movie thing where it slices a whole bunch of enemies at once in one swing real quick like.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what will undoubtedly have some folks going "halo's back!" is the beginning of a beta test for a team deathmatch mode. Details are slim on how this will work too. The Halo comparison is apt not simply because of the fact that it's Bungie who are making it, but because there's a deep-voiced announcer guy talking about all the sick kills you do. Beyond that, there's a few new weapons to flaunt, and maybe most excitingly, big ole alien enemies to take on.

Berdasarkan laporan, you've still got a little while to wait for symbiosis, which is currently slated to launch on december 8th. The game will be free to play from then until December 15th, too, obviously in a bid to show sceptics how good it is now (hopefully it is good, for Bungie's sake).
