#204. 'Genital Exposure Has Never Appeared This Frequently': GTA 6 Was Almost Refused Release in South Korea

📅 12 Nov 2026

'Genital Exposure Has Never Appeared This Frequently': GTA 6 Was Almost Refused Release in South Korea

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/11/genital-exposure-has-never-appeared-this-frequently-gta-6-was-almost-refused-release-in-south-korea

Diungkapkan bahwa gta 6 was, reportedly, very close to being refused classification in south korea just a couple of months back. The reason? Too many penises.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, according to inven's findings, the country's ratings board — the gcrb — was completely split on its initial classification vote. Three committee members voted for an 'Adults Only' rating, and another three voted to have Rockstar's game refused outright.

The report claims that the "frequent background appearance of male genital nudity without any sexual context" was the big sticking point.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in other words, there are a lot of instances in gta 6 where male genitalia is on full display — even when there's no sexual context attached. The ratings board found this to be "excessive" in comparison to other games where genitalia may appear.

"It is not that genital exposure is completely forbidden, but it has never appeared this frequently without context," reads one of the committee member's statements.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it continues: "i do not believe genital exposure to this extent falls within acceptable limits under the current [ratings] standard. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, the opposition's argument attempts to bring context into the equation: "in this game, scenes with heavy exposure are not particularly sexual. Conversely, in sexual scenes, exposure is limited. We must judge the content holistically. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, in the end, following multiple postponements and even some regulation adjustments, a second vote was cast and gta 6 was handed an 'adults only' rating. This time around, only one member voted for refusal, and eight pushed for Adults Only — so the argument for the latter was clearly quite convincing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, apparently, a fear of simply missing out on gta 6 also factored into the decision. There was an unwanted "pressure" in being the only country to potentially ban the game from sale.

Adding a bit of extra spice to this story, Korean outlet Gameple is now reporting that South Korea may be the only East Asian country where GTA 6 is not censored in some form.

There's evidence to suggest that Japan's version will be "modified" in order to adhere to region's often strict classification regulations.

Meanwhile, in mainland China, it's looking likely that GTA 6 won't be eligible for government approval, due to the crime-filled, violent, and sexual nature of its content.

What do you make of all this? How would you feel if a game like GTA 6 actually was banned from sale in your country? Keep your pants on in the comments section below.

Deputy CEO Mattias Lilja is taking the reins in January.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Sebagaimana diketahui, paradox interactive is getting a new boss: deputy ceo mattias lilja will take over from current ceo fredrik wester in january 2027, a move paradox said "is a natural evolution of how the company is already led. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "my plan was never to be ceo for life. The goal was to build the foundation before passing the baton on for the next chapter in the company’s journey," Wester said in today's announcement.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "since i returned as ceo, we’ve streamlined our strategy, rebuilt our pipeline and developed our commercial offering. Given his experience and vision, he is exceptionally well positioned to take the company to its next level. Mattias has had a central role in laying this foundation, and now is the right time to hand over. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as his statement implies, this is his second tenure as paradox ceo: he held the position from 2009 to 2018, when he resigned and was replaced by ebba ljungerud. But Ljungerud's tenure was rocky, and she resigned in 2021 over "differing views on the company's strategy going forward," at which point Wester returned to the role.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in many ways, lilja has been calling the ceo shots for a few years now anyway, while wester's focus has increasingly been on paradox's "long-term development and goals. " And he, like Wester, is also a returnee: He left the company in 2020 after five years in various executive roles, but returned in 2021 along with Wester as "chief of staff. " Lilja's LinkedIn profile says his primary duty was to "support the Paradox CEO in leading the executive team, aligning the strategic plan with the day to day operations," and that he would "act as the stand-in for the CEO when needed. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i approach this role with great humility," lilja said. Now we’re stepping up the pace: we will make further investments in our core business, push the boundaries of our game design, work even more closely with our loyal players, develop more and better tools and services that benefit both modders and players, and continue to sharpen our ways of working and our organisation, with player value in focus. "Paradox has a unique DNA that has made us one of the greats in deep and engaging strategy and management games. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, reaction among the paradox community on reddit seems guarded at this point, which is perhaps understandable given how it went the time the company got a new ceo. PC Gamer's Fraser Brown took a deep dive into that in his 2024 report on "the Dark Age of Paradox Interactive," which includes thoughts from Lilja on the "challenges" of success and what he saw as the future of Paradox.

From the creators of Edge: A free weekly videogame industry newsletter, featuring in-depth news, expert analysis and exclusive interviews.

Even back then, Lilja was clearly helping chart the company's course, and there's also some optimism among Paradox follower in the fact that he seems likely to carry on in Wester's footsteps—and an apparent understanding that Wester has been eyeing the door for a while now anyway.

Lilja will take over as Paradox CEO on January 4, 2027.

#207. Forza Horizon 6 explodes on Steam even before it's officially out

📅 15 May 2026

Forza Horizon 6 explodes on Steam even before it's officially out

Tanggal: 15 May 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/forza-horizon-6-steam-numbers-big-launch

Forza Horizon 6 looks to have easily delivered the most successful launch for any game in the series on PC, with record-breaking player numbers.

Sebagaimana diketahui, steam is abuzz this week with a couple of long-anticipated launches, but in forza horizon 6’s case, at least, the game isn’t even out for what will be most of its players. The anticipated sequel in the open-world driving game series doesn’t officially launch until May 19, but owners of its most expensive version - the Premium Edition - can play it right now.

Diungkapkan bahwa that version of the game includes more than just a few days of early access, of course, but you’d think the $120 price tag would’ve only been palatable to a small group of players. Not the case with this game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, forza horizon 6, which has spent 16 weeks in steam’s global top sellers list, currently occupies the number two spot, having jumped up three spots this week in anticipation of the launch. The game has also naturally been popular with players, so popular in fact that it has already overtaken the player counts of all other Horizon games on the platform.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at the time of writing, the game has peaked at 128,157 concurrent players on steam alone (via steamdb). The figure has already climbed several times during the writing of this story, so you can only imagine how much higher it’s going to get deeper into the weekend.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, all of that, of course, days before the official launch on tuesday, when, theoretically, the majority of the game’s audience will be able to start playing. In just a few short hours, Horizon 6 has already gone well above Forza Horizon 5’s peak concurrent of 81,096, as well as Forza Horizon 4’s peak 75,689 players.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, steam is the only platform that publishes player numbers, of course, but it’s easy to see how similar the enthusiasm is going to be on xbox. Though the game is not yet part of the Game Pass line-up, those who don’t want to wait could buy the Premium Edition Upgrade to get the included content, and play it right now.

Berdasarkan laporan, game pass, and xbox / windows store numbers don’t factor into steam’s, which is another thing to consider when viewing the numbers holistically. Indeed, given how successful Forza Horizon 5 has been on PlayStation 5, Horizon 6’s upcoming release on Sony's console is bound to be even bigger.

Berdasarkan laporan, forza horizon 5 has been off to a similarly flying start in the first few days of its own advanced access launch, so it’s obviously not surprising to see horizon 6 do better there. In case you missed it, check out our review of Forza Horizon 6. In short, we really liked it, even if we expected more.

#210. Guide: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Walkthrough (Switch 2 Remake): Guide To The Main Quest, Side Quests & Collectables

📅 05 Nov 2026

Guide: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Walkthrough (Switch 2 Remake): Guide To The Main Quest, Side Quests & Collectables

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/guides/zelda-ocarina-of-time-walkthrough-switch-2-remake

Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a dense adventure with many secrets to find, and while the critical path is fairly linear, it's rarely straightforward - asking you to pick up select items and upgrades before you can start exploring its many dungeons.

Berdasarkan laporan, that's why a zelda: ocarina of time walkthrough comes in handy. Though the Switch 2 version follows the same beats as the N64 original, we'd estimate around 10% of the game's puzzles and locations have been changed or updated - just enough to throw off those very familiar with the 1998 version.

This page features both an abridged and thorough walkthrough covering the critical path, plus a repository of our other Zelda: Ocarina of Time guides, from optional side-quests to items and collectables.

On this page: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Walkthrough (Switch 2 Remake): Guide To The Main Quest, Side Quests & Collectables.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you want brief directions and as few spoilers as possible in terms of item unlocks and progression, then use the following abridged walkthrough to take you through the game. If you want extra specifics - including useful optional extras as you go - then check the following section.

Diungkapkan bahwa for a more detailed walkthrough of the critical path, this section can explain specific steps on how to progress. If you want even more detailed step-by-step guides to the game's many dungeons, then follow the links to dedicated pages on each.

Sebagaimana diketahui, before you can visit the great deku tree, you must find a sword and shield, otherwise mido won’t let you through. You can find the Kokori Sword in the Forest Training Center to the southwest (crawl through the vent to get there, then find it in the chest above), and the Deku Shield from the shop in the northeast by collecting Rupees found scattered around the village.

Diungkapkan bahwa visit the deku tree, complete the great deku tree dungeon, and get the kokiri’s emerald key item and an instruction to head to hyrule castle. Now leave Kokiri Forest to the west to receive an Ocarina in a cutscene before leaving to Hyrule Field.

Berdasarkan laporan, head directly north along the path until you reach the castle drawbridge. The area inside is the Hyrule Castle Market - there’s lots of optional activities here, including the chance to get your first Bottle from the Potion Shop - and when ready, proceed to Hyrule Castle, where after getting the Weird Egg from Maron, you must make your way through the grounds to meet Zelda.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you'll now have zelda’s letter and learnt zelda’s lullaby on the ocarina. The critical path is to Death Mountain via Kakariko Village, though you should visit the Lost Woods first (for Saria's Song, which you'll need shortly) and ideally, an optional visit to Lon Lon Ranch (for a Bottle and the first step in how to get Epona).

When ready, go east from Hyrule Field’s drawbridge and up the steps to Kakariko Village.

Berdasarkan laporan, after finding all cucco locations for a bottle and visiting the graveyard for the sun’s song (both optional), show zelda’s letter to the guard at the north exit. He gives you an optional errand - returning to the Hyrule Castle Market for a "proper shield" (the Hylian Shield) and also to start the Happy Mask Shop quest.

Guide All Great Fairy Fountain Locations In Zelda: Ocarina Of Time.

Powerful upgrades for a small fee? Fairy 'nough.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the aim is to reach goron city. Hug the rightmost wall: this will take you up and round the corner, then back on yourself up the cliff. The path will now split: take the left branch to Goron City.

Berdasarkan laporan, inside goron city, head to the lowest level, where on the north side is a closed door. Talk to him, then play Saria’s Song (which you can get from the Lost Woods). Inside is Darunia. Play Zelda’s Lullaby here to open it. This will see you unlock the Goron’s Bracelet, allowing you to use Bomb Flowers.

Sebagaimana diketahui, now leave goron city the way you came (the top entrance), then go directly right to see a bomb flower near a fence. Now you have the Goron's Bracelet, throw it over and you’ll bomb the entrance to Dodongo Cavern, allowing you to enter.

Once you have completed the Dodongo Cavern dungeon and picked Bombs and the Goron’s Ruby (the Spiritual Stone of Fire), feel free to scale Death Mountain for a Great Fairy Fountain location (unlocking Din's Fire) before heading off to Zora Domain.

Zora River - which leads to Zora Domain - is just east of Kakariko Village and Death Mountain on Hyrule Field.

Reach the end - the way there is fairly linear - and access Zora Domain by playing Zelda's Lullaby at the waterfall.

Sebagaimana diketahui, inside, you must find the whereabouts of princess ruto by getting the silver scale in a mini-game at the top of the waterfall, then by visiting lake hylia via the underwater shortcut for a bottle with a letter inside. (Our dedicated Zora Domain walkthrough features more specific directions for all these, by the way!).

Speak to King Zora, Bottle up a fish found in Zora Domain, then give it to the giant fish in Zora Fountain to access Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly dungeon.

Berdasarkan laporan, once the dungeon is complete and the spiritual stone of water is in your possession, head to hyrule castle. After the cutscene, dive in the moat and collect the Ocarina of Time, where you’ll then learn the Song of Time.

Diungkapkan bahwa head to the temple of time which branches off from hyrule castle market. Inside, stand in front of the inscription at the far end, and play the Song of Time. Now go into the next room and retrieve the Master Sword.

Berdasarkan laporan, after the cutscene, you’ll become adult link, and are told to head to kakariko village. On the left row of graves is a tombstone with flowers in front; push the stone and head down the hole. Do so, then head to the Graveyard. Now follow Dampe through the maze and at the end, you’ll receive the Hookshot.

Diungkapkan bahwa to leave, play the song of time on the blocks, to emerge in the windmill. Use this opportunity to get the Heart Piece opposite, then speak to the man to learn the Song of Storms - you’ll need this later.

With the Hookshot in hand, you can explore more of Hyrule, but when ready, head to Forest Temple: it can be found at the end of the Lost Woods, and inside the dungeon, you'll unlock the Bow and be rewarded with the Forest Medallion story item.

Berdasarkan laporan, complete the forest temple dungeon to unlock a sage. At this point onward, upon returning to the Temple of Time, you can time travel back into Young Link by putting the Master Sword the pedestal. Also, to help, Sheik will teach you The Prelude of Light, which allows you to teleport back to the Temple of Time - a pretty handy shortcut.

As Adult Link, make your way to Death Mountain (it’s worth going into the Shooting Gallery in Kakariko Village now you have the Bow, which rewards you the Big Quiver to hold 40 Rupees as you go), then head into Goron City.

Diungkapkan bahwa on the next level down is a goron rolling around, and your aim is to detonate a bomb near him so he stops. Once successful, the Goron will reveal their name is Link, son of Darunia, and will explain the Goron's plight.

Exhaust the dialogue options to receive the Goron Tunic - a red garb which allows you to withstand high temperatures - and directions to the Fire Temple, which is by heading to Darunia’s room (located on the bottom level at the back) and then by pulling the statue to reveal a route to the Death Mountain Crater.

Sebagaimana diketahui, once in, go over the drawbridge using the hookshot to meet sheik, who will teach you bolero of fire. Now head through the left doorway, drop down and follow the passage to reach the dungeon, unlocking the Megaton Hammer and the Fire Medallion along the way.

Before you leave, it's worth going south across the bridge from the exit to Goron City in the Death Mountain Crater and using your Megaton Hammer on the cave entrance to get the Magic Meter upgrade from the Great Fairy Fountain within.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, head to the ice cavern, which is located in zora domain (or specifically, in zora fountain where you encountered lord jabu-jabu as a child). Doing so will see you unlock the Iron Boots; make sure you grab a Blue Fire before leaving, and return to Zora Domain and use the Blue Fire on King Zora to free him and receive a Zora Tunic, which allows you to breathe underwater for an unlimited amount of time.

Berdasarkan laporan, with both the iron boots and zora tunic in hand, we have everything we need to take on the water temple. Play the Serenade of Water to be teleported there when ready. Completing this will see you receive the Longshot - a Hookshot upgrade - and the Water Medallion.

Berdasarkan laporan, before we move onto the next temple, on this island is a plaque in front of you which hints at a puzzle involving the morning sun. If you are reading this as soon as the Water Temple has wrapped, the sun should still be rising: aim for the halo with your Bow and fire an Arrow, which will see it transform into a Fire Arrow on the platform ahead.

Berdasarkan laporan, (as an aside, provided you have completed the previous three adult link temples, and have unlocked epona, you now have everything you need to take on the optional biggoron sword trading sequence quest. ).

Guide Biggoron Sword Trading Sequence Quest In Zelda: Ocarina Of Time.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you’re ready, head to kakariko village as adult link. When you arrive, a cutscene plays showing the place on fire, Sheik appearing, and a spirit emerges from the well. You’re then taught the Nocturne of Shadow, allowing you to travel to the Shadow Temple - though there’s a place to visit you need to visit first - the Kakariko well.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as it's currently blocked off as an adult, so you need to return as a child. If you haven’t already, learn Song of Storms from the Guru-Guru inside the windmill, then return to the windmill as Young Link and play Song of Storms back to him (now you have the Nocturne of Shadow, the return journey will be a lot quicker).

Diungkapkan bahwa doing so will cause the windmill to spin out of control and lower the water in the well. Drop down and complete the Bottom of the Well mini-dungeon to get the Lenses of Truth.

Guide How To Get The Lenses Of Truth In Zelda: Ocarina Of Time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you haven’t already, you also need din’s fire. This is acquired by visiting the Great Fairy Fountain location at the top of Death Mountain. Now you have Din’s Fire and the Lenses of Truth, play Nocturne of Shadow, then use Din’s Fire in the centre of the torches to gain access to the Shadow Temple, where you’ll get the Hover Boots along the way, and another Medallion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with that done, it’s time to head to gerudo valley. It’s found in the west of Hyrule Field, and you need either the Longshot or Epona to make it over the bridge at the start.

Complete the Gerudo Fortress stealth section - essentially let yourself get captured, then find the four carpenters so you can explore freely - then past the Mirage Desert trials (you need the Longshot and the Lenses of Truth) to reach the Evil Desert Colossus area and the Spirit Temple.

This unlocks two new items - the Silver Gauntlets and the Mirror Shield - and another Medallion.

There are two optional extras in this region - a Great Fairy Fountain in Evil Desert Colossus (Nayru's Love; Bomb the cracked wall on the north side) and within Gerudo’s Fortress, the Gerudo Training Ground (a mini-dungeon which grants the Ice Arrow).

Assuming you have now awakened every Sage and received every Medallion, it’s now time to head to the Temple of Time and start the final stretch of the game.

A cutscene will play and you’ll receive the Light Arrow, and an instruction to head to Ganon’s Castle.

Diungkapkan bahwa approach the lava moat around the castle to form a bridge with the help of the sages. Now enter.

The Inside Ganondorf's Castle dungeon within is composed of six routes from a central hub, each with a 'Barrier' you must destroy; though you can tackle them in broadly any order, go for the Shadow Barrier first to get the Golden Gauntlets, which is required before tackling certain other routes in the dungeon.

Once that - and a brief trip to the Great Fairy Fountain just outside the castle beyond the bridge for a useful defensive upgrade - it’s time to scale the tower, or to halt your progress so you can mop up any remaining side-quests and collectables (see the end of this guide for a list) before the finale.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the tower within ganondorf’s castle is essentially a short gauntlet of battles until you reach ganon himself at the top, and from there, it’s a linear stretch until the end credits. Good luck!.

#212. Mystic Messenger's most loyal players are getting banned in droves for seemingly playing the game too much

📅 15 May 2026

Mystic Messenger's most loyal players are getting banned in droves for seemingly playing the game too much

Tanggal: 15 May 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/mystic-messenger-ban-wave-thousands-of-hourglasses-anniversary

With the 10th anniversary of Mystic Messenger nearly upon us, the dating sim has inexplicably begun issuing wide-spread bans for its most active players.

Sebagaimana diketahui, mystic messenger, arguably one of the best dating sims around, has been dormant for about seven years. Despite not receiving new content or any meaningful updates in all that time, the game remains popular with its core fans, many of whom just woke up to some shocking news about their accounts.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the free-to-play mobile dating sim has started banning players with seemingly too many hourglasses - the game’s virtual currency - saved up in their accounts. So far, it looks like players with 1,000 or more have been targeted, but others with far fewer hoards have reported getting the axe, too.

The news exploded on the Mystic Messenger subreddit overnight, with over a dozen reports from players logging in to play normally, only to receive an in-game notice that their accounts had been banned.

Berdasarkan laporan, the message players received is identical, and doesn’t mention the specific reason for the ban. “Your account has been banned because abusive behavior has been detected from your account,” it reads, ending with a support email address the affected user can contact if they believe they’d banned in error.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it didn’t take a while for players to realise that most, if not all of the bans are for players with thousands of hourglasses in their accounts. The virtual currency can both be acquired in-game just by playing, as well as through direct real-money purchases.

For a nearly ten-year-old game that stopped receiving content three years into its life, it’s easy to see how a dedicated group of players would be able to acquire so many Hourglasses by simply playing regularly for so long.

When contacted by the affected players, Cheritz, the developer and publisher of the game, has instructed them to send receipts of how they acquired Hourglasses (assuming they were purchased) to verify whether or not they’d been fraudulently obtained.

Considering that Mystic Messenger has practically been abandoned by its developer, certain exploits have emerged over the years that allowed players to farm Hourglasses faster than intended, but those instances have always been dealt with then and there.

The blanket and sudden nature of this ban is what’s spooked players, especially those who’ve been logging in for years and never thought accruing in-game currency from playing the game too much would make them the target of a ban.

Berdasarkan laporan, the running theory is that most of the bans are unintentional, and may be the result of a new automated security system that’s been implemented. It’s entirely possible, especially if its’s AI-based, that the new system simply couldn’t distinguish between those who have earned (or bought) their Hourglasses fairly, and those who used exploits.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the timing of the ban wave is also suspect. With the game’s 10th anniversary coming up in July, it could be that Cheriz is preparing to release a large update for Mystic Messenger, which may include new content. If most of the playerbase is already sitting on massive amounts of in-game currency, they may simply use that to fast-track their way to unlocking the new content, which would greatly affect the developer’s bottom line.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is a problem that other live service games have run into in the past. Just recently, extraction shooter Arc Raiders added a cap to the amount of Cred players can hold in their accounts very quickly after its launch. That currency is used to buy cosmetic sets in the store, so the logic is easy to follow.

All of that has certainly put a damper on the enthusiasm of the game’s most active players, many of whom were excited to get together in person for the coming 10th anniversary, participate in community nights and so on to celebrate.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s also disheartening to see a fanbase so loyal; playing a game as regularly for so long without new content, to be treated so poorly. Even without knowing what the game is, it’s impressive that so many people have kept the flag of their favourite game flying for so long.

Berdasarkan laporan, to find out how this dating system works, here’s a mystic messenger primer that explains it all. Once you’ve wrapped your head around it, you’ll no doubt want to pick the correct answers for every guest, and this guide will help you nail every one.

#214. Under pressure, Big Walk studio reveals it used generative AI "sparingly" while making its hit 2026 game

📅 10 Nov 2026

Under pressure, Big Walk studio reveals it used generative AI "sparingly" while making its hit 2026 game

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/house-house-big-walk-generative-ai-development

Sebagaimana diketahui, "it has become a matter of public interest. ".

Australian developer House House has revealed it used generative AI "sparingly" to help make celebrated, indie, multiplayer puzzle game Big Walk.

In a statement sent to Aftermath - following a judging fallout related to the Independent Games Festival - House House revealed it had used large language models primarily to help debug the game's code.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "in the final stretch of big walk's development, llms were used sparingly by house house to help work through difficult technical challenges and bugs," the developer said. 1 percent of Big Walk's code had anything to do with this usage, and generative AI was not used in any other context when making the game. "In some cases, snippets from LLM responses were copied as a starting point to be modified into game code - we'd estimate that well under 0. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, house house added: "the primary use case for house house's use of llms was to research, via chatbots, issues we encountered with third-party code. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the studio's revelation comes after a sizeable number of igf jurors - 19 of them - issued a statement saying they would not vote for any game that used generative ai during its development. This was done after seeing "a significant increase" in entry submissions involving generative AI use, which "set off some fairly intense discussion and disagreement across the judge and jury pools". And rather than not vote for these in silence, a collection of jurors decided to take a public stand.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, house house hadn't disclosed big walk generative ai use anywhere before disclosing it for its igf submission. "We have not made any disclosure on Steam as the platform does not request disclosure of code or chatbot usage," the studio explained. "We are posting this disclosure as it has become a matter of public interest. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, house house added: "this is not an endorsement of, or argument for, the use of ai tools, however minimal. We have some concern that voluntary disclosures like this might contribute to the normalisation of this technology, or its treatment as 'inevitable'. We support the work of those who are trying to limit the harm generative AI is doing to video games and our world, and apologise that Big Walk's LLM usage may not meet their standards.

Diungkapkan bahwa "big walk was developed without an internal ai usage policy in place, and we consider that lack of policy a failure. We will work to have a more comprehensive policy going forwards. ".

It's a revelation that's likely to leave a taint of some degree on one of this year's brightest stars - a game Eurogamer awarded a full five stars to in its Big Walk review.

Berdasarkan laporan, to save a favorite, go to settings > general > personalization > my background > dynamic backgrounds > dynamic backgrounds, choose a background, and press x. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you can also choose shuffle at the start of any background category. Have your background change each time you sign in, or set it to change hourly, daily, or weekly. Shuffle your favorites or explore a whole category, it’s an easy way to keep Home feeling fresh.

Sebagaimana diketahui, starting today, xbox insiders who’ve claimed a digital license from a disc-based games will see those games in a separate category in their full library. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, prefer the guide on the right? now you can put it there. Ahead of GTA 6's launch, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick says there's no need for the company to go private like EA because it's already successful enough.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, speaking on a new episode of bloomberg's david rubenstein show (below), zelnick is asked if he has any interest in selling the rockstar games parent company like "two of the biggest competitors" in the business recently did – while they're not mentioned by name, ea and activision blizzard are almost certainly the competitors in question here. Clearly, though, that's not a consideration for the CEO.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i think we've proven that we can do very well as an independent company," he begins. We are not in a place where we need to be part of a bigger organization to be competitive. "And now we're, you know, a rather large company. At the end of this fiscal year, we should be a net cash company again. We're at scale, and we're at a point where we have a terrific balance sheet. ".

Certainly, GTA 6's imminent release will help there – it's the most pre-ordered game of all time on both the PlayStation and Microsoft stores, and one market intelligence firm estimated that it's already reached $942 million in revenue, even before launch.

Diungkapkan bahwa "in the entertainment business, scale matters once you aren't at a certain point," zelnick continues. "Below about $1 billion in revenue, it's hard to field a competitive creative team, it's hard to field worldwide marketing and distribution, and it's hard to survive the inevitable flops that occur. 2 billion this fiscal year – additional scale doesn't seem to help you succeed. But once you're well over $1 billion in annual revenue – and we're way beyond that point, our guidance is $8 to $8. ".

Zelnick is right to be confident – after all, he reckons that Take-Two has "the best collection" of IP in the games business, and between GTA, Red Dead Redemption, Borderlands, and BioShock alone, it's hard to argue there.

Sebagaimana diketahui, acquisitions can bring in a lot of unwanted changes, too. Not long after EA was sold for $55 billion to Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, Silver Lake, and Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners earlier this year (taking on $20 billion in debt in the process), it announced the closure of Dragon Age and Mass Effect studio BioWare, and canceled Mass Effect 5. For fans of Take-Two and the studios it owns, then, it doesn't seem like a bad move to keep things as they are.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Diungkapkan bahwa grand theft auto 6 has been granted an adults only rating in south korea by the country's game content rating board. But in the weeks preceding that decision, the board had nearly refused to issue the game an age rating—effectively leaving it ineligible for sale in South Korea—due to ratings officials' concerns that GTA 6 might be way too comfortable hanging unprompted hog.

According to GCRB meeting minutes obtained by South Korean outlet Inven (via Kotaku), GTA 6 required a total of three ratings reviews, in which committee members repeatedly debated the presence of what they described as "out-of-context genital nudity"—a perception that seemed to have been informed by the leaked GTA 6 developer build footage circulated by cryptopeddling cornball master criminal, Cyberleek.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the gcrb's initial rating review for gta 6 took place on september 10, during which committee members argued over whether the game's "out-of-context genital nudity" was grounds for refusal. Previously, the GCRB's rating standards automatically rejected games with exposed genitalia, but those standards were relaxed in 2025 to permit an Adults Only rating for "cases where suggestive bodily exposure is directly and specifically depicted," as long as that depiction didn't extend to graphic sexual acts.

Diungkapkan bahwa despite that revision, the committee members arguing to refuse an age rating for gta 6 said that, while the gcrb had previously permitted "a certain degree of genital exposure where there is narrative justification," they "did not believe genital exposure to this extent falls within acceptable limits. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, as the report notes, that first review meeting occurred before the gcrb received a playable gta 6 build, meaning that the gcrb members' perception of the extent of visible in-game genitalia could have been informed by cyberleek's leaked footage of an in-game nudist colony—an area that, despite the abundance of human flesh on display, didn't actually entail much sex going on. It was mostly just nude people standing around doing people things.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the gcrb committee members in favor of an adults only rating noted as much, saying that "in this game, scenes with heavy exposure are not particularly sexual," while "conversely, in sexual scenes, exposure is limited. " The first meeting ended in a 3-3 tie vote, leading the committee to postpone its decision and instead recommend to Rockstar that the game be modified.

Diungkapkan bahwa the gcrb did eventually receive a playable build of gta 6 on september 28—just six days before its scheduled second review meeting on october 2. While an initial report from its gameplay researcher indicated that "genital exposure scenes mostly appeared as one-off mission backgrounds and did not lead to sexual interactions," the committee decided to once again postpone its decision simply because the game was too damn huge for it to be confident that it had seen all the relevant cases of penises and/or vulvas in the wild.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a few on the committee remained skeptical, however: "the basic principle of rating refusal applies when bodily exposure of sexual acts are depicted explicitly or excessively so as to disrupt social order," one gcrb committee member said. "By that standard, the current bodily exposure is sufficiently explicit and excessive. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa in its third and final review meeting on october 16, the gcrb—informed in part by the fact that 10 other institutions like the us's esrb and europe's pegi had issued their own ratings—ultimately voted 8-1 in favor of granting gta 6 an adults only rating. Its researchers concluded that, after playing the game more thoroughly, scenes featuring full-frontal nudity didn't allow for any sexual interaction, and that cutscene sequences where protagonists Jason and Lucia did do sex at each other didn't expose any genitalia.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, interestingly, the gcrb researchers also confirmed that they couldn't replicate the ability to fully strip jason and lucia of their clothes that was shown in cyberleek videos, inadvertently confirming that the gta 6 build that'll be available to the public won't allow players to roam vice city in the nude. Apologies if you were particularly invested in seeing Jason's dong.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and additional apologies to the one dissenting gcrb member who still voted for refusing an age rating for gta 6, in part due to their fear that the rating could serve as precedent for other genres, meaning "background genital exposure will frequently appear in future rpgs as a result. Diungkapkan bahwa as another addition to the slew of smaller studios being dissolved by their parent companies, bandai namco announced in a press release that they are shutting down their subsidiary studio reflector entertainment, a montreal studio responsible for 2024's action-adventure game unknown 9: awakening. In its notice, Bandai Namco explains that the reason for the liquidation is due to Reflector not meeting its expectations for "future business plans, necessary additional investment, and the possibility of profitability and business continuation. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the press release notes that the liquidation of reflector will result in an estimated "extraordinary loss" of around 21 million euros, or 3. 2025 then saw further redundancies amidst the cancellation of a prospective project, though details on those layoffs were not granted by the company. 5 billion yen, for Bandai Namco in its Q3 fiscal report of this year. This is not the first time Reflector has been cut by Bandai, as around a month after the launch of Unknown 9: Awakening and presumably in response to its low sales, 18% of the workforce was laid off. Unknown 9 was intended to be a transmedia franchise involving the game as well as comic books and novels, but these ambitions never came to pass.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bandai namco notes that the liquidation will be held to local laws and procedures, which make the actual schedule of the process uncertain for now. Zelda Ocarina's ReDead Were Set To Be "Very, Very Scary" In The Remake, But Nintendo Decided To "Dial It Back"

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2026/11/zelda-ocarinas-redead-were-set-to-be-very-very-scary-in-the-remake-but-nintendo-decided-to-dial-it-back

The team maybe went "a step too far", according to the producer.

Ocarina of Time's Switch 2 remake isn't really a scary game, but there are still some enemies throughout this adventure that may give players a fright.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, perhaps the most notable are redead, the zombie-like creatures that are difficult to escape when they set their sights on link. These return in the remake and apparently were even scarier at one point during development, until Nintendo decided to "dial it back".

Here's what producer Hidemaro Fujibayashi had to say about this during a recent interview with GameSpot:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "with this remake, the graphics are a lot improved, and so the redead–the sound, the graphics, and the movement–ended up being very, very scary. And the staff wanted to make this in service of making a good gameplay experience. But from our perspective, taking a step back, we felt like, let’s remember the experience that we don’t want to change, and taking that into consideration, maybe we’ve gone a step too far, so let’s dial it back. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so, the decision was made to ensure the experience was more in line with the original game. The final result is the ReDead are still somewhat scary, but not "very, very scary" to the point it changes the experience.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the game’s next season - its 13th - has been officially revealed as season of reckoning. The new season will kick off alongside the expansion’s release next week, and will be available to all players, just like all previous seasons.

Although Season of Reckoning will roll out as normal, the season itself won’t be as meaty, at least when it comes to the sort of gameplay mechanics and themes players have come to expect from each new season.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you’ll still find the normal season rank chase, smoldering ashes, and various rewards at each chapter. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the even better news is that, according to blizzard, future seasons will follow the classic format, which makes sense. The new season will come with a battle pass, of course, featuring four Reliquaries, as usual. The first Reliquary is free, while the others are paid.

On launch day, you’ll also need to download a smaller patch, version 3. #231. In a reveal that might worry eventual PC players glancing at their GPUs, GTA 6 will target 30fps on all consoles

In a reveal that might worry eventual PC players glancing at their GPUs, GTA 6 will target 30fps on all consoles

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/in-a-reveal-that-might-worry-eventual-pc-players-glancing-at-their-gpus-gta-6-will-target-30fps-on-all-consoles

Oh, and and it'll be streamable on the Xbox One before it's playable on PC.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a press release coinciding with grand theft auto vi becoming available for pre-load ahead of its november 19th release date, rockstar has confirmed that the game "has been fully developed from the ground up to provide the best possible experience for the current generation of consoles, targeting 30 frames per second while pushing both platforms to their absolute limits. so hope your PCs are up to spec, computer nerds. " Read between the lines, and you can kind of make out the words ". ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, gta 6, of course, still does not have a confirmed pc version, even if rockstar's former tech director says it's probably not far off. " If you ended up getting a PS4 last generation, no cloud play for you either, I'm afraid. Granted, this comes with a warning: "as with all cloud streaming, connection speeds and other technical factors may influence game performance in ways that would not impact local gameplay. And despite this, even ancient, last-gen consoles are getting in on it, as the release also unexpectedly confirms that the game will be playable on Xbox One via Xbox Cloud Gaming, Microsoft's game streaming service that has suddenly lost its ability to work on PC. It also states that it will "play best on Playstation 5 consoles", making great use of that Sony partnership, and will include Playstation Spectral Super Resolution and ray-traced shadows on PS5 Pro.

Diungkapkan bahwa a 2026 current-gen game targeting 30fps, let alone one as titanic of a release as gta vi, is probably not going to go down well with a lot of people, even if console players are traditionally les sensitive about fps counts than pc players. Now, let me just quickly have a glance at GPU prices. The availability of the game on Xbox One, even if just through cloud streaming, could have resulted in an acceptance that 60fps just wasn't going to be possible if it was also going to be able to 'run' on last-gen hardware. What this does imply, though, is that the inevitable PC release might be an even more demanding behemoth than expected, if Xbox Series and PS5 versions can't even target 60fps. Either way, when it does eventually escape console exclusivity, hopefully trying to run GTA VI on anything less than an RTX 5080 won't set your PC on fire. Oh, no.

#233. Round Up: The Reviews Are In For Metaphor: ReFantazio's Switch 2 Port

📅 13 Nov 2026

Round Up: The Reviews Are In For Metaphor: ReFantazio's Switch 2 Port

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2026/11/round-up-the-reviews-are-in-for-metaphor-refantazios-switch-2-port

Metaphor: ReFantazio brings more JRPG action to the Switch 2 this week, and the reviews are now rolling in.

Starting with our own here on Nintendo Life, we thought this latest Switch 2 port was an extraodinary experience, but couldn't look past the poor optimisation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "anyone looking for a huge, sprawling adventure with lovable characters, compelling parallels to the real world, and progression systems that will keep you coming back for more will be far from disappointed with this game, but there's no metaphor for a dodgy frame rate and visuals that can occasionally take you out of the fantasy. ".

Review Metaphor: ReFantazio (Switch 2) - An Extraordinary JRPG That Could Use Another Optimisation Pass.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "metaphor: refantazio is a fantastic, fresh new take on the persona formula, and the switch 2 is one of the best ways to play it. With very little in the way of compromises, Atlus has delivered a solid port that makes one of its best games in years available to players of the best handheld console on the market. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "as a video game, though, i can’t recommend metaphor: refantazio enough. While I wish the port was better, it’s been nice to revisit my favorite ATLUS game on my favorite system. There’s just so much tight, considered design all over the experience, and the story still feels relevant today. It set a really high standard for job systems, time management, and dungeon crawling in an RPG. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "this is a full-scope jrpg that comes dangerously close to being 100 hours without feeling like it could be consolidated down in any way, and it’s playable on the go. Yeah, the Switch 2 might not have the power of the PlayStation 5, but it’s to look at something like this running on it and think to yourself, “you know what? Close enough. I do think that we sometimes forget to consider that it wasn’t that long ago that the compromises that it took to get games onto handheld consoles meant that such devices didn’t really work as the primary gaming device for most people. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is a fantastic, imaginative tale that’s worth retelling. It speaks to the power of dreaming for a greater life and standing united against charismatic tyranny on a grand stage. It manages that while still giving its cast their own smaller moments to shine and without losing sight of being an excellent video game. it’s an ode to what’s possible when creatives set aside the safer path and strive for originality — something this industry could use more of while celebrating and holding fast to the talent that brings art to life.

Berdasarkan laporan, "if you’re an rpg fan who’s especially fond of the offerings that come from atlus, metaphor: refantazio is a dead simple recommendation. While the story might not be for everyone, the excellent combat and novel Archetype progression system are worth the price of admission for folks whose love of all things turn-based burns bright. Applying a fantasy coat of paint to the demon realms of SMT and the real world settings of Persona works wonders, and it’s a welcome sight to see Atlus step outside of their sequel tradition and try something new. You might be here for a long time, but Metaphor is like a familiar friend LARP-ing in a high fantasy world. The Switch 2 version makes for a worthy ship on which to take this voyage, with options to adjust the experience based on your preference for performance or graphical fidelity. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "between its combat, characters, politics, music, and striking fantasy world, metaphor: refantazio is still one of atlus’ best games of all time. Whether played docked or taken on the go, the Switch 2 version gives another audience a good excuse to finally experience it. ".

If you want to try before you buy, there's also a demo you can check out, and save data will carry over to the full game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, liam is a news writer and reviewer on nintendo life. He's been writing about games for more than 15 years and is a lifelong fan of many iconic video game characters.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i ended up deciding to commit to it last minute. Not super far in but so far not really had any major complaints about the performance.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is possibly the greatest rpg i’ve ever played. I’ve been thinking about it a lot lately and listened to a great podcast about it. Theme-wise, art, character, and story-wise. It almost feels like X-Men: the rpg to me. X. Not in any literally sense but there are so many themes that cross over between them. More is Prof. I bought the FF7 remake games because they were so ridiculously cheap and they’ll probably be a good time but this is the game that has captured my imagination. I’m not sure about the rest of the characters yet lol Also, I don’t think the wise but doe-eyed protagonist has an X-Men counterpart (maybe Jean Grey?).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, my only real criticism at this point is that, like so many atlus rpgs, metaphor can feel like it’s on a “track” with set pieces that move the story along. While that allows them to tell an awesome story and I love the medieval magic fantasy anime clips in this game, it can feel like I lack a little bit of agency. I would greatly appreciate being able to have some open-world style areas with maybe different types of choices you can make. Or even the ability to outfit the protagonist with different shirts and pants and things. It doesn’t seem like a big deal but these little touches make it feel more like “my” story.

Diungkapkan bahwa i appreciated in smt nocturne how you could align yourself with different philosophies to reshape the world with. I’m not sure if there’s anything like that in this game but it doesn’t feel like that’s where the plots going (and that’s okay). Just something else to give me more agency. So it doesn’t feel like I’m just moving the story from plot A to B. I have not gotten super far in the game and maybe there will be parts that give the player more agency or at least the illusion of it but I haven’t experienced them yet. All that said I truly love and appreciate the game for what it is.

#235. As investors ask about GTA 6 and AI, Take-Two CEO once again puts faith in dev creativity, states making hit games "remains the purview of human beings"

📅 09 Nov 2026

As investors ask about GTA 6 and AI, Take-Two CEO once again puts faith in dev creativity, states making hit games "remains the purview of human beings"

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/gta-6-ai-strauss-zelnick-earnings-call-purview

Sebagaimana diketahui, "making a big hit was hard then, and it's hard now, and it's going to be hard in the future. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, today, as part of take-two interactive software's q2 2027 earnings call, strauss zelnick fielded questions from investors after presenting the financial results of the company. One caller was concerned about AI - specifically about the proliferation of AI-powered compilations and decompilations that have been raising piracy concerns for publishers over the past few weeks.

Diungkapkan bahwa zelnick notes that "[the video games] business has been largely immune to piracy" thanks to factors like file size, how console ecosystems work, and aspects related to the online nature of the games industry. That said, Strauss continues, there is a threat posed to the industry because of AI. However, he assures listening investors that Take-Two is appropriately scaling its measures against bad faith actors using artificial intelligence.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we are utterly focused on enhancing our technical defences and enhancing our legal activities appropriately. I think it will be manageable and we are focused on it. And - at the same time, without in any way being cavalier - every entertainment business that exists is subject to some element of piracy, [and] this is likely to invade our business to a greater or lesser extent. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa zelnick pivots back to ai again later in the call, where one investor once again asks about ai, seemingly keen to learn whether the ceo feels it can provide gta 6 developer rockstar with any kind of "competitive advantage" in the games industry. Given Zelnick's previous comments on the subject, his answer was not a complete surprise.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "it's always been true [that technology benefits us]," explains zelnick. "We've always created our entertainment inside computers with technology. All advances have benefited us, and I don't expect that that will change - in fact, I hope it'll accelerate. And, more often than not, we have succeeded - and the creativity that drives that success is human creativity harnessing technology. I think at the same time, what we're known for [at Take-Two] is the desire to make the best entertainment on Earth. And I think that's what you'll see in the future, too.

Berdasarkan laporan, "undoubtedly some of the most recent technological advances that you've seen have made it easier to create assets. Where all that is consistent with the story of our business. When I started in interactive entertainment (longer ago than I would like to say), it was really difficult to create an asset in a computer. Today, it's a whole lot easier - but you know what's not easier? Making a big hit. Making a big hit was hard then, and it's hard now, and it's going to be hard in the future. And hit creation remains the purview of human beings. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this isn't the first instance of ai skepticism we've seen from strauss zelnick. Back in March, he outright rejected the idea that AI can tackle games on the scale of GTA 6. Elsewhere in the call, the Take-Two CEO reiterated how well GTA 6 is tracking as he reasserted pre-order numbers are well above expectations, and promised that the success of the game will "set a new baseline" for Take-Two's gaming business.

#237. Naval warfare, an actual server browser and more on the way to Battlefield 6 this year as BF Studios reveals 2026 roadmap

📅 17 Apr 2026

Naval warfare, an actual server browser and more on the way to Battlefield 6 this year as BF Studios reveals 2026 roadmap

Tanggal: 17 Apr 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-6-2026-roadmap-naval-warfare-server-browser-details

2026 is looking very exciting for Battlefield 6, even if much of what's coming is based on things we already know, and some we've long been asking for.

It took Battlefield Studios over four months to tell Battlefield 6 players what they can actually expect from the game over the course of this year, in terms of content - but we’re glad to see a plan laid out nonetheless.

The developer unveiled a grand 2026 roadmap, covering three more seasons currently in the works, and a wealth of new additions across the entire game, including new maps and the introduction of a new theatre of combat.

In a wide-ranging new video dubbed The Year Ahead, members of the Battlefield 6 development team have revealed a lot of new information about the future of the multiplayer shooter, going over plenty of the features and new content coming over the course of this year.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the video confirmed that bf6 has at least three other seasons in the works. Season 3, which begins in May, will be followed by Season 4, and Season 5 later in the year. Season 5 is the most mysterious, which is understandable.

Berdasarkan laporan, we’ve known about some of what’s coming in season 3, such as the remake of golmud railway (now called railway to golmud), but the video also revealed that a remake of battlefield 3’s grand bazaar - now cairo bazaar - will also arrive later in the same season. Other exciting additions, such as battle royale solos and ranked play for Redsec are also on the agenda for Season 3.

Berdasarkan laporan, season 4, set for july, looks to be the biggest so far, with the introduction of naval combat, which will be available across two maps. Tsuru Reef, which is said to be even larger than Golmud, the largest map in BF6. The Pacific-set map won’t be the only one, as later in the season, another remake will arrive, this time of the iconic Wake Island.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the introduction of naval combat will bring with it a new dynamic wave system, aircraft carriers with operational flight decks, and new naval vehicles. Custom lobbies and Spectator Mode are also planned for Season 4.

Season 5 will bring three maps to BF6, rather than two, but all of its content remains under wraps.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, perhaps a sour note is that almost all of the maps referenced and shown in the video are remakes of maps from other battlefield games, or reimagined at the very least. The Battlefield series is no stranger to remaking its own maps, but Battlefield 6 appears to be leaning on it much more than past entries.

If it’s any consolation, however, the map remakes we’ve played so far in Battlefield 6 have gone through major changes that have contributed to giving them a different flow and feel from their classic versions, or even remakes in other BF games.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, over the course of 2026, you can also expect the return of persistent servers, as well as a server browser to find them all - just like the good ol’ days. This includes the ability to host your own, though it’s unclear quite how this is going to work.

Season 3 is set to revealed in the coming days, so you’ll be hearing back from BF Studios in the near future.

#239. "A fight for all workers": SAG-AFTRA throw weight behind emerging Rockstar union ahead of its GTA 6 release week vote

📅 10 Nov 2026

"A fight for all workers": SAG-AFTRA throw weight behind emerging Rockstar union ahead of its GTA 6 release week vote

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/a-fight-for-all-workers-sag-aftra-throw-weight-behind-emerging-rockstar-union-ahead-of-its-gta-6-release-week-vote

Diungkapkan bahwa in what has come to feel like the dawn of the final day before grand theft auto vi's release, one thing that rockstar really don't want people to be aware of is the ongoing legal dispute between the rockstar games workers union and the studio itself following rockstar's alleged union busting in firing 31 union members last year. Starting on the 12th through to the 26th, recognition of the union will be voted upon by staff to ensure that workers would be given a say over "topics including pay and bonuses, overtime, redundancies, flexible working arrangements, and generative AI policies. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa if it passes, the vote would also make the union the largest recognised union in the uk games industry, partly thanks to its partnership with the independent workers union of great britain. Now, the global labor union SAG-AFTRA have chimed in to endorse the Workers Union, offering solidarity to the members involved and granting important leverage from a global force.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sag-aftra's statement declares that "unionisation is vital for the future of the video game industry", and that "in the face of record layoffs, job instability, hostile work places, and toxic crunch culture, it is now more critical than ever for unions and workers to stand in support of one another. " They advocate for fair treatment, especially in the wake of displacement due to corporate mismanagement and genAI, and proudly state that "this is a fight for all workers. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, their statement closes by saying that "the gaming industry is a commercial juggernaut, and the people that create these amazing works of art deserve fair treatment and the opportunity to improve the terms of their employment with a strong voice at the bargaining table. We honor the courage of our fellow game workers at Rockstar and proudly support their union vote. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, solidarity with the workers, always. We can only wait and see how the voting process pans out.

With less than a week to go until the release of GTA 6 – aka the biggest entertainment release of all time – the boss of GTA publisher Take-Two isn't ruling out a GTA movie or TV show, but suggests one hasn't happened yet because they're "very, very selective" about who they work with.

Speaking on The David Rubenstein Show, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick was asked why, after 30 years and six mainline games, there still hasn't been a GTA adaptation, saying in response: "We're very careful about line extensions [adaptations in other mediums] because this is a creative company and our goal is to make the best entertainment on Earth.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we would make a movie or a television show based on our ip if our creative teams were passionate about it," zelnick continued. "If they thought that would somehow engage and delight our consumers. It's a high bar to do that, and of course there's always the risk of failure. So we don't rule it out, but we're very, very selective. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, video game adaptations are currently all the rage in hollywood. 2026 alone saw the release of Resident Evil, Mortal Kombat 2, Street Fighter, Iron Lung, Exit 8, Return to Silent Hill, and the back half of Fallout season 2, and 2027 looks to be even bigger for video games on screen with The Legend of Zelda movie, A Minecraft Movie 2, Sonic 4, and potentially a wave of TV shows set to release. GTA is a unique case, however, and given its scale, it's arguable that Rockstar and Take-Two would have more to lose than gain from a GTA movie or TV show if any adaptation can't live up to the medium-defining legacy of the games.

Berdasarkan laporan, that said, imagine a gta movie directed by one of the crime movie greats – a michael mann or a martin scorsese. Could Rockstar resist if one of the legendary filmmakers who informed much of their work wanted to return the favor? For now, the closest we have to a GTA movie is the 2015 docudrama The Gamechangers, which stars Harry Potter's Daniel Radcliffe as then Rockstar Games President Sam Houser and depicts the legal battle with Florida attorney Jack Thompson over the supposed psychological effects of violent games. Rockstar, famously, weren't fans, tweeting: "Was Basil Brush busy? What exactly is this random, made-up bollocks?".

Sebagaimana diketahui, as for gta 6, the map for the long-awaited vice city-set game just leaked, and it could be teasing a ufo easter egg. For that and much more, head on over to our countdown to GTA 6 landing page.

Asha Sharma doesn't specifically mention AI in her 25th anniversary message, but I'm pretty sure that's what she's talking about.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Berdasarkan laporan, in a message marking the 25th anniversary of the first xbox console, xbox ceo asha sharma predicts that the future of gaming will look much like its beginning, "when a small team with a big idea could change how the world plays. " And even though the term never actually appears in her post, yeah, I'm pretty sure she's talking about AI.

Berdasarkan laporan, sharma's message kicks off with a blast from the early days of microsoft, beginning with a look at microsoft adventure, an adaptation of colossal cave "that looked more like ms-dos than an early version of minecraft," and the first-ever microsoft staff photo that showcases some absolutely spectacular hair. From there it's a quick trip through Microsoft Flight Simulator, Quake, DirectX, and then in 2001, the original Xbox.

Naturally, there's a tribute to the "generations of employees, studios, developers, and partners" who helped create and grow Xbox, and the people who have played on various generations of consoles over the years.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "since joining xbox, i've heard stories of friendships that began over a session and lasted a lifetime, of people who met the person they would marry, and of parents now sharing the games they grew up on with their children," sharma writes. Ultimately, this is why we exist. "I've also heard about people who are no longer with us, and how much those hours spent playing together still mean to those who love them. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa from there, sharma offers thoughts on the future of xbox, and this is where i think it gets interesting: after comparing the size and capabilities of the original microsoft flight simulator with the 2024 edition, she continues, "while modern games demonstrate the heights of human craft in ways unimaginable just decades ago, the cost, resources, and risk required to create them have grown just as dramatically. We must change this. As a result, too many ideas never become games, and too many games fall short of what their creators imagined. For decades, this has been the unavoidable tradeoff of ambition. ".

How exactly that change will come about goes unspecified, but my guess? She's talking about AI.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "throughout human history, the scale of what we could create was determined by the people, capital, and resources we could command. That relationship is beginning to break," Sharma writes.

Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "a single person will soon be able to wield capabilities that once required entire nations. A small team will be able to build worlds that today demand hundreds of developers and hundreds of millions of dollars. And our largest studios will be able to pursue ambitions as far beyond today’s games as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is from its first entry in 1982. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the explosive rise in the cost of game development is undeniable. The pioneering open-world sci-fi RPG Starflight was literally made by five guys; its distant descendant Mass Effect: Andromeda credits 14 people for working on "audio design" alone. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick summed up the situation quite aptly earlier this year, calling big-budget game development "a high-stakes game for big boys only"; the development budget of the upcoming Grand Theft Auto 6 is being talked about in terms of billions.

Despite Sharma's optimistic presentation, though, I'm not entirely confident that an AI-powered future where one person—or even a few—can do what currently takes hundreds is really a desirable outcome.

Sebagaimana diketahui, alongside questions of ethics and artistic vision, there are also very pragmatic concerns about the long-term future of the games industry itself. Because really, the embrace of AI—not just at Xbox, but everywhere—is about cutting jobs. Bethesda had nine concept artists working on Starfield: What happens when somebody in an office decides they can get the same job done, pretty much, with two guys hammering out prompts? Maybe even just one? Quarterly profits and shareholder return may go up, but I doubt we'll be saying the same about the quality of the games we play.

Berdasarkan laporan, sharma concluded by writing that she believes "the future of gaming will look more like its beginning, when a small team with a big idea could change how the world plays. " I would argue that small teams are already doing that—the big, billion-dollar blockbusters that have prompted these worries seem far more committed to merely giving us more of what we've already got.

#242. The Sims 4's much maligned paid mods have made it to consoles, but Kits are coming back to PC

📅 17 Apr 2026

The Sims 4's much maligned paid mods have made it to consoles, but Kits are coming back to PC

Tanggal: 17 Apr 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/the-sims-4-marketplace-paid-mods-consoles

The Sims 4's Marketplace and user-created content have officially arrived on consoles, a little over a month after their debut on PC.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the sims 4 players on playstation and xbox have now caught up to their friends on pc, at least when it comes to the game’s marketplace. This new feature is essentially a hub for paid mods and other user-created content.

As often happens when long-established games introduce paid mods, The Sims 4’s wasn’t especially well-received, in part because of the introduction of a new premium currency - Moola - that is the only way to purchase any of that content.

The Moola denominations and prices are similar to many other in-game currencies, and the criticism around them is the same: they obfuscate the true value of items, and because of the way those denominations are structured, you’ll never be able to buy exactly what you need.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for most games, the subject of paid mods has always been fraught, and that's certainly true for the sims 4. In the announcement blog post, Maxis said that the launch on consoles will work similarly to what PC players have seen, in that Kits will no longer be available to buy directly with real money on the PlayStation and Microsoft Stores. While Expansion Packs, Game Packs, and Stuff Packs will remain, you’ll need to buy Moola if you want to acquire Kits going forward.

Berdasarkan laporan, interestingly, however, ea seems to have changed its mind somewhat on the kits situation. A recently leaked memo (via SimsCommunity), appears to show that the publisher intends on making Kits available for purchase directly again, without the need for Moola.

Berdasarkan laporan, unfortunately, this only appears to affect the pc version, with the reversion reportedly forthcoming on both the ea app as well as steam. Indeed, according to the same report, the change has already taken place on the former, with the latter following on April 20.

Considering the Marketplace only just launched on consoles, the company may wait to see if the decision to remove Kits from console platform marketplaces will be as poorly received as it has been on PC.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, yesterday, a rumor emerged on x claiming that marvel 1943: rise of hydra, the upcoming world war ii-era superhero game led by uncharted creator amy hennig, was being cancelled. After making the rounds on social media, new reports claim this is not the case, at least for now.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the rumor stemmed from a now-deleted x post from a fan account called marvel 1943 rise of hydra countdown claiming, through supposed inside sources, that skydance was preparing to announce the game’s cancellation. This rumor was quickly picked up and circulated by online gaming circles, gaining steam due to growing uncertainty around the game’s status.

Diungkapkan bahwa marvel 1943: rise of hydra was revealed in 2022 and stars captain america and black panther (azurri, t'challa's grandfather), alongside howling commandos member gabriel jones and wakandan spy network leader nanali, as they battle hydra during world war ii. Developed by Skydance New Media, led by Amy Hennig, it’s been repeatedly delayed, and only cinematic footage has been released. This has understandably caused many to question the game’s fate.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, a few hours after the cancellation rumor made the rounds, bloomberg’s jason schreier reported on bluesky that skydance’s leadership addressed the rumor with the development team on slack and assured them marvel 1943 was not canceled. However, Schreier adds this could change due to the uncertainty caused by the recent merger between Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount Skydance (Skydance New Media is a game development branch of the now-merged Skydance Corporation).

Skydance Games told the development team behind Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra on Slack this afternoon that the game is not canceled, despite a widely circulated rumor on Twitter today claiming that it was.

Sebagaimana diketahui, furthermore, kotaku’s rebekah valentine clarified in her report that marvel 1943 executive producer lu giglotti told staff in a skydance slack message he’d spoken directly with the executive leadership team to confirm marvel 1943 is still alive, saying, "there is no truth to these claims. " According to Kotaku’s report, Giglotti informed the team that Marvel 1943 was approaching an Alpha milestone later this month. Giglotti also told staff not to let the rumor distract them and that Skydance was "monitoring the situation" to address in the future.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, kotaku’s report also sheds light on the game’s tumultuous development cycle. Marvel 1943 was originally pitched as a Netflix game before it was eventually turned into a console and PC title. This transition means the current iteration is “light on gameplay” and lacks substantial interactions, with players primarily using a single button to play it.

Diungkapkan bahwa this isn't a completely surprising revelation, as marvel 1943 was billed as a narrative-driven, linear single-player experience when it was revealed, but the style of game has never been clear. The same reveal also saw Skydance promise the game boasted "intuitive controls and exhilarating second-to-second gameplay that captures the action and excitement of Marvel, inspired by landmark comics, television, and films, as they navigate this all-new globe-trotting adventure. " This disconnect may be attributed to Kotaku also reporting that Marvel 1943 is “well over budget,” and its overall scope has been heavily scaled back. Regardless, the outlet’s source claims the game is “close to done. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, marvel 1943: rise of hydra was initially slated to launch in 2025. It was then delayed to early 2026 "to add more polish", according to Skydance, before being pushed again to an undetermined launch window. The game has no announced platforms.

Diungkapkan bahwa tripwire's announcement claims that this was "not an easy decision, but unfortunately a necessary one for the organisation," adding that "these are truly great people who are exceptional at their roles, and we will help support these individuals with compassion and dignity during this transition. " There's a small hope in me that this might mean helping those affected find new jobs quickly, though it's hard to stay optimistic when mass layoffs in games development have become such a regular occurrence.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, despite this post primarily being about the loss of 36 livelihoods, tripwire are quick to reassure fans that killing floor 3's post-launch updates remain in active development, as does their comedy shark-action sequel maneater 2. Diungkapkan bahwa this news also arrives just days after tripwire expanded its publishing business to support small indie developers, and less than a year after its last round of layoffs in march. On this page: GTA 6 Release Times: When Can You Start Playing?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rockstar has confirmed gta 6 will officially be playable from midnight on 19th november in your local time zone. If you have preloaded the game, it'll unlock at midnight, and then you can begin playing immediately.

Berdasarkan laporan, as such, the game will unlock and be available first in new zealand. Availability will then roll out worldwide as each time zone reaches midnight on 19th November.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rockstar has now officially confirmed the gta 6 file size on ps5, and what you'll need to download, is 212gb. This is one of the biggest downloads and installs on console in history, and will probably only get bigger through patches and the addition of GTA Online.

Diungkapkan bahwa gta 6 will unlock and be playable in new zealand first, as it's located in one of the furthest along timezones. The chances are New Zealand is further along in the day compared to wherever you live in the world, so yes, New Zealand will be the first to gain access to GTA 6.

Berdasarkan laporan, because of this, there's been a rising trend in people creating new zealand psn account to play games as soon as possible. This can be done with GTA 6 too, but you'll need to set up a fresh New Zealand PSN account and buy the game through its PS Store.

Sebagaimana diketahui, gta 6 is available digitally on the ps store, or in a basic physical version that ships without a disc. The latter provides a code in the box that you redeem on the PS Store to get the digital version.

The two PS5 digital versions on offer are: Standard Edition and Ultimate Edition.

Ultimate Edition / Ultimate Edition Upgrade Contents:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rockstar is only selling gta 6 in a digital format; you can't buy the game on a physical disc in any way. There's no version with a physical disc of any kind.

Instead, a physical GTA 6 map will be put on the official Rockstar store for $0. 99. Or, it'll be included for free in all other purchases from the storefront.
