#253. Steam's new Steam Deck framerate graphs are good news for handheld players, though I wouldn't fully trust the numbers yet

📅 10 Nov 2026

Steam's new Steam Deck framerate graphs are good news for handheld players, though I wouldn't fully trust the numbers yet

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/steams-new-steam-deck-framerate-graphs-are-good-news-for-handheld-players-though-i-wouldnt-fully-trust-the-numbers-yet

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, valve have finally made clear what they've been doing with all that hoovered-up performance data and all those "framerate estimator" text strings: a framerate estimator for the steam deck. Or, rather, a framerate average-r, as games on the Steam Store are now getting attached graphs – under their existing Steam Deck Compatibility details – that show how many frames-per-secondseses that game has been recording on real players' handhelds, the OLED and original LCD models both.

Diungkapkan bahwa the thinking, as valve explain in a steam post, is to set more precise performance expectations than the existing verification ratings – verified, playable, and unsupported – provide. This may induce some gentle learned nodding, if you've ever tried an Unsupported game only to find it works more or less fine, or have ever wondered why a game that can just about scrape 30fps together gets the same green good-job sticker as something that screams along at 90fps. Now, when checking that rating, you'll also get a relatively specific idea of smoothness and/or chugging potential.

Diungkapkan bahwa or will you? by valve's own admission, the displayed results may be skewed by v-sync treachery, where this anti-screen tear setting (which many games enable by default) could force games into briefly running at unrepresentative framerates. The scoundrel. My current handheld game beau, Mortal Shell II, looks like it may be falling victim to this: its results for the LCD Steam Deck show it mostly runs around 30fps, which is in line with my experience, but the OLED results show it averaging around 45fps. The Steam Deck OLED's APU is a tiny bit quicker than the LCD Deck's, but it's not that much of an upgrade.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's work to be done, then, though i do appreciate the concept. As tightly as I cling to my battery-efficient, mercifully Windows-free Deck OLED in the face of drastically more powerful handhelds, with every year it becomes a little less likely that new games will comfortably run on it. Verification ratings can still act as decent (if broad) guidelines, but even with V-Sync putting an immaculately untorn thumb on the scales, game-specific framerate data will be much more illustrative.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as for whether these histograms will also get steam machine versions, or perhaps cover non-valve handhelds, valve say this: "we see this update as a stepping stone toward providing framerate data for more devices than just steam deck. This opt-in is currently only on Steam Client Beta, and will ship to all customers in the future. To this end, we are also prompting customers to opt-in to providing anonymized framerate data in the Steam desktop client. " So, maybe, if you gizzus yer data.

#254. Metro 2039 goes back to its Metro underground roots, with a story shaped by the war in Ukraine and the people who suffer it

📅 16 Apr 2026

Metro 2039 goes back to its Metro underground roots, with a story shaped by the war in Ukraine and the people who suffer it

Tanggal: 16 Apr 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/metro-2039-reveal-early-details

Metro 2039 takes us back to the tunnels of the Moscow Metro where, fittingly, Nazi ideology never died.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the metro series is finally, officially back with a new installment. 4A Games has just unveiled Metro 2039 to the world, the follow-up to the outstanding Metro Exodus, released all the way back in 2019.

Berdasarkan laporan, 2039 takes an unusual route with its scope, however. Rather than build on the semi-open-world structure of Exodus, the upcoming sequel instead brings the focus back to where it all began: the Metro.

Berdasarkan laporan, what won’t be changing is the kind of game that it is. Metro 2039 remains, like its predecessors, a story-driven, single-player game. Returning to the confined spaces of the Moscow Metro brings the focus back to the claustrophobic, uneasy atmosphere of the original games.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the game’s protagonist is, for the first time, going to be voiced throughout. From what we’ve been able to see, the psychological horror in this installment will be driven more by the very real effects the apocalypse has had, and continues to have, on denizens of the Metro.

Berdasarkan laporan, 2039 has been in development for years, but 4a games has been rocked by two considerable events: the 2020 covid pandemic, and russia’s 2022 invasion of ukraine, where the developer is based. The game’s darker story has changed in response to that.

The team’s Ukrainian perspective is molded into the narrative, and more prominently represents the toll the events of the last several years has taken on members of the team, their families and communities.

According to the developer, you can expect a bigger emphasis on choice and consequence, with Russian author Dmitry Glukhovsky returning to co-write a narrative that explores the compromised morality of a post-war society.

Berdasarkan laporan, the new protagonist’s return to the metro comes with the reveal that the different underground factions are now united under one banner, the not-so-subtly named novoreich. Lead by a former Spartan, the Novoreich is an authoritarian regime which offers what it believes to be the only path to salvation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 4a games remains majority ukrainian, with teams based in kyiv, and malta. Unlike most AAA projects today, the studio continues to rely on its own engine tech. The 4A Engine is given a major upgrade for 2039: ray tracing is now a core component of the rendering pipeline, but the tech has been rebuilt to run better on modern hardware.

Berdasarkan laporan, today’s reveal sadly didn’t feature much gameplay - only a brief first-look with a mix of gameplay and cinematics. The developer, however, emphasised that creating cluttered, believable and lived-in environments remains a key focus.

Metro 2039 is set for release sometime this winter on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PS5.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the four years since its ps5 release and two years since its pc port, god of war: ragnarok has reportedly sold just over 20m copies and generated $1. 5 percent of the 15m copies it sold on console came from physical editions, and the action blockbuster apparently sold a further 1. 4b in revenue, according to estimates from Alinea Analytics. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, playstation has reportedly canceled fairgames, the long-in-development live-service shooter being made by haven studios, which jade raymond founded in 2021. Sony acquired Haven in 2022, and in 2025, Raymond left the studio, though it remained dedicated to developing Fairgames without her. It seems the story of Fairgames is now over, according to a new Bloomberg report.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the publication reports that playstation will not enforce any job cuts or layoffs as a result of fairgames' cancellation, which comes as a surprise, and the studio will instead shift to support other first-party teams under the playstation umbrella. According to Bloomberg, this cancellation comes after a recent test of the game that allowed "thousands of players" to check it out did not deliver the results PlayStation wanted.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "while the test demonstrated strong operational excellence, live ops readiness and community engagement, player feedback and retention results were mixed and fell short of the goals we had set," playstation executives sean decker and john doyle wrote in an email to employees today, according to bloomberg. "Combined with challenging market conditions in the PVP shooter genre, we have made the difficult decision to cease development on the game. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa this doesn't necessarily come as a surprise. PlayStation announced Fairgames back in 2023 and hasn't shown much since, leaving many to assume development has been struggling behind the scenes. Naughty Dog's Last of Us multiplayer game was canceled, Bungie ended active development on Destiny 2, and live-service Horizon spin-off Hunters Gathering is reportedly being overhauled following poor playtest feedback, amongst other stories. Since then, PlayStation has pulled back heavily on its live-service plans, which originally included launching more than 10 live-service games by March of this year. Reading between the lines, many fans were waiting for news like today's cancellation of Fairgames to drop.

Still, in an era where games are canceled and entire teams are laid off (sometimes even after releasing a successful game), it's nice to see Haven employees are not facing layoffs.

CD Projekt Red has worked with an AI voice generation company on next year's The Witcher 3 expansion, Songs of the Past, so the Polish voiceover for Geralt can match the original game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, jacek rozenek, the original polish voice actor for geralt has returned to voice the character for all the content in songs of the past. However, the actor unfortunately suffered a stroke in recent years that impacted his voice. This has left his voice unrecognisable compared to the lines he recorded for the original RPG.

Having received Rozenek's blessing, CD Projekt Red recorded all his voice work for Songs of the Past, and has taken that work to AI company Respeecher, who will make it sound like Geralt from the base game.

Berdasarkan laporan, again, this only affects the polish language option. Doug Cockle has returned to voice Geralt for the English language version.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rozenek suffered a stroke in 2019, and he was unable to speak following it. Through hours of training every day, he was able to return to voice acting in 2022, when CD Projekt Red released the PS5 version of The Witcher 3. There was a new quest in that edition, and the work he had to put into the voice lines accompanying it left Rozenek "exhausted" after the recording.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rozenek has recorded his polish voice lines for songs of the past as usual, but he's supportive of the developer's decision to involve respeecher to make them sound like geralt: "the point is that this voice should be as close as possible to my voice from 12 years ago. for the creators of this game. Szwed added that CD Projekt Red only considered this route because of Rozenek's health issues, and having gained his blessing, thinks this is an "ethical" use of AI that can do some good.

#260. Skydance Games lay off an undisclosed number of staff in the wake of Paramount-Warner Bros. merger, in latest case of consolidation killing livelihoods

📅 10 Nov 2026

Skydance Games lay off an undisclosed number of staff in the wake of Paramount-Warner Bros. merger, in latest case of consolidation killing livelihoods

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/skydance-games-lay-off-an-undisclosed-number-of-staff-in-the-wake-of-paramount-warner-bros-merger-in-latest-case-of-consolidation-killing-livelihoods

Berdasarkan laporan, a little over a month following the huge, vile, culture-defining (negative) merger between paramount and warner bros. into Skydance, the corporation has confirmed that games division Skydance Games will be facing a round of layoffs, according to a report from Variety.

Berdasarkan laporan, skydance games was born from combining paramount and warner bros' own individual divisions, bringing developers like netherrealm, rocksteady, wb games montreal/boston, tt games and avalanche under the same umbrella as marvel 1943: rise of hydra developers and teenage mutant ninja turtles: the last ronin publishers paramount games studio. All this was was done, of course, to maximise the amount of IP that the corporation can access to base games on, such as Avatar: The Last Airbender, Game of Thrones, Star Trek, the DC Universe, Harry Potter, and more. Skydance Games came into existence on October 6th; it barely lasted a month as it was.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a statement given to variety, skydance confirmed that "as part of our ongoing efforts to position skydance games for long-term growth and success, we are implementing reorganization and operational shifts across a few areas of our business. As a result, there are roles impacted. We have stepped back and taken some time to consider where we are investing our efforts and have made the difficult decision to scale down some of our projects. We are committed to approaching the process with transparency, care and respect for those who are leaving the company. This is not a reflection of the talent, dedication, or creativity of those affected and we are grateful for their contributions. " Skydance did not disclose the number of staff affected.

Sebagaimana diketahui, skydance joins the ever-growing list of corporations that have mandated layoffs in the recent past, such as microsoft, ubisoft, and ea. Workers will bleed until there is no one left to cut. Solidarity to all affected.

#263. Every 2026 Pokemon TCG Set Ranked From Worst To Best

📅 13 Nov 2026

Every 2026 Pokemon TCG Set Ranked From Worst To Best

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/pokemon-tcg-2026-sets-ranked/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sam woods is thegamer’s senior reporter. He’s been in games journalism since 2020 and has undertaken a variety of roles in that time. These have included roles such as SEO Editor, Managing Editor at DualShockers, and Global Head of Gaming, and he's also been seen on the BBC. He was promoted to the Senior Reporter position in 2025 following a series of high-quality reports and exclusives for TheGamer.

Diungkapkan bahwa since 2020, sam has written over 3,000 articles and specializes in telling the stories of the people behind the games. He’s also interviewed some of the world’s biggest musical artists to find out how the medium has inspired their work, and TV and Film actors about their roles in video game adaptations. He’s interviewed the biggest game directors, some of the industry’s top talents, told the stories of how indie games came to be, and spoken to players about what really makes them tick. He even hosted a PAX panel in 2021 and made a documentary in 2024 surrounding the creation of a Disney game.

Diungkapkan bahwa alongside this, sam focuses on breaking news. These articles have been picked up by the biggest gaming sites, including IGN, GameSpot, and PC Gamer. He got the scoop on Perfect Dark’s cancellation, provided context on some AI drama, and revealed that Lady Dimitrescu’s actress would love to step back into the character’s giant shoes. He also loves to dive into the numbers behind the games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sam’s journey in games journalism has taken him all over the world. He’s covered Gamescom in Germany, Summer Game Fest in Los Angeles, and Tokyo Game Show in Japan, each on three occasions.

He’s been learning Japanese since 2024 with the intention of identifying and translating Japanese-language news and bringing it to English-language audiences first, something he’s done countless times.

Sam’s first review was 2020’s Battletoads reboot, and he’s since reviewed games in The Legend of Zelda, Super Mario, and Pokemon franchises.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, last week, the pokemon company released the final pokemon trading card game set of the year—delta reign. It's perhaps a set that encapsulates 2026 as a whole for the Pokemon TCG, or at least the sets released, with some great cards, but not enough.

Berdasarkan laporan, as an avid pokemon tcg fan, i've opened more than 100 packs of each of this year's expansions and experienced the highest highs and the lowest lows. Putting the scalping issues aside for a second, here is our ranking of each, from worst to best.

Berdasarkan laporan, this was the easiest choice on the list— perfect order is comfortably the worst set the pokemon company released this year. It made sense to feature Mega Zygarde so prominently, given its importance in Pokemon Legends: Z-A, but there are 100s of other Pokemon to catch in Z-A, whereas the Mega Zygarde ex SIR took up one of only four SIR slots in the set. As a TCG, you need cards featuring Pokemon that will sell sets, and Mega Zygarde isn't one of them.

Berdasarkan laporan, the meowth sir is cool, and both the godzilla starmie and clefable sirs have some nice colors, but it's not a great selection, and the irs don't save it either. In my preview, I called it the worst expansion since 2024, and I stick by that.

Berdasarkan laporan, pitch black suffers from a lot of the same problems perfect order does, it's lacking a killer pokemon. Had the regular Darkrai been the feature, it'd have been far better, but instead we got the much-maligned Mega Darkrai. The card is killer, but it's not one that makes the set stand out, and as such, it falls low on the list.

Sebagaimana diketahui, like perfect order, pitch black features a pretty but underwhelming selection of sirs, including morpeko and mega chandelure, and a lackluster set of irs, which is saved only by slowbro. I called the set "deflating" in my preview, and I think that sums up the Pokemon TCG's recent momentum nicely.

Berdasarkan laporan, if there is one thing the pokemon trading card game did really well this year, it's making cards that pop​​​​​​. All of Chaos Rising's SIR's have really nice color schemes, but again, they mostly feature Pokemon nobody cares about. The Mega Greninja ex definitely puts it above the Mega Darkrai and Mega Zygarde. It also has the best IR selection of the three sets comfortably so far.

While this has no bearing on the rankings, during my Chaos Rising preview, I had some staggering pulls and called it the "most astonishing pack opening" I've had in 30 years of collecting.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, delta reign is the pokemon tcg's latest set, and it takes the top spot of the four regular expansions released this year. It does something the other three failed to do, and has TWO banger SIRS. I said the Mega Rayquaza SIR would be one of the most expensive cards in a while, and I was wrong, but it's still over $300 and a stunner; the Raikou SIR takes the cake for me, though. Jumping down a stormy mountain, the Gen 2 Legendary looks fantastic.

Berdasarkan laporan, with irs featuring adorable pokemon like eevee, growlithe, zorua, and azurill, delta reign takes the prestigious bronze medal. It's a damning indictment of the year, however, as I called the set "a big comedown" after the 30th Anniversary expansion, and suggested that "some of the spark is missing. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, speaking of the 30th anniversary celebration, it takes my second place of the year, and i'd say it's one of only two truly great sets in 2026. The main expansion understands the assignment—tons of popular Pokemon in celebration scenes—but it's packed with extras, too.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the 30-pikachu subset is really cool, and i'll never tire of the classic collection, pulling some of my favorite cards from a time gone by. It's chock-full of hits, and every opening is guaranteed to bring joy. I called the expansion "the most refreshing in years" in my recent preview, and with seemingly solid stock levels, it's one I'll be happy to open for a while.

Diungkapkan bahwa the pokemon company kicked 2026 off with style with ascended heroes. The affectionately named "Treekachu" is great, the Mega Gengar is menacing, the Mega Dragonite is beautiful, and all three SIRs featuring the starters are vibrant. It's probably my favorite since 2021's Evolving Skies, and it features some of the best SIRs ever created. There are too many to name-check, and I think that's what makes this set so good—the variety.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the irs let it down a little, though there are some bangers; the sirs do so much heavy lifting that it doesn't really matter. In my preview, I may have bemoaned the set size, but I said, "Ascended Heroes, for me, goes down as an all-timer. It has some of the best art created in Pokemon TCG history, and I had a blast getting through my packs. Even some of the Mega Attack Rares are peak. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa we want to hear from you. Share your perspective in the comments below, and please keep the conversation respectful.

Bandai Namco has announced it is shutting down Reflector Entertainment, the Montreal studio behind 2024’s Unknown 9: Awakening.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, reflector, founded in 2015, is a subsidiary of bandai namco that was acquired in 2020. Unknown 9: Awakening is the studio’s only released title, which was first revealed at Gamescom 2020 and released on October 17, 2024. The third-person action game is set within the broader Unknown 9 transmedia franchise, which includes a book trilogy, comics, and a web series, and stars Haroona, a woman able to traverse a separate dimension called the Fold. Haroona, played by The Witcher actress Anya Chalotra, uses this ability and other supernatural powers to battle a hostile secret society across India and other global locations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, upon release, unknown 9: awakening didn’t make much of a critical splash; it currently has a 59 metascore and "mixed" steam reviews. In November 2024, a month after Unknown 9's launch, Reflector laid off 18 percent of its staff. More layoffs were announced in January 2025 as Reflector canned an unannounced project while confirming Unknown 9 failed to meet expectations. With Reflector’s dissolution, Bandai Namco expects to post “an extraordinary loss” of approximately €21 million on its Q3 financial results for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.

#267. Following site-wide discussion on AI use, Nexus Mods add a "daily limit" to the spots in the new mods tab one person can hog via multiple rapid-fire uploads

📅 10 Nov 2026

Following site-wide discussion on AI use, Nexus Mods add a "daily limit" to the spots in the new mods tab one person can hog via multiple rapid-fire uploads

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/following-site-wide-discussion-on-ai-use-nexus-mods-add-a-daily-limit-to-the-spots-in-the-new-mods-tab-one-person-can-hog-via-multiple-rapid-fire-uploads

It's a "stopgap solution" while the site's staff are busy "working on more sophisticated tools".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the folks behind nexus mods have rolled out a new "daily limit" system which ensures modders who upload multiple works in bulk during a single 24 hour period can't take up more than one spot in the tabs dedicated to showing off new mods for different games. Instead, those who chuck up their mods in bulk will see one of their works given a spot, while the rest are neatly filed away behind it, ready to spring out if you click a bit of text indicating that modder's got other fresh works to show off.

Diungkapkan bahwa "nexus mods owner and ceo victor 'foledinho' folmann hinted measures related to making the glut of new mods currently uploaded on a daily basis less of a discovery nightmare in last week's announcement post about the site's current policy regarding the use of genai in mod making. "We’ve received feedback regarding authors uploading numerous mods at once and overwhelming the Recently Added section, pushing everyone else down the page," he wrote. "This is less of an issue related to AI, but it’s becoming much more prevalent as mod production is speeding up. The first of these updates will be available soon. Thus, we’re trying out limits on the number of mods from one author that can be shown in this section to give others a better chance of getting noticed. We’re also putting tighter restrictions on uploads from newly created accounts. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, cue an an announcement on nexus mods' discord server yesterday by community manager phoenix introducing the new "daily limit", which nexus were keen to emphasise is "an experiment" they're open to feedback on. This limit refreshes every twenty-four hours – so if you publish one mod every day, you won't be affected. "We know that time in the New Mods view is important for a new mod to be discovered and we believe every mod author should have equal chances of having their work seen," they wrote. "While we're working on more sophisticated tools to give you control over the mods displayed to you, we are testing a stopgap solution that we hope will address the issue for now: For the time being, the New Mods view will display one mod per mod author. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the all mods, updated, trending, popular, and surprise tabs for games are unaffected by the change, so will still dedicate a tab to each work regardless of who uploaded it when. If you take a glance at the New Mods pages for the likes of Skyrim, Fallout 4, and Cyberpunk 2077 this morning, you can already see the new mod stacking in action. The most mods from the same author I've seen stacked atop each other so far is 14 Fallout 4 works piled up.

It's worth noting you can also toggle the show only one new mod per modder rule off in the new mods tab, bringing back the older layout with one slot per mod regardless of uploader.

Diungkapkan bahwa personally, i tend to sort by mods with the most endorsements or downloads within the past 24 hours or seven days when i'm scanning for new mods, rather than just scrolling back through the new mods tab. Though I appreciate that could mean I've been missing out on some stellar works by lesser known modders whose creations never get the traction they merit thanks to being buried under an avalanche of other works. If so, hopefully this update does help the lone mods avoid being run over by mass upload freight trains.

Sebagaimana diketahui, first off, version 4. 2, dubbed So Laughed the Masses, arrives April 22, making two characters playable, and bringing back a host of beloved characters for re-runs. The new update continues the Phantasmoon Games arc, as the story takes an especially suspect new development.

Huang's permanent replacement will have some massive shoes to fill.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Sebagaimana diketahui, has there ever been a tech ceo quite like jensen huang? the nvidia chief has been an emblematic figure to pc gamers for years, before transcending into one of the primary architects of the ai revolution. Regardless of whether you love or hate the technology, (and the financial behemoth that Nvidia has become), you have to admit that Huang has presided over a meteoric rise to the top, the likes of which the tech world has rarely seen.

Diungkapkan bahwa now huang, the nvidia cofounder, figurehead, and global ai industry pillar, has announced his resignation. The admission of an affair with someone some people suspect to be a Chinese spy, followed days later by reports of another affair with an Nvidia employee, proved to be his undoing as Nvidia chief.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nvidia's share price has dropped significantly in recent weeks. In many ways, the situation is unprecedented, and it's hard to draw parallels. Investors, likely looking for some sort of stability after the past few weeks of AI and tech company financial woes, seem shaken. But now Huang has gone, it puts Nvidia in the unenviable position of finding someone to replace him at the top of the stack.

Nvidia CFO Colette Kress has taken over as interim CEO for now, but the board will almost certainly be trying to avoid a situation where it ends up with a revolving door of bosses over the next few years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, which brings me on to intel, which has found itself working through ceos at a surprising rate over the past couple of decades. While there are obvious downsides to having a single, totemic figure at the top of a company structure, flat or otherwise, swapping them out on a regular basis isn't necessarily good for business, either.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, intel enjoyed a good run of stability under ceo paul otellini, who served as intel chief from 2005 to 2013. He was then succeeded by Brian Krzanich. He became Intel's CEO in 2013, after joining the company in 1982 and working his way to the top. His tenure was not regarded as a particularly successful one due to stagnation in development, but the Intel ship continued to sail onwards for the next five years regardless.

Diungkapkan bahwa then intel learned that krzanich had been engaged in a consensual relationship with an employee, an interesting echo of current events. And so Intel's quest to find a suitable CEO began again. After the board decided this was in violation of Intel's non-fraternisation policy, Krzanich resigned. As a temporary solution, previous chief financial officer Bob Swan took over the top seat in 2019, although reportedly reluctantly.

The PC Gamer Circuit Breaker newsletter breaks down the latest PC gaming tech, and finds you the best deals on the best products.

Diungkapkan bahwa swan's time as intel chief was marred by manufacturing setbacks, which allowed tsmc and amd to pull ahead in terms of market share. Financially, though, Intel continued with strong performance—perhaps expected with a finance guy at the helm. Still, a more permanent CEO needed to be found.

Berdasarkan laporan, the company eventually landed on pat gelsinger. Gelsinger began his career at Intel at just 18-years-old, before working his way up to the CTO position over a 30-year-period. After a stint at EMC as president and chief operating officer (and later CEO of VMware), Gelsinger took over the reins of Intel in 2021.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, gelsinger's strategy for the company (in the face of fierce market competition) was based on a stunningly ambitious roadmap of five process nodes in five years, while focussing on intel's foundry business. He famously once said that he'd "bet the whole company" on its then-upcoming 18A process node.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, more manufacturing delays, workforce cuts, and a broken consumer cpu scandal were just some of the issues faced by the company towards the end of gelsinger's reign. This super ambitious roadmap, in combination with these factors and others, led to poor financial results for Intel, and Gelsinger retired at the end of 2024.

Berdasarkan laporan, this then led to cfo david zinsner and intel executive michelle johnson holthaus leading the company in co-ceo roles until 2025, when current ceo lip-bu tan was brought in. "They [had] too many silos, too many people needed reporting. Tan set about reorganizing the company, changing its structure so that engineering departments reported directly to him. And even though they come to the CEO, they are not paying attention to it," said Tan in May of this year about the previous company structure.

Diungkapkan bahwa "so i decided the best thing is to really understand where the problem is," tan continued, "so that i can focus on the engineering, how to redesign, [how to] simplify the products, and then get the real killer product out. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa intel has reported extremely strong financial results under tan's leadership, after a deal signed with the us government to steady the financial ship—although the company took a significant knock in the recent tech share sell off due to its position in the data center cpu market. However, while Tan now looks to be firmly in place at Intel, the company's ride through the market over the past two decades has undoubtedly been a bumpy one.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and still pretty bumpy today. It recently cut its sales outlook as the PC market flounders thanks to AI eating up all the RAM, and its share price plummeted as a result.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, finding a ceo with jensen huang's level of influence, public profile, and ability to lead the company to ever-greater heights seems near impossible. Whoever leads Nvidia next will step into truly gigantic shoes, and in the face of an AI market that looks increasingly wobbly, they'll need to be the right person for the job. And swapping leaders out on the regular? Well, it's taken its toll on Intel over the years, that's for sure.

Berdasarkan laporan, all of which must weigh heavily upon those sitting underneath the big green logo in santa clara, working out exactly who the next ceo should be. It's not easy, running a massive tech corporation, that much is clear. Not the least bit with the US government already making its thoughts clear on who might take the job. And in the modern world, they don't come much bigger than Nvidia.

#273. Intergalactic PS5 in the 'Last Stage of Production', Gameplay Coming Next Year

📅 12 Nov 2026

Intergalactic PS5 in the 'Last Stage of Production', Gameplay Coming Next Year

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/11/intergalactic-ps5-in-the-last-stage-of-production-gameplay-coming-next-year

Neil Druckmann thinks the game will "surprise people".

Diungkapkan bahwa since the announcement of naughty dog's next big game, intergalactic: the heretic prophet, we really haven't seen or heard much about it. In 2027, though, that's set to change.

In a brief appearance on a live show at Comic Creators Block Party 2026, director Neil Druckmann has teased a few things about the upcoming sci-fi adventure.

You can see all the Intergalactic chatter in the post below:.

Diungkapkan bahwa druckmann says the game is at the "last stage of production", meaning "we can play it, we're refining and polishing it". He says he "can't wait to show it to the world. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, it sounds like 2027 will be big for intergalactic, as sony and naughty dog will "show a lot of it next year" including "gameplay" and "more of the story". Whether the game actually launches next year is another question, but at the very least we'll be seeing plenty more of it.

"I think it'll really surprise people, what they think the game is and what it actually is," Druckmann says.

He also talks about how Naughty Dog has been making "relatively grounded" games for a long time with Uncharted and The Last of Us, and Intergalactic presents an opportunity for the team to explore something more fantastical.

"Something we've been really hungry for is to go sci-fi," he says, referring to the studio's previous series, Jak & Daxter.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we really wanted to take everything we learned from that franchise, which is sci-fi/fantasy, the pulp action adventure stuff we learned with uncharted, the more serious drama we got from the last of us. [Intergalactic] really is a combination of those three franchises. ".

Druckmann continues, talking about how the aim is to combine Naughty Dog's cinematic storytelling chops with "deeper gameplay systems" in Intergalactic.

I'm super excited to finally learn more about this game in 2027; fingers crossed its release won't be too far behind.

Diungkapkan bahwa @girlversusgame so true — depending on the game there can be some importance to relatability to the character you play as, but usually that’s not limited by the protagonist’s gender or orientation, in my experience. And that’s all fine, people can play or not play according to their heart’s desire but in the case of many games, I think they do themselves a disservice by ruling out a game simply because of the outward appearance of a character or a perception of the traits of the character. I guess it’s summed in the old adage ‘don’t judge a book by its cover. Part of gaming is experiencing a fictional world and doing things you can’t do in real life. I loved playing as (and could relate to) Aloy, Lara Croft, Jesse, Max Caulfield, Selene (Returnal), Kay Vess (SW Outlaws), Amicia (Plague Tale), or Kat, as well as playing as Kratos, Nathan Drake, Miles Morales, Cal Kestis (SW Jedi games), Snake, Joel, or Sam Bridges. Sometimes being able to relate to the character adds some extra value, but also sometimes role playing as someone different from you also adds to the impact of the experience. I also feel that games can be a great way to learn and broaden one’s horizons. I think there’s just a general lack of open-mindedness that a sector of the fandom lack. ’.

#274. Payday 3 Devs Thank Community In Official Blog Post

📅 13 Nov 2026

Payday 3 Devs Thank Community In Official Blog Post

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/payday-3-free-weekend-success-320000-players-team-promises-more-updates/

Sebagaimana diketahui, the payday 3 comeback is finally happening. I've been screaming from the rooftops to anyone who will listen (usually annoyed colleagues and uninterested friends) for some time now that the game is good, and certainly in a better state than it launched in. The free weekend just proved that, as the team pulled in over 320,000 players—250,000 of which were new to the game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "thank you," starbreeze ceo adolf kristjansson said in a new blog post. "Thank you to the veterans who carried a crew of rookies through their first heist (you were kind, supportive, and you welcomed the new recruits into our community). You turned a free weekend into something far bigger than we planned for. Thank you to the rookies who tripped every alarm in the building, but still returned for more! Thank you to everyone who recommended the game to a friend, and convinced them it was worth their time. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa kristjansson openly admits that a year ago, payday 3 would never have been able to pull off a free weekend this successful; the game "had not lived up to what you expect from this studio. " But as over 320,000 players worked together to fill their duffel bags with $600 billion in cash, "enough to make most countries nervous," the team promises that they aren't stopping here.

#275. Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business Review - Delivering Where It Matters

📅 10 Nov 2026

Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business Review - Delivering Where It Matters

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/review/australia-did-it-end-of-the-world-railway-defense-business/delivering-where-it-matters

Berdasarkan laporan, australia did it: end-of-the-world railway defense business is a game i catch myself playing in my head long after i shut it off. Though it uses turn-based strategy as its base, it expands beyond the genre’s regular confines, blending elements from roguelikes, puzzle games, bullet-heaven titles, and the tower-defense genre. The result is an experience that demands wide-scale experimentation and rewards improvisation.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a post-apocalyptic world where the atlantic ocean has dried up, you risk your life to ensure your shipment reaches its destination. Riding from station to station by train, you must build your team amid your many missions as various mutated creatures, malicious machines, and coordinated soldiers attack your convoy. Lore is doled out piecemeal and serves mostly as background dressing, but each time I learned more about the world, I became more curious.

Diungkapkan bahwa to survive the harshness of the wasteland, you must use cindermint, an in-game resource gained for surviving turns and killing enemies, to spawn defenders, with three base classes to choose from. The revolver-wielding Gunslinger is your primary damage dealer, while the Radshot applies corrosive radiation damage, and the Nomad offers a close-range shotgun blast with knockback.

Diungkapkan bahwa those base-level characters offer solid variety upon which to build. At the onset, you can merge two Nomads to create a level 2 Nomad with increased damage and knockback, but the real fun comes in combining disparate units to create completely new characters. In the midst of battle, you can merge two units of the same level to create new, more powerful defenders, influenced by the traits of those used in the merge. And that’s where the main hook for Australia Did It comes in: experimentation through combination. Even now, more than 15 hours into my gameplay, I’m still concocting new combinations I want to try on my next run.

Diungkapkan bahwa by the end of my first successful run, i had multiple level 6 characters, including a railgun-toting heavy, mages who steal health from enemies and redistribute it to nearby allies, a drone that can move beyond the walls of the station to attack enemies directly, and, my personal favorite, a dual-shotgun-wielding one-man wrecking crew. However, many of these higher-level units also possess drawbacks to consider, like the railgun scorching all adjacent tiles or the drone running out of battery if it’s outside the walls for too long. Though I started keeping notes in my head about which combinations led to my favorite results, I was grateful for a comprehensive compendium that tracked the tens of unit types I unlocked through this rewarding experimentation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the meat of the experience places your squad on a 25-tile square board with enemies spawning from the four principal directions. Thoughtfulness and positioning are crucial, as each unit on your squad possesses different traits and movement efficiency, as do the encroaching enemies. Basic enemies often make a beeline toward the station, while others may take a weaving route or keep their distance and blast you at range. Improvising and adjusting your strategy on the fly is the most engaging part of Australia Did It, and when you perfectly adapt in the moment, or escape the scenario by the skin of your teeth, there are few better feelings I’ve experienced in a game this year.

Diungkapkan bahwa your goal in this phase is to simply defend the station and gather resources to strengthen your squad before evacuating and moving on to the next area. I fist-pumped as I watched the train pull out of a station that was about to crumble, and I lamented the loss of high-level units I had to leave behind to ensure the survival of the convoy. The process is ceaselessly thrilling, even as you begin to see how the gears work under the hood. Considering each unit's strengths, weaknesses, and capabilities while strategically positioning them around the station takes some getting used to, especially during the more chaotic stages. I just wish I could say the same about the intervening train sections.

Berdasarkan laporan, once you escape the turn-based strategy portion, your surviving squad members hop aboard the train and chart their route. Using a basic map, you choose your next stop, with factors like enemy types and modifiers shown to you ahead of time. The top-down train segments between station-defense stages are largely passive; the units you evacuated from the previous station automatically attack swarming enemies with the same traits and perks they have in the main gameplay areas. You can aim a focus cone to instruct your units, but you’re at the mercy of the units you’ve brought. You can trigger an ultimate ability to send your defenders into overdrive, but I rarely needed it.

Diungkapkan bahwa while i love the idea of intentionally crafting a team that’s good at both the turn-based strategy and bullet-heaven transport sections, i was never fully engaged getting from point a to point b. Instead, I often caught myself checking how much longer before my train arrived at the next station; these sections can be completed in a minute or two, but that doesn’t alleviate the feeling that it’s a step down from the other gameplay. These novel portions aren’t bad by any means; they’re merely an average part of an otherwise excellent experience.

Diungkapkan bahwa looking back on the hours i poured into australia did it, the forgettable train segments will occupy only a small part of my memories, just as they do in each run. Instead, what will stick with me for months to come are the creative combination mechanics, the outstanding turn-based defense system, and the thrill of uncovering the mysteries of this bleak, yet engaging world.

".

#281. Asha Sharma Issues Statement On Xbox's 25th Anniversary And The Future Of Gaming

Asha Sharma Issues Statement On Xbox's 25th Anniversary And The Future Of Gaming

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.purexbox.com/news/2026/11/asha-sharma-issues-statement-on-xboxs-25th-anniversary-and-the-future-of-gaming

"Our largest studios will be able to pursue ambitions as far beyond today’s games".

We've been waiting all week for Xbox to acknowledge its 25th anniversary in a formal fashion, and Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has now issued a statement discussing the past, present and future of the brand to celebrate its birthday.

Diungkapkan bahwa it's a pretty lengthy statement, and a lot of it is just about recapping the history of xbox and microsoft gaming as a whole. Sharma talks about how things have come a long way since "Microsoft Adventure" in 1979, and then how Xbox was "impossible to miss" in 2001 while also revolutionising online play and being there for the launch of Halo.

There's also a cool high-definition ad for the original Xbox console that you can see down below.

Diungkapkan bahwa "when the original xbox launched in 2001, it was impossible to miss. It was 2-3x larger than rival consoles, with a giant X molded into a black enclosure and a bright alien green jewel at the center. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "a year later, xbox live revolutionized online play with persistent friend lists and matchmaking, as well as a common service for developers to build connected experiences. And bringing all of this together was Halo: Combat Evolved, a launch title that not only defined XBOX but proved its first advertising campaign: “Games Will Never Be The Same. ”.

After going through the history, Sharma mentions that each of the 111 people who have worked at Xbox since the beginning will be getting "a special engraved console to commemorate what you’ve helped build".

She then references the fans, Xbox FanFest and how today's FanFest event in Seattle will "bring the celebration home".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the story of xbox has never been ours alone. We’ve been celebrating this anniversary with fans around the world and special launches. Our fans have challenged us, cheered us on, held us accountable, and stuck with us. Today, we are bringing the celebration home to Seattle. ".

And finally, the most notable bit in this statement is probably what she says about the "next 25" years of Xbox, highlighting that the "cost, resources, and risk required" to create modern games has grown dramatically, and that it's had an impact on the ability to turn ideas into games, or at least allow those ideas to reach their potential.

As a result, she says it's something that "must" be changed, and that people and small teams will "soon" be able to achieve things that currently require much larger teams and financial resources in today's world.

Berdasarkan laporan, "while modern games demonstrate the heights of human craft in ways unimaginable just decades ago, the cost, resources, and risk required to create them have grown just as dramatically. As a result, too many ideas never become games, and too many games fall short of what their creators imagined. For decades, this has been the unavoidable tradeoff of ambition. We must change this. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "throughout human history, the scale of what we could create was determined by the people, capital, and resources we could command. A single person will soon be able to wield capabilities that once required entire nations. A small team will be able to build worlds that today demand hundreds of developers and hundreds of millions of dollars. That relationship is beginning to break. And our largest studios will be able to pursue ambitions as far beyond today’s games as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is from its first entry in 1982. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "i believe the future of gaming will look more like its beginning, when a small team with a big idea could change how the world plays. Our responsibility is to deliver great games, unmistakable hardware, and give more people the chance to make something the world has never seen. ".

There's some interesting stuff in here for sure, and we reckon it might be worth keeping an eye on tonight's Seattle Xbox FanFest event for any potential announcements - after all, it's the final stop and "home" destination for the FanFest tour.

For now though, let us know what you think about Asha Sharma's statement down below!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, yes. The passage is strongly AI-related, although it never explicitly mentions artificial intelligence.

It appears to be alluding to the transformative potential of AI, particularly generative AI, in video game development.

Berdasarkan laporan, 1. "A single person will soon be able to wield capabilities that once required entire nations. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, 2. "A small team will be able to build worlds that today demand hundreds of developers. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, 3. "The cost, resources, and risk required to create them have grown dramatically. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, no. The passage deliberately avoids mentioning AI, machine learning, or generative AI.

The underlying message is that AI and emerging technology will fundamentally change the economics and scale of video game development.

The author is suggesting that the next generation of games will be created with fewer people, fewer resources, and significantly greater creative ambition.

The wording is particularly interesting because it frames AI not simply as a way to cut jobs or costs, but as a way to enable creative possibilities that were previously impossible.

My verdict: I would interpret this as an indirect statement about the future of AI in gaming, with AI likely being a major part of the vision, even though the passage carefully avoids naming it directly.

Diungkapkan bahwa the way i look at it is that ai is just a natural progression of the technological revolution. In a decade, when AI involvement will be much greater, it will be largely accepted that this is the way games get made. Just as with the Industrial Revolution, humans will adapt to it happening, and will find other means of employment, and just as with the Industrial Revolution it won't happen all at once, it will be a gradual process of replacing certain tasks within game development, with the dynamic of who does what changing over many years rather than all of a sudden. Right now, there is resistance within the gaming community, but as time goes on, and AI usage becomes more prevalent, so too will the acceptance of the gaming community that this is the way of things.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i think what will sway things is that games will be made faster; potentially a lot faster. AAA games that take 5 to 7 years to make now, will be made in 2 to 3 years, and then possibly fewer than that as AI improves and is more deeply implemented.

Diungkapkan bahwa what should also happen, is that games will cost a lot less to be made, and hopefully that will be passed on to the consumer. If a game costs £200 million to be made now, it needs to be sold at £70 in the hope of recouping that money. With AI heavily involved, that development costs far, far less, and I think those companies that pass on those savings to the gaming community may find that it is very much appreciated.

So, if games can be made more quickly, and cost less, then I personally do not see the downsides of that because regardless of AI humans will always be involved somewhere along the process.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm of the same mindset, @titntin. I won't boycott a good game using AI just because it uses AI. All I really want, at the end of the day, is to enjoy the games I play, and if it is created using AI so be it.

Diungkapkan bahwa i don't want to sound heartless, and i don't like the idea of passionate developers using their jobs, but throughout history man has developed tools to make their jobs easier, less laborious, faster and ultimately cheaper. People losing their jobs to a new technology has happened ever since the start of the Industrial Revolution began.

Berdasarkan laporan, worldwide, as new tools and methods became available, we saw miners replaced by machinery. The same happened in the car industry where robots replaced human workers. In each of those examples (which happened in my lifetime) the workers found alternative employment, and the same will be true of game development; as AI becomes more and more capable, it will become more and more prevalent, and as it does more and more developers will find themselves being replaced (which I think is what Sharma is banking on as she dismisses 3200 employees this year). Many of those developers will move to other studios not yet in a position to deploy AI and still needing the human guiding hand, and some will move to completely different employment.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ultimately, i think human involvement in gaming will always be a thing, but over the next decade, many of them will be gradually replaced, and we, the gamer, will embrace the good games that come out. If AI is not up to the required standard, then the games will fail, but as time goes on, I can foresee that many of the games we play will have had heavy input from AI, and providing they are good, we will simply play what we are offered, and our protestations regarding the use of AI will gradually peter out just as happened with all the strikes when the car industry was changing, for example, and we will accept that change is inevitable because like it or not change is coming.

The Petit Planet beta is coming back with new updates, but you still need to hope for an invite

Tanggal: 02 Apr 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/petit-planet-stardrift-test-details

If you've been missing Petit Planet since it was last available to play, you'll be happy to know that HoYoverse is hosting another test soon.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s been quite a while since we’ve heard anything about petit planet, the upcoming game from genshin impact and honkai: star rail developer hoyoverse. By most accounts, Petit Planet is the studio’s take on Animal Crossing, though with a few interesting ideas of its own.

The game’s most recent test took place all the way back in November, but its next big test isn’t far off.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, hoyoverse announced today that petit planet’s stardrift test is scheduled for april 21. This latest build will be available on PC, Android, and iOS. The beta will include new Neighbors, an updated Starsea Voyage, and more for you to do at the Galactic Bazaar.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, seeing as interacting with neighbors is a core part of this life sim rpg, the confirmation that new faces will be available in this test is big news. Each Neighbor in Petit Planet is a character, with their own personalty and life story.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the starsea voyage now includes a map, too, which you can use to take you to other islets. If you played any of the previous tests, you should already be familiar with this feature.

Diungkapkan bahwa the only bit of bad news here is that this remains a closed beta. You’re still encouraged to sign up on the official website, but you’re not guaranteed access. HoYoverse said that only a portion of players who sign up will be invited to the upcoming beta.

Diungkapkan bahwa petit planet remains without a release date. If nothing else, it’ll be interesting to see the progress the game has made since last November’s beta.

Berdasarkan laporan, grand theft auto vi launches next week on thursday, november 19. You can preload the game on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S starting today, as detailed by Rockstar Games, PlayStation, and Xbox. Alongside this announcement, both PlayStation and Xbox have revealed that – surprise! – GTA VI is the most preordered game in the history of their respective digital stores.

Berdasarkan laporan, that's not shocking – gta vi is, by many metrics, the most anticipated game in history, with its predecessor, grand theft auto v, selling nearly 235 million copies since its launch back in 2013. Yes, you can go to a store to pick up a GTA VI box (and you can do so today, allowing you to preload the game), but inside that box will be a download code for a digital version of the game – you won't find GTA VI on a physical disc. There's also the fact that Rockstar Games is not releasing a physical edition of GTA VI, per se. So, naturally, many players are opting to purchase the game on digital storefronts like the PlayStation and Xbox game stores.

Berdasarkan laporan, "grand theft auto vi, the most preordered title of all time on the microsoft store, launches november 19," an xbox blog post reads. " PlayStation echoes this statement with a blog post of its own that reads, "Grand Theft Auto VI is now the most preordered game in the history of the PlayStation Store. Given this unprecedented demand, we've joined with Rockstar Games to allow players to start preloading the game nine days early, so they're ready to play on launch day. "Considering the unprecedented demand, we encourage everyone to begin preloading as soon as possible to ensure you're prepared for launch day. ".

There you have it: People are very excited about Grand Theft Auto VI.

Grand Theft Auto VI launches next week on November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for more, check out the song "pusher" from the game's original score, then check out the gta vi launch trailer. After that, check out this exclusive story about how GTA VI features over 170 animal species and another about its tropical storms and hurricanes. Be sure to read about how GTA VI will target 30 FPS gameplay on all consoles, too.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the event is being hosted at event space mana wynwood, and the pre-sale lottery for tickets begins this week on wednesday, 11th november. Tickets are limited to two a head.

Berdasarkan laporan, the full soundtrack for gta 6 is yet to be revealed, with only a handful of songs so far detailed - featuring rauw, ca7riel, paco amoroso, and travis scott, among others. But of course music and radio stations play a huge role in the series, and given the amount of time we'll be playing GTA 6 and listening to these songs, it may well provide a lucrative platform to be featured on.

Meanwhile, the cultural impact of GTA 6's imminent arrival continues with a takeover of swanky department store Selfridges in London, which has a custom Ferrari parked in a window and an extensive range of expensive merch to buy.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's not all good news for rockstar, though. The company is also fighting an employment tribunal in Scotland relating to the sudden firing of 31 staff from Rockstar North this time last year. Rockstar alleges this was done for gross misconduct reasons, whereas the fired staff maintain it was done in the name of union busting. The results of that hearing are expected close to GTA 6's release, on 19th November.

#285. Don't be fooled by Horses of Hoofprint Bay's hand-drawn art, this stable management game has all the drama of a Jilly Cooper novel

📅 10 Nov 2026

Don't be fooled by Horses of Hoofprint Bay's hand-drawn art, this stable management game has all the drama of a Jilly Cooper novel

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/dont-be-fooled-by-horses-of-hoofprint-bays-hand-drawn-art-this-stable-management-game-has-all-the-drama-of-a-jilly-cooper-novel

Sebagaimana diketahui, poema is my pride and joy. She'll never be a show jumper, and that's where the money and prestige are to be found. She was my first horse and she's a competition winner, but she's reached her potential. If I'm ever to grow my horse farm into a nationally renowned equestrian centre, I need the cash to expand and upgrade my facilities. Poema is a hoofstep on the path to that future, but she's not going to be able to take me all the way herself.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for all its hand-drawn aesthetics, horses of hoofprint bay has hard realities like the limits of poema's future bubbling under its surface. While the game's scripted narrative may be lacking, it's shockingly easy to fill in the gaps with drama worthy of a Jilly Cooper novel.

Diungkapkan bahwa there may be better author comparisons, but i learned everything i know about showjumping from cooper's riders – much as i learned everything about independent television franchise bids in the '80s from its sequel rivals – a book which is as much about the nitty gritty of horsetraining and competing as it is about toffs jumping into bed with one another. I was hoping there would at least be a similar setup to Regency Solitaire, where your motivation for touring the country's tearooms is motivated by paying off your brother's gambling debts. In Horses of Hoofprint Bay, the only real story you get is the fact you've scrimped and saved to buy your first horse and your uncle has lent you the use of his field while you start your business. In my mind the two are tightly connected - showjumping and Jilly Cooper, not horses and toff bonking. Yet, despite this disappointing start, I soon found its business simulation mechanics provide great storytelling material.

Diungkapkan bahwa horses of hoofprint bay has many of the trappings of a cosy game. Even something like taking a dirty horse to a contest can cost you. Leave an abrasion untreated and it can develop into an infection. Forget to brush down your horses' coats or pick out the stones in their shoes, and they're liable to develop saddle sores and other injuries when you ride them. At the start of each day, you'll prepare the stables, dragging a rake around the yard to sling away the manure, clicking buckets of water to refill the trough, and making sure there's enough hay for all the horses. I forgot to brush Poema before entering her into her first contest and despite taking first place, her embarrassingly unkempt coat lost my stable prestige. But this isn't just for the larks, if you skip these tasks there are serious knock on effects for yours horses. It was a cruel end to what should have been a great celebration.

Diungkapkan bahwa so long as your horses are well rested, you can train them each day. These latter too are much more tiring, but they build a horse's strength and endurance. The higher its endurance the more energy it can expend on training sessions each day, and the higher its strength the more jumps it can do in succession before slowing to a walk for a breather - essential when you're competing in a timed competition. You may want to take them through some confidence building lunges, where they need to walk, trot, and canter on demand, or a more physically demanding Cavaletti or showjumping course. Overdo the exercise, however, and you'll exhaust a horse, severely reducing its energy for the next day.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, now, unlike poema, my freshly bought stallion kolizey has the potential to compete in showjumping competitions. He'll never go all the way to the big national contests, but he can take a ribbon in the district and regional contests. Or he will when he's up to standard; he's arrived from the breeder in a sorry state: brambles in his mane, mud on his flanks, stones in his shoes, and his strength and endurance are far too low to make it through an entire course of obstacles.

Diungkapkan bahwa the biggest problem, however, is kolizey's confidence: it's shot. Before I can hope to earn him his first ribbon, I have to build up our relationship. I don't know what was happening in the stalls at the breeder's, but he arrived at my stables backing up at the first sign of a jump. If we exercise together enough in the yard, his confidence will grow and he will follow my direction without question.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it may be getting ahead of myself, but i also have plans for kolizey and poema to produce a foal. I want both horses to be at peak physical fitness. A stronger horse means a ticket to the bigger contests and the bigger prize pots. Done right, the two should raise a horse that's able to exceed its parents' potential, becoming stronger and more endurant than both of them. Not that I can start breeding the two just yet. Poema's already there, while Kolizey can't even manage a jump without shying away.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while getting koliszey contest ready, i still need to be bringing in cash. That means using Poema as a training horse for students' riding lessons. The better I am at the minigame where I use the Q, E, W, A, S, and D keys to tell them to sit forward or back, hold the reins higher or lower, or to level out their legs, the more they tip me. I have to be careful, because when Poema is working with students, she's not being stretched, and her strength and endurance can wither which means she struggles to maintain her winning streak in the contests.

Sebagaimana diketahui, another reason to hold off on getting poema pregnant is that during the second half of her pregnancy, she can't be ridden, which means no contests and no lessons for students. Currently, those are my two main sources of income besides what I'm paid in rent to board a couple of nearby farmers' horses. I don't want her out of the rota when Kolizey isn't yet ready to step into her place.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and, well, while i'm on the subject of plans, reader, i must tell you, the future lies in semen. I'm not going to afford all that by giving riding lessons to the local children or boarders' rent. With the money I bring in from a prizewinning semen I can expand into the far field, creating space to take on more horses, upgrade my home from the caravan I'm living in currently, maybe even build a proper training school. If I can build the facilities, earn the cash, and raise Kolizey's profile, I can make a good buck on his virile stallion cream. No, the big money comes from competition wins and valuable horse sauce.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while poema continues entering contests and carrying students, i start pushing kolizey harder. Multiple training sessions every day. I begin with Cavaletti, which is a kind of obedience competition. Your horse has to be travelling at the correct speed when it passes marker flags – walking, trotting, or cantering – and make some small jumps over cross bars. He warns me before he's about to speed up or slow down, and if I counter it in time he will obey me and even receive a little confidence boost, but often he does it just before a jump, messing up my timing and he hits the bars. It should be straightforward, but because Kolizey's confidence is so low, he keeps refusing my orders and trying to change speed. Each time he fails a jump it knocks his confidence, risking me taking me even further from where I need him to be.

Berdasarkan laporan, i try the easier lunges sessions. The time limits on these are much stricter, so you have to clear the course at a gallop. The faster you're going, the more strength it requires to jump an obstacle. This is also where a horse's strength really comes into play. And they raise his confidence a little but they're doing little for his physical health. It's all taking too long and Poema's getting older every day. In a fit of frustration, and in mark that I may not be able to cut it as an animal trainer, I skip from the Cavaletti training straight into a showjumping qualifier. Horses only recover strength when moving at a walk, so you don't want to tire a horse out by going at a gallop through the whole course, else they won't have the strength to make all the jumps and they'll be forced to withdraw from the event. But nor do you want to go too slowly and fall foul of the time limit.

Diungkapkan bahwa i realise my mistake as soon as the course begins: i try to stir kolizey into a walk he refuses. I tap again and Kolizey moves up to a trot, then to a canter, before picking up to a gallop. Thankfully the timer only starts when he crosses the line, but it's an inauspicious start. With a nervous eye on the depleting strength bar, I tap him down to a canter for the next jump. We're halfway through the course, I briefly slow to a walk to recover some strength then take the next three jumps at a canter. I think he's going too fast as we approach the first jump, but Kolizey clears it. I tap forward again and he begins to walk. We're so close to the end now but a big yellow exclamation mark appears next to the strength bar. Then another jump and another. Kolizey is on the edge of exhaustion but he refuses to slow down and increases to a gallop for the last two jumps.

Berdasarkan laporan, he completes the course with a perfect clear. Not only has Kolizey earned his showjumping license, his success swells his confidence. Not a single obstacle clipped and we end with ten seconds left on the timer. He's a natural athlete.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the next day, with my horses rested, i take kolizey and poema to town to compete in the showjumping and caprilli events respectively. They both bring home first place, raising the prestige of my stables, earning me a tidy little packet, and convincing me it's time my prized horses started a family. They've earned it. I'm perhaps too eager, when I try to send them to the breeding station, I'm told they're both 'Done for the day'. I suppose I should give my contest winners a bit of a break. I groom them and send them both to bed with an apple as a treat.

Diungkapkan bahwa except, maybe they weren't too tired: the next morning, i'm met with a message telling me poema is pregnant. My stable's become the Olympic Village, with my rosette-winning horses working out the highs and stresses of competition in the only way they know how. Good on them. I needn't have even made the breeding station.

Berdasarkan laporan, then, with horror, i remember the horses i'm boarding for the neighbours. Neither of them are at competition level, their strength and endurance is lower even than Poema's when she arrived at the stable. If either of them are the father, Poema is about to be out of action for a whole season and at the other end of it I'll have a foal that can't even compete in the beginner events. They're both stallions themselves. fetch the equestrian version of Hercule Poirot, I need to find out who impregnated my horse!.

It may not be a plot worthy of Cooper, but it will do for me.

Professor Layton And The New World Of Steam English Voice Cast Revealed

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2026/11/professor-layton-and-the-new-world-of-steam-english-voice-cast-revealed

Sebagaimana diketahui, it has been a tense wait to see whether level-5 would bring in real, human voice actors for the regional dubs of professor layton and the new world of steam, or whether it would slip into the ol' ai that its ceo seems to bring up at every given opportunity. Fortunately, it's positive news.

Diungkapkan bahwa the dev has today revealed the game's english voice cast, and it's headed up by christopher robin miller and lani minella — the returning north american layton and luke voice actors from the main series. You can even hear a snippet of them in action on the game's website, and yes, the nostalgia is a welcome listen.

The returning actors will be joined by the likes of Amber Lee Connors (Persona 4 Revival, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, Unicorn Overlord), Nic Olsen (Genshin Impact), Arthur Romeo (Street Fighter 6, AI: The Somnium Files - nirvanA Initiative) and more.

Interestingly, Cat Protano (Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition, Trails in the Sky) seems to be taking on the role of Luke in the UK dub, and not the previous main series actor, Maria Darling.

The website also showcases the cast list for the game's French, Italian, German and Spanish dubs, all of which use real voice actors — what a concept!.

Pre-orders for the New World of Steam's PC and PS5 releases have gone live today, with Switch 1 and 2 pre-orders expected at a later date.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's worth pointing out that the newly published steam page doesn't feature the site's ai disclosure, which is required for all games that use visual or other in-game ai assets. The lack of a disclosure doesn't mean AI hasn't been used under the hood (CEO Akihiro Hino said it hasn't been used anywhere in the game), but the last few years following Level-5 have made us cautious at every turn.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, years after its initial reveal, professor layton and the new world of steam finally got a firm release date back in the september direct: 10th december. We're cautious about getting our expectations too high around it, but the returning voice cast goes a long way toward alleviating some initial fears.

#287. The Legend Of Zelda Series Was Struggling Before Breath Of The Wild

📅 13 Nov 2026

The Legend Of Zelda Series Was Struggling Before Breath Of The Wild

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/the-legend-of-zelda-series-was-struggling-before-breath-of-the-wild/

Berdasarkan laporan, it's easy to forget that zelda fans were fed up with the formula not too long ago; twilight princess was often criticized for being too derivative of ocarina of time, and skyward sword—while a critical darling—was frequently called out for its excessive hand-holding. These games are looked back on fondly now, but the series was in need of an update at the time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, breath of the wild and tears of the kingdom might already be facing similar complaints, with vocal fans online calling on nintendo to drop the open world altogether in favor of a more classic zelda experience, but throwing link into the expanse of hyrule is what saved the series. To hear former Nintendo employee Krysta Yang say it, "They were selling like nothing. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i remember i was going to the focus groups. They had to do something drastic. We had so much data of every game, it was fewer, the interest in the audience was getting smaller and smaller. It was a really dark moment of like, the feedback is the fan base is dwindling," co-host and fellow former Nintendo employee Kit Ellis added. "This is not bringing in new players. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa kit claims the idea that the zelda team tore down the foundations at the "peak of their popularity" to make room for a more experimental, open-world game is "revisionist history"—fans were not interested in the series anymore. Breath of the Wild wound up selling over 36 million copies across Wii U and Switch, whereas Skyward Sword sold a mere 3. Tears of the Kingdom, meanwhile, sold almost 23 million copies. You only need to look at the chasm between their sales. 5 million copies on the original Wii. The open world games put Zelda back in the spotlight.

Would it really be a Nintendo console without a proper Zelda title on it? Here's every Legend of Zelda game available on the Switch.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of course, the lesson to take from their success isn't that open-world zelda is better, and that nintendo should continue pumping out breath of the wild games. That stagnation is exactly what led to the series' downfall in the first place. The lesson should be that experimenting with the formula and taking big swings pays off, and the team shouldn't pigeonhole themselves into one style or else they risk fans getting exhausted again.

Strauss Zelnick says that Nintendo "should be very proud" of the Ocarina of Time remake.

#288. Marathon’s Symbiosis Update Adds Host Of New Modes, Including Permanent PvE, Next Month

Marathon’s Symbiosis Update Adds Host Of New Modes, Including Permanent PvE, Next Month

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/2026/11/10/marathons-symbiosis-update-adds-host-of-new-modes-including-permanent-pve-next-month

Sebagaimana diketahui, bungie has detailed its upcoming symbiosis update for marathon, which introduces several significant modes next month. Chief among them is the new permanent PvE mode, which Bungie previously experimented with and promised earlier this year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, symbiosis is headlined by expedition, a co-op pve destination with roguelite elements. Expedition pits teams of players against escalating challenges and offers randomized upgrades called Flash Boosts to increase their odds of success.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the perimeter zone has also been expanded with the new burrows and reservoir areas. Another addition is Limbo, a new social hub for players to gather that features a firing range. You can also try out the new sword-wielding Bishop Runner Shell alongside new weapons and gear, such as the Maverick pistol, throwing knife, hack grenade, and V17 flamethrower. Lastly, you can test your skills against other players in the beta PvP Deathmatch mode.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, symbiosis arrives in marathon on december 8. An open play week will kick off the same day, allowing new players to experience all of Marathon’s content for free until December 15.

Berdasarkan laporan, the symbiosis update marks marathon's evolution into a more co-op-friendly, pve experience as its initial focus on pvp extraction has struggled to sustain a substantial audience since its march 5 launch. Bungie announced in September that it plans to spend the rest of 2026 improving Marathon's core mechanics and features while giving players more agency for how they engage with it beyond competitive PvP.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you’re only interested in the 5-star variants, you’ll be happy to know that infold is sticking with 150 pulls as the absolute maximum to guarantee earning netherlord. This will be automatically unlocked after you pull both Nether Yearning and Nether Parting through the Wish Pool.

Berdasarkan laporan, obtaining either of the two will give you access to all chapters for the new myth that’s also available as part of this event: yin yang sundering. You can read all the lore once either of the two Memories have been unlocked, and you won’t even need to upgrade either of them.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the lost souls event has also kicked off alongside the new update. You can take part to claim a 4-Star Solar Slor Memory Pair for Caleb: Duskshard Dreams and Duskshard Lotus. You can also earn the 3-Star Memory, Lotus Bond, alongside some other freebies like more Wishes, Diamonds, Photo Poses, and an event-exclusive title.

Berdasarkan laporan, after you unlock caleb’s netherlord companion, you may want to fight alongside him to get another 4-star memory for free. You’ll need to challenge the the Rehearsal Stage to do so, and your first clear is guaranteed to get you the Duskshard Lotus Memory.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you’re new to love and deepspace, or you simply want a refresher, we’ve put together a guide to help you wrap your head around myths; how they work and how to unlock them. Banners are also an important part of any gacha game, Love and Deepspace included, so here’s how banners work, and what the current and next banners are.
