#291. Activision cracking down on popular Call of Duty: Warzone app that basically constituted cheating

📅 09 Nov 2026

Activision cracking down on popular Call of Duty: Warzone app that basically constituted cheating

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/call-of-duty-warzone-agent-cheating-software-shutdown

"Lobby shopping" is what Call of Duty: Warzone players have been calling the ability to check the skill level of players in a lobby prior to joining it, enabling them to pass on those that include a lot of tough competition.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are several ways players, notably twitch streamers and content creators, have been able to do that over the years. But the use of one app in particular - Warzone Agent - has been considered by many to be cheating, and Activision is finally doing something about it.

Alongside the launch of Modern Warfare 4's version of Warzone and the game's first season of post-launch content, Call of Duty's anti-cheat team Ricochet has announced it's officially cracking down on Warzone Agent.

Berdasarkan laporan, "yesterday, we began taking action against warzone agent, a paid, unauthorised third party tool that lets users lobby shop in warzone," the developer revealed in a post on x. "Ricochet anti-cheat will block players attempting to load the software and instruct them to unload it before accessing multiplayer. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, having the ability to cherrypick the lobby with the lowest-skilled players possible bypasses the game's matchmaking algorithm, potentially ruining the game for the dozens of other players in the match. Historically, content creators have used the app (and other methods) to post impressive kill records.

Berdasarkan laporan, as part of this crackdown, ricochet reiterated its stance on boosting - artificially increasing (or decreasing) one's skill rating - saying that it too is considered cheating. "Receiving a boost, having another player log in to boost your account, or purchasing a boosted account are all against policy," the developer said.

Berdasarkan laporan, "boosting services flood lobbies with low effort accounts used to farm xp and complete challenges. Those accounts can later be sold as Ranked Play ready, directly feeding the cheating marketplace. ".

More than 20,000 boosting-related accounts have been removed since the launch of Modern Warfare 4, according to the developer, and Ricochet will "continue to apply pressure" in this area.

The quality of multiplayer was a particular highlight in Eurogamer's review of Modern Warfare 4, in which Dom Peppiatt lauded the complexity of weapon handling, which works without taking away from accessibility of the gunplay.

Nintendo Switch 2, PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S.

#292. Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy releases in January, leaving not very long to prepare for all the crunchy cRPG choices and secret wars it'll lob your way

📅 09 Nov 2026

Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy releases in January, leaving not very long to prepare for all the crunchy cRPG choices and secret wars it'll lob your way

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/warhammer-40000-dark-heresy-releases-in-january-leaving-not-very-long-to-prepare-for-all-the-crunchy-crpg-choices-and-secret-wars-itll-lob-your-way

Embrace the role of an Inquisitor in the grim darkness of the not so far away future.

Sebagaimana diketahui, oh shit, that's not too far away. Terrifyingly, that last sentence is now a thing I can accurately write about games coming out in January 2027. Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy has just been confirmed as one such game, with the cRPG's heresy investigation set to commence towards the end of the month.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, january 28th, 2027, is the full dark heresy release date, as announced by devs owlcat on steam. The beta version of the game'll be closing down on January 7th to make way for the full game, so as of writing there's still some time to give that a go if you fancy.

If this is the first you've heard of Dark Heresy, here's Owlcat's synopsis of what it's all about:.

Berdasarkan laporan, embrace the role of an inquisitor in the grim darkness of the far future in a crpg set in the rich warhammer 40,000 universe. Start your service as an acolyte of the Inquisition: Investigate heresy, command a diverse warband, and shape the fate of the Calixis Sector in a story-rich experience where every decision has weight, justice is non-existent, and the line between salvation and damnation is razor-thin. Explore an in-depth depiction of the Inquisition as an organisation and the vast force it commands: its power, bureaucracy, and inner conflicts laid bare like never before.

Diungkapkan bahwa as an inquisitor, you have one primary goal: to protect the imperium, whether that be from the taint of xenos, the betrayal of heretics, or the scourge of mutants, by any means necessary. Be the conduit of the Emperor’s will in a place where all hope was lost decades ago, explore the mysteries of the maddening Tyrant Star, and overcome the worst horrors thrown at you by the Noctis Aeterna.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a place where all hope was lost decades ago? you sure this is the warhammerverse and not real life lads? i jest, but bursting into rooms and shouting 'nobody expects the god-emperor’s inquisition!' monty python-style does sound quite fun. Oisin's previously written in more depth about what Dark Heresy devs have said regarding what to expect from its investigations, if you want nitty-gritty details rather than references to sketch comedy.

#293. Guide: PlayStation Studios: All Sony First-Party Developers and What They're Working On

📅 10 Oct 2018

Guide: PlayStation Studios: All Sony First-Party Developers and What They're Working On

Tanggal: 10 Oct 2018 | Sumber: https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/playstation-studios-all-sony-first-party-developers-and-what-theyre-working-on

Sony's first-party developers are known collectively as PlayStation Studios, and it's these teams that make all the games published by the company.

Sebagaimana diketahui, whether it's ps5, pc, or beyond, there are always new games in the works. While we don't always know everything about what's in development, we've done our best to collate all the current info in this page.

Diungkapkan bahwa below, you'll find a list of every subsidiary studio under sony's umbrella as well as what they're currently working on. We'll be updating this article every so often, when new information comes to light.

On this page: PlayStation Studios: All Sony First-Party Developers and What They're Working On.

Here are all of Sony's teams working out of the company's home country.

Originally an internal development unit named Polys Entertainment, Polyphony Digital is best known for creating Sony’s flagship racing simulation franchise, Gran Turismo.

Sebagaimana diketahui, current projects: polyphony has been supporting gran turismo 7 consistently since launch, with lots of free updates adding new events and vehicles. While this looks set to continue, we expect work has begun on the studio's next game, which will presumably be another Gran Turismo.

Berdasarkan laporan, team asobi rose from the ashes of japan studio, initially an internal group building tech demos and on-boarding software such as the playroom. It brought us Astro Bot Rescue Mission for PSVR, PS5 pack-in game Astro's Playroom, and is now best known for its full-fledged 3D platformer, Astro Bot.

Diungkapkan bahwa current projects: team asobi's post-launch updates and support for astro bot appears to have concluded, so we can presume the whole studio is now working on its next game. It isn't known what that game is, though given Astro's success, we reckon a sequel is likely.

Below you'll find details on all of SIE's European studios.

Diungkapkan bahwa firesprite has an interesting history; it was initially formed by developers from studio liverpool, an old sony studio shuttered in 2012. After The Persistence and supporting Sony on The Playroom and The Playroom VR, it made Horizon Call of the Mountain alongside Guerrilla. It's now SIE's largest UK-based studio.

Current Projects: Firesprite is currently working on Until Dawn 2, a narrative horror adventure game coming to PS5 in January 2027.

Berdasarkan laporan, creators of the killzone franchise, and acquired by sony following the release of shellshock: ‘nam 67 in 2005. One of SIE's most technically capable studios, it's now best known for Horizon Zero Dawn, which runs on the studio's own Decima Engine.

Berdasarkan laporan, current projects: guerrilla is currently making horizon hunters gathering, a co-op action game with roguelike elements and a very different art style. Also in the works is Horizon Steel Frontiers, an MMO being built for PC and mobile; NCSOFT is spearheading production, but Guerrilla is involved as well. It can also be safely assumed that Horizon 3 is in the pipeline.

Sebagaimana diketahui, finnish developer housemarque has worked closely with sony for over a decade. The studio specialises in arcade-like action, bringing us titles such as Super Stardust HD, Resogun, and of course its latest work, Returnal. The success of the latter pushed Sony to acquire the team in 2021.

Berdasarkan laporan, current projects: housemarque recently released saros, a rogue-lite third-person action game that builds on the returnal formula. It has since released a free update adding more content and features. Plans for what comes next are unknown.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the makers of the littlebigplanet franchise, and one of sony’s most imaginative studios. Media Molecule was acquired by Sony in 2010 following the success of Sackboy’s inaugural adventure.

Diungkapkan bahwa current projects: with post-launch support of dreams now concluded, media molecule is working on its next project, which will be a new ip. It's expected this will reduce the focus on creation and will be a more traditional game. Reports suggest it's making an Animal Crossing-esque life sim.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a company held aloft for its uniformly excellent pc ports, sony acquired nixxes in 2021 for this exact purpose. It's mostly been focused on porting existing PlayStation Studios titles to PC, but made its first real creative effort with Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered in 2024.

Berdasarkan laporan, current projects: nixxes collaborated with housemarque on saros. It's also likely to be working on unannounced PC ports.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, xdev is a team that mostly concerns itself with providing support to external teams that are making playstation-exclusive titles. Over the years it has helped bring many games to PS5 and PS4, such as Detroit: Become Human, Returnal, Death Stranding, Stellar Blade, Rise of the Ronin, and many others. Though it originated in the UK, the company now also operates in the US and Japan.

Current Projects: XDEV is working with Housemarque on Saros, Arc System Works on Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, and presumably more yet to be announced.

Berdasarkan laporan, most of sony's best-known studios hail from the united states. Here they all are — plus a bonus Canada team!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, infamously created bubsy 3d for the ps1 before moving on to the syphon filter series under the eidetic name. Acquired by Sony in 2000. Historically focused on portable games, the team broke back into AAA territory with Days Gone on PS4.

Current Projects: Unknown, though reportedly it won't be a Days Gone sequel.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, famed for its expertise in first-person shooters, bungie has made some of gaming's best-loved franchises in halo and destiny. Thanks to its work on the latter, Sony acquired the company in 2022 during its big push into multiplayer and live service games. Bungie has retained some autonomy under this new ownership, though this has softened over time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, current projects: bungie's latest is marathon, a reinvention of its own sci-fi shooter series from the 90s. This iteration is an intense extraction shooter that launched in March 2026. It'll be supporting this game for the foreseeable future.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a new studio co-founded by jade raymond, famed for her work on the assassin's creed and watch dogs series. The developer has yet to release a game, but has been scooped up by Sony as the team works on its debut project.

Berdasarkan laporan, current projects: haven was developing the now-cancelled fairgames, an online multiplayer shooter described as a "competitive heist experience". The studio is currently acting in a support role for other teams.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, famed for playstation exclusive series such as ratchet & clank and resistance, the developer has felt like part of the first party family all along. With Marvel's Spider-Man and Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales being such huge hits, it's no wonder Sony scooped the studio up in 2019.

Berdasarkan laporan, current projects: insomniac recently released marvel's wolverine exclusively for ps5 in september 2026. It's extremely likely that Marvel's Spider-Man 3 is in the works, too.

Sebagaimana diketahui, perhaps the most famous of sony’s studios, naughty dog has a long history creating series such as crash bandicoot, jak & daxter, uncharted, and the last of us. Acquired in 2001.

Sebagaimana diketahui, current projects: naughty dog is currently working on sci-fi action adventure game intergalactic: the heretic prophet. It's expected this will launch in 2027, though no release information has been announced yet.

Most famous for the critically acclaimed MLB The Show series, San Diego Studio has previously operated as a support studio for external developers, and has also worked on titles like The Mark of Kri and Pain.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, current projects: san diego studio recently launched mlb the show 26, the latest instalment in its annual series. It's also working on MLB The Show Mobile.

Berdasarkan laporan, creators of the god of war franchise. Previously incubated developers like thatgamecompany, while also serving as a support studio for external developers working on exclusive games.

Diungkapkan bahwa current projects: santa monica studio's next game is god of war laufey, a game following faye and what happens to her after she dies at the start of god of war (2018). This is due for release in May 2027. Additionally, the team has announced God of War Trilogy Remake, which revisits the Greek mythology games, though this is further out.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one-time nintendo 64 developer, sucker punch is the creator of playstation fan favourites like sly cooper and infamous. Acquired by Sony in 2011, the studio is now best known for Ghost of Tsushima.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, current projects: sucker punch most recently released ghost of yotei, an indirect sequel to ghost of tsushima. Ghost of Yotei Legends, a co-op multiplayer DLC, is now also available. It's unknown what the studio's next game will be.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of sony's newest studios, teamlfg is a developer that began as a standalone team within bungie, but has now spun out to become its own thing. It has yet to release a game.

Diungkapkan bahwa current projects: teamlfg is working on something currently known as project gummybears. It's described as a "team-based action game that draws inspiration from fighting games, platformers, MOBAs, life sims, and frog-type games" set within a "lighthearted" and "comedic" sci-fi universe.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, valkyrie is perhaps best known for its guns up! series, which sony published on various platforms prior to the acquisition. After being a reliable external collaborator on several projects, Valkyrie Entertainment was brought into PlayStation Studios in December 2021. It has since provided support on numerous games including God of War Ragnarok, The Last of Us Part II Remastered, and Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection.

Sebagaimana diketahui, current projects: valkyrie entertainment holds its cards very close to its chest, so it's difficult to know what it's working on. It can be assumed it's helping out across various projects within PlayStation Studios.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that's everything we know about playstation studios and its current projects. Which is your favourite of Sony's first-party developers? What games do you want to see them make next? Discuss in the comments section below.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as the editor of push square, sammy has over 15 years of experience analysing the world of playstation, from ps3 through ps5 and everything in between. He’s an expert on PS Studios and industry matters, as well as sports games and simulators. He also enjoys RPGs when he has the time to dedicate to them, and is a bit of a gacha whale.

If I had to rank the top five Sony developers in terms of what I’ve seen in terms of fun, graphically and/or technologically impressive games along with potential for future awesomeness:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 1. Naughty Dog. It’s been the juggernaut, top dog, tour de force studio that Microsoft’s always dreamt of having, and it’s what Rare should’ve/would’ve been if MS hadn’t wasted Rare’s time with avatars and Kinect experiences.

Berdasarkan laporan, 2. Spiderman. Yeah, Insomniac rules. Here’s hoping for a Feral Rights sequel/remake for PSVR 2, done with the size, scope, and budget a true AAA game should have! Make the system seller VR2 truly needs and deserves. Spyro. Ratchet and Clank. Insomniac. Put our faith back into VR, Sony (or send the job over to MediaMolecule because they’re known for their innovative tech-based PlayStation games.

Berdasarkan laporan, 3. God of War. Santa Monica Studios. Boom!.

Diungkapkan bahwa 4. InFAMOUS 2 was so, so good! After years of trying different open world games, InFAMOUS 2 was the first one that I truly sunk my teeth into. It was my personal gateway to an entirely new gaming world. Sucker Punch. And the ability within that game to create and design your own missions? Revolutionary! SP took a slight step back with InFAMOUS: Second Son and First Light, but their work in creating Sly Cooper keeps them at #3.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 4. Housemarque. Fantastic action games. In an alternate universe where arcades still exist, Housemarque would be #1 and it wouldn’t even be close.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, 5. Guerrilla Games. Horizon. Killzone. Awesome-sauce.

Diungkapkan bahwa as an aside, i love claphanz for the fantastic hot shots golf games (which includes the vr game, too!). I’d have loved to see more Hot Shots entries in golf and other sports—tennis, baseball, football, basketball, soccer, volleyball, fencing, curling, hockey, tee-ball, tag, axe throwing, log cutting, fencing, corn detasseling—heck, it doesn’t matter what sports are represented. Berdasarkan laporan, @oram77 yeah, i didn’t intend to cast any blame or criticism, per se, rather more of a surprising (and disappointing) observation. Development takes ages now. It is what it is. Added to that the poor strategic planning that resulted in several cancelled projects and studio closures and… here we are.

Diungkapkan bahwa i don’t hold it against bluepoint or media molecule necessarily. I’m sure BluePoint’s PS6 game will be fantastic. It’s just crazy to think they might go the length of the entire generation without a release (Demon’s Souls Remake at launch notwithstanding). And I suspect Mm will squeeze out something on PS5, and it will probably be good too.

Diungkapkan bahwa the development cycles for even studios that didn’t have years wasted on a canceled project are now around 5-6 years (taking ghost of yotei as an example. Or Death Stranding 2) whereas it was previously about 2 years, especially for sequels. (Again using Sucker Punch as an example — Infamous 2009, Infamous 2 2011, Infamous: Festival of Blood 2011, Infamous Second Son 2014, Infamous First Light 2014. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, i’m not saying anything we don’t already know, development times have increased 2-4x compared to prior generations. If it can improve efficiency and keep production on track (and keep a studio from being shut down as a result) then maybe that’s a good thing. It’s one reason why AI may not be such a bad thing as a tool to streamline some of the tasks of development, so long as it doesn’t replace the creative parts of the process. But that’s a whole other discussion for debate.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i will say also, that despite the drastic ballooning of game development times, there has been an equally significant expansion in number of developers producing games, particularly from emerging markets. As a result there is no shortage of games to play and in fact, we have more games than ever before to choose from. So I don’t necessarily want to imply that it’s doom and gloom.

#294. Marvel Cosmic Invasion's Doctor Doom-Themed DLC Gives It The Post-Game Tail It Was Missing

📅 10 Nov 2026

Marvel Cosmic Invasion's Doctor Doom-Themed DLC Gives It The Post-Game Tail It Was Missing

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/impressions/2026/11/10/marvel-cosmic-invasions-doctor-doom-themed-dlc-gives-it-the-post-game-tail

Sebagaimana diketahui, marvel cosmic invasion was a bit of a dream game for me; i loved the x-men arcade game in the '90s, so when tribute games released the excellent teenage mutant ninja turtles: shredder's revenge in 2022, i immediately hoped they'd revitalize other licensed brawler franchises released by konami in the late '80s and early '90s. While we still haven't heard any word of a new brawler starring The Simpsons, Tribute did follow up its Turtle triumph with Marvel Cosmic Invasion, another throwback side-scrolling beat 'em up, this time starring Marvel's mightiest.

Berdasarkan laporan, i played through marvel cosmic invasion multiple times and had a blast, but i moved on quickly, as i didn't feel the need to collect different palette-swaps of the many heroes on offer. Even after Cyclops and The Thing joined the roster as DLC in May, I still saw Cosmic Invasion as a game in the rearview. That changes this week, as The Siege of Castle Doom not only adds two additional playable characters (Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom), but also a mode that has the potential to bring me back for more runs for the foreseeable future.

Sebagaimana diketahui, seeing that annihilus is threatening the universe, doom decides to take matters into his own hands. In The Siege of Castle Doom, you select your team and fight your way through various floors of the stronghold belonging to the man who is perhaps Marvel's greatest villain. Unfortunately, much in the way that it seems that he may try to fix the multiversal incursions in the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday, Victor Von Doom's solution in Marvel Cosmic Invasion – the Cosmic Inductor – would lead to untold death and destruction. Your goal is to fight through the winding, randomized hallways of Castle Doomstadt, charging Reed Richards' Stabilizer and tactically bolstering your team along the way, before Doctor Doom can enact his plan.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as for the new playable characters, doctor doom is less agile, but his attacks pack a whallop, while invisible woman's force fields and speed make her the more versatile pick. I don't know that I see either of them replacing my mains from the base game, but I had fun experimenting with them throughout this mode. Regardless of which character you choose from the expanding roster, you still must traverse Castle Doomstadt before Doom achieves his objective.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fighting through waves of enemies across differently themed and booby-trapped rooms, you encounter all manner of foes from the base game, as well as new minion types from doom. Conversely, each time an enemy hits your character, it charges Doom's Cosmic Inductor, inching him closer to victory and making his minions faster and stronger in the process. As you might expect, the rooms get harder the deeper you go, and while each player starts with two characters to swap between, if a character completely depletes their health, they're gone for good, making it even tougher. When you defeat enemies, they drop batteries that charge your Stabilizer, letting you even the odds and stop Doom. As such, you need to keep your eyes on each character's health and swap them out when it makes sense.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as you complete each room, you can choose which path to take to augment your characters with new special abilities. True to the roguelite structure, as you complete rooms, you can also buff your characters' stats within the run. Certain rooms offer extra batteries to help your Stabilizer charge, while others offer new and upgraded equipment. There's also one that promises random events that can easily alter the trajectory of your run for better or worse. Though I often enjoyed boosting attack stats to make enemies less like damage sponges, I had to balance that against buffing their health to keep them alive and charging the Stabilizer to have a fighting chance.

Berdasarkan laporan, beyond the in-run upgrades and modifiers, you can also amp up the action run-over-run through upgrades in reed's lab, which add to the pool of modifiers you can select from at the start of each run. While I've only done a few runs of The Siege of Castle Doom (each taking between 45 and 90 minutes, depending on how successful you are), I feel a revitalized sense of excitement for Marvel Cosmic Invasion. The expansion also adds new palettes for existing heroes, plus new music by composer Tee Lopes. Tribute claims completionists can spend upwards of 15 hours in this new mode, which has me champing at the bit to dive back into what will likely be my primary way of interacting with Marvel Cosmic Invasion going forward.

Berdasarkan laporan, marvel cosmic invasion – the siege of castle doom is available today on all platforms, and it is a strong addition to an already great game. You can read our review of the base version of Marvel Cosmic Invasion here.

#295. Never one to lag behind HSR and ZZZ, Genshin Impact will introduce its own new pink-haired animal-themed girl in Version Luna 6

📅 27 Mar 2026

Never one to lag behind HSR and ZZZ, Genshin Impact will introduce its own new pink-haired animal-themed girl in Version Luna 6

Tanggal: 27 Mar 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/genshin-impact-luna-6-new-mondstadt-area

Plus Mondstadt is expanding yet further north in Genshin Impact's Luna 6 update.

Diungkapkan bahwa today’s genshin impact special program has wrapped up, and it’s brought us some big news about the next major update. Luna 6 is the next phase in the action RPG’s story, titled Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo - Augured Homecoming.

It’s set to arrive on April 8, bringing with it a tonne of new content, including a big expansion to the original region of Mondstadt.

Diungkapkan bahwa as part of this new update, mondstadt’s northern parts expand with new areas. The new Dornman Port is one thing, but the most exciting is the Temple of Space. This floating structure is home to Asmoday fragments, and is made up of different realms inspired by Liyue, Sumeru, and various other civilizations from around Teyvat. Launching with the update is a new mechanic that lets you manipulate the space to reveal hidden paths containing secrets.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you take the time to explore, you’ll find a lot to there to learn about asmoday, ruler of space. There’s a new boss to take on in the temple, too: Watcher: Fallen Vigil.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the only new character in luna 6 is linnea, who continues the current trend within hoyoverse games of focussing heavily on cute pink-haired animal-themed girls. Linnea is a 5-Star Geo Bow user who can really work with parties made up of Lunar-Crystallize characters, with her big gimmick being the ability to turn Hydro-Crystallize reactions into Lunar-Crystallize reactions.

Berdasarkan laporan, linnea has a companion, lumi, who allows her to increase the lunar-crystallize damage she deals, while also lowering her enemies’ geo resistance. Linnea can also deliver either off-field Geo damage or a Lunar-Crystallize reaction hit with her Elemental Skill.

Diungkapkan bahwa beyond that, she can heal the party using her elemental burst. If you take Linnea with you as you explore, she can help you discover rare animals, thanks to her innate naturalist abilities.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this update will also see chasca get her first-ever rerun, and you’ll be able to roll for her in the first phase of event wishes. The second phase will feature no new characters and instead focus on Nefer and Lauma. There’s going to be another Chronicled Wish banner, this time specifically for Fontaine characters.

You can look forward to a few other new arrivals in Luna 6, including The Nod-Krai Trade Expo, some quality of life updates to Miliastra Wonderland to up the number of players in each lobby, not to mention various other UI changes.

Diungkapkan bahwa warhammer 40,000: darktide has announced its newest class, the sister novitiate, is arriving on december 7, finally bringing the much anticipated adepta sororitas faction to atoma. Alongside the Skitarii, which was the last class added, the Sisters of Battle have been long–requested by players.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, also similar to the skitarii, this class has a slightly different design to the other rejects. The Sisters Novitiate can choose from six Acts of Faith instead of blitz and combat abilities, drawing on a new "Faith" resource to use an offensive Neural Whip, or more support based abilities like the Icon of Purity and protective prayers.

Sebagaimana diketahui, essentially, sisters build their faith through combat via doctrines and pledges within the talent tree, which change how it's accrued, allowing them to then unleash up to two chosen acts of faith. It sounds fairly similar to the Skitarii's somewhat looser skill and ability tree.

In terms of weapons, we can look forward to:.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's also a meltagun (the first in darktide), which will be added as a free update alongside for the veteran class to also use. I'm personally pretty excited for the Condemnor Stake Thrower, a crossbow which pins enemies in place, and as a Zealot main, a new chainsword in the form of the Penitent Eviscerator. There'll likely be a fair bit of crossover between the Zealot and Sister Novitiate.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, overall, this new class is a clever way of including the adepta sororitas in darktide. Lore wise, it would make little sense for a full Sister of Battle to be running around with convicts and rejects, but a sister-in-training, sure, why not?.

You can find the new class on Steam where it's set to cost €12 (so I assume £10/$12, the same as the Skitarii was) when it launches on December 7.

#298. Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Following Infidelity Scandal

📅 12 Nov 2026

Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Following Infidelity Scandal

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2026/11/nvidias-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-following-infidelity-scandal

Company produces custom processor for Switch 2.

Nvidia, one of the largest tech firms in the world and the company responsible for the Switch 2's custom processor, has found itself embroiled in scandal over recent days.

As reported by The Guardian, Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang, who you might recognise from the 'Creator's Voice Special Edition' video for Switch 2, has now resigned after reported affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and a company employee.

Berdasarkan laporan, he will be replaced on an interim basis by nvidia’s chief financial officer, colette kress, until a full-time successor is named. Nvidia's share price began to sharply decline following reports of the scandal, to the point where it is now no longer the most valuable company in the world.

The BBC speculates that Huang's departure could set him up to be a "formidable opponent" to the very company he co-founded, with Elon Musk stating that it would be "an honour" to work with him at SpaceX.

Diungkapkan bahwa with regards to nintendo, it's likely that none of this will have any immediate impact on nvidia's relationship with the japanese company. Nvidia will no doubt be under contract to supply custom chips for the Switch 2, but what happens with the inevitable Switch 2 successor is under question.

Hopefully everything will go smoothly for Nintendo, but if it wants to utilise Nvidia's architecture for its next console – particularly for backwards compatibility – then its efforts may be impacted by Huang's departure along with Nvidia's sharp pivot towards AI.

Of course, it's really early to be speculating about the 'Switch 3', but you can bet that Nintendo's R&D department will be looking at all of this very closely and considering its potential impact.

News Nintendo Switch 2 Chip "Unlike Anything We've Ever Built Before" Says Nvidia CEO.

#299. Nintendo's legendary Kirby designer Masahiro Sakurai weighs in on gen-AI, saying "it has yet to gain my trust" but not to reject it completely

📅 09 Nov 2026

Nintendo's legendary Kirby designer Masahiro Sakurai weighs in on gen-AI, saying "it has yet to gain my trust" but not to reject it completely

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/masahiro-sakurai-generative-ai-famitsu

Berdasarkan laporan, "doing nothing is probably not the right approach. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, masahiro sakurai, the designer behind many iconic nintendo franchises such as super smash bros. and several Kirby titles, has weighed in on the ongoing discussion of generative-AI use in game development.

At an event celebrating the release of his new book - Masahiro Sakurai’s Thoughts on Games - the veteran director told Famitsu he hasn't and currently isn't using the technology to make games, noting that the role of a designer is to generate ideas.

Diungkapkan bahwa "it has yet to gain my trust," sakurai said via deepl machine translation. Regarding graphical use specifically, he added that, "It must not amount to exploitation of any kind," and that "for the time being, we can produce better results by coming up with ideas ourselves".

Diungkapkan bahwa but sakurai is wary of rejecting gen-ai completely, saying "making games today is far too difficult", with some games "running at a loss even after selling millions of copies". A company in that position may go under if it does not change its stance on generative-AI, he suggested. "Doing nothing is probably not the right approach," he said, but "where and how to use it" is a complex topic with a lot of uncertainties. Sakurai is taking "a slow-paced approach" for now.

Sebagaimana diketahui, outside of regular industry layoffs, the use of generative-ai in games has been the most controversial topic amongst developers and players. Some argue it's already being used in multiple development disciplines, notably programming and writing code. Others, such as Shigeru Miyamoto, are more sceptical of the technology's capabilities, especially when it comes to the more creative and art-driven parts of game development.

#300. Swarmbreaker is an uncommonly mesmerising tower defence game in which enemies "cluster, collide and flow like a fluid"

📅 09 Nov 2026

Swarmbreaker is an uncommonly mesmerising tower defence game in which enemies "cluster, collide and flow like a fluid"

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/swarmbreaker-is-an-uncommonly-mesmerising-tower-defence-game-in-which-enemies-cluster-collide-and-flow-like-a-fluid

Diungkapkan bahwa it is said that king canute once placed his throne on the shore and commanded the sea not to get his feet wet, thus proving to his flattering courtiers that only god almighty holds sway over the elements. "But sire!" I would have told him, if I'd been one of the aforesaid lickspittles. "Why not lay down spike strips and park a couple of flamethrowers in the shallows?" I would have said this because I have just been playing Swarmbreaker, a tower defence game that aims to prove there is no fluid body so awe-inspiring that it cannot be machine-gunned into submission.

Diungkapkan bahwa in swarmbreaker - which launches on steam tomorrow, and still has a demo as of writing – you have to defend your rocketship against waves of insect aggressors, who spawn at the map's far corners. Sounds like bog-standard attrition management, perhaps, but what lifts Swarmbreaker is the "swarm" part. Between waves, you spend earnings from kills on turrets, barricades, troops, and upgrades for all the foregoing. The rapacious scuttlers come in several distinct varieties, but they also "cluster, collide and flow like a fluid".

Diungkapkan bahwa the results are hypnotic: coloured particles burst from each burrow and course through the map's contours, pushing movable terrain elements and eroding your structures like acid. Speaking of which, the more oil derricks you save during each wave, the more cash you'll have to spend before the next, but committing to their protection obviously risks leaving your ship exposed. You can practically hear the oil derricks fizz as they are engulfed and chewed to a lumpy puddle of iridescent digestive enzymes. Your fallback option is an inexhaustible mouse-click-fired artillery cannon, but this won't save you if the bulk of the swarm makes it all the way to your doorstep.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm still not convinced this isn't a run-of-the-mill tower defender, beneath it all, but it's worth giving the demo a shot just to enjoy the swirling tidal dynamics of homocidal buglife. What would King Canute have made of it all? I think he would have stuck his throne right by the biggest burrow, surrounded by gravity traps and howitzers. "Back in your hole, hungry liquids!" he'd have bellowed, firing dual AK47s simultaneously. "The only god I recognise is efficient chokepoint management! Death to sense-of-flow! Death to trickle-down politics!".

Berdasarkan laporan, "sire," i'd have told him sternly. And also that is a total waste of howitzers - those things are best placed on hills. "You are getting your metaphors confused. " Read more on Steam.

Sebagaimana diketahui, first off, cost of hope is set for release this summer. It’ll arrive on all current platforms simultaneously, meaning PC, Xbox, and PlayStation. The expansion is described as “non-linear”, and it takes place in the heartlands, deeper into the Zone.

Diungkapkan bahwa the story revolves around a conflict between duty, and freedom, two factions whose idea of the what the zone is and their understanding of its possibilities differ widely. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, gsc game world says cost of hope will introduce two new regions, offering dozens of hours of gameplay. We’ll get to actually explore the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant as part of the expansion, alongside the Iron Forest.

Sebagaimana diketahui, each of the two new regions will have its own hub area, npcs, quests, activities and stories. Of course, it wouldn’t be a Stalker expansion without some new weapons, and Cost of Hope promises a few - some can even be seen in the trailer.

Diungkapkan bahwa the developer also confirmed that there’s one other story dlc in the works. Together with Heart of Chornobyl, and Cost of Hope all three will form a trilogy of interconnected stories. More details on Cost of Hope - including a release date - will be revealed sometime in the summer.

#303. Pikmin 4 Is Still Great, But Dandori Academy Is Underwhelming

📅 10 Nov 2026

Pikmin 4 Is Still Great, But Dandori Academy Is Underwhelming

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/opinion/2026/11/10/pikmin-4-is-still-great-but-dandori-academy-is-underwhelming

Berdasarkan laporan, pikmin 4 was released for the original switch in 2023, and it ranks among my favorite games on the platform; i happily award it the honor of being the best pikmin game. It looks and plays great, and Oatchi the dog makes the sometimes annoying process of managing a collection of little plant creatures willing to do your bidding much smoother.

Berdasarkan laporan, the over-titled pikmin 4 – nintendo switch 2 edition + dandori academy releases november 12, and much like other comparable nintendo games that have been ported and improved for switch 2 (like kirby and mario party), the base game is as good as it was initially and looks even better. If you skipped Pikmin 4 on Switch for whatever reason (probably because it was day one of the Barbenheimer epidemic), I encourage you to play it now. You have about a week to beat it before… something else comes out. Who’s to say.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the “big” addition here for the switch 2 version of the game, alongside improved performance and visuals and the ability to give oatchi verbal commands, is dandori academy. The Academy is an expanded time trial mode that awards medals for practicing specific levels, which you can then play and upload your high scores on specific days. For example, I can play the Advanced B level, Rockaway Cellars, as much as I want, but it only really counts if I play it on November 12. And you only get one try (though you can unlock retry tickets).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in theory, i like the unique approach to high-score battling, and the limited timeframe adds fun intensity, but this isn't what i am looking for from pikmin. I recognize and acknowledge the design decision to place timers on your interactions in Pikmin, but it’s never been my favorite part. I like building my adorable little army and exploring, discovering, and retrieving as many unexpected items as possible. But I mostly get annoyed at the ticking clock, especially when I am watching my crew meander toward my spaceship holding a Game Boy Advance SP (or whatever they manage to find on the never-acknowledged, but potentially post-apocalyptic Earth you are exploring).

Sebagaimana diketahui, i also like having a list of missions to complete, and in dandori academy, there isn’t much acknowledgment of your success in practice. You can earn a platinum medal while practicing Rockaway Cellar, but it’s mainly to let you know that this is what you could earn when you play on the right day.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the main takeaway is that pikmin 4 is still excellent, and i was grateful to transfer my save file from the switch version (and i was tempted to start a new game + save), but dandori academy is not a strong incentive to return if you already played the game. It is a nice bonus and an interesting concept that reimagines the familiar time trial mode featured in plenty of video games, but the original campaign is still the main attraction.

#305. Skyrim lead designer hopes Sentinel will finally solve The Elder Scrolls' ladder problem

📅 09 Nov 2026

Skyrim lead designer hopes Sentinel will finally solve The Elder Scrolls' ladder problem

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/the-elder-scrolls-6-sentinel-ladders-skyrim-bethesda-designer

Berdasarkan laporan, for such a simple, straightforward real-world object, ladders have been the bane of game developers' existence since the early days of the industry. And Bethesda's The Elder Scrolls Series is certainly no stranger to that struggle.

Berdasarkan laporan, while we may be years away from the release of the elder scrolls 6: sentinel, the recent title reveal reignited conversations about what longtime fans hope to see from it. That includes former Bethesda developers, such as Skyrim lead designer and Bethesda veteran Bruce Nesmith, who picked ladders as one thing he hopes Sentinel actually figures out.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you're unfamiliar, ladders in skyrim work in a weird way. You don't animatedly climb up and down them, but rather the character simply teleports from one end to the other. Speaking to The Examined Game (via GamesRadar+), Nesmith said that Skyrim's approach "really limits the art team in terms of how you can do multi-layer [levels]".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "it seems simple, it seems stupid, but you don't climb up and down ladders," said nesmith. "All the ladders in Skyrim, you click on the ladder, poof, you're at the top or you have to climb a stair.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "but to do ladders, you have to deal with a whole host of questions which our programmers very legitimately put in front of us and said, 'you give me answers to these, i'll tell you how much programming time it's going to take to make them. ' And you know, that caused problems right there. ".

Nesmith then pointed out the hidden complexity of creating functioning ladders in games, and the scenarios developers have to anticipate and account for, especially in a game as dynamic as an Elder Scrolls title.

Berdasarkan laporan, "so, i'm halfway up a ladder, and [an] npc decides to climb down it. "The NPC has to have AI that will adjust for that. What happens?" Nesmith posited. Does the player go through the NPC? Is he blocked by the NPC? Does the NPC stay on the ladder? Does the NPC go back up and know to wait and then come back down?.

Diungkapkan bahwa "and i'm just scratching the surface of some of the problems they brought up. So, it seems simple, and other games have climbing ladders, but we chose to put our efforts into other things to make them better rather than deal with that. So, I'd like to see Bethesda finally come around to making ladders a reality where you're actually climbing them and make the world feel a little more immersive. ".

While we know very little about Sentinel right now - much less how it's going to solve the ladder problem -that hasn't stopped fans from speculating about a number of topics, including what they believe is going to be a split / alternate timeline setup.

#306. Cyberattack on Sega third-party newsletter distributor reportedly sees over two million email addresses leaked, but Sega accounts unaffected

📅 09 Nov 2026

Cyberattack on Sega third-party newsletter distributor reportedly sees over two million email addresses leaked, but Sega accounts unaffected

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/cyberattack-on-sega-third-party-newsletter-distributor-reportedly-sees-over-two-million-email-addresses-leaked-but-sega-accounts-unaffected

Japanese email distribution firm Arara were the target of the attack.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sega have revealed that over two million email addresses have leaked due to a cyberattack on japanese email delivery provider arara, whom the like a dragon and sonic publishers use to distribute newsletters. Sega and Arara are currently busy investigating what happened in the breach, which doesn't appear to have affected the Sega accounts you can use receive in-game rewards and access a calendar which reminds you when it's Kazuma Kiryu's birthday. The companies have urged those who signed up for the affected newsletters to be wary of potential phishing attempts.

Diungkapkan bahwa according to automaton, who've translated sega's official press release about the cyberattack, 2,196,044 email addresses in total were affected. 92,273 of that number were linked to the newsletter distribution.

Diungkapkan bahwa the company have listed some specific newsletter releases as having been affected, including two exhibition announcements for this year's tokyo game show, the announcement of arcade rhythm game chunithm mate's launch, six newsletters about online character lottery service sega lucky kuji online, the launch of a rhythm game update dubbed ongeki re:fresh act. 2, and the launch of another arcade rhythm game update called Maimai DX MAGiCAL. Number one, that's a lot of rhythm games, and number two, Sega have advised those who opted in and received those newsletters to watch out for fishing emails from people posing as being tied to Sega or Arara.

Diungkapkan bahwa sega reportedly confirmed that - as far as the affected emails go - no names, dates of birth, genders, residential addresses, phone numbers, credit card information, and passwords are known to have been leaked. There had also been no reports of cases where the leaked information had been misused as of the time Sega made their announcement. The company have naturally put distributing any further email newsletters through Arara on hold until their investigation's done and plan to reach out to each affected person individually once the full details of the leak have been confirmed.

While data breaches and cyberattacks are nothing new, there have been a fair few recently, with both Street Fighter makers Capcom and Kingdom Come Deliverance 2 devs Warhorse suffering incidents of their own last month.

#308. Disney Confirms News For Its “Most Anticipated Titles” At The Game Awards

📅 13 Nov 2026

Disney Confirms News For Its “Most Anticipated Titles” At The Game Awards

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/kingdom-hearts-4-the-game-awards-news-very-likely-major-announcements/

Following yesterday’s announcement that The Game Awards can be streamed on Disney Plus, it’s been confirmed that the show will feature “major announcements” for some of its games.

Berdasarkan laporan, the whole world may be waiting on november 19 and the launch of the biggest video game of all time, but there’s plenty going on in the world of gaming after that. As always, The Game Awards is bookending the year with a showcase that’ll hopefully feature some big announcements for upcoming releases.

Berdasarkan laporan, i’m a little biased here, but one of the games that i’ve got my fingers crossed to make an appearance at the game awards is kingdom hearts 4. We know that it’s coming in a year’s time, so a new trailer appearing there didn’t seem far-fetched at all. It now seems even more likely based on Disney’s own words about the collaboration.

Diungkapkan bahwa as we reported yesterday, the game awards is teaming up with disney to offer a new way to watch the show through disney plus. That already had Kingdom Hearts fans thinking something was going on, but Disney itself has fanned the fires with a statement that confirms big news is coming for some of its games.

The latest trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4 might be short, but it’s absolutely packed with easy to miss details.

Berdasarkan laporan, as pointed out by twitter user hmkilla, the disney press centre shared a blog post about the game awards coming to disney plus. In the post, Disney outright says that the show will feature “major announcements and surprises” from some of Disney’s “most anticipated titles in gaming”, which could apply to quite a few games.

Diungkapkan bahwa of course, the biggest thing that disney has on the horizon (that’s been officially confirmed, at least), is kingdom hearts 4. With a release window of late 2027 already revealed, it would make a lot of sense to see it at the event, likely with a new world reveal instead of just showing more of Coco.

I’ve seen Battlefront 3 making the rounds as a possible game, but that’s reportedly not even started development yet, so you really shouldn’t get your hopes up.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nomura did say that we’d be waiting a little while to hear more about kingdom hearts 4, but that was back in the summer, so we’re definitely in the right time frame. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this latest update only includes an initial set of fixes, but pearl abyss vowed to keep working on addressing all other points of feedback. 00. A highlight in 1. 03 is the addition of a Storage at Howling Hill Camp, which can be used to store inventory items.

Diungkapkan bahwa the most important changes, of course, affect how the game controls on keyboard and mouse. Pearl Abyss included several fixes and altered some of the default presets to make the experience less painful when playing the game with a keyboard and mouse.

Microsoft workers accuse company of trying to get customers "addicted" to AI while forcing it on their own staff and making them party to "human rights violations"

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/microsoft-workers-accuse-company-of-trying-to-get-customers-addicted-to-ai-while-forcing-it-on-their-own-staff-and-making-them-party-to-human-rights-violations

Open letter warns of "a cascade of business and ethics risks".

Diungkapkan bahwa a group of "concerned microsoft workers" have published an open letter criticising their employer's "speed-at-all-costs" approach to generative ai, which they argue is "harming our customers, colleagues, shareholders, vendors, and the planet". They accuse Microsoft leadership of trying to get people "addicted" to genAI, while making their own staff miserable by mandating AI usage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, echoing the on-going bds campaign against microsoft's xbox business, the writers contend that microsoft have become party to "human rights violations" by selling generative ai technology to israel's military during the latter's invasion of gaza, which a un commission has deemed a genocide. They're also critical of Microsoft's contracts with the USA's draconian Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency. While seemingly not against generative AI in principle, they're organising against "the AI industry’s trajectory to continue to enrich AI’s powerful few", pointing out that AI companies now account for a terrifying share of the global stock market.

I know about the letter thanks to Vertical Slice, who cite a New York Times report on Microsoft's recent voluntary buyouts, which follow several waves of mass layoffs at a company with a market value of around $4 trillion.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "for many, working at microsoft has become joyless and demoralizing, with job satisfaction declining around the same time the company accelerated its ai investments," the workers write. "Crushing workloads, threats of AI job replacement and layoffs, constantly shifting business priorities, and re-orgs destabilize our work environment and erode employee trust in leadership. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the letter organisers complain that "workers are forced to use ai in almost every work area, with little to no training and no strategic rationale besides 'speed'," obliging them to spend a lot of time "learning and relearning tools, fixing ai slop, and reworking or rolling back low-quality features". They feel that Microsoft's generative AI strategy is exposing customers "to overreliance, misuse, and physical and mental harm", not least because "our own research shows that AI agents don’t prioritize user safety, and internal planning documents detail how to 'make people addicted' to AI products. " If that last part is an actual quote from an internal feature document, then: yeeeeeeesh.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the writers further take issue with microsoft's investments in data centers for generative ai use, which may use up a lot of water while contributing to carbon emissions (jeopardising microsoft's older commitments to reducing their carbon footprint). They note that "our Community-First AI Infrastructure plan makes vague financial and job-creation commitments, but doesn’t address greenhouse gas emissions or other damage already being done. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the organisers also call out their employer for becoming "a partner to human rights violations" by licensing generative ai tools to the israeli military and ice. "Not only are we risking reputational, financial, and legal damage, we are allowing our AI products to be used against whole communities for mass surveillance, detainment, deportation, and genocide," they write.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, finally, they take a swing at "microsoft’s participation in circular investment across a handful of ai leaders " - that is, ai companies pouring cash into each other, which naturally creates the risk of several companies biting the dust if one company's fortunes take a tumble. This ouroboros strategy "exposes workers, customers, shareholders, and society to a cascade of business and ethics risks," the writers claim, noting that AI-linked stocks now dominate the S&P 500 index.

Diungkapkan bahwa the letter writers have a number of demands. They'd like more say over "AI product strategy decisions", and for Microsoft to consider customer feedback and bring different development disciplines together "to help guard against shipping AI-worsened user experiences". They want Microsoft to "offer quality training and empower workers to integrate AI in their workflows without tying AI use to rewards, reprimand or layoffs. " They call on the execs to "end unfair AI-driven workforce reductions and agree to worker protections".

Berdasarkan laporan, looking beyond microsoft's walls, the workers argue that "job opportunities from data center investments are mostly temporary" and that "microsoft must protect all workers, not attempt to avoid the unionized trades in local communities, and ensure a just transition for all impacted workers. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the letter writers call on microsoft to "expand responsible ai and sensitive use teams and fund programs to communicate potential harms to users". They would like Microsoft to stop selling AI materials to organisations "if they are engaged in violence, mass surveillance, detainment, deportation, or genocide", requesting that Microsoft "transparently share contracts with all governments and their agencies or contractors, including police and armed forces, and immediately terminate any contracts with those directly or indirectly involved in human rights violations. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the letter writers want microsoft to "reduce financial dependency on openai and other ai partners and provide transparency into all ai investments". In general, they want their bosses to "stop offloading financial risk to workers, vendors, partners, customers, and shareholders through irresponsible investments and relationships. " As regards the environment, the workers are demanding that Microsoft "reaffirm our goal to be carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste by 2030". They want Microsoft to cooperate more with environmental regulators, and "to respect local communities by rejecting dirty energy, engaging fairly and transparently, and refusing to build in resource-scarce areas. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, it's not clear who, exactly, is behind the letter, or how many others at microsoft have signed as of writing. I've requested comment from Microsoft, and will update this piece as and when I hear more.

#317. 'You'll Own Nothing': Sony Wins Hall of Shame Award for Deciding to Kill Physical Discs

📅 11 Nov 2026

'You'll Own Nothing': Sony Wins Hall of Shame Award for Deciding to Kill Physical Discs

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/11/youll-own-nothing-sony-wins-hall-of-shame-award-for-deciding-to-kill-physical-discs

I can't imagine this is something Hermen Hulst will want to display on his mantelpiece: PlayStation and Sony have won a Hall of Shame award, called a Shonky Award, from an Australian outlet for its decision to stop making physical discs.

Berdasarkan laporan, choice, an australian website, runs an annual hall of shame series, known as the shonky awards, where it highlights the "worst products and services uncovered by our experts this year". In 2026, PlayStation finds itself with a Shonky Award alongside Virgin Australia, Ticketmaster, and more companies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is because of the company's decision to end playstation disc production from january 2028, combined with its current eula (end-user license agreement) tied to digital game purchases. A lot of the Choice write-up focuses on the latter:.

Berdasarkan laporan, "in this age of instant gratification, it doesn’t get much more convenient than being able to easily download a movie or video game to your collection to start enjoying immediately," it opens with. "But will you be enjoying them for years to come? That’s less certain. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the site then continues: "because, according to sony interactive entertainment, you don’t actually own the movies and games that you buy as a digital download instead of a disc. Instead, you’re buying a licence to access the content via Sony’s various digital storefronts, such as the PlayStation Store. ".

News Sony Reminds PS5 Owners Their Digital Games Are Licensed, Not Sold.

But Steam, Xbox, and Nintendo all say the same.

News No Disc, No Buy and PS5 Blackout Protests Fail to Impact PlayStation.

Active users increases, digital sales percentage increases.

Berdasarkan laporan, it speaks about how sony still "owns your digital media", and how, in reality, you're actually buying a "long-term rental". Choice then points to the sudden removal of Studio Canal movies from the PS Store, where refunds weren't offered.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the decision to stop physical playstation discs is then discussed, with worries over digital ownership arising once more. It analyses the EULA once more, but as we've pointed out in the past, the terms of Sony's license agreement are virtually identical to that of Xbox, Nintendo, and PC platform Steam.

Berdasarkan laporan, the content and services are licensed, not sold. Your license confers no title or ownership in the Content and Services. To make use of the Content and Services, you must have a Steam Account and you may be required to be running the Steam client and maintaining a connection to the Internet.

Sebagaimana diketahui, all digital goods are licensed, not sold. Your right to access or use any Digital Good is subject to your compliance with: (a) all license terms, license limitations, codes of conduct, and payment terms in the Terms; (b) your payment in full for the applicable Digital Good; (c) these Rules, and; (d) any additional terms provided when you acquire your license.

Sebagaimana diketahui, subject to the terms of this agreement, nintendo grants you a non-exclusive, revocable license to use the software solely on the console for your personal, non-commercial use. For clarity, the Software is licensed, not sold, to you, and you may not make use of the Software except as expressly authorized by this Agreement.

These all read very similarly and mean the exact same thing: on all the major video game platforms, you purchase a license to play a video game; you don't own the actual video game.

However, because Sony is removing the option of buying physical PlayStation discs in just over a year to channel all of its business into the PS Store, it's catching considerably more scrutiny than anyone else.

For that, PlayStation wins a Shonky Award from Choice.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "you can’t protect your licensed media based on the current eula, and there won’t be any alternatives once the discs go away. You’ll own nothing," it concludes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, [source choice. com. au, via gamesradar. com].

#318. All the hype has already made Crimson Desert one of the biggest launches on Steam this year

📅 20 Mar 2026

All the hype has already made Crimson Desert one of the biggest launches on Steam this year

Tanggal: 20 Mar 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/crimson-desert-steam-launch-numbers

We're merely days away from the end of the first quarter of 2026, and Crimson Desert has come in clutch to join the list of big sellers.

Diungkapkan bahwa crimson desert, the open-world action rpg off-shoot from korean mmo black desert online, has officially launched, nearly six years after it was initially revealed. The game has been building up a lot of momentum over the years, which recently coalesced to turn it into one of 2026’s most anticipated titles.

All of it has been leading up to this moment, and the game appears to have landed smoothly, though not without controversy, as has seemingly become part of its MO.

Berdasarkan laporan, it has not been 24 hours since crimson desert launched on pc and consoles, and it’s already become a big hit. On Steam, one of two stores where the game can be purchased (the other being the Epic Games Store), the game shot to the top of the charts.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the action rpg continued to accumulate more and more players on steam, peaking at a very respectable 239,045 concurrent players (via steamdb). Though its success was very much expected, we perhaps didn’t predict its peak would be that high.

Diungkapkan bahwa indeed, crimson desert has been in steam’s top 100 global sellers list for six weeks, jumping up six spots to become the number one seller this week just before it launched. As we get closer to the weekend, the numbers could climb even higher.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this peak concurrent puts crimson desert in the same league as several of the other major releases of the first quarter of 2026. It happened just days after the juggernaut Resident Evil Requiem achieved its own 344,214 peak concurrent, which was the year’s highest up until Slay the Spire 2’s release. The top spot continues to belong to Slay the Spire 2, which peaked at a staggering 574,638 concurrent players. All three are well ahead of Nioh 3’s 88,045 peak concurrent, and Marathon’s nearly identical peak of 88,337.

Sebagaimana diketahui, crimson desert has seen something of a mixed reception by critics. James gave it three stars in our review, saying it “lacks the connective sinew to be truly functional,” which is a common criticism shared by other outlets. Many also lamented the sheer number of systems fighting for player attention, its poorly explained mechanics, and counterintuitive controls.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on steam, at least, players have similarly been divided, with the current steam user rating sitting at mixed, based on 8,728 reviews. Unsurprisingly, most of the negative reactions fall on the clunky controls and the game’s tendency to, as one Steam user put it, “so miserably tries to be everything at once, and fails to be anything at all. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you’re just getting started in crimson desert yourself, or plan to do so soon, we recommend reading these crucial tips to help orient yourself in the game’s vast world. You should also plan your initial skill unlocks by prioritising these skills to spend your Abyss Artifacts first.

Crimson Desert strongbox puzzle solutions.

#319. The Best Abyss Gears In Crimson Desert

📅 20 May 2026

The Best Abyss Gears In Crimson Desert

Tanggal: 20 May 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/crimson-desert-best-strongest-abyss-gears-tier-list/

These are the strongest Abyss Gears to use in your weapons and armor.

Berdasarkan laporan, abyss gears are one of the most essential parts of upgrading your gear in crimson desert, as these upgrade items imbue your weapons with certain special effects and abilities. The strongest Abyss Gears range from offering superb abilities that deal damage to allowing you to fire as many arrows as you'd like for your powerful bow and arrow build.

Deciding which Abyss Gears to use can be challenging, so we sifted through dozens of options to select the Abyss Gears that offer the most additional damage, alongside others that enable entirely new play styles when used in tandem with the right gear.

Updated on November 12, 2026, by Kaitlyn Peterson: This article has been updated and reformatted to help you discover the best Abyss Gears in the game, and why they were chosen!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the best abyss gears in crimson desert are primarily composed of easy-to-use, damage-dealing modifiers. While certain Abyss Gears put powerful modifiers to use, the strongest options offer damage in the form of additional skills or attacks that trigger in tandem with your swings. These are the best Abyss Gears to add to your collection in Crimson Desert.

You can extract any Abyss Gear from its original item and embed it into another piece of gear.

Find a Raptor and bring some meat along to offer your new friend.

Summons orbs that track enemies after a short delay, dealing damage.

Ator's Orb is a fantastic Abyss Gear that you can find embedded in the Darkbringer sword, which you can find either in the open world, or as a reward for defeating the Archon of Antumbra.

Ator's Orb tracking projectiles and additional damage are massively helpful against both individual boss enemies and large crowds.

These orbs track enemies regardless of where you slash your sword, so they'll track and impact on enemies even when you're not facing them.

Summons a murder of crows to viciously attack nearby enemies.

Ator's Orb is even better when combined with Crow's Pursuit, as this Abyss Gear triggers when you use a heavy attack.

Similar to Ator's Orb, the murder of crows from Crow's Pursuit will track your enemies, though they do a better job when you aim your slash directly at an enemy.

While the damage itself isn't massive, the extra range and consistent hits from Crow's Pursuit make it a must-have option for your favorite two-handed sword.

Summons a wave of frozen spikes in a frontal cone to deal damage.

Frost Spike is an exceptionally difficult Abyss Gear to get, since you'll need to defeat Beloth, the Darksworn and claim the Armor of Shadows en route to earning this powerful boon.

Frost Spike is best used against crowds of enemies, since the wave of frozen spikes offers enough of an AoE to hit multiple people.

Shatters the ground in a cone in front of you to deal damage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, groundsurge is a fantastic alternative to frost spike, and offers a similar effect without requiring you to beat beloth. This powerful Abyss Gear is excellent against groups, and its relatively low additional Spirit cost makes it easy to spam in tough situations.

While it doesn't offer extra elemental damage, Groundsurge is a great Abyss Gear that you should add to any two-handed weapon.

Berdasarkan laporan, has a chance not to consume arrows. 60 percent for Infinite Arrows 3, 40 percent for Infinite Arrows 2. These effects stack to 100 percent.

Automatically applies when the Abyss Gear is embedded.

Berdasarkan laporan, infinite arrows is easily one of the best abyss gears in the game, especially when combined with itself. Using Infinite Arrows 2 and 3 in tandem will guarantee that every arrow you fire is returned, functionally giving you an infinite supply of arrows.

Combining this Abyss Gear with Explosive Arrows is an exceptionally strong strategy that can trivialize every boss fight in the game.

Unleashes three swipes forward, dealing additional damage.

Shadow Claw is another excellent Abyss Gear for dealing damage, which you can acquire after tracking down and defeating Black Fang.

This Abyss Gear mimics Black Fang's attack, allowing you to unleash a claw-like swipe of damage at any enemies in your path.

Unleashes three blades of dark energy that push enemies back and deal damage.

Wound of Darkness is a similar Abyss Gear to Shadow Claw, but luckily, it can be combined without issue.

The best part of Abyss Gears that use the same mapping is that pressing the button combination triggers them all at once.

Combining Wound of Darkness and Shadow Claw will help you deal damage to several enemies in front of you, making it one of the best AoE Abyss Gears in Crimson Desert.

Fight your way through Fort Windridge to face Balthazar, The Wyvernflame.

Grand Theft Auto VI Will Run At 30 FPS On All Consoles, But PS5 Pro Will Feature 'Improved Clarity' And Ray-Traced Shadows

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/2026/11/10/grand-theft-auto-vi-will-run-at-30-fps-on-all-consoles-but-ps5-pro-will-feature-improved

Sebagaimana diketahui, grand theft auto vi launches next week on thursday, november 19, and you can preload the game on your playstation 5 or xbox series x/s starting today, rockstar games has announced. The studio has also revealed what kind of visuals players can expect on their respective consoles, making clear that regardless of where you play, GTA VI targets 30 FPS gameplay.

"Grand Theft Auto VI has been fully developed from the ground up to provide the best possible experience for the current generation of consoles, targeting 30 frames per second while pushing both platforms to their absolute limits to bring the vast and rich world of Leonida to life – while maintaining the density and visual fidelity of all its environments and inhabitants," Rockstar writes in a blog post.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rockstar games also breaks down the different graphical settings available on playstation and xbox consoles. On PS5 Pro, GTA VI will feature "improved clarity through PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) and ray-traced shadows only available on PlayStation 5 Pro. " On PS5 and PS5 Pro, the game will include "high-fidelity haptic feedback" fully integrated into DualSense controllers and adjustable via accessibility settings, improved spatial rendering so all in-game sounds take full advantage of Tempest 3D audio, and improved load times, "making Grand Theft Auto VI play best on PlayStation 5 consoles. ".

On Xbox consoles, Rockstar doesn't dive into performance; instead, it focuses on Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox Series X/S and Xbox One consoles, noting this feature will use Xbox Series S graphics settings.

GTA VI will also fully support Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox.

GTA VI launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.

#322. "The lesson learned is you can have both": Skyrim lead designer reckons there's merit in Baldur's Gate 3-style tough choices and Bethesda's do-anything approach

📅 09 Nov 2026

"The lesson learned is you can have both": Skyrim lead designer reckons there's merit in Baldur's Gate 3-style tough choices and Bethesda's do-anything approach

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/the-lesson-learned-is-you-can-have-both-skyrim-lead-designer-reckons-theres-merit-in-baldurs-gate-3-style-tough-choices-and-bethesdas-do-anything-approach

How many doors should be open at any point in an adventure?.

Diungkapkan bahwa whether rpgs are better off prioritising player freedom or endeavouring to have several doors slam shut every time you put another foot forwards in order to encourage multiple runs with different characters is, to put it bluntly, something i reckon will still be a matter of debate in the year 4000. We'll all have evolved in non-corporeal beings floating in a galaxy that's been racked by such change that even the six million copies of The Elder Scrolls 5 we've littered the Earth with will have been swept away into the great recycling bin on the gods' desktop, and there'll still be sniping going on about whether it's ok that Skyrim lets you be a master thiefssassin who leads the companions, knows every spell under the sun, and slapped up a world-eating dragon for fun.

For what it's worth, the game's lead designer reckons both games that do and don't let you do that have their merits when executed well.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, speaking to the examined game, ex-bethesda dev bruce nesmith talked about being "pleasantly surprised" when playing baldur's gate 3 just how much he enjoyed making "consequential decisions that closed off gameplay". In Nesmith's view, Larian "redefined things in a certain way" with their take on the D&D universe and the fantasy rules it plays by. However, he argued that there's still merit to taking an approach more akin to Bethesda's post-Morrowind Elder Scrolls entries and striving to make it possible for the player to see the majority of what the game has to offer in a single playthrough.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "they were both fun," he said. I can enjoy this game over here that does it this way and enjoy this game over here that does it that way. I would have expected to fall on one side or the other, as if they were things that you couldn't have both [of]. The lesson learned is you can have both. "They were just fun in different ways and that to me was part of the surprise. ".

Nesmith made clear that he still thinks the idea of, with a few exceptions like Skyrim's civil war, not gating the player off from the likes of doing multiple faction questlines is a "very good philosophy" that he supports.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as much as it's always a bit of a cop out to declare that everything's equally good, actually, i do think that there's merit in both approaches. I love the dedication the likes of New Vegas, Disco Elysium, and The Witcher 2 have to making you pick a path and see where it takes you at the expense of not seeing other stuff. Hell, the latter game's infamous for being totally different depending on who you choose to waltz off with at the end of the opening act.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that said, skyrim's open-endedness was undoubtedly one of the factors which made it so easy for me to get majorly into when i was just cutting my teeth in rpgs as a teenager. Whether there's still as much value in being the gateway drug nowadays compared to in 2011 is the question The Elder Scrolls 6'll likely answer whenever it rocks up. There's value in such games existing, even if for plenty it might be as a gateway drug to games with crunchier and more challenging narratives that do demand you plug in your brain and carefully consider every choice you make. Coming as it is after the likes of BG3 and The Witcher 3 have had near Skyrim-level gangbusters success while leaning a lot more heavily into the hard stuff typically pegged as having less potential for mass appeal.

Berdasarkan laporan, for what it's worth, while you can very much argue about the execution, fallout 4's main quest was a lot more choice-heavy than fallout 3's. So, Bethesda may well opt to pivot or make compromises in their player freedom-first ways if they feel some crunchier choice is in order.
