#324. Talking Point: What's Your Favourite Tiny Tweak In Zelda: Ocarina Of Time?

📅 12 Nov 2026

Talking Point: What's Your Favourite Tiny Tweak In Zelda: Ocarina Of Time?

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/features/talking-point-whats-your-favourite-tiny-tweak-in-zelda-ocarina-of-time

While the Ocarina of Time we see on Switch 2 is undoubtedly the same game we all know from the N64, there are enough tweaks in there that have had the biggest fans amongst us clicking and pointing at the screen like that Leonardo DiCaprio meme.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we're not talking about the big changes, either. You can keep your new visuals, fancy jump buttons and modern camera controls; we're getting excited over new floor textures and wall decals — stuff that wouldn't stand out unless you had played the original more times than you care to admit.

Sebagaimana diketahui, below, we have shared our favourite tiny tweaks that have stood out so far. Some are more niche than others, but these are the little changes that had us beaming in our first few hours of rediscovering Hyrule and finding it not quite as we remember it.

After you've read through our picks, why not head to the comments and share your top tweaks?.

Berdasarkan laporan, editor's note. If there's any Zelda-related topic (or, indeed, anything else game-related) you'd like to bring to the attention of NL and the community, remember you can also submit letters for our monthly letters page. The mailbox is looking per-ritty empty at the time of writing, and we'd wager it's down to a certain November game keeping you all occupied!.

Knowing the original game like the back of my hand, I'm yet to walk into a room without going, "Oooh, look how they changed that bit!" But the one that has stood out to me the most so far is being able to ride Epona right up to the entrance to Kakariko Village without getting chucked off at the bottom of the stairs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, does it change the game in any way at all? absolutely not. But praise be to whichever innovative dev at Nintendo thought, 'What if Jim didn't have to sit through a backtracking animation every time he forgot to dismount quickly enough?'.

The ragdoll may not be a substantial inclusion, but if I can pick between a stiff, canned animation of Link collapsing to the floor and seeing his lifeless body tumble into the rapids that lead up to Zora's Domain, you know what I'm going to choose.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the option to remove one of the few tweaks i haven’t enjoyed so far — navi’s incessant dialogue boxes commenting on everything — is a godsend. I was concerned she’d spend the entire game puncturing the mood with “Oooh, big mountain!” and “Wow, great work!” and “OMG, that was a lucky escape!” (I’m paraphrasing, but that’s the gist), and she does.

Sebagaimana diketahui, turning on the ‘master’ display option, though, reduces the ui to the bare minimum, removing almost everything, including navi’s dialogue boxes. Bliss. So when I emerge onto Hyrule Field, the landscape speaks for itself (with a little help from the music). Other people might enjoy her interjections, and yes, I will miss a cute line or two, but thanks for letting me turn off the running commentary, Nintendo.

Sebagaimana diketahui, turning grouch mode off, the slingshot easter egg in the courtyard window is ace. And Kakariko feels more like a real place now. And that part of Lon Lon. And those little rivulets on Hyrule Field add so much. *babbling trails off.

Without heading into spoiler territory, I suppose my niche tweak (if it’s considered niche) would be the addition of Threads of Time, but more specifically the Tapestry.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i’ve filled out my tapestry now, but throughout each stage of link’s journey it was nice to see the progress i was making. I jumped into the remake with the hope of experiencing it with fresh eyes (although I’d played the original), and it really felt like it at times. It was also a really good way for me to gauge what I could do next should I forget, collectables I likely still needed, or even secrets I still had to unlock.

It’s a very simple addition common in modern gaming, but a tweak which was needed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i’m enjoying all the revamped music, but one arrangement that took me by surprise is when you encounter common or garden foes. There’s more urgency and danger now: notes are sharply cutting in, there’s a subtle, unnerving rise and fall in volume, and if the battle lasts long enough, it goes up a notch when a horn (I’m guessing!) is eventually layered on top.

For a track I hadn’t given a second’s thought to in the original, I’m now delighted every time an enemy nears.

Sebagaimana diketahui, note. Very minor pre-Hyrule Field spoilers ahead.

Sebagaimana diketahui, some of the subtle tweaks to ocarina of time’s narrative landed so well with me. I won’t go into the later examples, but I absolutely adored the moment when Link runs into both Mido and Saria after leaving the Deku Tree.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mido, who feels much more fleshed out in the remake, expresses shock and immediate concern for the deku tree, while saria is devastated at the thought of link leaving kokiri forest. She leaves, heartbroken at Link’s decision, and it’s only when we exit the forest that she catches up to make amends and deliver the Fairy Ocarina.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this extra scene isn’t much in the grand scheme of things, but it really adds weight to link’s departure, emphasising the home and friends that he’ll be leaving behind. I love it.

Diungkapkan bahwa mask of truth. don't even have to think about it. I love the flavour text.

Berdasarkan laporan, edit: i mean, it might not qualify as tiny neccessarily, but it is my favourite tweak. If I had to give an alternative, the Megaton Hammer given it can effectively replace bombs.

I enjoy the little tweaks they made to the quality of life of the dungeons:.

Diungkapkan bahwa 1. Enemies don't respawn every time you re-enter a room 3. No loading between rooms 2. More visual differentiation between rooms, and indicators of 'where to go next'.

Taken together, I felt like I spent a lot less time backtracking back and forth between identical-looking rooms and re-killing the same annoying enemies, it made the dungeons I've always found the most annoying in the original (Jabu Jabu, Water Temple, Beneath the Well, Shadow Temple) a lot more tolerable (the free camera and motion-control aiming helps a lot in this regard as well).

Ganon is far more challenging in this plus i like their connecting totk ganondorf malice with the final boss but over all i like everything about the game.

So far for me (still relatively early in the game) it's the additions of scenes like the one Ollie mentioned - anyway, great to hear about all these tweaks and looking forward to seeing what others will mention in the comments, too!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i love that the camera is fully usable in castle town. Makes it far more alive and more tragic when it's all destroyed.

They could've easily kept it faithful, but chose to expand it greatly.

Lil’ Link is just so stinkin’ cute, runnin’ around bein’ all cute and stuff.

Also being able to actually control the camera is a big win for me ☑️.

There's a lot of changes that avoid blindly guessing or taking chances, and previous secrets are re-implemented so you aren't reliant on things like the Stone of Agony (that required the rumble pak sold separately).

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's much less "how was i supposed to know?" moments. On one hand it's more accessible, on the other hand it's less cryptic and mysterious when you stumble into something, or learn from another source. These were always the smaller things that you didn't need to do to beat the game, anyway.

My favorite tweak is how they made Link leaving the cutscene where he gets the Fairy Ocarina more impactful.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the original, he takes a couple tentative steps back, then leaves using his normal running animation. You could interpret it as emotional, but it could’ve also been just him walking away since it’s the normal movement animation.

Berdasarkan laporan, i like that they emphasized that small detail by making it more obviously emotional in the way link leaves. Just a small detail that reinterprets the original material in a way that I thought they might have been going for, but was unclear due to hardware limitations.

@bluemujika 70? Someone didn't get to buy it from Walmart or Amazon for 60.

Berdasarkan laporan, cutscenes in general are much improved while keeping the tone of the original. They over did her guilt a bit though. Ruto (especially in Japanese had the Ojousama mannerisms dialed up while somehow making her sound …less spoiled?), just Ruto. Link getting knocked TF out by Darunia had me in stitches. They made Mido somewhat decent. Loved Impa as usual and Nabooru felt more like a warrior for justice this time around (she has never liked Ganondorf, but she really felt he didn’t deserve blind praise simply because he was their king due to a genetic quirk). Anytime they lean on Zelda being a badarse is always a plus in my book and woo she’s even cooler y’all while still having an air of vulnerability and gravitas. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i have never hated navi, but i teared up when she left at the end. When you meet a great fairy her comment on the fountain made me laugh. I really enjoyed hanging out with that little lightbulb. You could almost hear her trying to figure out to become a great fairy. I do miss her hanging out in Link’s hat though.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i’ll admit muscle memory makes me not try a lot of stuff so i tend to notice scene changes, but i agree with bringing epona to the gate. My eyebrows went up at that. I don’t like that redeads run at you now. F that. Grottos are way easier to find (thank you!). Somehow Dark Link feels like more of an ahole?.

Berdasarkan laporan, morpha boss fight was fun this time. And the shadow and camera angle was good for my visually impaired self. (As was Ganon). I was concerned. I spend too much time reflecting back beamos lasers.

My favorite though? THE ZORA ARE FREE (and all have the flu but still…)!!.

How that stupid Owl doesnt ask if you understand, ITS THE BEST!!.

Oh definitely the little tassels on Ganondorf's armour.

Diungkapkan bahwa if i'm being serious, i liked that new item that allowed you to summon a business scrub at will. Didn't think I'd actually use them but they came in handy in a pinch.

Berdasarkan laporan, the extra bits of context in the cutscenes are great. The story just makes more sense with them.

Just finished a 100% play through today and I have to say i'm mighty impressed.

Diungkapkan bahwa i went back to play the original for the first time after beating the remake. Besides the obvious improvements like camera controls, being able to save and quit and be in the same area is game-changing. The first time I saved in the original was in Kakariko and when I opened the game to be back in Link's house, I was pretty peeved.

Berdasarkan laporan, also after dying to the big octorock and having to run back to the boss room every time with only 3 hearts, that was pretty annoying but i'm not sure if it works like that in the remake considering how few times i died. OoT64 is definitely harder, but i think it comes from the single stick control more than actual difficulty changes in the remake.

Sebagaimana diketahui, also one little note, i did see a lot of bad-faith haters complaining about the changed dialogue, but i have honestly enjoyed the original writing and lack of shoddy voice acting in the original more than the remake so far. It does kinda feel like they watered it down for the remake, and the voice acting does not help that at all. even if the cutscenes are pretty.

Berdasarkan laporan, @solarwolf07 yeah, it's kind of funny how a lot of the difficulty change feels like it's mostly just due to the controls and camera being so much easier so you're not constantly getting merced by flaming bats you can't get the camera to focus on or whatever. It feels like you actually get fewer hearts and fairies and stuff in dungeons so I don't think it's like the game constantly giving you health that it didn't previously (aside from the fairy thoughts, if you get those).

Berdasarkan laporan, the fact that you can wear masks as an adult! i actually specifically asked for this in a thread a couple weeks ago. Now I don't have to go back to child form every time I come across a new gossip stone just to find out what it says. And of course I can read everyone's thoughts in the future to find out how they have changed.

Diungkapkan bahwa the emotional beats between link and saria are tweaked just enough, that my god. It just hits you like a bus. Even when you just talk to her at her spot outside the forest temple, that sense of leaving childhood is so intense in a way I did not expect.

Diungkapkan bahwa probably thawing zora's domain. Nothing of substance to do there afterward which is why I'd consider it tiny but it was a big loose end to leave in the original and it's nice having the quick access tunnel from Lake Hylia working as an adult.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the movement, this is the best any character has controlled in possibly any game i've ever played. But Link has a bit of that at the start of his run but they kept it very arcade like where any direction he goes is almost instant, combine that with being able to walk over any terrain and perform jumps and acrobatics in the environment and you're left with a result that enhances the greatest game of all time to an even higher level. I was very worried that they were going to introduce momentum based movement like how characters control in more realistic AAA games (Uncharted for example seems to be the template for this and many other games in the same vain). The longer I played the game the more impressed I became with how intuitive it was to control Link and cannot praise the work the developers did enough.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for me it's navi extra dialogue, sorry to disagree gavin. But her having extra flavortext makes her feel more like a character than a tool to explain and target enemies. And now that she feels more like an individual the game feels like your playing it with a buddy! I even used her more not for actual help but because i was curious as to what she had to say.

I like that the Mask of Truth can actually be used to read minds now! It's not just backstory flavour, it functions like that for the player too.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i like that the gerudo's are a little more aggressive and mindful of their surroundings now. It made finding the carpenters more challenging!.

Diungkapkan bahwa the cuccos thing is slightly harder as you now have to remember to jump. Along with loads of other bits being harder if your a dum dum and forget to jump. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, my favourite minor tweak is that the hookshot can hit those eye switches now. That means you can legitimately do water temple first if you want. Good change.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, my least favourite tweak is how they've streamlined dungeons by taking out locks and keys. They don't feel as difficult or labyrinthian now.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, @aurumonado i always did water temple first. Gotta rescue the wife before the friend!.

Berdasarkan laporan, @danelectrode very true. On the topic of heart drops, I noticed that heart drops in the original seem to spawn three instead of one, which pleasantly surprised me haha.

I’m not going to go into specifics and spoil anything, but for me it’s post-Water Temple Zora Domain.

Diungkapkan bahwa i just love the ability to jump. Feels like some Mario game sometimes because I jump like an idiot everywhere 🤣 Especially from rock to rock, really funny to do !.

I did not play much of the original, so I can't compare extensively, but one aspect I really like too is the fact you can explore cities at night now ! Kokiri forest is so beautiful at this time of day !.

Putting Din's Fire in the Death Mountain GFF rather than the hidden Hyrule Castle one.

Sebagaimana diketahui, breath of the wild references love. But a fairy now only heals 6 hearts not full health hate.

Diungkapkan bahwa difficult to remember because i only played zelda ocarina once back in the day, and revisiting it in recent years i was confronted with a blurring, clunky mess and barely lasted an hour in it. The remake is a godsend for someone like me eager to experience it again without suffering the many archaic elements that present themselves today.

Berdasarkan laporan, i mostly notice that everything feels nicer. There's none of the clunkiness whether that be in the controls, obviously a vastly improved frame rate, and general design tweaks. One that I did note is the narrow path in the Fire Temple where a fall meant a long walk all the way back to trying it again. Boring! Now, Link will cling to the ledge and recover, or will fall into a lava pit, lose health, and respawn.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i bet this is one of the petty examples that ign used to say this version of ocarina is "easier" in its obvious agenda to not score it a 10. The path is easy to traverse as long as it's not rushed, so clinging to the ledge or losing health is an excellent two-stage warning to be careful compared to the previous brutal method after some simple carelessness. Whereas to sane people, the punishment from that fall is purely cheap game design. That is much more in sync with the ethos of Ocarina whereas in something like Ghosts N Goblins, that sort of cheap punishment is to be expected!.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are a lot of little things i like. Jumping changes gameplay. The cutscenes are astonishing, especially the scene you get the master sword for the first time. The environment changes with the modern rendering makes everything feel more natural and true to their vision. Pro / Master HUD is great. And as others mentioned, the orchestral music is just beautiful.

Diungkapkan bahwa all great but the best? it’s the three c’s. Character, Camera, and Controls for me.

Diungkapkan bahwa we take it for granted but dual sticks and 100% camera control makes such a fundamental difference in the gameplay that i truly believe it will surprise many how it feels to go back to play the original. It just gives me even more freedom. I can control my sword swing direction. I can swing the camera just where I need it and it doesn’t clip into the environment. Link does what I want, when I want it, and how I want. To now experience that with modern camera controls with all the other changes just really seals the deal for me. I never feel cheated. I feel like when I run up and jump near Epona, it just works and Link mounts correctly. It was my first 3D game and introduced me to “open worlds”. Ocarina of Time was the first game I played on N64. I like when I walk around with my shield up, he keeps walking forward but I can pivot my shield to the left or right. They way Link responds to all my inputs just feels… right.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a lot of people will go back to the original. I can say so far, this is my favourite version of Ocarina of Time and I am surprised I feel this way. It was will still hold up very well, but all things considered, the camera controls makes the biggest difference to me. This game beat my expectations.

If I had any minor criticisms about the controls, it’s simply the fact I can’t be as hardcore as in the N64 version, and I don’t have a separate dedicated button to raise my shield while Z-targeting like in the original version.

Berdasarkan laporan, they nailed the feeling of walking on ice! the frosting and the snow in the ice cavern is amazing. Actually made me reach for a blanket!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, regardless of which pack you get, you’ll earn collection points for each, which puts you on the path to unlocking outfits like the dreamlight cinematics festival-specific modern show dandy and modern show belle. #326. Dungeons in World of Warcraft: Forever get a huge XP buff, but power-levellers shouldn't celebrate just yet

📅 09 Nov 2026

Dungeons in World of Warcraft: Forever get a huge XP buff, but power-levellers shouldn't celebrate just yet

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/world-of-warcraft-forever-dungeon-mob-xp-rate-buff

World of Warcraft: Forever has received a massive buff to the XP drop-rates of dungeon mobs (enemies), which should make running these instances multiple times feel more rewarding - and may revive an older levelling strategy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this buff is a 50 percent increase in experience from all mobs killed inside all dungeons. As detailed in this World of Warcraft forum post, community manager Kaivax wrote that this change has been made "so it feels better to go back in for more runs". They don't outright say this is in response to community feedback, but the subject has been a hot topic since the beta.

Berdasarkan laporan, world of warcraft: forever developers have spoken in the past about the decision to deliberately bring down dungeon mob xp to disincentivise power-levelling in dungeons. The idea was that by doing this, people would be encouraged to actually go out into the world and explore it, rather than hopping from instance to instance until they reached max level.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sadly, a side effect of this change is that doing a dungeon more than once could feel unrewarding. Playing it once is great, as you get to complete lots of quests that reward guaranteed items and XP. However, if you go back again, you don't get these, so your only source of progression comes from a heavily decreased XP rate.

Sebagaimana diketahui, some quests exacerbate this issue. Dungeons like Wailing Caverns and especially Blackfathom Deeps have a quest that can't really be completed in one run due to a reliance on drop rates for items you need, and having to fight for drops with the rest of your dungeon party. Having to go back to complete this used to suck, and now it sucks less!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so does this mean farming dungeons to power-level is back? maybe, but it still won't be nearly as efficient as it was in older versions of classic wow. The current mob XP rates, after this buff, will still only be 36 percent of the original Classic rate - a third. Given how fast you can level by doing quests out in the world, it seems dungeon farming isn't due for a comeback just yet.

Diungkapkan bahwa after an especially smooth launch, world of warcraft: forever has become the biggest launch in the series' history, beating out wrath of the lich king, cataclysm, and all the other past expansion launches. The developers have been quick to hotfix things on the fly, including a change that left PvP battlegrounds heavily advantaged for the Horde.

Top accolade at the Golden Joystick Awards.

Resident Evil Requiem has been crowned the Ultimate Game of the Year at the Golden Joystick Awards, the first major games award ceremony of 2026.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, alongside the biggest award, it was also named the console game of the year, and it won categories celebrating the best lead performer (angela sant'albano as grace ashcroft) and the best game trailer. Most of the Golden Joystick Awards are decided by a public vote, and the race for Ultimate Game of the Year was extremely close.

Resident Evil Requiem won the award with 17% of the overall vote, but Phantom Blade Zero was right behind it with 16% and then Crimson Desert got 15%.

Obviously, since it's not out yet, GTA 6 wasn't eligible for any categories.

Berdasarkan laporan, elsewhere, the award for the best remake / remaster went to the witcher 3 remastered, then dispatch won the best soundtrack and best storytelling categories. Onimusha: Way of the Sword has the Best Audio Design according to the voters, Valheim was the year's Best Indie Game, and The Witcher 4 is the Most Wanted Game.

#329. Zenless Zone Zero Version 2.7 brings Angels of Delusion to the battlefield with playable Nangong Yu

📅 16 Mar 2026

Zenless Zone Zero Version 2.7 brings Angels of Delusion to the battlefield with playable Nangong Yu

Tanggal: 16 Mar 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/zenless-zone-zero-update-2-7-nangong-yu-hollow-champion-competition

Champions Never Fall to the Past indeed, as Zenless Zone Zero prepares for a major update that fans of Angels of Delusion will appreciate.

Diungkapkan bahwa hoyoverse has delivered another special program for the second day running, this time for zenless zone zero. The developer revealed the full details of Version 2. 7, subtitled Champions Never Fall to the Past.

This next major update arrives March 24, adding two new Agents, and introducing the Hollow Champion competition.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, most things in version 2. 7 follow on from the Hollow Champion competition, which brings together old friends and familiar faces, as well interesting newcomers. Everyone is in it to win some big rewards and earn glory.

Sebagaimana diketahui, among the unexpected participants the competition has attracted are the public security's metropolitan order division, and even some former calydon's sweepers. A big challenge that awaits is Black Wolf Romeul, who’s capable of increasing his Crit Damage Resistance and Interruption Resistance by activating a Corruptive Barrier.

Romeul can also cause enemies to continuously lose HP, but you can beat him by putting together a squad that can deal sustained Anomaly damage, which will break through the barrier quickly.

Berdasarkan laporan, our first new arrival in version 2. She is an S-Rank Electric Attack Agent who automatically gains three stacks of Venom when she enters the battle. 7 is Cissia of the Metropolitan Order Division. Each stack deals Electric Damage while also increasing her Crit Rate for a time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when she runs out of venom, which will happen, cissia can generate more stacks by using her ex special attack. She can also use her Basic Attack, Serpent's Kiss, to better utilise the new stacks of Venom she generates.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the other new agent may be the more exciting. Nangong Yu, the captain and lead dancer of the Angels of Delusion, can now be part of your team. Nangong Yu is an S-Rank Ether Stun Agent who can boost her team’s Anomaly Buildup Rate against Stunned enemies.

Berdasarkan laporan, being part of an idol group has its perks, because she automatically regenerates downbeat as time goes on, and even more any time a squad member inflicts an enemy with anomaly. #334. "There is no excuse for what I did," Nvidia CEO says, as affair with an alleged Chinese spy makes the US-China AI race look even more ridiculous

📅 09 Nov 2026

"There is no excuse for what I did," Nvidia CEO says, as affair with an alleged Chinese spy makes the US-China AI race look even more ridiculous

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/there-is-no-excuse-for-what-i-did-nvidia-ceo-says-as-affair-with-an-alleged-chinese-spy-makes-the-us-china-ai-race-look-even-more-ridiculous

Just saying, Jensen, this probably doesn't happen if you stick to gaming GPUs.

Ostensible graphics card company and definite AI giants Nvidia have commissioned an independent investigation into themselves, amid reports that CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

Berdasarkan laporan, per both the new york times and nvidia themselves, nvidia offered to go under the microscope after us intelligence organisations elected to investigate huang’s paramour, chinese national alice huang (no, uh, relation, and also known as huang le), on suspicion of sharing sensitive information with beijing. The Nvidia-running, leather-jacketed Huang has thus far only copped to an unspecified affair, admitting in an extraordinary public statement that he was "unfaithful to my wife. " Still, the two investigations are likely to start a bizarre new leg in the alread-messy AI arms race that the US and China have been indulging in for years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, see, the basis for huang and huang’s relationship appears to be the same thing that’s been fucking us as pc owners: data centres and ai hardware. Alice Huang is a former managing director of Megaspeed, a Singapore-based data centre company who’ve bought billions of US dollars’ worth of Nvidia chips – and have been investigated for allegedly getting some of them into the hands of Chinese companies, in defiance of US trade restrictions on goods that might threaten the States’ AI dominance. Possibly also, given both countries’ increasing interest in the technology’s military uses, their perception of national security.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, many of these embargo-dodging accusations originate from after alice huang left megaspeed, though she is now under that separate investigation for intelligence-sharing, and the prospect of any high-tech pillow talk from the lips of someone like jensen huang would be very disturbing to the feds indeed. Both Nvidia and their "deeply sorry" CEO deny that he shared sensitive information beyond that required for routine customer/client discussions.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "while the board has no reason to believe that either national security or nvidia secrets were compromised, the board's inquiry will examine all available information," the company’s statement reads. "Jensen fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it. The Board has confidence in Jensen and his leadership team and will provide further updates as appropriate. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the us-sino battle of artificial intelligence, jensen huang has – as with his marriage – played both sides. He’s undoubtedly been a, perhaps the driving force behind reinventing Nvidia from beloved makers of gaming gear to the US’ number-one purveyors of environment-ruining, brain-polluting slop technology. But after the Biden administration banned American-made GPU exports to China over fears they’d be used to boost the latter’s military capabilities, Huang successfully lobbied Donald Trump into relaxing those restrictions, allowing Nvidia to flog their wares – including their crème de la crème AI GPU, the H200 – to cash-rich Chinese companies.

Berdasarkan laporan, in a further twist, many of those chips have got mysteriously stuck in hong kong import facilities, suggesting the chinese government in fact wants ai companies to stick to chinese-made parts. Maybe both, and either way, one can see how a well-placed honeypot could prove useful. But then, the Hangzhou-based DeepSeek reportedly trained their latest AI model on illicitly-gained Nvidia tech, so there’s either a healthy black market in operation, or the CCP is willing to tolerate the occasional bit of decadent Western silicone if it helps them catch up to the burger-chomping likes of ChatGPT and Claude. Allegedly.

Diungkapkan bahwa without wanting to pick sides, in a race where i hope both teams lose, it’s also china who have more work to do. The People’s Republic produces a greater proportion of successful 'open' AI models, where the inner workings and even source code is made public, and mines more of the crucial minerals needed to build components and infrastructure. However, US-produced 'closed' models dominate global AI usage, and despite the lack of minerals, its existing data centres are estimated to wield 40 times the combined compute power of China’s. Probably because they just get all the RAM they need from Best Buy instead of digging it up themselves.

#336. COD: Modern Warfare 4 gets a surprisingly sudden free trial, so you can see what the game's extraction mode DMZ is like

📅 09 Nov 2026

COD: Modern Warfare 4 gets a surprisingly sudden free trial, so you can see what the game's extraction mode DMZ is like

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-dmz-free-trial-november

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, activision has released the first trial for call of duty: modern warfare 4's extraction mode dmz. The trial is available across PC (Steam / Battlenet), PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S until Wednesday, 11th November.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the free trial only includes access to dmz and no other part of modern warfare 4, such as multiplayer or the campaign. And while it's not uncommon for Call of Duty titles to make some of their modes available for free for a limited time, the timing of this DMZ taster is notable.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dmz launched days before modern warfare 4's 23rd october release date, meaning this first trial has arrived just two weeks after the game's full launch. By comparison, Black Ops 7's Endgame mode had its first free trial months after launch, in the game's third season. That said, Endgame continued to be freely available until Season 6.

Diungkapkan bahwa the dmz trial also coincides with the launch of modern warfare 4's iteration of free-to-play call of duty battle royale mode warzone, and season 1. Indeed, both DMZ and the new Warzone take place on the same Hajin map, so even if you don't decide to buy the full game to continue playing DMZ, some of that map knowledge will certainly transfer to Warzone.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the dmz trial does not appear to have any limits, meaning you can climb the ranks, access story missions - the only way to play pve, with caveats - and complete orders to your heart's content. That includes X01, the new endgame dungeon-like area available to experienced and fully-equipped players.

DMZ players who've been asking Infinity Ward to offer a PvE-only playlist of the PvPvE mode will certainly be happy with the influx of new players, as they could potentially amplify their calls for a PvP-free playlist.

#339. Petit Planet Hands-On Preview – Creature Comforts

📅 09 Nov 2026

Petit Planet Hands-On Preview – Creature Comforts

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/preview/2026/11/09/creature-comforts

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, petit planet marks hoyoverse’s maiden voyage into the life sim genre popularized by games like animal crossing, stardew valley, and, most recently, pokémon pokopia. The creators of Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, and Zenless Zone Zero have crafted well-received, lucrative free-to-play gacha games across several disparate genres; Petit Planet, fittingly, sees it try to attract yet another world of players. It’s been a year since I first played Petit Planet’s initial alpha test, and I spent a couple of more hours exploring its cozy cosmos at the Hoyoverse Media Tour in Seoul, South Korea. Although what I played has not dramatically changed my opinion of the game – it remains a delightful, if familiar, good time – speaking to its lead designer who goes by the single name Murphy and lead artist Yunli Huang helped shed light on how Petit Planet will differentiate itself from contemporaries and its approach to multiplayer, storytelling, and monetization.

Berdasarkan laporan, the game’s premise centers on a customizable protagonist who sets out to populate their own personal planet (which is about the size of king kai’s world from dragon ball z). Although you are ostensibly human, everyone else is a talking animal. Your mentor of sorts is a chillax sheepdog named Mobai, who enjoys wearing straw hats and dropping his catchphrase/life mantra “Mo worries” and “Mo Rush. ” The business-minded Glenn the Squirrel is a shopkeeper and seems like a cuter, less aggressive Tom Nook. Yunghou is a shy fox who enjoys farming and has the slightest hint of a southern accent. These critters and many more inhabit your planet, which you’ll grow from an empty (but vibrant) rock into a bustling village filled with homes, businesses, crops, decor, and, of course, neighbors.

Berdasarkan laporan, story is rarely a hook for a genre that largely promotes creating your own fun through the emergent moments with your neighbors and friends in multiplayer. Still, after Pokémon Pokopia presented an unexpectedly wild and fascinating tale, I ask if players should bother getting invested in a grander narrative à la Genshin Impact. The short answer seems to be “not so much. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “unlike other hoyoverse games, there is no such main plot,” murphy explains in my group interview. If you look at the description of creatures, many of them are real creatures in real world, and you get to learn more knowledge of this creature by reading those descriptions. So that is how we treat narrative in this game. But the whole narrative of this game will be more fragmented. And also, we've developed a very comprehensive narrative for each of our neighbors, so that is also part of our, called like, main plot, main narrative, because we want to make this world more like more lively and a more livable world. For example, if you look at those descriptions of those items, there will be a lot of content and narrative behind it. “There will be a main story at the beginning, but the main purpose is just to guide the players, get more familiar with the setting and the world. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while players who enjoy a substantial story to propel them through a game may be disappointed, those looking to unwind with a laid-back experience should be pleased. Hoyoverse is designing Petit Planet to be a no-pressure experience to enjoy at your leisure, hence why it emphasizes it as a life sim more than a management sim. There are no complicated stats to manage; simple inputs make it easy to pick up and play; imperfection is encouraged, with Hoyoverse comparing the experience to doodling as a child: your creation may not be perfect, but you had fun bringing your imagination to life.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i spent the first hour of my roughly two-and-a-half-hour session starting from scratch to see if any notable changes were made to this introductory portion in the last year. Performing special tasks for residents, from completing requests to simply interacting with them, grows their bond, which, when high enough, will entice them to move in. You have all of these foundational mechanics within the first 45 to 50 minutes, which is a nice pace. For veteran genre fans, it’s a familiar song and dance. If there are any differences, they’re imperceptible because I wen went through the same onboarding of learning how to catch bugs and fish, building your first home, inviting your first neighbor, and farming crops, all while growing a magical sapling that, after performing enough tasks, blooms into a full tree that brings new life and mechanics to your world as it grows. What I did notice this time around is how refreshingly quick the onboarding is. It was a good refresher for some foundational mechanics I’d forgotten since I last played, but it created an appetite to dive deeper.

Diungkapkan bahwa thankfully, hoyoverse provided a second build set many hours into the game to give an idea of how planets can evolve. My sparse quest log was tricky to tackle since they revolved around mechanics I had no context for, such as setting up Vignettes. Sporting winter gear, I ran around the snow-covered planet, which was densely populated with shops, homes, and neighbors. I was initially greeted by unfamiliar faces named Trixie and Kookoo, who provided weather forecasts and news reports reminiscent of Isabelle from Animal Crossing and Callie and Marie from Splatoon. This build was set during winter, one of Petit Planet’s revolving seasons that alter the environment and introduce themed cosmetics and decor for players and residents. These are essentially templates for unique scenes filled out by dropping the correct furniture pieces in their layout; in this case, I had to set up an outdoor movie on the beach.

Berdasarkan laporan, i only spent roughly an hour with this late build, and my biggest takeaway was simply how dense and lovely the village looked. None of what I saw surprised me, however. Petit Planet so far checks many of the boxes you’d expect and want from a life sim. A lot of work went into crafting this build, which boasted a farm filled with different crops (with unlockable recipes to create dishes from them), crafting tables to build furniture from collectible blueprints, and several shops, including Glenn’s to purchase a revolving selection of decor items. My cursory tour of a later-game planet did little to reveal any big new ideas, but what I did experience seemed perfectly cromulent.

Sebagaimana diketahui, my biggest question regards multiplayer. And even once your buddy arrives, interactions are disappointingly limited. As much as I enjoy Animal Crossing: New Horizons and Pokémon Pokopia as solo experiences, playing with friends feels like a mean joke because of the tedious number of hoops to jump through just to invite other players into your world. “The multiplayer experience is a very important part of our game because, just as the interaction with NPCs, the interaction with other players is also a form of building up emotional connection to this game, and we want to provide that kind of experience to our players. When I ask if Petit Planet offers a comparatively frictionless multiplayer experience, Murphy vaguely assures smoother sailing. ” More specifically, Murphy cites features such as dynamic server load adjustments based on player counts and the option to allow or ban visiting players from taking resources from your planet to prevent griefing.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as a free-to-play hoyoverse game, monetization is a major talking point. Instead, all monetization will revolve around cosmetics; players can unlock new furniture and themed decor sets, outfits, and other cosmetic accessories for their character. Unlocking a full themed set of decor earns currency points, and there are myriad reward meters to fill for performing mundane tasks like greeting residents or catching bugs. In Petit Planet’s case, the team agrees that rolling for neighbors gacha-style would be strange and defeats the spirit of the genre. It remains to be seen if and how Petit Planet’s progression begins nudging players into opening their wallets, but Hoyoverse promises it will be an experience that deemphasizes grinding.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i also briefly checked out the recently announced switch 2 version of petit planet. My impressions after about 15 minutes of playtime: it’s fine. It sometimes ran noticeably hitchier than the PC version I spent most of my time with, but it seems perfectly adequate so far and, hopefully, will be a smooth experience when it launches sometime next year.

Diungkapkan bahwa since life sims require more than a couple of hours to fully reveal their quality, it was tough to get a read on petit planet even with this new showing. The game looks beautiful thanks to Hoyoverse’s signature sharp and colorful visual style. It has a relaxing vibe, and feels mechanically decent for the most part. In short, it seems broadly fine and like a respectable take on the genre. I suspect its biggest appeal will be that it will receive what Animal Crossing: New Horizons lacked: years of constant, substantial support.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, hoyoverse is very good about keeping fans of its games well fed with regular updates for years on end, and i don’t expect it to stop now. I imagine this is the reason Petit Planet is coming to Switch 2 next year, where it can lure in Animal Crossing and Pokopia players before other consoles. The idea of a seemingly well-made spin on Animal Crossing that’s free to download and, unless it completely bombs, will almost certainly receive years of new content is enticing on paper. PC and mobile players, meanwhile, must only wait until December 4 when Petit Planet fully launches to see if it has the chops to stand alongside the coziest giants of the genre.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sam woods is thegamer’s senior reporter. These have included roles such as SEO Editor, Managing Editor at DualShockers, and Global Head of Gaming, and he's also been seen on the BBC. He’s been in games journalism since 2020 and has undertaken a variety of roles in that time. He was promoted to the Senior Reporter position in 2025 following a series of high-quality reports and exclusives for TheGamer.

Sebagaimana diketahui, since 2020, sam has written over 3,000 articles and specializes in telling the stories of the people behind the games. He’s also interviewed some of the world’s biggest musical artists to find out how the medium has inspired their work, and TV and Film actors about their roles in video game adaptations. He’s interviewed the biggest game directors, some of the industry’s top talents, told the stories of how indie games came to be, and spoken to players about what really makes them tick. He even hosted a PAX panel in 2021 and made a documentary in 2024 surrounding the creation of a Disney game.

Berdasarkan laporan, alongside this, sam focuses on breaking news. These articles have been picked up by the biggest gaming sites, including IGN, GameSpot, and PC Gamer. He got the scoop on Perfect Dark’s cancellation, provided context on some AI drama, and revealed that Lady Dimitrescu’s actress would love to step back into the character’s giant shoes. He also loves to dive into the numbers behind the games.

Berdasarkan laporan, sam’s journey in games journalism has taken him all over the world. He’s covered Gamescom in Germany, Summer Game Fest in Los Angeles, and Tokyo Game Show in Japan, each on three occasions.

He’s been learning Japanese since 2024 with the intention of identifying and translating Japanese-language news and bringing it to English-language audiences first, something he’s done countless times.

Sam’s first review was 2020’s Battletoads reboot, and he’s since reviewed games in The Legend of Zelda, Super Mario, and Pokemon franchises.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with sony recently confirming that it will no longer port its playstation games to pc, there has been a rush to perfect emulation of its titles. Over the summer, 2025's Ghost of Yotei was booted on PC via an emulator for the first time, and the same happened with the PS5 launch title, Demon's Souls.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, while sharpemu is certainly the choice for running emulated versions of ps5 games, one player is trying to get astro bot to run natively on windows, without the need for an emulator, and so far, they've had some success. After jumping through a few hurdles, the game is running on Windows, with up to 120 FPS via frame generation.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the native astro bot pc port was shared on reddit by equal_classroom_872. It runs through a "Windows executable using AnyPS5, with a Kyty-based Vulkan graphics layer. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, across four of astro bot's different areas, equal_classroom received varying frame rates. In Sky Garden, they received 32-34 fps; in Hoover Beach, 51–53 fps; in Snowy Canyon, 43–44 fps; and in Cymbal Party Land, 37–39 fps. This was, however, boosted drastically via frame generation.

Diungkapkan bahwa with 2x frame gen, the game reached around 63 fps; with 4x, it reached 124-128 fps. Naturally, the frame generation has caused some controversy, as they aren't native frames, but it is a way to boost performance.

The port also includes DLSS Super Resolution, NVIDIA Reflex integration, and controller support, including DualSense, DualShock 4, Xbox, Switch Pro, plus motion controls.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unfortunately, like many other pc ports recently, this is almost certainly vibecoded. We've seen it with the likes of Super Mario Galaxy and Need for Speed: Underground 2, and Equal_Classroom actively cites AI in their post.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it comes at a time when public perception of sony and playstation is at an all-time low. The PlayStation fanbase has been rallying against the company's decision to stop producing discs starting next year. The backlash has included protests, petitions, new bill proposals, and class-action lawsuits against the move, and Sony even won a Hall of Shame award.

You may recall that back in July, Xbox announced a new free version of Xbox Cloud Gaming that would allow you to play games at no charge, but you'd be forced to deal with ads as a compromise.

That tier of Xbox Cloud Gaming was in testing for months, but as of today (November 11th), it's rolled out publicly - meaning the vast majority of Xbox users around the world should now have access to it.

Xbox has been very quiet about it today so far, but based on what we've seen around the web, the free tier of Xbox Cloud Gaming will provide you with a 30-minute slot to stream "select games from your library" as well as select free-to-play games, after which time you'll be kicked off and will have to start a new session.

You'll see ads before the session begins, and seemingly never again throughout your 30-minute playtime.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "you can stream select games for free by watching ads before each gaming session. After a session ends, you can watch another set of ads to start a new session. Session time limits apply. ".

Rolling out now as a "test" for Xbox Insiders.

We'd urge some caution for now though, as Xbox has yet to confirm whether GTA 6 will be one of the "select" games that supports this feature.

Meanwhile, the cloud playtime limits that were announced a while ago for Xbox Game Pass members have now started kicking in, which also means you can now purchase "Cloud Playtime" to top it up if you run out.

The prices for this here in the UK are as follows:.

Curiously though, I've checked the new "Cloud Playtime" option in the Settings menu on my Xbox Series X and I'm being informed that I've still got "Unlimited" access to Xbox Cloud Gaming with my Ultimate membership, so it might be worth checking the same thing on your end and seeing what it says for you.

I'm not the only person who's spotted something similar:.

Anyway, we've thrown Xbox's official tweet up above, and you can hit the link in it to find out even more details.

#342. Poll: 15 Years Later, Is Skyrim Still One of the Best Open World RPGs Out There?

📅 11 Nov 2026

Poll: 15 Years Later, Is Skyrim Still One of the Best Open World RPGs Out There?

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pushsquare.com/features/poll-15-years-later-is-skyrim-still-one-of-the-best-open-world-rpgs-out-there

11/11/11 — the famous release date that will forever be associated with The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim.

If you haven't already realised, today marks the title's 15th anniversary, and it's crazy to think that the open world RPG remains one of the most consistently popular games out there.

Berdasarkan laporan, indeed, at the time of writing this article, skyrim's racking up around 40,000 concurrent players on steam. Again, it's 15 years old!.

Berdasarkan laporan, there's no denying that skyrim has a unique magic to it; an atmosphere, a sense of time and place. Bethesda struck absolute gold with this one, despite its often obvious flaws as a role-playing excursion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of course, the fact that skyrim's simply never been replaced probably bolsters its legacy. The wait for The Elder Scrolls 6 has felt eternal at points, and the long, long awaited sequel is reportedly still years away from release.

I mean, would you be at all surprised if we got a PS6 port of Skyrim before Sentinel's arrival?.

Berdasarkan laporan, but skyrim also owes so much of its longevity to its players. Modders have kept the candle burning for over a decade, and people are still forging ahead with extremely ambitious projects today.

Berdasarkan laporan, no game maintains that level of interest without being special in the first place, however. I'd argue that even now, there's no open world RPG quite like Skyrim — it's a truly timeless experience with regards to its gameplay loop, dynamic happenings, and player-driven sense of adventure.

Diungkapkan bahwa i've seen skyrim dubbed distractions: the game, and that comedic description still rings true. I've lost track of how many times I've started a new Skyrim playthrough over the years, but somehow, it's never lost its appeal — and that's primarily because of how freeform it can feel.

But do you think Skyrim still stands tall as an all-timer RPG? Dare I ask if you're still playing it in 2026? Vote in our polls, and then tell me all about your wintry adventures in the comments section below.

Sebagaimana diketahui, robert (or rob if you're lazy) is an assistant editor of push square, and has been a fan of playstation since the 90s, when tekken 2 introduced him to the incredible world of video games. The Witcher, Persona, Dragon Quest, Mass Effect, Final Fantasy, Trails, Tales — he's played 'em all. He still takes his fighting games seriously, but RPGs are his true passion. A little too much, some might say.

I think time hasn't been kind to Skyrim (and Bethesda in general) due to games such as The witcher 3, Cyberpunk 2077 and Baldur's gate having better character interactions and world building, but when it came out Skyrim was a revelation, and easily one of the best games of the PS3/Xbox 360 generation.

It's janky but still a great RPG and as Todd says:.

There's something timeless about the vibe of the game. That said, there's something magical about Skyrim. In my opinion, Oblivion just doesn't hold up today, but Skyrim does and I can't really tell you why.

Berdasarkan laporan, do oblivion and morrowind have better main quests? oh, absolutely. And, yet… there’s still something just a little bit more immersive about Skyrim. Fallout 3 and New Vegas may hold that honor as well. Fallout 4 didn’t quite replicate it and neither did Starfield.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what it is is the storysensing. The game understands that it’s a game for everyone. My son is now able to sink into the game and appreciate its majesty and it’s not so complex a game, as many of the other games I’ve listed, that he is repelled from the game pretension. And even just a moment back in its world is strangely still as inviting and absorbing as it was all those years ago now. You choose good or evil. Skyrim is the absolute master of this craft. You choice the guilds you work with, to become a werewolf, a vampire, etc. I’ll be honest and say it’s probably my only and last 1000+ hour game. And it holds up remarkably well today too. You choose to fulfill your destiny as Dragonborn or not. You become a character wholly of your own existence as you play and you experience quests as that imagined being would experience them. Storytelling is a far more familiar concept, where you’re interpreting a story that you’re meant to experience, but storysensing is the concept of absorbing enough details in a game’s world that you personally tell yourself your character’s story. You subconsciously fill things in and create things mentally in the game that don’t exist, but mesh into the world. And let me also say that the game has an immense pull with all people, not just those of us that are dedicated gamers. Skyrim was the first game that my wife ever really loved and is likely the only game she will ever hit 100+ hours in. It’s a classic, an all-timer, and it was obvious 15 years ago and it still is today.

Berdasarkan laporan, skyrim’s one of the greatest games of all time. And perhaps time had been kind enough to give us some absolutely essential DLCs that do provide deeper storytelling that present epilogues just as immersive as base game. Skyrim is, basically, to video games what the Beatles were to rock music. I do find the main quest to have quite a weak third act, but yet I’ve been compelled to complete it more times than games with far “better” storylines. You can argue why you think it’s overrated, but at the end of the day, it delivers so many hits and everything is so memorable, even though you can see its influences. Certainly in my personal top 10 list of games of all time. Todd Howard was right back then when he said, “It just works. It does have its flaws, but they’re strangely something easy to overlook. ” It may have been buggy at times, but he was certainly right.

#343. Rockstar were "definitely" thinking about giving a Japanese studio the keys to GTA, says former tech director - "I have a name, but I'm not gonna say it"

📅 09 Nov 2026

Rockstar were "definitely" thinking about giving a Japanese studio the keys to GTA, says former tech director - "I have a name, but I'm not gonna say it"

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/rockstar-were-definitely-thinking-about-giving-a-japanese-studio-the-keys-to-gta-says-former-tech-director-i-have-a-name-but-im-not-gonna-say-it

Obbe Vermeij on ancient plans for a GTA Tokyo.

Berdasarkan laporan, since time immemorial, north american and european publishers have racked their brains over ways to make their games sell in japan, ancient heartland of mythical beings like mario, sonic, and polaroid pete. In the late noughties, Microsoft launched a big push to give Japanese youth the Xbox virus with such targeted console exclusives as Blue Dragon and Lost Odyssey. And Rockstar once dreamed of making a Grand Theft Auto game set in Tokyo.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, speaking to me last week, rockstar north's former technical director obbe vermeij shared a little about the abandoned project. Emphasis on the "little" – it doesn't appear to have gotten very far, despite recently unearthed allusions to "Tokyo PS2" in GTA 5's source code.

Diungkapkan bahwa rockstar's parent company take-two interactive filed a trademark for gta tokyo back in 2003, the year before the release of the los angeles-flavoured gta: san andreas. It was the plan. At the time, Rockstar were apparently looking at collaborating with a Japanese studio on the project. "But yeah, there were negotiations with studios, and I have a name, but I'm not gonna say it, because then it becomes like a bigger thing than it is, and I'll probably get it wrong, and I don't know how far the negotiations were, how serious it was. "So this was kind above my pay grade," Vermeij told me. I mean, it was definitely serious. But I don't know how close it got to actually happening. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the game itself would likely have been a contemporary story, not a historical yarn like rockstar's subsequent red dead redemption. "Or sort of not too [far off] - it wasn't, like, sort of the medieval era in Japanese history, or anything. "It definitely had samurai swords in it, I remember that, but I think it was present-day probably," Vermeij went on. It was definitely not like that. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, vermeij was at rockstar from 1995 to 2009, where he worked on the first four mainline 3d gta games, plus some handheld spin-offs. "It was Moscow, London. During that time, he says, Rockstar frequently considered the idea of a Grand Theft Auto set outside the United States. "In the same way that we were always thinking about other games, we also thought about cities that would be cool, and it was always the same list," he said. It was always the same ones that people suggested. Istanbul, Rio de Janeiro, maybe Paris and Tokyo. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, grand theft auto has never quite the money-spinner in japan that it is in north america and europe. Localised editions of the original three 3D GTA games were published by Capcom, sometime after the original releases, selling a few hundred thousand copies apiece in their launch years.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i think perhaps [rockstar's co-founders] the housers were a little annoyed that gta wasn't as big in japan as they thought it deserved to be," vermeij reflected. So, it made sense to have a Japanese studio have a shot at it, and I think it would have been really cool, because you know, a GTA made by somebody else in Japanese culture – that's something I would probably play. "So it kind of made sense to get a local studio to do it. Japanese people actually kind of like different games from westerners a fair bit. For instance, they don't like first person shooters and stuff. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, take-two ultimately abandoned their original "gta tokyo" trademark in 2008. It's not clear how much Rockstar have considered setting GTA overseas since Vermeij's day, but co-founder Dan Houser (who left the company in 2020) recently told podcaster Lex Fridman that they ultimately decided it wasn't a credible objective.

Diungkapkan bahwa “we made a little thing in london 26 years ago - gta london - for the top-down for ps1," he said. But that was so much about what the thing was that it wouldn't really have worked in the same way elsewhere. It just felt like the game was so much about America, possibly from an outsider's perspective. You know, you needed guns, you needed these larger-than-life characters. "That was pretty cute and fun, as the first mission pack ever for PlayStation 1. I think for a full GTA game, we always decided there was so much Americana inherent in the IP, it would be really hard to make it work in London or anywhere else. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if this article has left you pining for the shibuya scramble npc-tipping sim that will never be, i bring good news: japanese developers are quite capable of making their own urban open worlders. All these games have the advantage of being playable on PC right now. There's also Ghostwire: Tokyo, a respectable first-person parkour sim, though this particular incarnation of Tokyo has a lot of paranormal congestion. The obvious go-tos are Sega's Yakuza/Like A Dragon games, with their abundance of lovingly modelled eateries and discount stores. As for GTA 6? Who can say, but Vermeij thinks Rockstar might want to port it sooner to get ahead of the slopcomp craze.

#344. Ocarina of Time remake datamine suggests Master Quest is on the way

📅 08 Nov 2026

Ocarina of Time remake datamine suggests Master Quest is on the way

Tanggal: 08 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/zelda-ocarina-of-time-remake-master-quest-dlc-datamine

Ocarina of Time's notoriously tricky Master Quest mode could be making a comeback in the new remake.

Dataminer MrCheeze shared a list of strings from the remake's files on Bluesky, several of which tie the tag "MQ" to dungeons like Dodongo's Cavern.

In a follow-up, as spotted by TheGamer, they pointed to further entries, including "HasMQ", "IsMQModeExist", "NewGameMQ", and "ReleaseMQ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, fellow dataminer oatmealdome added on twitter/x that the mode will be unlocked by owning dlc, rather than arriving in an update, though "the data is incomplete". "I can confirm that the world is mirrored and dungeons are modified (e. g. cows in Jabu-Jabu's Belly)," they said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you've not played it, master quest is a remixed version of ocarina of time with rearranged dungeons and tougher puzzles. It first appeared as a bonus disc on GameCube, then came back in 2011's Ocarina of Time 3D, which unlocked it after you finished the main game. That version also mirrored the whole world, which matches what OatmealDome has found, and had enemies deal double damage.

Diungkapkan bahwa [ocarina of time] #ootspoilersthere is data in the game files for master quest. It will be unlocked by *owning DLC* - it is not just an update. g. The data is incomplete, but I can confirm that the world is mirrored and dungeons are modified (e. cows in Jabu-Jabu's Belly).

Sebagaimana diketahui, as with any datamine, there's no guarantee it'll ever see the light of day. Nintendo hasn't announced any DLC for the remake, and it's not clear whether Master Quest would be free, like it was on 3DS, or paid.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the ocarina of time remake launched on switch 2 on 5th november. Donlan called the new version an "astonishing remake" in his five-star Eurogamer Ocarina of Time review.

#346. Battlefield 6 is getting a free trial next week with a decent selection of maps and modes

📅 13 Mar 2026

Battlefield 6 is getting a free trial next week with a decent selection of maps and modes

Tanggal: 13 Mar 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-6-free-trial-march-2026-maps-modes-dates

Battlefield 6's second-ever free trial, and the first in 2026, is upon us.

Berdasarkan laporan, battlefield studios has announced that battlefield 6 is going free to play for one week next week. Well, a portion of the game is, anyway, as part of a free trial that will include some of the game’s most popular modes and maps.

Berdasarkan laporan, though it does not encompass the entirety of the game, the free trial is fairly generous. Here’s what to expect.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for starters, the trial kicks off tuesday, march 17 and will run until the following tuesday, march 24. The trial will be accessible from Battlefield Redsec, the already free-to-play portion of the game.

Berdasarkan laporan, once downloaded, you’ll find a new battlefield 6 free trial section in the main menu. Because Redsec and Battlefield 6 multiplayer share progression, if you played the former at any point, you’ll be able to pick up from where you left off.

The same is also true the other way around; if this is your first time with Battlefield 6, all your unlocks will carry over to the full version, as well as to Redsec if you decide stick with the free-to-play off-shoot.

Berdasarkan laporan, once it kicks off, you’ll find three playlists to choose from. Casual Breakthrough, All-out Warfare, and a third playlist showcasing the new Nightfall game mode and its associated map.

Diungkapkan bahwa all-out warfare is what you come to battlefield for, and that playlist features conquest, breakthrough, as well as bf6’s newcomer escalation - all large-scale, combined arms game modes. They will be playable across four maps. You get to play on two from Season 2: Contaminated, and Hagental Base, one from Season 1: Eastwood, and Mirak Valley from the base game.

Diungkapkan bahwa casual breakthrough is based on a playlist that already exists in the core game, and it’s really designed as a nice on-ramp for new players. It also offers less intense gameplay, perfect for people grinding unlocks.

Berdasarkan laporan, casual breakthrough is limited to just 16 real players (eight per team), with the rest filled up with bots. You earn the same amount of XP in those matches, except when you interact with bots, so killing a bot will net less than a human player. Outside of that, unlocks, Challenges and all other things that don’t depend on stat-tracking can be done within.

In the trial, the Casual Breakthrough playlist includes Hagental Base, Contaminated, and Eastwood.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the most interesting is the third playlist, in part because its content will also be available to owners of the full game for the first time right alongside free-to-play players. Nightfall is a playlist exclusive to the Hagental Base map.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is a very small map, so the mode selection here is team deathmatch, squad deathmatch, and domination. Under Nightfall conditions, lights across the entire map are turned off, so you’re going to have use your NVGs to be able to see. This is also a god opportunity to try out weapon attachments that specifically work under low-light conditions, which typically don’t get much use in multiplayer.

March 17 also marks the launch of the second stage of Battlefield 6’s Season 2, which comes with the aforementioned Nightfall content, as well as a big new update - so the timing works out nicely for everyone.

#349. Ahead of The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past, here's a "lore friendly unofficial expansion to Geralt's life in Toussaint" from a well-established quest modder

📅 09 Nov 2026

Ahead of The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past, here's a "lore friendly unofficial expansion to Geralt's life in Toussaint" from a well-established quest modder

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/ahead-of-the-witcher-3-songs-of-the-past-heres-a-lore-friendly-unofficial-expansion-to-geralts-life-in-toussaint-from-a-well-established-quest-modder

Diungkapkan bahwa while its remastered upgrade might have broken cover in late september, the witcher 3's extra expansion isn't set to join it until next year. With 2027 still a month and a bit away, a modder's taken it upon themselves to add a few more adventures to Geralt's time in Toussaint, Blood and Wine's gorgeous French-ish duchy, before the bloke from the river heads off to Letten for Songs of the Past.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so far, only the opening chapter of the mod - annals of the duchy - has been released. It adds in a new quest about Geralt, with help from either Yen or Triss if either have made the trip out to Toussaint as part of your playthrough, getting into a scrape thanks to a halfling who seems to promise Gerry the chance to juice up his vineyard's vines.

Berdasarkan laporan, the mod's creator, jontej, has previously put together a couple of other custom witcher 3 quests. While they do look to have used AI voices in English versions of those mods, for Annals of the Duchy they've enlisted a cast of human actors for both Enlish and Polish versions.

Diungkapkan bahwa jontej has plans to expand this new questline going forwards, having cited specific "plans for an extra storyline involving syanna", whom you might remember from blood and wine's main quest. Given that - spoilers ahead - the mod relies on you having gotten the Blood and Wine ending which sees both Anna Henrietta and Syanna survive, as well as having paid to renovate the gardens of Geralt's vineyard. They add that, when it comes to their additions, the "timeline fits quite well [with] the upcoming official Songs of the Past Expansion, which has been confirmed to take place after the events of the main game/Blood and Wine".

Diungkapkan bahwa as much as i've argued that, as of right now, i struggle to see how songs of the past will manage to outdo blood and wine as a satisfying end to geralt's tale in the witcher game trilogy, i am intrigued by the idea of a few more modded adventures showing gerry adjusting to the semi-retired life. After all, Toussaint's got to have a few more dungeons tucked away that're worth temporarily dusting off the White Wolf's twin swords for.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to kick off annals of the duchy, you'll need to trigger its first quest by taking a stroll from the corvo bianco manor house down to its gardens between 11am and 1pm. It's worth noting that any other mod which messes with Yen, Triss or companions in general has a chance to muck things up as far as Jontej's creation goes.

#350. Where To Find Wild Ginseng In Crimson Desert

📅 08 May 2026

Where To Find Wild Ginseng In Crimson Desert

Tanggal: 08 May 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/crimson-desert-wild-ginseng-farm-locations-spirit-meter-upgrade-where-to-find-guide/

Here are three of the best places to farm Wild Ginseng for your Spirit meter upgrade in Crimson Desert.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are a lot of crafting materials in crimson desert. From the plethora of minerals used to refine your weapons to make them stronger to the various ingredients you'll hunt down to cook meals, you can easily miss some of the more obscure, but important materials in the game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of these is wild ginseng, which is used to further increase your spirit meter beyond level 8. However, Wild Ginseng isn't a plant you can find everywhere, as there are a few key locations you'll want to visit where it's guaranteed to spawn.

Updated on November 12, 2026, by Kaitlyn Peterson: This article has been updated and reformatted to make sure you can find all the information you need as quickly as possible.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you're looking for wild ginseng, head north to silver wolf mountain. Specifically, you'll want to go just southeast of the Abyss Gate right by the Longleaf Shade Outpost. When you warp here, begin climbing up the rocks until you reach the top and look for a small outcropping with several tall trees and some lavender plants.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, along the rocks, you'll want to look for some small red buds, as these are the ginseng plants you are looking for. There are typically only two to three of them, but harvesting these plants can net you one to four individual pieces of Ginseng, which is helpful. Given the close proximity to the Abyss Gate and relative ease of access at all levels, this is one of the best spots to farm this material.

Here is where to find the best rings and how to unlock them in Crimson Desert.

Diungkapkan bahwa sticking near the silver wolf mountain, this time you'll want to head southwest of the mountain itself to a place called longroots. Specifically, you will want to find the Abyss Gate that is overlooking this area, which is on top of a mountain (shown above). From here, you'll want to look west and jump down to the bottom of the mountain.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, now, turn and face the mountain you just hopped off and look for a small cave entrance that has a large tree just out front of it. This can be a little tricky to find since the area is covered in an incredibly dense fog. Once you find the cave entrance, make your way inside the cave and follow the path until you cross some water.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you'll find three wild ginseng plants in front of a stone lantern. Similar to the previously mentioned farm location, this is another great spot to check for Ginseng since it spawns literally right by the Abyss Gate. Just remember, it takes a bit of time to.

Diungkapkan bahwa the final location i recommend going to if you need ginseng is actually a street vendor in pailune. However, to even unlock this person, you will need to progress through the main story until you complete Chapter 7. This is because the main city in Pailune is under the control of a hostile faction until this series of quests is beaten.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once you've progressed through chapter 7, go to the capital city of the pailune region and then head to the northeast side. Specifically, you will want to go to the large temple where you fought Myurdin. Outside this temple, there will be a street vendor who has set up a small stall on the right side of the main doors.

Berdasarkan laporan, in this vendor's inventory, there will be five ginseng you can purchase for 1. 50 Silver each. Since vendors refresh every 24 hours, this is a great place to consistently buy Ginseng if you have a lot of money to spend and don't feel like doing the legwork to harvest it.

Remember, you'll need a total of 10 Wild Ginseng to progress your Spirit meter, so if you hit all these locations, you should have enough without needing to go back and farm more.
