#388. Zelda Ocarina Remake Producers Talk Changing And Maintaining The Game, Easter Eggs, The Bombchu Bowling Alley Operator, And More

📅 05 Nov 2026

Zelda Ocarina Remake Producers Talk Changing And Maintaining The Game, Easter Eggs, The Bombchu Bowling Alley Operator, And More

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/interview/2026/11/04/zelda-ocarina-remake-producers-talk-changing-and-maintaining-the-game-easter

Berdasarkan laporan, today marks the release of the remake of the legend of zelda: ocarina of time for switch 2. You can read my full, positive review here. Ahead of the game’s release, but after having played the game to completion (well… 99% as you will learn below), I traveled to New York to speak with Zelda series producer Eiji Aonuma (whose work on the original Ocarina of Time marked his first involvement with the series) and Ocarina of Time remake producer Hidemaro Fujibayashi (director of Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom among other Zelda titles).

Topics include how the team approached remaking Ocarina of Time, what needed changing and what needed to stay the same, their thoughts on the Easter Eggs from the original game, the fate and marital status of the Bombchu Bowling girl, and more.

The discussion covers a fairly faithful remake of Ocarina of Time for Nintendo 64, which launched nearly 30 years ago, but I have spoiler-marked certain questions and answers that might be considered sensitive if you want to maintain surprise when playing the remake yourself.

Diungkapkan bahwa mr. Fujibayashi, what is your relationship to Ocarina of Time?.

Berdasarkan laporan, fujibayashi: regarding the original ocarina of time, at the time i was working for a different company, so it was mainly me as an end user trying to looking forward to the experience of what a 3d zelda is going to look like. So, really, I was just waiting in anticipation for that.

How long has the remake been in development?.

Diungkapkan bahwa aonuma: it's actually kind of hard to say exactly when development began because the earliest thought process was us thinking about the 40th anniversary of the legend of zelda approaching, and so we started to have this conversation, “oh, what should we make to mark this occasion?” and then at that point, we decided on ocarina of time, and so a lot of time elapsed from the beginning of that conversation about the anniversary until we got to ocarina. So it's hard to pinpoint exactly when the development itself began.

Was this a more relaxing game to develop after making Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom back-to-back?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, aonuma: was it relaxing? that's kind of a hard question to ask. I would say it's more a different style of development. So, if we looked at Tears of the Kingdom, Breath of the Wild, these were created as new games with a very different kind of development cycle. Whereas for a remake like this one, we decided to take an interesting approach, which is to bring in this new younger staff and find out what they would bring to this project in terms of their own experience, their own interpretation as newer staff.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and so my role here was really advising them on this, and it's not always like the development cycle of a new game. But in one sense, the producer has to be careful not to advise too much, to say that you must do it like this. You don't want to prescribe the approach that anyone is going to take. You want to make sure that there's enough space for these younger staff members to have their own interpretation, their own approach to it.

Do you have remake philosophies or rules, like what needs to stay the same and what should change?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fujibayashi: so, in fact, there were pretty clear kind of rules or guidelines, as you said. And when we first started discussing what kind of game and what kind of approach you wanted to take. Aonuma had mentioned, where he wanted to, the development team was centered around the young directors that took part in this development. First, is because you know, as Mr. One thing that really came through and we clarified was, as you mentioned, what are we going to change and what are we going to keep the same.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and i'll start with what we wanted to change, and that was really to make sure that – because we have the ability to use the latest technology through the nintendo switch 2 – there's a lot we can change and improve upon, such as you know obviously things like controls, graphics. We also have a new controller, so that allows for the new camera controls. And we’re really able to fine tune and polish the feel of the game and there was excitement for all the ways of expression we can provide the player.

Berdasarkan laporan, but on the other hand, thinking about what we didn't want to change, we were thinking about the creators of the original ocarina of time, and what they wanted to convey, the experience that they wanted to provide for users and players through this title. That's something that we wanted to keep intact and that spirit to carry across. And we wanted to make sure that this new game is able to deliver that in the way that we wanted them to.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, aonuma: so speaking as someone who worked on the original ocarina of time for nintendo 64, you always have those moments looking back of, “oh, you know, i really wanted to do more of this,” or, “i wanted to be able to express this in a different way,” but you're faced with certainly the tech limitations of the time. And I went on from Ocarina of Time to work on other Zelda franchise titles, as well. And with each new title, you're always looking for a new way to express something that may not have been available to you previously. But you always have to keep in mind is what makes a Zelda game special, and how do we protect that? How do we keep that in store for the players, as well. So, on this project in particular, I had to think of that through the lens of how do we protect the things that make it the Zelda Ocarina experience, but also how do I give the freedom to the staff to find their own expression of these ideas? And I think between those two things, we found a really good balance. So I'm very happy about that.

Berdasarkan laporan, when we interviewed you, mr. Aonuma, for Game Informer’s Breath of the Wild cover story, Shigeru Miyamoto was present, and he made a joke about the challenge of the water temple. Are you happy with where the Water Temple is now in the remake?.

Berdasarkan laporan, aonuma: certainly, looking back on the challenge level of the water temple, i think it was hard, but some of that came from the system that we were presenting to players. But now that we're able to give players a shortcut, single button on the gameplay screen, I think they can get to that more quickly. So, for example, if you look at the way that players used to have to switch to the heavy iron boots so that they could sink in the water, you had to go to a different screen and press the button. It's a better experience because they can focus on solving the puzzle rather than having to navigate menus and thinking about that and interrupting the flow of their thought each time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, another consideration compared to the original is that you couldn't move the camera angle in the original game, and so if you were looking for a certain room in this 3d space relative to where you are now, it was much more difficult to orient yourself and think about the space where that room might exist. So I think those two together, you know, also with the heavy boots being one button press, I think this, for me, is the best version of the Water Temple.

Is the canon of the Zelda timeline considered at all during development? Did you think about adding in Easter eggs that made references to things that would have happened later in the Zelda story? Like Wind Waker taking place after Ocarina of Time, for example.

Berdasarkan laporan, aonuma: it's funny because the staff would sometimes ask me about the possibility of including nods to the timeline or references to the other game, and i actually, at the time, would say, "no, let's focus on this game. Let's make this the best version of Ocarina of Time that we can. " So, the timeline was in the back of our mind, but we didn't consider taking an approach to this game where we actually, explicitly included references like that.

When testing the game, was it challenging to find people who had never played Ocarina of Time?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, aonuma: as it turns out, both on our staff and in the testing teams, there's a lot of young people, and many of them had never played the original. So it wasn't a challenge to find them.

Diungkapkan bahwa who do you primarily consider this remake to be for? new people who have never played ocarina? or fans like myself who consider it to be, frankly, their favorite game. Who is the important audience?.

Berdasarkan laporan, fujibayashi: the answer is both. Our response to those fans who have fond memories of this title is really what I mentioned earlier: being able to provide the experience of what it was like to play Ocarina of Time back to them, and that was our response to them. And when it comes to the players that are experiencing this for the first time, whether it's the graphics, or the controls, or the ability to shift and move the camera; those are all changes and fine-tuning that we've made to make sure that people who are used to modern gaming are able to enter this experience with as little friction as possible. So again, to answer your question? It's really both.

Berdasarkan laporan, aonuma: certainly, when you look at the original the legend of zelda: ocarina of time, there is so much hidden in the world that people spend a lot of time looking for things. And your first time playing through, you may not find all of it in one go. People in that kind of situation would refer to strategy books and information that they can find.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for example, when you're looking for the like last skulltala and you already have 99, our job is to think about how to give the player an approach to that sort of a problem. What kind of information can we give them to help out. To make it a fun, but still challenging experience, because we want even new players to come in and to be able to fully experience this world that we've created for them, even though old fans are going to come in with a little bit of an advantage in the form of a lot of prior game knowledge.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm not kidding about needing some help with that final skulltala. I'm going to hand you my Switch 2 after this so you can show me where it is because it's been driving me crazy. I've been having dreams about where the final Skulltala might be.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the end of the game in the remake made me emotional in a way i wasn't expecting. It made me cry, just the whole ending of the experience overall. Were you expecting that kind of reaction from players?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, fujibayashi: so first, i want to say i'm very, very happy and excited to hear you say that because, as you mentioned, that cutscene – cutscenes in general – but that cutscene specifically is something that we, as a dev team, heavily discussed. Because of the limitations of the technology back in the day, there might have been things that we weren't able to convey fully, whether it's because of the tempo of the game… whatever it is. And so, when we approached this remake, we wanted to make sure that we captured that moment in the way that we wanted to express it. So that the right kinds of emotions are evoked, and that we can convey the emotion and the story that we wanted to at that moment. And now that hearing you say that and kind of having that reaction really struck a chord? I'm really relieved to hear that because that's exactly what we wanted to do.

Diungkapkan bahwa the redeads, the shadow temple, the dead hand miniboss, wall masters – these enemies traumatized a whole generation of kids. I'm curious if that was always the intention and how did you approach making sure that those elements still remained scary? Was there a line that was too scary?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, aonuma: certainly, at the time, we had this intent to make sure that we allow the players to find the enemies a little bit scary. But more than anything, they are part of this Fantasy world, which has both light and dark portions, and so we're trying to bring that feeling across. They have to be, right? We want to express that sort of thing. It’s not that we're trying to scare people outright as the entire intent, but rather show that you know Link is part of a brighter part of the world where people are friendly, and Ganon is a part of the darker part of the world where there's a lot of scary things. And we kept that in mind in the remake as well.

Berdasarkan laporan, we wanted to make sure we were bringing that out, but the tools that we have available to us now for expression are so capable that if we really tried, of course, we could make something that was very, very scary. But this is supposed to be for all kinds of players. We didn't want to hit the scary notes so strongly that we were putting off new players or younger players, and so we want to have that tuning very carefully in mind as we're making those adjustments in terms of presenting that final expression in the game.

I shudder to visualize what the scarier versions of the ReDeads might look like.

Aonuma: What was your experience of them this time?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, oh, terrifying! that noise. The noise they make. That scream. I feel it in my chest. It just recalls that scariness of my childhood in a way that I admit is very entertaining, and I like. Do you remember recording that sound effect? How did you do that? Did you have someone scream?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for the remake, a lot has been rewritten. The meaning hasn't been changed dramatically, but pretty much everything has been rewritten. What was the goal with the rewriting overall?.

Diungkapkan bahwa fujibayashi: yes, it's as you said. We did a lot of rewriting of the text. When it comes to the original Ocarina of Time, there's the idea that because it was 28 years ago – it's a long time ago – there's the turn of phrase, or the way it's been written, is sometimes not clear or doesn't work in the modern day, given the context of the modern day. And so that's why we wanted to make sure that it makes sense and it's easier to understand for people who are familiar with playing modern games, and also that it works better here.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and when you think about… obviously the graphics have been improved significantly. So with the new graphics, if you go through the wordy explanation of what it is, the player is going to be like, "Yeah, I can see it. Before we had to do things like… “That blue ocarina that is the size that you could fit on a hand,” something like that, to make sure that the idea gets across to the player. But now, because the graphics are improved, it's very clear what the size it is. It's very clear that it's a blue ocarina. " So in order to make sure that we remove those kind of slight hurdles and really make sure that we can present the game and improve not only the expression but also the pacing of the game? That's something that we really took into consideration as we were rewriting the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa i wanted to ask about some specific changes for the remake. You get five bottles now. Why?.

Berdasarkan laporan, aonuma: because bottles are so important to the way the player plays the game, like looking for strategies to deal with different kinds of situations, even at the time of development of the original title, i thought, “oh, you know, i could do with even just one more bottle. ” I think certainly when you collect all four in the original, you feel great about that at time. But I was still thinking like one more would be okay, right?.

Diungkapkan bahwa so, all this time that was in the back of my mind. But yeah, certainly, once you have a certain number of bottles, you're going to feel a little bit more confident and more comfortable. It strengthens that whole sequence through the game by changing the order just a little bit there. But when the new younger staff were familiarizing themselves with the old game and thinking about what they might want to change in this version, one thing that I suggested was that the player could get their first bottle earlier, and this would actually be really useful in terms of reinforcing for the player how helpful bottles were and motivating them on their quest to find the next bottle. But reinforcing that feeling early on, I think, was important for us in the development of this one.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the original, there were nintendo character portraits in zelda's courtyard of mario, yoshi, and more, but those have been removed. I was curious as to why.

Berdasarkan laporan, aonuma: certainly, at the time, when we put those there, i don't think anybody thought it was too big a deal. Maybe there was a more carefree or comfortable approach to that sort of thing. But looking at it now, like if a player is coming through that area, and given the overall way that we're, you know, creating this world and giving the player that form of expression, if they look up and they think, "Why is Yoshi there?” We don't want that moment to interrupt their experience of the world in that way. So we're feeling a little bit differently about it this time.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, you will remember that there is one design element on talon with bowser on it, and that's part of the original design of the character. So we didn't change that. That stays as is.

Diungkapkan bahwa i have some short-answer questions. What happened to her after seven years. The woman who runs the Bombchu Bowling game. And is she single?.

Aonuma: That's something we're not going to touch, and I'll leave it to your imagination.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of the skulltala rewards is bombchus, which i found disappointing when i was young, and i found disappointing as an adult. Why does he give you Bombchus?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, aonuma: so that feeling you had when you got, as a reward for a certain number of skulltalas, the bombchus, and you thought, “wait, that's it?” that's also part of the original experience of the 64 version. So there, there's an approach that we take where we try to keep all of the different notes that people felt in the original game in place. You know, sometimes it's really remarkable, fun things, and other times it's slight moments of disappointment. Even that could be memorable in that way. It's important to maintain that.

Berdasarkan laporan, the great fairies. What do they need rupees for?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fujibayashi: you know, it's really about a feeling. It's like in Japan sometimes, like donations to a temple or something similar like that. It's to express your reverence for the great fairies.

Berdasarkan laporan, the 3ds remake had skyward sword art hidden in a couple of places, but you removed it for this remake. You didn't want to keep the Skyward Sword art?.

Diungkapkan bahwa aonuma: [laughs] i do remember at the time the designers on the 3ds version were really interested in placing easter eggs like that throughout the game, and the timing of the release of skyward sword was such that it was perfect to go ahead and include that. ” But like earlier when we were talking about in the courtyard sequence with the Yoshi portrait. So I said, “Okay, sure. You know, you don't want to interrupt the player's experience by seeing something that's unrelated to what they're currently doing in the game. So for that reason, we decided not to go that way.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mr. Fujibayashi, you directed Skyward Sword. Were you sad to see that reference removed?.

Diungkapkan bahwa fujibayashi: [laughs] no, it’s really as mr. Aonuma said. There was an underlying concept in what we were going for, so no hard feelings there.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i think the biggest cutscene change in the game is when link transitions from child to adult. It is now a much more involved sequence. Why did that scene need such a drastic change?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, aonuma: so i think that's really connected to the way we were thinking about expressing things in the original. We couldn't do everything. We couldn't express everything that we'd like to, and I think in that moment where you have Ganondorf having this reaction to Link becoming older, that cutscene in the original, it was very low on explanation.

Berdasarkan laporan, so, you have these thoughts in the player's mind like, “oh wait, why is he there? what's the relation to this process?” so, you want something that explains his presence, that explains his reaction to make a bigger impression on the player overall, and that's something that you can use to connect the motivation to want to face ganondorf in the final fight. Something that I think comes across better now.

[I pulled out my Switch 2 and showed them how I was missing one Skulltala in Hyrule Field].

Berdasarkan laporan, you can see here i have 99 out of 100 and am have two out of three in hyrule field. Can you point to a general location to give me an idea of where to look?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, square enix popped up at the september nintendo direct to reveal romancing saga 3: destinies united for switch and switch 2. It came with a 16th February 2027 release date, but the studio has changed its plans in the months since, and we're now getting our hands on it a few weeks earlier.

According to Square Enix, the HD remake will now launch on 4th February 2027, with pre-orders going live on the eShop next week on 19th November.

For those who missed the initial announcement, this remake gives the 1995 RPG a modern facelift, complete with brand-new visuals, fully voice-acted scenes, new arrangements of Kenji Ito's iconic score, and a few other tweaks previously deployed in Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven.

Most importantly, this new version has made some changes to the original's Free-Form Scenario system with the goal of making the main story and its eight (yes, eight) protagonists easier to follow.

Sebagaimana diketahui, alongside the standard edition, square enix is also releasing a digital deluxe edition for the game, which bundles in bonus costumes and equipment, a battle music toggle, and additional items for the business and war mode minigames. You'll even get to start the game 72 hours earlier than everyone else. Nice.

#392. "I feel that sense of responsibility more acutely": After BioWare's closure, the makers of a new Mass Effect 3 co-op remaster mod look to carry their legacy

📅 07 Nov 2026

"I feel that sense of responsibility more acutely": After BioWare's closure, the makers of a new Mass Effect 3 co-op remaster mod look to carry their legacy

Tanggal: 07 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/i-feel-that-sense-of-responsibility-more-acutely-after-biowares-closure-the-makers-of-a-new-mass-effect-3-co-op-remaster-mod-look-to-carry-their-legacy

"It's like watching a friend lose a parent - maybe you're not attached, but you feel the secondhand distress".

Sebagaimana diketahui, it appears i was premature in suggesting that the closure of bioware might quickly spell an end for mass effect 3's strangely good, preposterously enduring co-op mode. I reinstalled and logged on just last week, and easily found a series of packed lobbies. Still, it was always regrettable that 2021's Mass Effect Legendary Edition opted not to remaster this multiplayer component alongside its dolled-up main trilogy, thus failing to introduce to a new generation the joys of performing teleporting psychic headbutts as a millennia-old bipedal frog.

Berdasarkan laporan, this oversight has now been addressed, with the release of the legendary edition multiplayer mod for said remaster. It's both a reconstruction and a slight expansion of ME3 multi, built in secret since 2023 by the ME3Tweaks group: a modding collective who've previously imbued the Legendary Edition with Mass Effect 1's Pinnacle Station DLC. It's also, some of its makers tell me, a bittersweet expression of appreciation for a series that looks unlikely to continue after EA's Mass Effect 5 cancellation.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at least some of that affection can be seen in how legendary edition multiplayer differs from the already-available lemp mod, which uses ai vibecoding to slap a mechanically identical recreation of me3's co-op into the legendary edition's ones and zeroes. ME3Tweaks's version instead adds, according to member and longtime ME modder Audemus, a "completely overhauled UI, rebaked level lighting, upscaled and redrawn textures, upgraded shaders, native LE features such as HDR and controller support, networking and server replication improvements, extensive bug fixes, and entirely new wave modes such as Unified and Coalition. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, unified mode, for instance, quite literally mixes up me3's enemy factions by forming mishmashed waves of baddies from across the geth, reaper, and cerberus armies, thereby dusting off and stamping on your 14-year-old battle tactics. The mod also offers the ability to use ME3Tweaks' own servers for matchmaking, though a private server option remains for scraps with mates.

Berdasarkan laporan, i'll definitely be giving this a try, once i'm back from my current travels. Though as with those OG ME3 multiplayer sessions last week, it'll be with a certain glumness, knowing that – despite a vocal campaign to give Mass Effect 5 a reprieve– I'll be playing something that had its future cut short.

Diungkapkan bahwa the circumstances aren't lost on legendary edition multiplayer's creators. But now that the future of Mass Effect has never been more in question, I feel that sense of responsibility more acutely than I ever have before. "I feel as though our responsibility as a modding community has always been to carry the torch for this franchise, with or without an official future for it. "BioWare's closure is an incredibly sad moment for the games industry, and a particularly heartbreaking thing for the Mass Effect fanbase to contend with," Audemus tells me over email. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mgamerz, another modder on the project, recalls how "the day bioware closed it didn't hit me until later in the day, a sort of numbness i can't really describe. I've spent 14 years working on their games - it's like watching a friend lose a parent - maybe you're not attached, but you feel the secondhand distress. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for some legendary edition multiplayer modders, the affected bioware staff included developers they knew personally. ME3Tweaks had previously been invited to embargoed discussions with both BioWare and EA on game modding, and Mass Effect writer and director Mac Walters (who left BioWare voluntarily in 2023) allegedly advocated for an even closer relationship.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "it's a shame to see it shut down," mgamerz says. " [Owners EA say the decision was only made after "months of planning, review, and analysis", though independent reporting suggests it was largely down to a straight choice between making ME5 or Star Wars Battlefront 3. "Everyone speculated about it, but I know from talking to people internally there, that nobody knew the guillotine was about to drop. ].

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "when we had our nda with bioware (since expired), apparently mac walters pushed internally to get my dev team brought into the manifold," he adds. "I say this as 'apparently', cause due to scheduling issues we never got to speak with Mac. But secondhand stories tell me he was a big proponent of modders - something that I would have loved to see more publicly shown.

Berdasarkan laporan, "it is disappointing to know that the people who helped build the world my work now builds upon were killed unceremoniously - a problem that plagues the industry, and what kept me from further pursuing entry into it, something i used to dream of doing when i was younger. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa rps lawyers are telling me to tell you that nobody was literally killed. All the same, and even as someone much more familiar with playing the Mass Effects than tinkering around in their engine bays, the ME3Tweaks team make relatable points: we can frolick around an uprezzed Firebase Hydro, biotically biffing half-robot Turians like it's 2012, but it'll be hard not to look at all those conspicuous waist-high walls and think about the people who put them there. The same's true of having your mind drift to thoughts of their successors.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but there's another way of looking at it, which is that mods like legendary edition multiplayer can preserve and maintain an original developer's work well beyond what their leveraged-buyout executive overlords might deem financially inconvenient. "I hope," as Audemus puts it, "that this mod - along with the fact that we've been able to build the technology to make mods like this in the first place - sends a message that there is incredible value in this franchise, and a passionate fanbase that is not ready to say goodbye to this universe and these games. ".

Jensen Huang has resigned, and in his place is a familiar face for anyone that's listened to one of Nvidia's financial calls: it's the company's long-standing CFO, Colette Kress.

But you might be excused as a gamer for never hearing about her; an earnings call isn't everybody's cup of tea.

Berdasarkan laporan, colette kress has been chief financial officer at nvidia since 2013. That's 13 years sat alongside Jensen in calls with investors and financial institutions to discuss how the company is doing. Kress has been in the role for the record highs of recent years, and the not-so-record lows of others, like the price plummets of '25, '21, and '18.

Sebagaimana diketahui, prior to her role at nvidia, kress was svp and cfo at cisco for a couple of years and corporate vp at microsoft for nearly five. She also worked at Texas Instruments—all the big hitters, then.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, generally, kress has stayed out of any contentious issues with the company, only occassionally commenting on the big issues during earnings calls. Like when the RTX 30-series was out of stock everywhere thanks to cryptocurrency mining (the mining had an impact on the company's financials in a slightly contentious way, too).

Berdasarkan laporan, or ceaseless comments on the increasing demand for ai datacentre build out. That's of less interest to gamers, but what do you expect? Nvidia to talk about gaming GPUs in this day and age? It cannot be done.

In an email to employees in the wake of Jensen Huang's departure, Kress reportedly said (via Hadas Gold on X):.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i believe deeply in this company and in its future. More than anything, I believe in each of you, in our customers and partners and in the vital role we play every day in the global economy.

Berdasarkan laporan, "the board, estaff and i recognize that this has been an extraordinarily difficult period and i want you to know how grateful we are for your resilience, professionalism and continued dedication. Thank you.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ". We play a vital role in building the technology that is powering the AI revolution, and we have important work ahead of us. So let's move forward together, with the same determination and commitment that have always defined this company. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, here are the emails sent to nvidia employees: company meeting nov 18 https://t. co/9X67XzSOCeNovember 12, 2026.

Kress also notes there will be a company meeting on November 18—the day after Nvidia's next financial call, which Kress will have been preparing for in her CFO role, and the day of Jensen Huang's meeting with US House leaders.

Sebagaimana diketahui, kress will have been chosen for this interim ceo role in some part to steady the markets. So someone inside the company had to take the chalice for now. It takes a long time to find and finalise a deal to secure a new full-time CEO, especially with a job opening as internationally as important as this one. With Kress at the helm, Nvidia will be hoping investors won't be quite as worried about the company's financial future.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's the same playbook we saw when intel ousted then-ceo brian krzanich over a consensual relationship he had with an employee, which was against company policy. Krzanich was replaced by Bob Swan as interim CEO, who actually took over as CEO at a later date, before Pat Gelsinger took over from him in 2021. Pat then retired in 2024.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nvidia will likely look at this as a bit of a cautionary tale: you want stability and leadership, not a revolving door of top execs and no one steering the ship. If the board has any wits about it, it'll be looking for a strong leader with a clear direction for the company and the will to deliver it.

#395. Wardogs Season 3 brings an urban map, Limited Mode, and a 185,000-account ban wave

📅 07 Nov 2026

Wardogs Season 3 brings an urban map, Limited Mode, and a 185,000-account ban wave

Tanggal: 07 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/wardogs-season-3-release-date-limited-mode-ban-wave

Wardogs' Season 3 will launch on 12th November, complete with a new urban map, a new Limited Mode, and a ban wave targeting 185,000 accounts.

Developer Bulkhead confirmed the details earlier this week, revealing plans for a full wipe and progression changes that it hopes will "recapture the shared discovery and sense of achievement that defined" the 100-player tactical shooter when it first launched in Early Access.

The new map will focus on close-quarters fighting, and for a "more level playing field", players can dip into Limited Mode, which offers "an alternative way to experience" the game as it restricts weapons, ammunition, armour, and vehicles.

While the full list of restrictions is still being decided, it currently includes FMJ-only ammunition, a Tier 2 armour cap, and a reduced attack vehicle selection.

"The mode is designed to preserve the feel of early-to-mid-game combat and reduce the advantage offered by more powerful equipment," the team said.

Berdasarkan laporan, bulkhead also confirmed seasons are getting longer. From now on, they’ll last three months, giving players "more time to work towards their goals before each wipe and the development team more time to prepare future updates". Progression will also be "brought closer to the pace of Season 1", following the studio’s acknowledgement that Season 2 accelerated "the journey too aggressively".

Berdasarkan laporan, "season 3 is about giving players a new battlefield to learn together and a progression journey worth spending time on," said bulkhead ceo joe brammer. "Longer seasons give everyone more room to reach their own goals, and give us the time to properly develop what comes next. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, alongside season 3, bulkhead revealed it has used machine learning to review is "activating further layers of its anti-cheat" after analysing 187 million hours of gameplay with help from machine learning. It says having close to four million unique players since launch gave it enough data to pull that work forward from next year.

"[E]xploiters, real-money traders, and gold-farming networks" have been permanently banned and lost their server-hosting privileges, and a player trust score is planned for 2027.

"Protecting the people who play Wardogs fairly is essential to everything we're building," Brammer added.

Berdasarkan laporan, bigger changes to the metagame, including a new progression system, are also due in 2027 as bulkhead works towards wardogs 1. 0. Full Season 3 patch notes will be out before launch.

Wardogs launched in Steam Early Access on 10th September, and is due on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S in 2028.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wardogs is one of the breakout successes of the year. In our early access Wardogs review, we said the game's mix of competitive shooters' best bits with something entirely of its own made it "a brilliantly refreshing take on the genre".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, covering the video games industry since 2017, with experience in news, articles, and reviews. Currently a writer at DualShockers and gaming magazines.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you were thinking about calling in sick on november 19 to spend the day exploring vice city, don't worry: you're definitely not alone. In fact, a new gaming survey suggests that millions of Americans are planning to rearrange their work or school schedules for the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6.

And while some of us might have to get creative with our excuses, one company has decided to make things considerably easier for its employees.

Berdasarkan laporan, according to a survey commissioned by pcmag and conducted by yougov, approximately 12. 5 million US gamers intend to take paid time off or adjust their schedules to play Rockstar's highly anticipated open-world adventure – that's around 8% of adult gamers in the country, which is quite a number for a game that hasn't even hit store shelves yet!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the survey questioned 2,024 american adults, including 1,154 people who identified as gamers, between october 23 and 27. Among those planning to make room for GTA 6, 3% intend to take at least two days off, another 3% are planning to take a full day, and 2% will either take a half-day or adjust their working hours.

As GTA 6's launch approaches, everyone wants part of the PR pie, including internet ISPs.

Diungkapkan bahwa interestingly, gen z appears to be the most committed group, with 13% of respondents in that generation planning to change their schedules. So, if your younger colleague suddenly disappears next Thursday, you might already know what's going on.

Berdasarkan laporan, while most players will probably have to negotiate with their bosses to have some free time to play rockstar’s title, worldworthy has decided to take a different approach. The company, which publishes the Worldworthy 100 global rankings, actually announced that employees who want to play GTA 6 can take up to three paid days off starting November 19. No doctor's notes, questionable excuses, or suspiciously timed dentist appointments required!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, approximately 12. 5 million US gamers intend to take paid time off or adjust their schedules to play Rockstar's highly anticipated open-world adventure.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we decided not to fight it," founder and editor ivgeni zarubinski said in the press release sent to the media. "Everyone knows where a large part of the world will be next Thursday. Nobody on our team has to invent a dentist appointment. ".

Logitech wants employees to reap the personal and professional benefits of gaming.

Berdasarkan laporan, the offer is optional, meaning employees who would rather keep working can do so, and the company's rankings desk will remain open throughout launch week. Still, it's a pretty generous way to acknowledge just how big this release is expected to be. Zarubinski even joked that after spending the year ranking the world's best airports, pizzerias, and cities, his team would get three days to "rank the streets of Vice City instead. " To be honest with you, that's probably a much more entertaining assignment!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of course, the survey also shows that the excitement isn't universal. Around 68% of US adults said they don't plan to play GTA 6 when it launches, while 14% intend to fit the game into their regular routines. Another 4% plan to clear their evenings and weekends rather than take time off.

Sebagaimana diketahui, still, with gta 6 arriving on november 19, it's clear that plenty of players are already making room for rockstar's next adventure. The game follows the success of Grand Theft Auto 5, which has sold more than 200 million copies since its release in 2013. And if you're lucky enough to have a boss who understands the importance of visiting Vice City on launch day, maybe it's time to start planning that extended weekend!.

A massive music festival will be held in Miami the weekend following the game's release, with numerous big-name performers to participate.

#399. The Sims 4 is getting paid mods, and a new in-game currency to pay for them

📅 04 Mar 2026

The Sims 4 is getting paid mods, and a new in-game currency to pay for them

Tanggal: 04 Mar 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/the-sims-4-marketplace-maker-program-paid-mods

The Sims 4 is about to launch a couple of major initiatives that may not exactly be what players have been looking for.

Berdasarkan laporan, the sims 4 has officially entered into its paid mods era. Developer Maxis announced The Sims Maker Program, and The Sims 4 Marketplace - two new destinations to publish, and discover new add-on content.

Diungkapkan bahwa the two new features will arrive first on pc and mac, starting march 17. PlayStation and Xbox players will receive them over the next couple of months, which is very much in line with how other franchises have rolled out their own paid mods systems.

Diungkapkan bahwa the maker program is a way for community creators to get their work out there, and profit from it. The content they create will end up on the Marketplace, where other players can browse it, and pay for it if they want to use it in their game.

Berdasarkan laporan, created content will be available across all platforms. All previous packs The Sims 4 players should be familiar with will move to the Marketplace, too: once the feature launches, this is where you’re going to find Expansion Packs, Game Packs, Stuff Packs, Kits, and other official additions created by Maxis.

Diungkapkan bahwa alongside this, the game is also introducing a new virtual currency - moola - which is what you’re going to use to purchase maker packs, as well as sims 4 kits in the marketplace. A portion of your purchase will go to the creator (roughly 30%) of what you buy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it is worth noting, however, that you’ll still be able to buy expansion packs, game packs, and stuff packs without having to purchase moola, or go through the marketplace. Kits are the only items that will no longer be available on the existing PC/console storefronts. Moola comes in the usual denominations you’ve seen a hundred items in other games’ in-game shops.

Diungkapkan bahwa in order to start creating custom content and publishing it on the marketplace, you’ll need to first be accepted into the program. Once that’s done, you’ll be able to directly publish your content on the Marketplace.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the blog post announcing the new features, maxis said that creators will have control over the price of their content, and how it's packaged. These are referred to as Maker Packs, which can include Create-a-Sim or Build/Buy items.

Berdasarkan laporan, you can apply to become a maker from march 5. Once accepted, you’ll also get access to the Maker Suite, which is what you’re going to use to test your work to ensure it runs smoothly on the different platforms, and eventually publish it.

Good/Bad? The Sims 4's much maligned paid mods have made it to consoles, but Kits are coming back to PC.

#402. Xbox is testing a way to use your phone as a controller on smart TVs

📅 07 Nov 2026

Xbox is testing a way to use your phone as a controller on smart TVs

Tanggal: 07 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/xbox-cloud-gaming-phone-controller-smart-tv-nano-cloud-connect

Xbox is testing two new ways to play its cloud games, and one of them doesn't require a controller at all.

Sebagaimana diketahui, announced on xbox wire on 4th november, the phone controller preview is rolling out on supported tvs wherever xbox cloud gaming is available. The phone option - which works with both Android and iOS devices - lets you use your phone "as a controller when you don't have one nearby". Connect to your TV via QR code, and the controls open in your phone's browser.

The second preview, called cloud connect, is currently limited to the US and lets the new Xbox Nano controller talk to your cloud session over wi- fi instead of pairing directly with your TV to "help reduce input latency, so gameplay feels more responsive".

To try out the phone controls yourself, switch on Preview Features under Settings > Account in the latest version of the Xbox smart TV app.

Xbox has published a setup guide with full instructions, although you should note that both experiences "are still being tested", so the availability and supported games or devices "may be limited while [Xbox] learns from your feedback".

Sebagaimana diketahui, icymi, as of yesterday, anyone in the xbox insider program can try microsoft's updated xbox pc app. The company claims it now boots up 60% faster, several pages can launch up to 50 percent faster, and in-app windows can open up to 65 percent faster.

I hear you, though: How is the movie going to explain away Tony Stark and Doom having the same face? Well, he's rarely ever unmasked in the comics. We'll see come December.

#406. Interview: Honkai Star Rail lead designer talks epic Aeons and lasting memories aboard the Astral Express

📅 13 Nov 2026

Interview: Honkai Star Rail lead designer talks epic Aeons and lasting memories aboard the Astral Express

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pocketgamer.com/interviews/honkai-star-rail/

Only good things to come for Trailblazers out there.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you haven't been keeping up with the latest, you should know that honkai: star rail's recently launched update is massive in more ways than one. The RPG has been making waves since it launched, and for good reason - one of the main ones is the fact that its narrative is, as my own brother puts it, "just so, so good".

Diungkapkan bahwa obviously, it's not just him who's enamoured with the deep lore of honkai: star rail, as hoyoverse's space fantasy adventure is happily enjoying over 10 million downloads on google play alone. It's hard to believe it's been three years since it launched - I still fondly remember how much I enjoyed giving it a go in its early access phase way back when.

Now, with its Planarcadia arc drawing to a close, it's only fitting that we peek behind the curtain to see the inner workings of this epic tale - something we luckily got the chance to do over at the HoYoverse Media Tour 2026 in Seoul (answers have been edited for clarity and brevity).

Sebagaimana diketahui, during the roundtable interview with chengnan an, lead game designer of honkai: star rail, we learned more about version 4. 7 - particularly Aha, the God of all Elations, which is also what ChengNan An says he is most excited for. For the uninitiated, Aeons are the Ultimate Beings here, and with the arrival of Aha, everyone will finally get the very first playable Aeon.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, apart from that, there are also more exciting things to look forward to over the horizon. "We started a new design to break free from the limit of the 4-character team to bring players a fresh experience. This allows you to create different team combinations, strategies, and options in battle, providing a sense of novelty. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it was nice to hear how the team is continuously improving on the combat elements too, especially since honkai: star rail has such a robust turn-based battle system (which i really appreciate!). "Looking at the history of turn-based games, we see that it's already been well-loved by players for a long time. The team is a big fan of turn-based games, so we learned from the classics of the genre and realised that there's room for expansion there. We also created something more story-driven but still builds upon the action of Honkai Impact 3rd. We're so glad that players are rediscovering the charm of turn-based combat, and we're happy to be a part of it!".

Sebagaimana diketahui, major updates for the latest version include reward stages as well, and with all these new additions, the notion of keeping things balanced for newbies and veterans remains the same. "In the future, we will also look for more ways to reduce our players' burdens while playing," he says.

That's actually something I've always been curious about -  live service games are a huge challenge, so how can the team give HSR lasting power and yet make sure it stays accessible to new players who might be intimidated by the RPG and its deep lore?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "ever since honkai: star rail's launch, we have been continuously looking into how to provide our players with fresh experiences while keeping the barrier to entry low. Shortly after the launch, we already added some quality-of-life designs to help our players have more flexible options," he explains. More importantly, we always need to introduce something new for our players, such as Aha and the new gameplay modes. "We also have features that help players get into the storyline more easily, or they can accelerate the dialogue if they want to. They can also get into the latest content without worrying too much about the prerequisite quests. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, this goes hand-in-hand with the entire planning process that also takes into consideration all kinds of player feedback. "We always try to balance long-term planning and instant changes too," he adds.

Sebagaimana diketahui, obviously, this includes improvements not just within the game itself but also in how it runs, particularly with mobile devices getting far more advanced as the years go by (and file sizes getting bigger and bigger). I did have to bring up the inevitability of the iPhone Duo, which they're already on top of. "We keep improving our game to adapt to modern platforms, and in terms of the iPhone Duo, we already received the requirements for adaptation, so stay tuned for more info on that!".

Diungkapkan bahwa based on everything i learned at the interview, at the end of the day, what keeps the fire burning for honkai: star rail, in my opinion, is the fervent passion that the entire team has for bringing emotional stories to players - true to the honkai brand. ChengNan An echoes this.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we work together to give our players lasting memories, so what i enjoy most is when, after all our efforts, we finally see the highlights of the storyline or the characters in-game, and that moment is what i enjoy most, along with seeing players react to how they've been impacted by the game. The characters give them a new perspective on how to tackle difficulties in the real world. They find a way to live a better life, and that's the most touching moment. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, and before we wrap up, he shares his wishes for the community moving forward. "Honkai: Star Rail is a journey that continues throughout different planets, and for our development team, it is also a journey of exploration. We strive to keep giving players surprises through stories, characters, and game modes," he concludes. "We want to give players lots of memories to look back on, so that years down the line, they'll recall that one person or that one moment they experienced, and that will bring them joy. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa it's safe to say that things are only going to get better from here, especially with such a dedicated and inspiring team giving the rpg their all. So, full steam ahead for the Astral Express!.

Real-time strategy game The Fertile Crescent 2 is an isometric odyssey inspired by Age of Empires, with the 1.0 release out now

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/real-time-strategy-game-the-fertile-crescent-2-is-an-isometric-odyssey-inspired-by-age-of-empires-releasing-out-of-early-access-now

Time to power-rank the biggest Bronze Age civs.

Berdasarkan laporan, age of empires-influenced real-time strategy game the fertile crescent 2: collapse of the bronze age leaves early access today, publishers microprose have announced, with the 1. 0 version adding the final chapters of the singleplayer story. You'll also get your grubby fingers on the very same map editor developers Wield Interactive used to design the campaign.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm new to the fertile crescent 2 myself. The land has been thrown into turmoil by the arrival of the Sea People, this being a loose historical term for assorted ocean-going migrants who, I gather, are often blamed for the crumbling of the Hittites among other once-glorious Bronze Age powers. I do like the sound of a strategy sim in which you guide a fugitive community through the Late Bronze Age Collapse. I don't have much scholarly insight to share - I thought the "Sea People" referred to expansionist mermaids, at first - but I do have a trailer.

Berdasarkan laporan, nate crowley (rps in peace) was exceedingly fond of the original game, calling it "a bite-sized chunk of phenomenal rts design" that "manages to riff nostalgically on age of empires, while completely rewriting its ground rules". The sequel continues with the same core concepts – above all, the paramount importance of food, which determines population and army size together with your civ's progression.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "this is not a game about building the biggest empire," the developers explain in a press release. Expanding your army too quickly can put your food economy under pressure. Building and managing a sustainable economy is as important as commanding your forces in battle. Every expansion, every battle, and every decision must be weighed against survival. "Resources have to be managed, stability is fragile, and growth comes with risk. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the story spans 17 missions, with four playable factions: the assyrians, egyptians, babylonians, and hittites. The 1. 0 release also includes some standalone scenario missions, a skirmish mode, and multiplayer on dedicated servers with bot support.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, read more on steam. If you're partial to historical strategy and don't mind winding back the clock (upturning the hourglass? Adjusting the sundial? Recalibrating the henge?) another few thousand years, Folk Emerging is pretty terrific. If you like stories about migrant tribes, and you don't mind trading your Hittites for Vikings, you might get a kick out of The Banner Saga.

#412. Danganronpa Creator Says Physical Game Production Is Reliant On Day-One Patches

📅 12 Nov 2026

Danganronpa Creator Says Physical Game Production Is Reliant On Day-One Patches

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2026/11/danganronpa-creator-says-physical-game-production-is-reliant-on-day-one-patches

"We barely pass platform certification requirements".

Kazutaka Kodaka, creator of Danganronpa and The Hundred Line, has made a pretty incredible admission regarding the production of physical games.

His comments were made during a roundtable discussion at the SKY31 Convention Seoul (thanks, Kotaku) during which he explains how developer Too Kyo Games is able to meet ongoing demand for physical games, particularly in Japan.

Sebagaimana diketahui, essentially, the production of physical games requires the original master to be submitted much earlier than digital titles. This is to account for the extended time required to pack the items, especially if it's a collector's edition.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so kodaka-san confessed that the studio often submits builds that, in his words, shouldn't be played by anyone. He operates under the assumption that everyone has access to the internet these days and is therefore able to download a day-one patch to bring the game up to an acceptable standard.

Berdasarkan laporan, “honestly, we approach it with the mindset of finalizing the master via patches. Collector’s editions in North America or Europe take an enormous amount of time to pack with figures, so the master submission deadline is absurdly early.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "to be frank, we sometimes submit builds where we think, ‘no one should ever play it in this state. ’ We barely pass platform certification requirements and release it while believing no one plays games without an internet connection these days. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he goes on to jokingly say "i’m not sure if i should be making such risky confessions in a venue like this". To be fair though, it sounds like Kodaka is merely being honest and open about a practice that is widely adopted by the industry at large.

Berdasarkan laporan, hell, even ocarina of time received a day-one patch. Granted, this was primarily to enable connection to Zelda Notes, but if you bought the physical and couldn't update it for whatever reason, you wouldn't be able to use this feature.

Sebagaimana diketahui, kodaka's next project is danganronpa 2x2 for the switch and switch 2. In somewhat related news, it was revealed earlier this year that the collector's editions on Switch 2 would no longer come with a full cartridge, with Spike Chunsoft instead opting for a Game-Key Card.

News Danganronpa 2x2 No Longer Getting A Full Cartridge Release On Switch 2.

News The Hundred Line Creator Wants To Keep The Game Going For "Around Ten Years".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lauren has experience in the gaming and esports space, writing news, guides, features, reviews, lists, conducting interviews, and more. Before joining the team at DualShockers, Lauren was a Features Writer at Adventure Gamers, a Guides Writer at Gameranx, as well as contributing as a News Writer at PCInvasion and Daily.

Paradox Interactive, best known for being behind some of the biggest strategy games such as Age of Wonders, Stellaris, and Crusader Kings, has revealed that a change in leadership is on the horizon.

Berdasarkan laporan, fredrik wester first served as the ceo of paradox in 2009. He stepped down in 2018 to become Executive Chairman of the Board, but made his return as CEO in 2021, and will remain in position until the new CEO transitions in.

These strategy games don't bother making you feel like a hero.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the board of directors of paradox interactive announced on november 11 that mattias lilja, the current deputy ceo of the company, will be the new ceo effective january 4, 2027. Wester, who informed the Board of his decision to step down, will become a member of the Board, focused on the future of the company.

Berdasarkan laporan, the move has been called a “natural evolution of how the company is already led. The company’s strategic direction remains firm, and Fredrik Wester remains the largest shareholder in Paradox. ” The statement continues, “Since 2021, Mattias Lilja has taken on increasing responsibility for operations and the execution of the company’s strategy, while Fredrik Wester has placed increasing focus on the company’s long-term development and goals. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, wester says, “my plan was never to be ceo for life. The goal was to build the foundation before passing the baton on for the next chapter in the company’s journey. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, lilja returned to paradox when wester took over as ceo in 2021, and in 2024, was appointed as deputy ceo of the company. Given his experience and vision, he is exceptionally well-positioned to take the company to its next level. Wester believes Lilja “has had a central role in laying this foundation, and now is the right time to hand over. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa in relation to stepping into the role of ceo, lilja explains that he intends to “approach this role with great humility. Paradox has a unique DNA that has made us one of the greats in deep and engaging strategy and management games. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, as ceo, lilja will be "stepping up the pace: we will make further investments in our core business, push the boundaries of our game design, work even more closely with our loyal players, develop more and better tools and services that benefit both modders and players, and continue to sharpen our ways of working and our organisation, with player value in focus. ”.

The Board of Directors of Paradox Interactive announced on November 11 that Mattias Lilja, the Deputy CEO of the company, will be the new CEO effective 4 January 2027.

Berdasarkan laporan, paradox has had a rocky ride with its new releases as of late. Europa Universalis 5 launched in November 2025 to mixed reviews, while the Across the Pillars DLC, which made its debut in October 2026, failed to impress fans. Paradox Tinto admitted that the team is “disappointed” with the release of the DLC, outlining: “we have put care, love, and a lot of effort into it, but it hasn’t turned out the way either you, the players, or us, the devs, would have liked it to be. ”.

As the publishers of Cities: Skylines II, this title also had a disappointing start when it launched in October 2023, but the developers have continuously worked on improving the game ever since through regular updates.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it will be interesting to see how future projects will fare under this new leadership. Paradox Interactive has a new strategy game in the works named Afterworld, for example, with a release date yet to be confirmed.

#417. Broken Ranks beginners guide - Everything you need to know to get started

📅 13 Nov 2026

Broken Ranks beginners guide - Everything you need to know to get started

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pocketgamer.com/broken-ranks/tips-and-tricks-guide/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at first glance, broken ranks looks like a classic isometric rpg, but the moment you set foot in the game, nostalgia almost immediately follows. Inspired by the golden age of CRPGs, this MMORPG combines nostalgic visuals with tactical, turn-based combat, a dark fantasy setting, and cross-platform progression.

Sebagaimana diketahui, like any mmo worth its salt, broken ranks gives you plenty  to consider from the first second you start playing: what class will you play? what skills should you use? and most importantly, how to get stronger? these are the questions this guide will answer. And, because Broken Ranks is not as simple as blindly following the quest line, we’ll be shedding some light on the most unique features it has to offer.

Sebagaimana diketahui, picking your class broken ranks features seven classes, each with a completely different skill set and value in groups. Of course, if you are a seasoned RPG player, chances are you already know what class you like; however, if you’re a complete beginner, you can find an overview of each class below:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, whichever class you pick, bear in mind that you should choose based on what you like, not what is meta. However, it’s not mandatory. If you want to be useful to the group (or you play with a friend), then picking a Knight or a Druid is ideal. As a solo player, anything can work as long as you have fun with it.

Berdasarkan laporan, there’s no objectively bad choice here, just different preferences and playstyles. Know the trade-offs upfront, and you’ll spend less time second-guessing and more time playing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, understanding what makes broken ranks different broken ranks isn't a game that holds your hand. So, don't be disappointed if you die during your second encounter (somehow). It rewards players who pay attention, think ahead, and learn from their mistakes. The game relies heavily on player skill and tactical decision-making, and that's precisely what makes it so enjoyable.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, combat is turn-based and tactical. You need to have a strategy in mind, even when facing enemies you've encountered before. Think chess on steroids, with a 10-second round to plan your next move. And if something doesn't work, you'll need to adapt quickly.

Diungkapkan bahwa but combat isn't the only thing that makes broken ranks stand out. Its world is just as interesting, drawing inspiration from Slavic mythology and low fantasy. Navigation is straightforward: simply tap where you want to go on mobile or click your destination on PC.

Diungkapkan bahwa the quests are another highlight. Don't expect to be saving kingdoms every ten minutes. Some of the game's best writing revolves around ordinary people with surprisingly unusual problems, whether that's untangling someone's romantic troubles, rigging a local village election, or searching for a missing drunk in a well.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s also worth noting that most of the early game, including quests and exploration can be enjoyed solo and at your own pace. You're not forced into groups, giving you plenty of time to explore the world, understand your character, and experiment with different tactics.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, how combat in broken ranks works - the part that surprises most people chess on steroids is the shortest accurate description. Here’s the longer one.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when a fight starts, you have 10 seconds per round to plan your actions. You distribute action points (AP) between your attack skills and three defense zones - melee, ranged, and mental. More AP on an attack increases your chance to hit; more AP on defense lowers the chance of taking that type of damage.

Diungkapkan bahwa on top of that, you’re managing stamina and mana, depending on your class and the skills you use. If you’re short, the action simply doesn’t happen - wasted AP, wasted round. Both resources regenerate a bit at the end of each round, so there’s a constant rhythm of planning what you can actually afford to do.

Sebagaimana diketahui, combat gets another layer at level 7, when a quest unlocks rage - a fourth resource that builds every time luck goes against you (yup, that’s a factor too). If you miss an attack or you take a heavy hit, the bar fills. Once it’s maxed out, you can spend it on one of three Special Skills:  A guaranteed strike that acts before everyone else A recovery that restores your resources mid-fight A reflex boost that lets you avoid incoming damage.

It’s the game rewarding you for bad luck (your character gets pissed off, just like you do) - and that alone adds a satisfying rhythm to even the roughest encounters.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, outside combat, you can save preferred skill setups as tactics - preset rotations you can select at the start of a fight and tweak during the 10-second window. This makes farming significantly smoother, but also adapting to tougher fights, rather than starting from scratch every time.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s a system built for people who like thinking over reacting. PvP is optional, but addictive You are not forced to PvP in Broken Ranks, but it’s extremely fun if you do. If you opt to stay in peaceful mode, no one can touch you outside designated zones. It’s also why the game translates well to mobile. The faction system is there if you want it; it’s never pushed on you.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you do decide to pvp, you should have some knowledge about the other classes, because chances are, you will encounter them. You always want to know what the best tactics are for dealing with each, so knowledge about that is clutch.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, f2p vs premium - what actually matters broken ranks uses platinum as its premium currency. You can purchase it with real money or obtain it through the in-game economy by trading valuable items with other players on the marketplace.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the good news is that you don't necessarily need to spend money to enjoy the game. Free-to-play players can still progress and participate in the MMORPG experience.

Berdasarkan laporan, a premium account does, however, offer several convenience bonuses, including additional backpack capacity, faster regeneration, and daily rewards. These can make progression smoother, particularly if you spend a lot of time playing.

Diungkapkan bahwa ultimately, premium is worth considering if you want to save time and get more convenience out of your sessions, but it isn't something you should feel pressured to purchase when starting out. A few Broken Ranks tips to know before you start Below you will find some additional tips to help you progress:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, broken ranks is a game made by a polish indie studio with obvious love for what they’re building. It doesn’t compete with the giants of the genre on budget or scale - it competes on atmosphere, depth, and a combat system unlike anything else in the mobile MMO space. If that sounds like your kind of thing, there’s never been a better time to find out.

#418. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (2026) Review - Exceptionally Familiar

📅 04 Nov 2026

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (2026) Review - Exceptionally Familiar

Tanggal: 04 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/review/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-2026/exceptionally-familiar

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the legend of zelda: ocarina of time for the nintendo 64 is the most important video game ever made… to me. Ocarina of Time was due for a re-examination, and its remake is a wonderful recreation of the 1998 experience with improvements on basically every element: visuals, storytelling, timeless design, and more. My byline would not appear in the pages of Game Informer without my original experience playing that game. But it is nearly 30 years old, and despite establishing many important staples of 3D gaming, its age is becoming more apparent. It is, however, a remake, and the coloring (though expertly done) is firmly inside the lines.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ocarina of time is gorgeous. I never quite came around to the odd looks of child Link or Zelda, but every other character, environment, enemy, item, and boss looks incredible. That the game is less than 25 GB is an engineering marvel. The ReDeads and Stalchildren are more traumatic than ever, and every NPC childhood crush I thought I had moved on from was reignited. I eagerly looked forward to meeting every weirdo in Hyrule to see their new look, and was never disappointed. Watching the sun rise and set over Hyrule feels as magical as it did in the past.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the same accolades can be awarded to the soundtrack. Characters don’t necessarily have more to say, but what they say is more impactful, and there are a handful of small but exciting expansions to character and story details. The new orchestrations are incredible, and watching Link’s 4K fingers play the proper notes on his ocarina is mesmerizing. Nintendo continues to fumble voice acting with stiff performances, but thankfully the vast majority of dialogue – one of the primary changes in this remake – is not spoken. Nothing is groundbreaking or changes how you look at familiar elements, but it manages to be simultaneously nostalgic and improved.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and that’s the closest i got to what i would debatably call a problem: it all looks new, but doesn’t feel particularly new. All those elements have been adjusted, but not overhauled. But they’re all ultimately small changes that don’t cast Ocarina in a new light or consider its history. Ocarina’s overall design holds up. Dungeons and their puzzles have been tweaked to remove annoyances (such as fewer keys in the Water Temple), and the new swordplay effects make connecting your blade to monsters feel incredible. It’s a straightforward recreation. The time travel element is surprising and creates great opportunities to see the world change and evolve; puzzles and their solutions are rewarding; the basics of combat, though simple, are thrilling. But an admittedly very good one.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the biggest, most impactful changes are the new full camera control and active jumping. Swinging the camera around to take a closer look at the upgraded environments is genuinely stirring, especially in the locations that used to be pre-rendered. Jumping may seem small, but it made me a more active participant in exploration. There is an undefined and exclusive-to-video games emotion I experienced often while trekking locations I thought I knew so well, only to realize I have never seen or looked at it in this way, and I chased and captured that feeling all over Hyrule. It also has the benefit of making some encounters feel somewhat trivial (turns out being able to jump over Blade Traps really diminishes their threat), and I was just fine with that.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the beautiful 2026 version of the legend of zelda: ocarina of time does not study the legacy or impact of the landmark game on the video game medium. I was rarely surprised during my playthrough, but I was incredibly excited to see old friends and I happily share without embarrassment that playing through its final hour made me cry. Instead, it is a meticulous and incredibly impressive recreation of one of the best games ever made. For many like me, the original Ocarina of Time is an impactful adventure that arrived at a time in their lives when magic still felt real. Playing the game again 28 years later and appreciating the care taken to maintain and improve that original vision was the ultimate surprise of the whole experience: I didn’t expect to be so moved.

Alex Van Aken contributed to this article.

Premium in-game purchases have now been disabled on PlayStation 4, as one of Genshin's four original launch platforms prepares to get dropped in early April.

Version Luna 5 of Genshin Impact is now live, but it's a bittersweet occasion for fans of HoYoverse's breakout gacha RPG – at the very least, those who are still playing the game on PlayStation 4, which is presumably true of somebody out there.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, hoyoverse announced last year that they intended to wind down support for genshin impact on ps4, which – alongside pc, android, and ios – was one of the launch platforms for the game back in 2020. And with Version Luna 5, those end days are upon us.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the game has already been delisted on the platform since last september, meaning it was no longer available for download and could only be updated by players who already had it installed. But as of today, paid purchases from the in-game store have been disabled on PS4; and in six weeks' time, on approximately April 8, Version Luna 6 will discontinue access to the PS4 version altogether.

In many ways this is unsurprising – Genshin is already available on both PS5 and Xbox Series to sate fans eager to play on console, and the PS4's hardware is increasingly struggling to keep up with this massive open-world game after more than five years of regular updates have ballooned both its file size and technical requirements.

Sebagaimana diketahui, aptly enough, luna 5 takes the main story action back to the nation of mondstadt, the location where the traveler (and, by extension, the players) took their first steps into the world of teyvat back in september 2020. It feels like a symbolic last hurrah for the original console home of the game, as does the inclusion of a Chronicled Wish banner focussing on some of Mondstadt's most iconic (read: too old to be meta by now) 5-Star characters – namely Eula, Mona, Albedo, Klee, Diluc, and Jean.

And as the icing on the Tea Break Pancake, this banner is running alongside the long-anticipated introduction of Varka – the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius who has been a major character in the game's lore from the very beginning, but who only became playable with today's update.

Looking ahead to that post-Luna 6 future, Genshin Impact will still be available on PS5, as well as Xbox Series consoles, PC, and mobile devices – so hopefully anyone who is still playing primarily on PS4 will find another platform they can continue the adventure on by April.

Extremely good King's Field-style RPG Queen's Domain – or is it a Metroid Prime homage? Or a stealth Morrowind-up? We hacks simply cannot decide – has received its first proper patch, adding a hitherto "missing" throwing weapon, the Grave Knife, alongside a bunch of quality-of-life fixes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, they've stirred in the ability to disable screenshake, alongside some new icons to make status effects more obvious. They've also introduced "options to make some late game puzzles less frustrating", though they don't specify which. How frustrating! Still, it's a tidy overhaul for a game that has rapidly become one of my 2026 favourites.

Berdasarkan laporan, the big mystery with the update is what the new grave knife does. You'll find it inside the Tower of Knowledge, once you've managed to unlock passage. As for those overly aggravating late game puzzles – I find the toughest part of puzzling in Queen's Domain is often just spotting switches and key objects, so perhaps it's something to do with that?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, true, there's a large selection of skeleton tableaus who comically point the way to your next objectives, but the game's pixel aesthetics can be rather dense. I very much approve of this on the whole. I like how organic and tumbledown the environment feels - the repeated delight of realising that, yes, you can get over there, and wow, there's a whole other level down here.

Berdasarkan laporan, queen's domain has earned a lot of happy reactions, and is a solid commercial hit. Glad tidings indeed. Developers Freshly Baked say it has sold over 100,000 copies, with Vertical Slice reporting that they've already broken even. Find the full patch notes below, via Steam.
