#422. Bringing Bloodborne back is tricky because "there's a lot of involved rights associated," according to former PlayStation boss

📅 06 Nov 2026

Bringing Bloodborne back is tricky because "there's a lot of involved rights associated," according to former PlayStation boss

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/bloodborne-involved-rights-former-playstation-boss

Sebagaimana diketahui, every year, bloodborne fans pray for the birth of another game set in fromsoftware's lovecraftian world. Every year, we're no closer to a Bloodborne 2 or even a Bloodborne Remastered. But why? PlayStation's former head honcho, Shawn Layden, blames it on the tricky situation of rights ownership.

Asked about the noticeable lack of Bloodborne in the decade since its blood moon shone down on us all, in an interview with The Trophy Room podcast, Layden explained that returning to any beloved game is tough.

Berdasarkan laporan, "bringing back old games has a certain challenge to it," he said. "Can you do something that is not only respectful of the original, but can you, you know, recreate the phenomenon as it were?".

Berdasarkan laporan, bloodborne's situation is slightly more complicated, though. It seems that the rights are somehow split between original publisher PlayStation, developer FromSoftware and the studio's primary stakeholder Kadokawa Corporation.

"There's a lot of involved rights associated with it, and in something like that - where Sony's in there and [FromSoftware] is in there and From's parent company is in there - I think just getting everyone to sign off on the same thing is probably the biggest challenge there," Layden said.

Diungkapkan bahwa having led the playstation brand during most of its ps4 golden years, layden said working with fromsoftware on bloodborne and the original demon's souls was "fantastic. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, despite endless calls for a comeback and very stable sales more than a decade on, bloodborne itself is still stuck on the ps4 - though it's still playable via backward compatibility on the ps5, i should add. The closest we seemingly got to a Bloodborne comeback came from Bluepoint Games, which reportedly pitched a remake sometime before parent company PlayStation shut down the acclaimed studio, though FromSoftware supposedly didn't want the project to go ahead.

Berdasarkan laporan, another former playstation executive, shuhei yoshida, previously speculated that bloodborne hasn't been remade because game director and soulslike pioneer, hidetaka miyazaki, would prefer to handle it himself: "miyazaki-san really, really loved bloodborne, what he created… so i think he is interested but he's so successful and he's so busy, so he cannot do it himself, and he doesn't want anyone else to touch it. ".

Elsewhere, a Bloodborne animated feature is in the works with YouTuber JackSepticEye attached as a co-producer.

#425. The Sims 4 developer hasn't forgotten about its quality of life commitment, and is back with an update on what to expect in 2026

📅 25 Feb 2026

The Sims 4 developer hasn't forgotten about its quality of life commitment, and is back with an update on what to expect in 2026

Tanggal: 25 Feb 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/the-sims-4-quality-of-life-update-2026-roadmap

Maxis has offered some fresh details on its long-running mission to improve player quality of life in The Sims 4.

Berdasarkan laporan, as the the sims 4 continues into its second decade, the volume of new content, major expansions, and long-awaited features has grown in lockstep. Unfortunately, that has also meant that, given how old the game is, a few technical problems remain a nuisance.

The effort required to fix them is what led developer Maxis to make a commitment to improve the game’s technical state, and the developer has now returned to update the community on what to expect in 2026.

Diungkapkan bahwa the quality of life pledge was made in september last year, through the introduction of a roadmap. Since then, the developer issued one update on its progress. Which brings us to this week’s new blog post, which further builds on everything that’s come before.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the post, maxis revealed a few key areas it’s going to be focusing on going forward. Though specific release dates for these changes were not shared, the list of issues should resonate with many players, as it covers many often-discussed topics.

Berdasarkan laporan, the first stage of the new roadmap covers march through august. Over that period, you can expect Sims' autonomy to improve. This goes for things like how they choose locations for certain actions, they way they interact with certain objects, and even how often they interrupt conversations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the infant and caregiver relationship is being updated, too, in order to improve autonomy and make sure your little sims don’t miss out on milestones and interactions. That stage of the roadmap also includes fixes for black photo issues, and other crashes and freezing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the next period takes place september through december, and it includes more interesting changes. One of the goals with this one is to improve Sims’ dining experience, which covers issues around eating and drinking.

Sebagaimana diketahui, another important area of focus with this stage is family trees, and relationships between members of the same family. Maxis wants to improve the game’s genealogy systems to make relationship tracking across generations more robust so that your family history isn’t lost.

Depending on how the first stage goes, you might see more issues join the list of what the developer is looking at for the second stage of the roadmap.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the good news is that you won’t have to wait too long for the game’s next patch. Due out in March, this next update will feature around 55 fixes, including for some commonly reported issues.

Diungkapkan bahwa until then, you may want to check out the sims 4’s lost legacies event, which is available now until the middle of march. If you picked up the game’s latest expansion, check if you tried those Royalty & Legacy cheats.

#426. World of Warcraft: Forever hotfix puts a stop to super speedy flag carriers that were dominating PvP battlegrounds

📅 06 Nov 2026

World of Warcraft: Forever hotfix puts a stop to super speedy flag carriers that were dominating PvP battlegrounds

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/world-of-warcraft-forever-hotfix-flag-carrier-plainsrunning

World of Warcraft: Forever has received its first major hotfix patch, which among other things has put an end to an especially powerful bug that made PvP battlegrounds like Warsong Gulch favoured to the Horde's advantage.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while taurens are running, they gradually build up stacks of increased movement speed. That means a Tauren can gain 60 percent increased movement speed, though it's worth noting that when they stop moving, these stacks decrease. They gain a two percent movement speed bonus per stack, and it stacks up to 30 times. In short, cows run fast.

Berdasarkan laporan, the hotfix, detailed in this blizzard blog post, stops the tauren's plainsrunning passive from stacking during a battleground's preparation phase. What players were doing to exploit this was running back and forth in the minutes before the Warsong Gulch battleground let both teams loose. It's a capture the flag game mode, so once the gates opened, Taurens were sprinting ahead of everyone else, allowing them to quickly push towards the enemy base for a potential early flag capture.

Berdasarkan laporan, in addition, the hotfix removes any plainsrunning stacks from taurens once they pick up the enemy flag, and prevents them from gaining stacks while the flag is in their possession. The goal of the enemy team is to stop and kill the enemy flag carrier as soon as possible, so a Tauren moving far faster than any of your team made this pretty difficult.

Diungkapkan bahwa tauren's could be tanky warriors or druids too, which further added to the difficulty in killing them. With this change they're now easier to lock down, though it's worth noting a Tauren can still make use of Plainsrunning to rush into the enemy base early. They just don't have that wild speed boost from the jump.

Berdasarkan laporan, surely this was the only reason my alliance warsong gulch games were all lost this morning, and not because my faction is for chumps. In other World of Warcraft: Forever news, the launch earlier this week was applauded as one of the smoothest in the series history, save for a few broken boats and zeppelins.

Diungkapkan bahwa the hotfix has also decreased the respawn time of the npc deathstalker erland who is needed for an escort quest. Also, supply vendors on the Zephras Isle have been stocked with handy tradeskill bags that you could find in other starter zones. People were mulling around his spawn and wasting away while waiting for him to respawn. It's the shipping I assume, it takes a while for stock to make it all the way up there.

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/airframe-ultras-ps1-cyberpunk-city-is-an-amazing-tribute-to-g-police-and-wipeout-and-i-wish-you-people-would-slow-down-to-appreciate-it

But what if we could gawk at the dumpsters.

Berdasarkan laporan, i do not wish to "rule the streets" of megacity west, dear creators of airframe ultra. I wish to be ravished by them, rubbing my face against the rusty corrugated metal of the shipping containers, and savouring the acid blue waters of the bay. I do not want to "become the one thing with freedom in a city of billions: A racer. " I want to become the other thing with freedom in a city of billions: a person who slowly drives or – whisper it - walks around just looking at stuff, because gadzooks, this is one of the prettiest PS1 cyberpunk burgs I've laid eyes on.

Berdasarkan laporan, those eroded pastel chevrons. That layer of invigorating crackle over everything. Then, somebody waps me in the skull with a stop sign at 300 kilometres an hour. That electric reef of a downtown backdrop, murderously luring your gaze from the on-coming trucks. Every moment or so, I dismount from my hoverbike to inspect some concrete ruin I could swear I last saw in G-Police, or ponder the resemblance between a subway tunnel and WipEout 2097's Gare d'Europa. Those seductively wobbling vertices. But I was already stopped, frantic stranger! Your brutal poetic ironies are wasted on me.

Diungkapkan bahwa despite my best efforts, airframe ultra is a battle racer. It's co-developed by Videocult, the people behind Rain World – a game it looks nothing like, but is comparable to in the sense that there is an ocean of industrial refuse to navigate, and you will very often die. Each battle race is broken into sprints around a branching course that has been smashed together by the forces of urban decay. You will corkscrew down storm drains and barge through old abandoned clifftop mansions under a scarlet sun, zip along deadly flyovers and thread the barely legible layouts of high density slums.

Your hoverbike handles like a bronco full of helium, and that's before you start wanging it off the gloriously marbled, low-poly rubbish heaps that stud the city, shunting the game's camera through surfaces and exposing the map's underside in what the absolute squares amongst my readers will doubtless deem "an inelegance", but which true turbojunkeys will appreciate for its makeshift exuberance.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you've got a boost button which generally gets you exploded – and all that's before you get to the time-limited battle arenas that bookend each sprint. I have not won many matches. The first player to earn 10 points and place first in a subsequent sprint wins the match. Here, players attempt to slaughter each other as much as possible, spending collectible cash on floating weapon pick-ups that range from bent pipes to Gatling guns and EMP grenades. Then it's off for another sprint. My primary goal right now in Airframe Ultra is persuading everybody to stop and swap some emotes, while I coo over an amazing piece of graffiti I've found.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, my efforts to make airframe ultra a walking sim aren't just about scenery. The game is surprisingly engrossing on foot, with some woozy tank controls that make me think of the experimental days before every third-person control scheme became a variation on Assassin's Creed, Uncharted or Gears of War. You can also perform punches and kicks in four directions, with grander attacks to discover by smooshing together inputs. You have to hammer a button to run, for instance, and you'll wind yourself fast. You'd best believe I burst into tears when I realised what this reminded me of: it's Bungie's Oni! The game with the finest martial arts system ever coded! There are more obvious influences, like Road Rash, but in these grim days of endless parrying, I'll take all the Konoko callbacks I can get.

Diungkapkan bahwa ahhhhh. Let us rule them together. Online and local splitscreen with drop-in bot support are all you get. That mild shambolicness is arguably part of the charm, in that it supplies incentive to stop and drink in the atmosphere. These streets are big and broken and beautiful enough for all of us, friends. I wouldn't say Airframe is the most balanced deathracer, either. In my experience, and do bear in mind I mostly try to avoid the racing component, victory typically goes to whoever lands a fat cash reserve and grabs an AK47. But if only this had a proper single player mode. Read more on Steam.

Diungkapkan bahwa bobara is one of those idle games where you are waiting around and then are delighted when something happens. In Bobara, there is a tiny capybara called Momo who is hanging out inside a Japanese water bath. It's warm there, and he seems cosy.

Berdasarkan laporan, the app itself tracks your local weather. When it was windy outside, I saw the trees change and whistle away. It's a nice touch, seeing the weather change! Beyond that, you can tap various bits of the screen. When it rains, it rains in the game as well. Momo will give you a few phrases about what they are like and what is happening around him.

Berdasarkan laporan, you can also change a boba tea at the bottom of the app, which you are meant to do when you have that same tea in real life. There isn't a way for the game to verify this, and instead you can just change it. These sort of lure different creatures or items to Momo, which are held inside your tea house.

Berdasarkan laporan, some of the trinkets are food like pretzels and milk bread. Other than that, Bobara doesn't have much else going on. They don't appear around Momo. There is no real goal beyond hoping that you end up collecting everything else that the game has to offer. Characters like Cha and Yuki hang out with Momo, and you can tap them as well. You can use Siri to speak to the app and change your boba via voice command, if you want to put the app on your Apple Watch, which is a nice touch.

Diungkapkan bahwa at the same time, there just wasn't a lot to keep me interested. I wish that I could interact with my trinkets and could move them about a house or decorate in some way. But, the game is more of a collection and a pet.

Berdasarkan laporan, despite this, grand theft auto 6 almost got refused a rating in south korea twice, a status that would have left it rudderless in the region. The main argument seemed to be less centered on story moments of nudity, and more on the purely functional moments of nudity. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the biggest shifts in opinion came from finding that no sexual interactions were possible while nude, leaving it more of an absurdist comedy beat than potential erotica. Sebagaimana diketahui, where rockstar manages to avoid the downsides of these industry shifts is by staying insular, focusing so hard on their craft and their own design philosophy that they shift the industry around them. Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s rockstar’s world, and we’re all just living in it, if the unprecedented hype surrounding gta 6 wasn’t enough to clue you in on that fact already. #434. Square Enix accidentally botches a Nier: Automata update, balloons required file size from 50GB to 366GB on PC

📅 06 Nov 2026

Square Enix accidentally botches a Nier: Automata update, balloons required file size from 50GB to 366GB on PC

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/square-enix-nier-automata-update-required-file-size-366gb

"Do you think games are silly little things?".

Berdasarkan laporan, yesterday, nier: automata received a new patch on steam, adding more language support to the title - it can now be played with korean, simplified chinese, and traditional chinese options - but this new update also, somehow, inflated the file size of the game on pc from about 50gb to 366gb. D'oh! What's worse is, the update is not optional.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the cause of this, reportedly, is a bug that caused all the dlc in the yorha edition of the game to become the same size as the base game - and the new download stacks them all concurrently. "Only SquareEnix can turn 40GB into 366GB with 8GB patch," says one dissatisfied Steam reviewer.

If you don't have space for this massive new file on your PC (and I can't say I blame you, it's ridiculous), there is a workaround, as confirmed by Square Enix in a tweet via its Japanese Twitter account.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we have confirmed an issue where, following the latest update to the steam version of nier: automata, the installation process indicates that more storage space is required than expected," noted the publisher. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. "We are currently investigating the cause and working on a solution. As a temporary workaround, you can download the base game by unchecking the DLC under Steam → Properties → DLC. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa it's quite ironic, really, that so many steam reviewers are complaining about things like "i just need to delete 90% of my computer to install this" when a large part of the game is managing the software/programmes installed on your android protagonists in order to upgrade your abilities and stats. There's even an ending for uninstalling your OS on your mechanical main characters. I'd be inclined to suggest this is some sort of meta psy-op from creator Yoko Taro, but… nah, that's just fantasy, isn't it? Isn't it?.

Diungkapkan bahwa speaking of taro, earlier this year we learned that "nier automata will continue", though we only heard back in 2025 that most of the projects the developer was working on were cancelled. One of these may have been the Tencent-backed Nier mobile game in 2024, which reportedly "struggled to find a monetisation to offset its high costs. ".

Knowing what I’d discovered with the Command & Conquer tapes, I really felt like we had to find out what was on all these tapes. "He took me over there, opened it up and it was like Indiana Jones… just, whoa. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the producer was able to convince ea's bosses that this stuff was worth the work needed to stick it back on storefronts, and lo, an ea blog post gushing about their vault's door having slid aside to reveal this pile of retro games. #437. Genshin Impact Luna 5 takes the squad back to Mondstadt, finally makes Varka playable

📅 13 Feb 2026

Genshin Impact Luna 5 takes the squad back to Mondstadt, finally makes Varka playable

Tanggal: 13 Feb 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/genshin-impact-luna-5-varka-return-to-mondstadt

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, genshin impact's next update will have you reminiscing about the good ol' days of. 2020.

Berdasarkan laporan, the latest big content update has been revealed for hoyoverse's breakout game, genshin impact. Version Luna 5, which has the unusually long and needlessly layered title — Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation - Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind — is set to arrive February 25.

Diungkapkan bahwa this one is a bit of a nostalgia play, taking everyone back to mondstadt, the place where you may remember taking your first steps. And, as with any good return to the ol’ hunting grounds, come familiar characters, too.

Diungkapkan bahwa the big new arrival is varka, who joins as a playable character for the first time. He is a 5-Star Anemo Claymore wielder with a dual-wield combat style, capable of dealing two different types of Elemental damage. His addition means that there's now finally a burly 5-Star male character of each elemental type. Varka, Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, is a character whose debut has been long-awaited. do with that information what you will.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, varka's dual-wielding combat style allows him to deal two different types of elemental damage at the same time. The way it works is that his Elemental Skill boosts the damage of his regular attacks, but it also converts the damage type of his right-hand claymore to match his teammates’ elements (Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo). The left-hand claymore always deals Anemo damage.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the more normal attacks you use, the more frequently he can activate a special elemental skill, or trigger a charged attack that doesn’t consume stamina. He can also rely on the Hexerei effect to trigger more instances of Elemental Skill, as well as Charged Attacks, making him a monster damage-dealer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, varka, of course, has been a staple member of the cast, featuring in both the original story in a small cameo, as well as taking a bigger role in the recent nod-krai chapters. With the return to Mondstadt, his playable debut makes sense. His Story Quest will shed light on his encounter with the Wild Hunt, and the Great Wolf King of the North.

Diungkapkan bahwa the reruns for this version are going to be flins — who will be available in the first phase of event wishes — as well as skirk and escoffier in the second phase. You can also look forward to the return of the Chronicled Wish with Mondstadt characters.

Diungkapkan bahwa staying on the theme of reminiscence, the big event in luna 5 is centered around revisiting memories from the beginning of your time with genshin impact, and reuniting with old friends. In Echoes of Memory, you’ll witness familiar scenes that have been changed slightly, and you’ll need to use the Spotter Kamera to detect and record those differences.

The Knights of Favonius are hosting several other activities for everyone to take part in, including an event that lets you catch up with old friends over drinks which you make for them.

Diungkapkan bahwa outside of events, there’s a new set of gliding and combat challenges. And, of course, there are new minigames that you can relax with. The Kamera is being utilised yet again, and this time you can use to capture sights from your time in spots across Natlan, Fontaine, and Sumeru. There’s also… a horde mode of a sort, where you fend off waves of enemies.

25 OG Xbox titles are now on PC, and it's an utterly bizarre list of games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this weekend marks xbox's 25th birthday, and while any celebration of the milestone is going to be muted in view of the layoff bloodbath microsoft is currently engaging in, the gaming division is taking steps to keep us thinking about the brand in a positive light. That includes a fresh expansion to the list of original Xbox games that are now backwards compatible on PC.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after the four original xbox games that microsoft brought to pc earlier this year, another 21 have joined the list – a total of 25 games for the console's 25th birthday. The new list of games is an utterly bizarre one, largely dominated by LucasArts titles. That includes plenty of beloved Star Wars titles, alongside largely forgotten obscurities like Secret Weapons Over Normandy and Thrillville.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, some of the titles you might recognize, like star wars classics battlefront 2, jedi outcast, and knights of the old republic, are odd choices in themselves, since those games are already available on pc. Assuming Xbox is using the same emulation-based solution to port these games, they're all going to be substantially worse experiences than simply picking up the native PC versions for the same price on Steam.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that goes double for the elder scrolls 3: morrowind, which is also on the list of newly added games. The Xbox version of Morrowind was a stunning technical achievement back in 2002, but it was notoriously janky even at the time, filled with bugs and technical limitations that have been robustly addressed on PC. I struggle to come up with a compelling reason anyone would want to play this version over the PC original today, especially with all the mods available for the RPG.

Berdasarkan laporan, there are two games i absolutely will not complain about, however: timesplitters 2 and timesplitters: future perfect. Developed by the Rare veterans at Free Radical Design, the TimeSplitters series was a spiritual successor to classic N64 games GoldenEye and Perfect Dark, refreshing the FPS gameplay for a new generation with fun weapon gimmicks and charmingly goofy characters.

Berdasarkan laporan, timesplitters never moved beyond cult classic status, and attempts to revive the series ended in failure. None of these games ever got PC ports, which makes their inclusion arguably the most notable part of this Xbox backwards compatibility update.

#439. 9 PS5 RPGs Where You’re Actually the Villain

📅 12 Nov 2026

9 PS5 RPGs Where You’re Actually the Villain

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/ps5-rpgs-where-you-are-actually-the-villain/

Eric Warner is a Journalist and Multimedia Producer based in New England with over 7 years of experience producing stories for multiple publications.

Most video game narratives typically have players embody heroic roles, such as Link in The Legend of Zelda series, but several games do allow people to adopt more villainous roles.

This is especially seen in role-playing games, as they offer players the chance to go down heroic paths, neutral paths, or even downright diabolical ones, with some of the best RPGs featuring karma systems that track good and back actions and have characters and factions respond to players’ choices.

Berdasarkan laporan, while some rpgs still push players towards acting heroically, here are nine rpgs available on the playstation 5 that allow people to play completely villainous roles and wreak havoc. Naturally, there are big spoilers ahead for these titles, so beware if you haven't played them yet!.

Warhorse Studios’ Kingdom Come: Deliverance surprised many players in 2018 by depicting an engaging, realistic medieval RPG centered around the Bohemian commoner turned hero Henry, as he sets out to avenge his family and join Lord Radzig Kobyla in fighting invading forces.

Berdasarkan laporan, henry’s story continues in the recently released kingdom come: deliverance ii, but warhorse studios granted players more freedom in how to control henry’s life and how he interacts with npcs. Players are able to keep Henry on the path of a hero or have him become a complete jerk.

For instance, Henry can tattle on people to authorities resulting in their imprisonment or death, sabotage businesses, and commit various crimes, with these diabolical actions ending up with the spirits of Henry’s parents disavowing him from the afterlife.

Some of the best RPGs to play as a villain in are those created by Bethesda, and luckily Virtuos remastered one Bethesda’s best RPGs for modern platforms with The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered.

Like many Elder Scrolls games, The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered starts with players embodying an unnamed prisoner destined for greatness, but they can quickly ignore that grand destiny and go about slaying almost everyone in Cyrodiil.

Players can even go so far as to join the Dark Brotherhood, a merciless cult of shadowy assassins, and take part in several contracted killings, such as staging a fatal accident to kill the innocent Wood Elf Baenlin and wiping out every living member in a family.

PlayStation 4 players who want play adventure titles that feature villains as protagonists should check out these 10 games.

Obsidian Entertainment is widely regarded to be one of the best RPG developers in modern gaming, having created Fallout: New Vegas, South Park: The Stick of Truth, and The Outer Worlds, with one of their better RPGs available on PS5 so far being Avowed.

A first and third-person fantasy RPG, Avowed has players embody a character simply known as the Envoy as they journey to the Living Lands region of Eora, to investigate a mysterious plague known as the Dream Scourge and confront several factions vying for control over the region.

Easily the most evil faction in the region is the Steel Garrote, a corrupt order of paladins, and, if players chose to kill the assassin Ygwulf, allow the Garrote to burn the Fior mes Ivèrno settlement, and help destroy the Godless Ruins, they’ll be able to slay the god Sapadal, betray their companions, and formally join the Garrote.

While Fallout 4 did originally launch on the PS4, Bethesda did recently rerelease the game, complete with all DLCs, for all modern platforms, in the form of Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition.

Here, players embody a long-frozen survivor of both the Sino-American War and the Great War, who reawakens in the Commonwealth wasteland in search of their lost son who was kidnapped by a mysterious organization.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, throughout this journey, players can aid and join many factions such as the minutemen and the brotherhood of steel, but easily the most villainous factions to align with in fallout 4 are the institute and the nuka-world raiders. Both will continue to capture and experiment on humans and sentient synths alike.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fromsoftware’s soulsborne titles are notoriously abstract with their storytelling, with even their endings often confusing players. There are still several ways to play more destructive, villainous roles in their games, leading to concrete chaotic endings, such as one seen in Elden Ring.

Similar to Dark Souls, Elden Ring has players embody an unnamed, reanimated being known as a Tarnished, as they set out to explore the Lands Between and strive to find a way to repair the titular Elden Ring, fighting multiple gigantic, monstrous bosses along the way.

While players can restore order to the Lands Between, they can also choose to destroy the world by defeating Mohg, the Omen and becoming imbued with the Flame of Frenzy by the Three Fingers, ultimately resulting in the Erdtree and the greater world’s destruction.

A list of ten soulslike games where the player turns out to be the villain by the end.

One of the best RPGs to debut in the ninth console generation was 2023’s record-breaking Game of the Year, the exploratory turn-based RPG Baldur's Gate 3.

Set roughly 100 years after the events of Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn, Baldur's Gate 3 stars a new player-character attempting to stop mind flayers, cure themselves of parasitic tadpoles, and stop the Absolute, otherwise known as the Netherbrain, from restoring the Illithid Empire.

However, players can ultimately take the Netherbrain’s power for themselves in the end, resulting in the citizens of Baldur’s Gate becoming mind flayers, dutiful warriors, or mindless fighters, among other dark outcomes such as the player simply killing everyone.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when it comes to finding a series full of brutal, often villainous protagonists, players would be hard pressed to find one darker than warhammer 40,000. It’s filled with ruthless Space Marines that perceive any life that is not human as heretical and ripe for slaying.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while there are several great 40k games available on the ps5, there’s only one rpg from the series that debuted on the system, with that game being warhammer 40,000: rogue trader. It stars the titular Rogue Trader, as they venture into the Koronus Expanse beyond the borders of the Imperium of Man.

Here, players can conquer alien worlds in the name of the God-Emperor or go rogue by aligning with the forces of Chaos, but no matter what path players go down, the people of the Koronus Expanse will surely suffer.

One of the most recent RPGs to allow players to dive headfirst into a truly despicable playthrough is Rebel Wolves’ debut title, The Blood of Dawnwalker.

Set in the fictional Eastern European kingdom of Vale Sangora after it was taken over by the Ancient Roman vampire Brencis, The Blood of Dawnwalker introduces the young half-human, half-vampire Coen of Laslea, as he sets out to save his family from the clutches of Brencis.

"It's a brave new world": GTA 6's PC port will release sooner than you think to avoid losing money to AI rip-offs, says former Rockstar tech director

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/its-a-brave-new-world-gta-6s-pc-port-will-release-sooner-than-you-think-to-avoid-losing-money-to-ai-rip-offs-says-former-rockstar-tech-director

Diungkapkan bahwa "if it's gta, i think people are gonna try it. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, gta 6's pc release may come sooner than anticipated, according to former rockstar north technical director obbe vermeij, because rockstar and publishers take-two will be concerned about losing money to unofficial generative ai clones of the ps5 version, once it launches on 19th november. In general, Vermeij thinks that how to avoid having your games duplicated by chatbot herders is "the big question" right now for devs and publishers, particularly those who don't have the means to enforce their intellectual property dominions as vehemently as Take-Two do for Grand Theft Auto.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, speaking to me during a wide-ranging chatathon, vermeij reflected on the early days of grand theft auto development at rockstar north in the 90s, and how the noel-and-liam-gallagher-esque relationship between pc and console gaming has evolved. He shared a sweary anecdote about the company's difficulties getting the original GTA 1 to look the business on Sony's PlayStation.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i didn't work on gta 1 and 2, but i worked for the company at the time, and i was actually right next to the gta 1 team, so i was able to follow it," he said. "So they worked on PC and then an external company in Dundee did the PlayStation version. Which was really weird, because like, PCs were so much more powerful - still the case, but in those days, it was even more so.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "and i remember, at the time, the gta team was definitely the most rowdy of all of the teams," vermeij continued. So it always has been that sort of awkward relationship between PC and the console. "And there was one particular day where they sent the PC build away, and then it came back from the PlayStation people, and they had cut down all the textures from 256 colours to 16 colours, and my god, the artist was just going around and swearing - 'what the fuck did they do to our textures, I can't believe it, we can't release this shite'. So in those days, it was like PC first and then console second, even though that didn't really make much sense for the sales, because the PlayStation versions sold way better. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, when it came time to develop gta 3, rockstar "flipped that around", vermeij went on, creating the console versions first. So, you know, that makes sense. Most publishers prefer to release all versions at once, Vermeij added, "because then there's only one marketing campaign they have to pay for. And for developers, it's way easier to just do one version at a time. " GTA lives by its own rules, however. "I guess it's less of an argument for them because the game is just so big, so they just kind of always left it that way. "Clearly the PC market has sort of grown, caught up with the console market, but there's still that same mindset," he said. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the arrival of generative ai threatens to throw all this to the winds. Tools such as Reverse Engineer Anything allow for speedy unofficial ports or "slopcomps" of console games on PC, despite warnings from seasoned recomp developers that using genAI for this purpose wrecks the community aspect of unofficial porting, and results in illegible "bruteforce" code rather than preserving some understanding of how the original game was made.

Berdasarkan laporan, "it really has changed the world," vermeij observed, "and i think i would be concerned, if i was rockstar, that somebody would just take the ps5 version and get ai to change it to pc, which won't be won't be as good as their effort, but it could still also hurt their sales. Obviously, I don't really know what they're thinking. So, I wouldn't be surprised if there was an effort to get [the releases] a little bit closer together. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, gta 6 is, according to rockstar and take-two at least, an enormously fiddly production, costing hundreds of millions of dollars over eight years in development. And it will take a bunch of tokens and everything, so it would probably cost like, tens of thousands of dollars in tokens. But like, you know, if it's GTA, I think people are gonna try it. It actually, physically takes hours and hours and hours to do these things. "It will take a long time. Nonetheless, Vermeij thinks current genAI tools are "probably" capable of pulling off a port. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa there are already signs that genai pc port goldrushers are ready to pounce on gta 6. Just today, Ars Technica reported on efforts to yassify the game's PS5 trailer footage by piping it through a stronker PC graphics card and using Nvidia's DLSS 5 to apply extra layers of gloss.

Sebagaimana diketahui, vermeij himself left rockstar way back in 2009 and is now an indie developer. It uses "AI-assisted machine translation for localization", but not for "gameplay content, art, or audio". Vermeij is, in general, interested in generative AI despite the surging tide of slopcomp ports. His current early access project is Plentiful, a hexagonal god sim with an emphasis on water physics. Smaller indie developers are, of course, more vulnerable to the financial fallout from having their work unofficially cloned by generative AI, but Vermeij thinks it's an existential worry for megacorps like Take-Two as well.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i don't really see how you could protect against that, to be honest," he told me in closing. What was the case before, is that there's so much effort in developing the game, that it is not possible to rip it off, and that's completely changed now. But yeah, I mean, it's a brave new world. So, yeah, we're going to have to see in the next couple of years, how that's going to pan out. "I don't see it. But a big company like Take-Two, they would be able to get the lawyers on the case, and maybe, like, you said, for a big game, maybe the AI doesn't really do a particularly good job. ".

#443. Void/Breaker Review – Chaos Is The Point

📅 03 Nov 2026

Void/Breaker Review – Chaos Is The Point

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/review/voidbreaker/chaos-is-the-point

Sebagaimana diketahui, many games tout impressive destruction systems under the hood, but few implement it as well as void/breaker. The ruin is visually spectacular, sure – who doesn’t love to watch buildings crumble because of your grenade or gravity-thrown explosives? But importantly, it’s a critical aspect of Void/Breaker’s roguelite design. Countless weapon mods and permutations make fewer than a dozen weapons feel like hundreds in your arsenal, adding even more blissful chaos to the mix. Enemies caught beneath falling rubble become instantly staggered, and that’s your moment to kill. Grenades do this too, as do most items you throw at the hostile AI machinery trying to end your run, creating a vortex of shifting priorities as you dash, jump, and shoot at sequential staggered enemies in your sightlines. Though it can be difficult at times, if you can see through the literal remains of your destruction, one of the year’s most engaging shooters awaits.

Berdasarkan laporan, void/breaker wastes no time getting a gun in your hand. An AI voice in your head wants your help escaping a simulation where thousands of runners attempt to reach the end of multi-arena stages to defeat a boss. He asks that you simply follow the simulation’s commands; meanwhile, he uses the data you collect along the way to find new exits for you and him. The storytelling style is very reminiscent of Valve’s Portal. Something much larger is at play here, but it’s worth discovering for yourself.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this narrative framework supports the game’s roguelite structure. Mechanically, however, you enter various themed digital stages, from liminal spaces to beaches to snow-capped cliffs and more, and attempt to survive. Most arenas consist of a couple of starkly white structures that your grenades and thrown explosives can topple (ideally onto waves of enemies below). Developer Stubby Games throws plenty of wrenches into this formula, like armored foes and electrostatic enemies you must melee first, and elite bots that will have you on the back foot, but for the most part, Void/Breaker’s formula is “Break stuff, then kill. Learning the language of Void/Breaker means constantly scanning your field of view for explosives and structures practically begging to come down, and then eyeing neon-green bars above enemies that tell you they’re staggered and ready for a quick kill. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the game emphasizes explosives and bringing buildings down, but your guns do most of the killing; you can only select one weapon per run. Not to mention, mods change how the gun fires, how much damage certain bullets do, recoil, accuracy, and just about any other stat you associate with firing a video game gun. You choose from a pistol, shotgun, machine gun, sniper, and more, and each has its perks (though once I unlocked the SMG, I rarely picked anything else). There’s no sense overthinking your weapon, though, because the dozens of mods you pick up each run determine its effectiveness. As you pick up more schematics, the pool of mods you find in chests or drop from enemies expands, and soon your gun fires corrosive acid, electricity, fire, projectile missiles, and more. Wild combinations are easy to create, and a unique mod-stacking mechanic that can double or triple effectiveness adds a light touch of puzzle design to this otherwise straight shooter.

Sebagaimana diketahui, stubby games smartly emphasizes player expression, never getting in the way of the zanier combinations available to players. I’m thankful for mid-run saves because this SMG permutation, paired with an ability mod that let me throw infinite grenades for a limited time, filled my screen with so much destruction that the entire game crashed. The SMG I used to beat the final boss featured mods that made each bullet electric, shot missiles with each shot, covered each bullet in a destructive orb, and featured a ricochet perk that made each bullet bounce off walls and split into even more bullets. I’d usually bemoan such a thing, but I couldn’t help but laugh. I pushed my PC to its limit with my on-screen chaos.

Berdasarkan laporan, boss fights leave a little to be desired – i rarely died because of their simple bullet-hell arenas. Instead, most runs ended because, after bringing down every structure around me, I’d get so lost in the chaos that I wouldn't realize I was stuck in debris while enemies swarmed my location. As stunning as it is to see so much happening on screen, it can be hard to understand what is going on during the most chaotic moments.

Sebagaimana diketahui, between enemy-filled arenas en route to a stage’s end boss, you might find a shop to buy more mods, ominous obelisks with risk-reward propositions (gain a lot of health or lose half your health, for example), optional trials, and strange phenomena that transport you to different locations. These moments are quick breaks in between bouts of adrenaline-fueled shooter action that I always welcomed – enemies can be relentless, especially as new types are introduced in each stage.

Diungkapkan bahwa the rest of the void/breaker package offers few genre surprises. You can upgrade various traits between runs, research new mod schematics to add to the random pool, purchase new weapons, and discover fun secrets. You can unlock shortcuts, glean in-world information from computer terminals, and hear intriguing dialogue barks from the AI partner who needs your help. It’s all standard stuff for the rogue genre, but if anything, its simplicity pushes you back to the meat and potatoes of this shooter.

Berdasarkan laporan, void/breaker’s shorter runtime – i rolled credits at 12 hours – ensures nothing gets too repetitive in its roguelite structure, but an expansive endgame promises even more to engage with, like different run modifications you can enable to make an already chaotic shooter even more anarchic. I’ll certainly be running it back (again and again) to see what other disruptions I can bring to this AI-simulated adventure. It’s hard not to when destruction feels this good.

#444. Random: Yes, Young Link Is Still Quicker When He Rolls About In Ocarina's Remake

📅 12 Nov 2026

Random: Yes, Young Link Is Still Quicker When He Rolls About In Ocarina's Remake

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2026/11/random-yes-young-link-is-still-quicker-when-he-rolls-about-in-ocarinas-remake

As many fans begin to wrap up their first play sessions of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2, more attention is slowly shifting to the game's speedrunning community.

Diungkapkan bahwa during the zelda direct, mr. Aonuma noted how child Link's new "dash" ability had been introduced in the remake because many players in the original game would often roll from one point to another. While it is definitely a faster option than walking, it turns out rolling is still a slightly quicker way to get to your destination (at least as Young Link) in the remake.

Diungkapkan bahwa speedrunners have now time-trialled young link dashing and rolling across hyrule on the switch 2, and if you roll about, you should arrive at your location sooner. And hey, every second counts when it comes to speedrunning!.

Zelda speedrunning channel 'Kethnaldo' took a closer look, and between running (dashing) and rolling, the real winner here is the technique referred to as "forward hop roll-cancelling", which in one demonstration sees the player run from Koriki Forest to Hyrule Castle and arrive at the castle roughly four seconds earlier than other methods.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "after you front hop, you can roll immediately and get rid of that end lag. you will mess up, but even with mess ups. so all you're doing is target forward hopping to get that insane momentum, rolling immediately to get rid of all of the end lagging, and then front hopping again as soon as possible to maximise that front hop speed, and you just chain them together as best as you can. it's about roughly four seconds faster than running. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, so if you want to speed things up when you're on foot as young link, rolling is still recommended. And if you can nail the other technique, you'll be shaving quite a bit off the adventure. Of course, keep in mind, this isn't the original Zelda: Ocarina of Time, so there's always a chance Nintendo could make subtle or major adjustments to game mechanics in future game updates.

#446. After taking over EA, Saudi Arabia and their private equity cronies have reportedly held talks about buying Unity

📅 06 Nov 2026

After taking over EA, Saudi Arabia and their private equity cronies have reportedly held talks about buying Unity

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/after-taking-over-ea-saudi-arabia-and-their-private-equity-cronies-have-reportedly-held-talks-about-buying-unity

The engine builders have, it's claimed, been working with an investment ​bank to evaluate [their] options.

Sebagaimana diketahui, members of the consortium led by the saudi arabian government's public investment fund and some private equity suits which took over ea this year in a leveraged buyout worth $55 billion reportedly have a new target in their sights. Unity, software company and makers of the game engine bearing the same name, have held talks with the consortium over a potential takeover, it's claimed.

Diungkapkan bahwa according to reuters, a consortium including saudi arabia’s sovereign wealth fund and private equity firm silver lake partners recently approached unity about a deal that would value the company at around $25 billion. Unity are, it's claimed, currently working with an investment bank to evaluate their options following the chat, with no deal set in stone right now.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, silver lake, reuters note, are already among unity's largest shareholders and invested up to $400 million in the engine builders in 2017. In fact, Silver Lake's managing director and CEO Egon Durban already has a seat on Unity's board of directors, so will probably have to butt out of any takeover talks.

Sebagaimana diketahui, assuming the consortium would go the leveraged buyout route, loading unity up with debt like the ea takeover did, it's hard to see any deal not resulting in similarly catastrophic consequences for those working at unity. EA laid off a reported 400 people in an effort to cut costs after coming under the boot of the Saudi state and private equity, shutting BioWare and cancelling something Sims-related codenamed Project Lotus. BioWare's demise has since been reported to have largely come down to EA execs not wanting to fund both Star Wars Battlefront 3 and Mass Effect 5, with them opting to back only Battlefront 3.

Unity's recent financial results are looking strong, propped up by year-on-year growth in an AI-powered ad network dubbed Vector, so one would assume that bit of the business likely wouldn't be top of the list if any bloodletting was to end up happening.

Solidarity to any Unity workers who're now having to live under the shadow of this prospective takeover and the upheaval it could lead to if it goes ahead in a fashion which mirrors the EA deal.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the happiest time of year is just around the corner, folks. The PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted sponsored by Pot Noodle will be airing December 3rd, and we'll be counting down The Council's 20 most anticipated games.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's one major change this year, though. We've made this decision to ensure each game gets its time in the spotlight, meaning the show will be more enjoyable to watch. We've gone from counting down the top 25 games to the top 20. Also, The Council have recently unionised and refuse to count more until we agree to give them bathroom breaks, which we simply will not do.

The Council remains, as ever, an inscrutable bunch of journalists, developers, celebrities, creators, streamers, gaming luminaries, and just generally people whose opinion on videogames carries some weight.

Sebagaimana diketahui, each year, we knock our heads together and puzzle over how to whittle down the thousands of upcoming games into a list of just 100. Several factors go into this, such as how many wishlists a game has on Steam, how interesting a trailer is, the position of the stars at the time a game was first announced, and generally just how excited those of us at PC Gamer are for a title.

Berdasarkan laporan, the full list awaits below, and the top 20 are nestled within it, but you'll never be able to figure out which ones they are. And if you do, please don't share your findings on the internet or you'll ruin the whole show. You'll notice there are fewer than 100 games, and that's because each year, some come out before the show or unfortunately get cancelled. Try as we might, we can't get The Council to predict the future—we'd all be retired by now if they could.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the council gives each game they're excited for a score from one to five, with one being passingly curious to five being intensely, worryingly hyped. If a member has no interest in a game at all, they simply don't vote on it and that is counted as a zero.

Diungkapkan bahwa we also take into account how many members of the council voted for each game so that any with the same average score have a reliable tiebreaker. Some other factors go into the weighting, too, like if we've had no news about a game in a long time or, again, where the stars are and what they think of the whole thing.

#452. Diablo 4’s next class is the Warlock, but you can sort of play it today in Diablo 2: Resurrected’s new DLC

Diablo 4’s next class is the Warlock, but you can sort of play it today in Diablo 2: Resurrected’s new DLC

Tanggal: 12 Feb 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/diablo-4-warlock-reveal-diablo-2-anniversary-spotlight

Blizzard has officially unveiled the Warlock, the second class coming to Diablo 4 with Lord of Hatred.

Diungkapkan bahwa diablo 4’s segment in the big diablo 30th anniversary spotlight was among the biggest, even if the reason most of us tuned in was somewhat spoiled earlier in the same livestream. Blizzard unveiled the Warlock, the second of two classes coming to the game with the upcoming Lord of Hatred expansion.

The first class, being the Paladin, is already available to play for anyone who pre-ordered the expansion, but the Warlock won’t be accessible until the expansion arrives in late April.

Diungkapkan bahwa the warlocks are positioned as the opposite of the paladins, in that they don’t mind utilising forbidden knowledge, drawing on the powers of hell itself to fight its own overlords. The Warlock is the edgy, antihero counterpart to the Paladin’s purity and devotion to the Light.

Berdasarkan laporan, the livestream did not show off any warlock gameplay, but blizzard is planning a dedicated livestream to show off the new class’ gameplay, and dig deeper into its lore and abilities. That show is scheduled for March 5.

Diungkapkan bahwa what we did get to see was our first look at skovos, the expansion’s new region. This Mediterranean-inspired location is where the new story arc will unfold, but it’s also being positioned as the endgame destination for Diablo 4 once the credits roll.

Lord of Hatred, of course, as previously revealed, introduces two new endgame modes in War Plans, and Echoing Hatred.

Berdasarkan laporan, war plans lets you create a custom playlist of up to five endgame activities to target specific rewards and create your own experience. There’s a new activity tree that works with all endgame activities, and creating War Plans is how you earn progression there.

Diungkapkan bahwa echoing hatred, on the other hand, is a rare event that pits you against legions of mephisto’s minions. It’s triggered through a rare lootable item that unlocks access. It’s essentially horde mode; where you’ll face unending waves of enemies, though not without a couple of twists.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we also got a bit more colour on the expanded class skill trees, which all players will benefit from when the expansion arrives. The Talisman system, which unlocks set bonuses, was also shown off. And, of course, the return of the iconic Horadric Cube, which gives you control over Affixes.

Berdasarkan laporan, the anniversary spotlight should’ve had a year of the warlock subtitle, because the class is also making its way to both diablo immortal, as well as diablo 2: resurrected. The showcase revealed the Reign of the Warlock DLC, which adds the aforementioned Warlock to D2R - its first new class in 25 years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, reign of the warlock, which is available now in d2r, also makes a few updates to the game, such as new quality of life features, the colossal ancients endgame encounter, updated terror zones and more. You also get some cosmetics in Diablo 4 if you purchase this expansion.

#453. Take on a time-manipulating corporation in the very Soul Eater meets Jet Set Radio action roguelite CHRONO PUNK

📅 05 Nov 2026

Take on a time-manipulating corporation in the very Soul Eater meets Jet Set Radio action roguelite CHRONO PUNK

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/take-on-a-time-manipulating-corporation-in-the-very-soul-eater-meets-jet-set-radio-action-roguelite-chrono-punk

Plus a little bit of Spider-Man, Devil May Cry and Kingdom Hearts.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, my favourite kind of game that's obviously going for the vibe of a particular era of gaming is one that doesn't look like it's trying to be any other game from said era, moreso if someone told me it was a ps2 or a dreamcast game everyone forgot about i'd believe you. CHRONO PUNK fits that vibe quite well, an action roguelite that looks like it's taking some cues from those aforementioned consoles, alongside the likes of Soul Eater, Jet Set Radio, Devil May Cry, and Spider-Man.

Berdasarkan laporan, that is, obviously, a lot of things, but chrono punk on the surface appears to have its own identity at least. Your player character looks like an almost nightcore version of Sora Kingdom Hearts, with various roles and weapons to choose from; there's a sword and shield, pistols, shurikon, grimoire, and most Soul Eatery of all, a scythe. The cities you do combat in are big and nondescript when it comes to details, but ripe for jetting about and Spider-Man-style swinging across the place. CHRONO PUNK's got vibes, too. And besides, it looks like there's some hub areas ripped straight out of any stylised MMO from the 2000s.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'm liking the look of the combat too. Slow paced, this is not. Pair all of that with some bouncy, wall running movement, and there's some real potential for a strong game here. Sick, I hope this is. This'll obviously be one for the combo pilled out there, people who like to bounce back and forth between their enemies like a pinball. Sounds like you'll be able to play it in co-op or solo too, which is a nice touch.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the story doesn't seem all that complicated, with some mega corporation manipulating time thereby controlling the city and the masses, leaving you to deal with the mess, but hey, i'm here for the vibes. As of right now, there's no release date attached to CHRONO PUNK, but you can wishlist it on Steam while you wait.

#454. "Is there any accountability left in this world?" Warren Spector pops off at EA executives and their massive payouts as BioWare shuts down

📅 06 Nov 2026

"Is there any accountability left in this world?" Warren Spector pops off at EA executives and their massive payouts as BioWare shuts down

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/bioware-closure-warren-spector-comments-accountability

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's only been two weeks since we last heard warren spector sound off about ea's sudden decision to close bioware, following the publisher's acquisition by saudi arabia's pif and venture capitalist concerns. But now, the storied developer is back and - apparently - angrier than ever.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i recently posted my thoughts about ea’s shuttering of bioware," spector wrote in a post on linkedin. I remain so. The tragedy of so many layoffs the last few years hasn’t been lost on me, but for some reason, BioWare hit me on an emotional level that nothing before had. "Those of you who read my post know that I was unhappy. I felt gut-punched. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, spector goes on to counter the idea that the studio was closed down as a "sound business decision" because the "studio’s glory days (artistic and commercial) were behind them" and that "businesses don’t succeed on history alone". These reactions, more than anything else, appear to be what's inspired Spector to take to posting again - he simply cannot agree with this assessment.

Berdasarkan laporan, "if studio-level people leave, resulting in dilution of talent, someone is creating an environment that pushes them out. Do those culture-killers pay any price? If executives misread the market, over-hire, or make decisions that result in under-funded, over-funded, poorly-marketed games do they lose sleep let alone jobs?" he asks.

Diungkapkan bahwa "do those same executives suffer like developers when the needs of financial partners and private investors take precedence over the people who actually create value, let alone over the interests of players? does anyone up there in or adjacent to the c-suite care? is there any accountability left in this world? obviously not. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, he then goes on to list the yearly payouts that some of the highest-level executives at ea are rewarded per annum. These include:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "tens of thousands of do-ers and makers are out of work and these people think they're worth that kind of compensation?" continues spector. Or at least that people have the sense not to go work for you. "And if you think this is a discussion about 'sound business decisions', I hope you never get anywhere near running a business. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, back in august, we saw warren spector announce his intention to retire from the world of video game development. Spector's announcement comes shortly after the last game he worked on - Thick as Thieves - had its final major update only a few months after its release. Despite its charm and low price, Thick as Thieves sadly didn't sell what it needed to, resulting in layoffs at Spector's studio.

#456. Battlefield 6's next season will speed up battle pass progression, and make it so Redsec players who don't own the game can actually make progress

📅 11 Feb 2026

Battlefield 6's next season will speed up battle pass progression, and make it so Redsec players who don't own the game can actually make progress

Tanggal: 11 Feb 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-6-season-2-major-goals-gameplay-changes

Season 2 of Battlefield 6 looks to bring a host of broad, positive changes to XP, progression, audio and more.

Diungkapkan bahwa ahead of the start of battlefield 6’s season 2 next week, battlefield studios has shared some insight into a few of the major goals the developer has with the season 2 patch. The game’s second season was delayed in mid-January, and the developer even brought back Battlefield Labs to test out some of the new content and features coming with the new season.

Indeed, the broader goals BF Studios shared with players in a new blog post reflect some of what Labs players already went hands-on with, while others are the result of work on long-standing issues with both the game itself, as well as free-to-play mode Redsec.

Diungkapkan bahwa we know that season 2 is introducing a big new map to the game, contaminated, which the developer has been teasing. The map will indeed arrive in the first part of the season, and it’s going to do so alongside a new LTM that “introduces a new element of tactics. ” A second, “high-intensity map” will debut later into the season, alongside another LTM where players battle through an underground base, in darkness.

Diungkapkan bahwa the real meat of the blog post, however, covers the broader gameplay changes everyone will see once the new season kicks off. There’s a massive focus on player progression, especially when it concerns free-to-play Redsec players.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, challenges are being streamlined yet again, with more broad parameters that don’t require specific modes. Some, like dailies, will also allow for assists to count towards their criteria. Less restrictive challenges are welcome, but even more so is the faster battle pass progression.

Diungkapkan bahwa bf studios is changing the rate at which battle pass tokens are earned from career xp, and making it so they’re earnable by playing the game normally, and by completing weekly challenges. These changes should also help Redsec players, who will also benefit from faster career and weapon XP earn rates - across both battle royale, and Gauntlet. In general, the career experience should feel more rewarding, especially for earlier ranks.

Weapon balance and recoil are two areas that will continue to evolve in Battlefield 6, it seems, and Season 2 is specifically tackling recoil patterns to make them more consistent when you compensate for them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, movement is being adjusted with the season 2 patch, too, though thankfully it’s limited to general feel that touches areas like vaulting, ladder transitions, and acceleration curves. You should also see better continuity and consistency between animations and feel.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, audio is getting a pass with the upcoming patch, especially when it comes to footstep and interaction audio. This also extends to something the developer has been working on improving for a while, and it has to do with how the game decides which audio tracks to prioritise in busy situations.

Tomorrow, the full Battlefield 6 Season 2 trailer will be released, while a more detailed roadmap is expected by the end of this week.
